### Công thức địch theo wave

Đặt w=wave, d=difficulty. Scaling nền = `(1+0.1×(w−1))×(1+0.18d)×(1+0.07d²)`. HP từ source × scaling; boss thêm BossHealthMultiplier asset 0.55 × BossBulk(w) × 1.6; địch không boss thuộc nhánh behavior cao có bước ×0.9. Tất cả thêm CarnivalEnemyHealth ×1.1 × EndlessHealth, rồi late HP factor `(1+max(0,w−10)×0.055)` và EnemyHealth modifier. Specialist thêm HP ×1.6, thân ×1.2, radius ×1.15.

CarnivalEnemyHealth = `1.2×(1+(max(0,w−1)/12)^1.45)×(1+1.4×(max(0,w−4)/16)^1.4)`. BossBulk tăng tuyến tính 4.6→7.5 từ wave 4→20. CarnivalEnemySpeed = `1.08×(1+1.8×(1−exp(−max(0,w−1)×0.05)))`; boss thêm ×1.08. CarnivalEnemyDamage = `1.15×(1+min(3,max(0,w−3)×0.09))×(1+min(1.4,max(0,w−5)×0.07))`.

Nguồn contact/weapon damage cộng `w×0.35` rồi đi qua giới hạn theo loại boss/thường và late; nhân pressure `(0.62+0.095d)×CarnivalEnemyDamage×1.08×EndlessDamage`; boss thêm ×1.18. Có cap tốc độ đạn địch 2.4 tại nhánh compile chuẩn. Keeper/Last Customer/sự kiện có override riêng; không lấy một con số nguồn làm HP thực của mọi lần gặp.

Endless dùng HP thêm `1.16^min(200,max(0,w−19))`, damage thêm `1.075^min(200,max(0,w−19))`. Nhánh này chỉ chạy khi Endless=true, nên wave 20 normal không tự nhận hệ số Endless. Sau 200 bước số mũ hai hệ số này ngừng tăng, scaling nền vẫn tiếp tục.

### Affix, summon và áp lực phụ

| Affix | Tỉ trọng trong lần affix thành công | Nhánh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BlackSmoke | 35% | Khói / đường che và strike |
| BlueFlame | 25% | Lửa xanh / volley |
| RedFlame | 25% | Lửa đỏ / áp sát |
| Blackfire | 10% | Biến thể hỏa lực đen |
| TwinFlame | 5% | Hai nhịp lửa |

Từ wave 5, chance affix `min(24,8+wave−5)%`, tối đa 4 affixed enemies đồng thời. **Mã hiện hành có buff stat affix**: HP ×2.4, body ×1.3, radius ×1.25, speed ×1.08, contact/weapon damage ×1.45. Đây là điểm lệch với tài liệu K25 cũ từng nói không có hidden stat boost. Nội dung moveset và thời gian của từng biến thể nằm trong EnemyVariantCombat và EnemyInteractionRules ở phụ lục.

Specialist tối đa 3; concurrent windup đặc biệt tối đa 4. Summon tối đa 12, sống 12 giây, HP ×0.35, entrance 0.55 giây, không summon đệ quy/không affix/không rơi loot thường; vẫn có nhánh on-kill riêng. Ash remnants tối đa 24, sống 7 giây. Swarm tăng áp lực ×1→3 từ wave 3→12, batch crest tối đa 36, chu kỳ 12 giây có nhịp nghỉ. Mỗi 3 swarm kills trả một payout bằng GoldPerKill của trận, đã qua scaling vàng theo wave.

### Sự kiện giữa wave và đồ chơi đấu trường

Wave lẻ không boss từ wave 5 có thể có spectacle, khởi động khoảng 40% thời gian wave, tổng cửa sổ 10 giây và báo trước 2 giây: PaperParade (tối đa 12 xu 1 vàng, hazard di động damage 5 với giới hạn HP theo rule); GildedTrap (rương giá trị 10, vùng nguy hiểm ngắt nhịp damage 4); WanderingEclipse (tối đa 8 thưởng xu 2, damage 2). Các trường này vẫn có kiểm tra mục tiêu, cooldown và trần sát thương, không phải ép người chơi làm thử thách parkour.

Đồ chơi ArenaToyKind: StageBell, ToyCart, InkBottle, HangingHammer, SleepMirror, FloorMusicBox. Trạng thái Charging→Warning→Rolling→Cooldown, báo trước cơ sở 1.2 giây, cooldown 5 giây, roll 0.8 giây. Chúng tác động combat bằng vùng/va chạm và phản ứng lên hero/địch theo simulation. Props nền có neo chân và collision theo loại, không phải toàn bộ vật vẽ đều là vật tương tác.

<a id="bosses"></a>

## 14. Toàn bộ boss và bộ phận

Boss thường vào wave chia hết cho 4; catalog có 10 loài, nhóm/rotation chọn theo seed và stage; wave 20 normal được thay bằng The Last Customer. Boss đã xuất hiện chưa chết thì có overtime, không kết thúc cứng ở giây 45. Thân boss thường hiện ×0.8 so với scale trước lượt cân bằng, các bộ phận có bù kích thước; boss miễn knockback kể cả kéo/đẩy của nhánh mới.

Damage lên bộ phận chọn theo vị trí hit: trục dọc nổi trội đi vào core, còn lại chọn trái/phải. Durability là tỷ lệ HP boss cho bộ phận, không phải một boss HP thứ hai độc lập cộng vào bảng. Phá Lash/Volley/Props/Pool/Pulse/Vacuum/Locomotion/Tempo/Rupture làm yếu đúng nhánh tương ứng; không xóa mọi đòn của boss cùng lúc.

Cả 12 boss thường/đặc biệt thêm bộ encore sáu hình đạn: spiral/weave 72, fan 24, vòng có khe 36, cross 28, hook 24, rain 11. Đây là tổng viên trong mẫu phát, có chia đợt và cap lượng đạn, không phải mọi mẫu bắn tất cả trong một frame. Windup 0.9 giây; cooldown cơ sở Keeper 4.2 giây, boss khác 5.2 giây; **mọi boss trong nhánh này** thêm 1 giây khi còn trên nửa máu. Đạn thường speed 1.65–2.2, life 7 giây, damage ×0.7 của nguồn mẫu. Boss thường lao ở mỗi encore thứ ba: báo trước 1.1 giây, travel 0.55 giây. Mẫu này có biến thể theo boss nhưng vẫn là bộ mẫu dùng chung; Keeper và Customer giữ các đòn chữ ký riêng.

**Outside Stage Keeper:** sau các lần transfer bằng Hand / CarpetTongue / KeyholeEye ở các mốc sau wave 4/8/12 (đi vào wave 5/9/13), nhánh boss ẩn có thể mở sau đủ 3 transfer. Chọn chiến đấu là rủi ro thật: thua kết thúc run, không có hard timer. HP nguồn ×20 trước các hệ số difficulty/wave/Endless của nhánh; thêm `(1+0.25d+0.08×max(0,w−13))`; damage vũ khí ×2.8, contact ×2.5; thân ×1.75. Điều kiện/ràng buộc chính xác nằm trong OutsideStageRun. Thắng được chọn một trong ba offer Rainbow từ pool 4 relic và 2 allies; tránh thưởng trùng đã sở hữu, bảo đảm có nhánh ally khi hero không solo. Có preview và mô tả trước Claim.

**The Last Customer:** boss cốt truyện wave 20, không cần thắng Keeper hay thấy hết event. Arena riêng 28×20, EnemyBudget=0, WaveDuration=0; HP có override source ×(1+0.2d) trong nhánh finale. Có sáu đòn chữ ký của LastCustomerCombat và encore mới. Đánh bại hắn đưa game tới Dawn/lựa chọn goodbye; Endless không bỏ qua lời kết đang chờ.

<a id="secrets"></a>

## 15. Cổng bí mật, hợp đồng và phần thưởng

Hệ thống gồm 8 phòng, mỗi phòng 3 lựa chọn. Cửa discovery có cơ hội bố trí ở các kỳ shop sau wave 3/7/11/15/19 theo seed riêng; hai cổng ứng viên, tối đa hai lượt thăm thông thường mỗi run, một lượt mỗi kỳ nghỉ, không lặp phòng đã thăm. Vào rồi rời mà không nhận deal vẫn tính lượt. Dead Letter có thể xếp Empty Theatre chưa thăm vào lượt thêm về sau. Các phòng tập trung giao dịch, lựa chọn và combat, không có thử thách di chuyển riêng.

Wave và stock shop cũ được giữ khi trở về. Trận event không trả thu nhập/loot thường; HP đã chi vẫn bị trừ, chết kết thúc run. Một hợp đồng đang hoạt động tại một thời điểm; đếm tiến độ bằng chiến thắng wave thường, không farm bằng event. Chặng cuối vẫn hoàn tất hợp đồng theo rule mà không tạo một khoản thu nhập của wave không tồn tại. Journal lưu tối đa 24 dòng; đã chọn rồi không lấy phần thưởng khác của cùng lượt.

<a id="story"></a>

## 16. Cốt truyện và toàn bộ kết thúc — SPOILER

### Tiền đề và ý nghĩa

Cửa tiệm không muốn đóng cửa vì sợ bị quên. Đồ chơi, người chủ tiệm và đoàn bạn nhỏ nằm trong một giấc mơ đang tìm cách giữ lại sự ấm áp của mình. Càng tiến xa, môi trường càng biểu lộ một cơ thể: vân gỗ như nhịp thở, mặt kính như mí mắt, thảm như lưỡi, cánh tay nâng lối đi. Keeper thuộc về nơi đang mơ này; The Last Customer là kẻ muốn sở hữu toàn bộ giấc mơ bằng hợp đồng và hóa đơn.

Chủ đề chính là khác biệt giữa giữ gìn và chiếm hữu, giữa thuộc về nhau và bị mua, giữa tạm biệt và quên lãng. Các căn phòng ẩn thêm bằng chứng cho việc bên ngoài vẫn tồn tại: một người bạn được cứu, một lá thư gửi đi, một lời hứa trả xong. Chúng thay đổi ký ức/lời nói và lời kết, không phải điều kiện bắt buộc để người chơi được kết thúc chiến dịch.

| Depth | Wave | Diễn biến hiện hành |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 1–4 | Tiệm ấm, trà và chuông; ghế trống và hóa đơn chưa có giá là dấu gợi đầu |
| 1 | 5–8 | Đường ngoài im, bóng phản chiếu sai; đồ vật bắt đầu nhớ người chơi |
| 2 | 9–12 | Kệ thở, giấy nhớ tên, kính lộ mắt; từ wave 11 có art sàn/mắt ác mộng |
| 3 | 13–16 | Tiệm nhận ra cơ thể của mình; tay/lưỡi/mắt và ký ức sở hữu lộ rõ |
| 4 | 17–20 | Ghế cuối đã có người ngồi; Customer định giá mọi thứ; hướng tới bình minh |

Depth = clamp((wave−1)/4,0,4) theo chia nguyên; tăng theo wave, không theo bộ đếm thời gian chơi riêng và không có một thanh Sanity tiêu hao. Wave 19 có khoảng lặng mở đầu shop khoảng 4 giây trong presentation, vẫn cho điều khiển. Vật mốc từ sự kiện giữ hình dạng quen thuộc giữa biến dạng; props không bị làm trong suốt hàng loạt. Nhạc đổi lớp theo depth nhưng không biến thành cơ chế đánh đúng beat.

### Cao trào và lựa chọn

Sau Last Customer, hợp đồng vỡ; dưới mặt nạ là một người giữ hóa đơn không có tên. Đoàn bạn không phải thứ hắn có quyền mua. Chủ tiệm nhận ra rằng mở cửa mãi không phải cách duy nhất để được nhớ. Người chơi chọn **Close the shop** hoặc **Leave a light**. Cả hai là kết thúc bình minh thực, không chia thành good/bad dựa việc ép hoàn thành bí mật. Leave a light thêm lời hẹn/afterword; không đồng nghĩa có Chapter 2 chơi được trong bản hiện tại.

### Toàn văn các trang kết thúc đã xuất từ runtime

#### CloseShop — không các ký ức tùy chọn trên

**Trang 1**

> THE RECEIPT ENDS HERE
> The Customer's contract breaks. His own name is still missing, but he releases the names he took.
> From the empty chair, the One Who Stays asks for the old promise. You do not renew it. The door opens anyway.

**Trang 2**

> THE SHOPKEEPER
> I delayed the directions because I feared being forgotten. I called it shelter.
> The key is yours. You do not have to forgive me to use it.
> The letter, the lock and the visitor's register stay in your hands. Someone did come.
> The unsent letter is yours to deliver, or keep. Nobody chooses for you.

**Trang 3**

> MORNING, TOGETHER
> Your companions cross as living creatures, each carrying a life beyond this crossing.
> There are other lives still waiting beyond the rooms you visited.
> Beyond the shop, the Keeper's unanswered door remains a crossing for another day. The One Who Stays remains by the chair. It cannot choose for you.
> Morning is real. Nobody is erased.

**Trang 4**

> A PLACE WITHOUT A PRICE
> You ask: 'Does anyone still need me to do something?'
> A chair is pulled closer. 'Sit here a while.'
> The new tune misses a beat. Someone waits, and you start together.
> The shop closes. You do not have to return to prove you remember.

Bốn bản trên ghép hai lựa chọn farewell với hai bộ ký ức đại diện. Các điều kiện LetterSent, RescuedToy và KeeperCompleted là độc lập; trong run thật chúng có thể trộn từng câu. Nếu không có companion, câu mở cửa đổi sang nhân vật tự đẩy cửa. Hàm Ending đầy đủ ở phụ lục giữ mọi nhánh ghép để reviewer không hiểu rằng chỉ tồn tại bốn trạng thái cứng.

## 17. Toàn bộ 104 achievement nhật ký

<a id="presentation"></a>

## 18. Mỹ thuật, animation và khả năng đọc trận

Định hướng hiện tại là đồ chơi/cửa tiệm đêm có chất liệu Paper, Metal, Wax, Fabric, Glass, Wood; đi dần từ ấm áp sang cơ thể ác mộng. Hero/ally/enemy có pose, weapon motion, phản ứng và body puppet theo nguồn. 21 hero mới có pose idle/walk/windup/release và trạng thái biểu cảm riêng; 19 companion bổ sung có pose di chuyển/tấn công. Điều này không đồng nghĩa toàn bộ 10 hero cũ đã được vẽ lại.

Animation dùng authored frames cộng diễn xuất bằng code, pose windup/release, recoil/weapon tilt, idle/walk và thay biểu cảm. Foot grounding lấy vùng mực sprite để neo chân và đặt bóng tiếp xúc; hàng hóa bám mặt đỡ, vật sàn bỏ bob/rock toàn thân. Merchant vẫn có diễn xuất nhưng chân bám nền. Door có 4 pose, mở theo khoảng gần và không còn bị lifecycle quầy ghi đè sprite/transform.

Rarity shop hiện dùng 16 frame ánh sáng vẽ riêng xanh/tím/vàng/cầu vồng, ánh nền rộng và motes. Aura đi theo món hàng khi focus/reroll/rời quầy; companion mua xong không mang aura shop vào trận. Rương có quầng vàng và glint; hỗ trợ reduced flashes/effects. Sao 2/3 chỉ tăng thân ×1.35/×1.8, bỏ phụ kiện đính lên người. Hình thái build vẫn có choreography/đạn/VFX riêng; mô tả silhouette trong data còn là dấu vết thiết kế cũ.

Lỗi chớp/mất bộ phận khi ally đánh đã được sửa ở BodyPuppet: rect UV của frame được cập nhật đúng cho các mảng thân thay vì sao chép nhầm vùng vật liệu. Các báo cáo đã lưu bao phủ 66 loài ×3 sao và 31 hero qua 12 trạng thái, cả thường/giảm hiệu ứng. Đây là bằng chứng của lượt kiểm tra đó; hồ sơ xuất lần này không chạy lại toàn bộ QA đồ họa và không chứng minh mọi map/góc nhìn đã được duyệt tay.

Môi trường nightmare thêm sàn, mắt và art rìa từ wave 11; giữ alpha của props và khoảng chiến đấu ở giữa. Finale có dàn cảnh riêng, phần hậu cảnh ở rìa tránh che vùng né. VFX, projectile và audio có budget/cooldown để trận đông không phát vô hạn sự kiện; hiệu năng thực tế vẫn cần đo trên cấu hình reviewer mục tiêu.

## 19. Toàn bộ nhạc và âm thanh

Runtime manifest có **15 bài**, mỗi bài **4 stem** (tổng 60); **206 cue** ngoài nhạc với **582 đường clip**. Bộ nhạc hiện là Toybox revision 4: mỗi bài có score, hòa âm, bass, trống, phrase và form riêng. Foley revision 5 tổng hợp mới toàn bộ clip ngoài nhạc; không dùng các file studio khác theme làm nguồn.

| `menu_curtain` — Midnight Overture — The Shop Wakes | A chiming six-beat question with a delayed piano reply; warm suspended harmony opens into a singing celesta refrain. | 112 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 85.71s |
| `select_dressing` — Roll Call — Pocket-Sized Heroes | A dotted toy-trumpet salute answered by clipped clarinet; snare rudiments and two-beat tuba bass make a confident miniature parade. | 120 BPM · 4/4 · 24 bars · 48.00s |
| `combat_toys` — Wind-Up Parade — Ratchet Riot | A low toy-piano riff in a 3+3+2 accent, springy octave bass and answering brass; the B theme opens into a broad minor-key melody. | 132 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 72.73s |
| `combat_spoons` — Cutlery Brigade — Drawer Funk | Muted-trumpet funk built around a falling sixth, syncopated slap bass and offbeat spoon knocks; a clavinet solo makes room between the hooks. | 126 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 68.57s |
| `combat_clockwork` — Gearworks — Escapement | A clipped square lead with rests on the downbeat; a two-bar machine groove and chromatic B7 turnaround, contrasted with a longer glassy refrain. | 142 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 67.61s |
| `combat_carousel` — Carousel Chase — Crooked Horses | A wheeling accordion melody over walking bass; clarinet takes an eight-bar detour through a diminished chord before the carnival tune returns. | 138 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 62.61s |
| `combat_overtime` — Midnight Stampede — Porcelain Rush | A bell riff that leaps up a ninth then tumbles into a fast two-step break; long string answers and a half-time tom passage create pressure without a repeated march. | 172 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 55.81s |
| `combat_lasttrain` — Toy Train Express — No More Stops | A train-flute pickup rising through a minor sixth over rolling jungle drums; plucked strings reply in a lower register while the train keeps moving. | 166 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 57.83s |
| `boss_ringmaster` — The Ringmaster — Velvet & Iron | An organ ostinato in descending half-steps answered by low brass; heavy half-time toms turn into a rock charge and a rising theatrical second subject. | 150 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 64.00s |
| `boss_clown` — Jack-in-the-Box — Smile with Teeth | A lopsided descending music-box hook with delayed spring accents, deep half-time 808 and bass clarinet taunts; a short crooked waltz-like phrase interrupts the grin. | 148 BPM · 4/4 · 40 bars · 64.86s |
| `shop_gold` — Ka-Ching Swing — Coins on the Counter | A cheeky honky-tonk pickup, falling chromatic approach notes and a muted-trumpet reply over a walking jazz bass; an eight-bar piano solo opens the till. | 118 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 73.22s |
| `shop_layaway` — Window Shopping — After-Hours Neon | A relaxed city-pop chorus with a vocal-shaped electric-piano melody, suspended guitar voicings and a warm descending bass; marimba takes a luminous middle eight. | 110 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 78.55s |
| `shop_dream` — The Dream Counter — A Waltz through Glass | A breathing three-quarter celesta waltz with an upward sixth, harp responses and a chromatic minor-subdominant passage; no pop backbeat or shared bass riff. | 132 BPM · 3/4 · 36 bars · 49.09s |
| `endless_neverclose` — Open All Night — Lights on the Roof | A sustained supersaw chorus shaped around repeated high F notes and a wide answering leap; piano offbeats and octave disco bass drive a new bright dance theme. | 128 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 67.50s |
| `endless_encore` — One More Encore — Brass on the Barricade | A brass anthem with an anacrusis and a long held high D; live-rock drums and straight eighth guitar chords turn into a stomping half-time singalong before the final refrain. | 140 BPM · 4/4 · 36 bars · 61.71s |

### Nhạc thích ứng và mix

Bốn lớp base/rhythm/melody/intensity chạy đồng bộ DSP; đổi scene theo bar và crossfade. Độ đông combat và low-HP danger thay đổi trọng lượng stem. Depth nightmare giảm melody dần 1→0.5 và rhythm 1→0.85; dawn trả về trạng thái sáng. Pause/mất focus có xử lý dừng/khôi phục. Nhịp nhạc không khóa input và không tự thưởng crit do đánh đúng beat; cue `ui.encore.ready` là cue dự trữ, không chứng minh đã có một thanh Encore gameplay.

Sample rate 44.1 kHz; nhạc render master PCM24 và encode Vorbis chất lượng 8; SFX nguồn mono PCM16, peak thiết kế −3 dBFS, ambience khoảng −7 dBFS. Cue có gain riêng nên mức nghe thực còn qua bus/mix/ducking. Combat, UI, Foley, Voice, Ambience và Music được phân bus; danger ưu tiên sự kiện né đòn, cooldown/maxVoices hạn chế spam. Voice hiện là âm vô ngôn tổng hợp, không phải diễn viên đọc toàn bộ thoại.

### Nguồn và khả năng tái lập

Music soạn/render bằng code, nhạc cụ sampled dùng **GeneralUser GS 2.0.3** và percussion tổng hợp gốc. Foley dùng engine tổng hợp gốc, không sample/soundfont/studio đầu vào; voice là tổng hợp không lời. Audio fallback cũ còn credit riêng (các bộ Kenney CC0/K8) nếu thư viện mới thiếu. Các tuyên bố provenance cũ về bộ v2 hoàn toàn không sample không được áp sang nhạc Toybox dùng GeneralUser GS. Hồ sơ này giữ nguyên license và manifest hash ở phụ lục, không tự xác nhận quyền phát hành mọi asset khác của toàn game.

<a id="review-notes"></a>

## 20. Giới hạn hiện tại và gợi ý kiểm tra review

| Điểm cần biết | Tình trạng thực tế / tác động khi review |
| --- | --- |
| Số nội dung | 31 hero, 66 ally, 170 item, 29 bond, 25 recipe; một số doc cũ ghi số khác |
| Description và số hiệu lực | Đã chuẩn hóa 66 companion và 170 item theo cơ chế hiện có; giữ metadata legacy để đối chiếu. UI dùng EffectiveModifiers, tier và số bản sở hữu. Giới hạn chiến đấu vẫn có thể giảm lợi ích stat |
| Silhouette build | Data còn mô tả phụ kiện nhưng code presentation hiện bỏ phụ kiện; đánh giá choreography và VFX thực |
| Affix stat | Có buff HP/damage/speed hiện hành; tài liệu cũ nói không buff là lỗi thời |
| 45 giây | Nhịp wave thường; boss overtime, Keeper/finale và sự kiện có ngoại lệ |
| Chất lượng/khác biệt nhạc | Có 15 score riêng và audit kỹ thuật; cần reviewer nghe thực, không coi độ khác MIDI là hài lòng người chơi |
| Boss moveset | 12 boss có encore chung có biến thể; không phải 12 bộ encore hoàn toàn độc lập |
| Bất tử ally | Đội hình xoay quanh nguồn damage/support/position, không có chiến thuật cứu ally khỏi chết trong bản hiện tại |
| Rarity và số lượng | Item tồn tại không bảo đảm xuất hiện trong mọi hero pool/shop; reward-only và cap vẫn áp dụng |
| Ngôn ngữ | Copy trong game chủ yếu tiếng Anh; hồ sơ tiếng Việt không phải gói localization |
| Thoại độc nhất | Có thoại hero và pool theo chất liệu/loài; chưa có bộ thoại dài riêng cho đủ 66 loài |
| Art và QA | Có frame/vẽ mới cho phần nội dung mở rộng; không đồng nghĩa vẽ lại toàn bộ art cũ hoặc duyệt thủ công mọi góc map |
| Balance dài hạn | Các test dữ liệu và render không chứng minh economy/Endless luôn cân bằng hoặc mọi build đều thú vị |
| Phạm vi hồ sơ | Xuất bản working tree hiện tại; không thay gameplay, không tự coi tất cả check cũ là check mới của snapshot này |

Một lượt review hữu ích nên đi qua: một hero có đoàn quân và một hero solo/hấp thụ; build melee/ranged/collision và ít nhất hai morph khác hướng; mua/ghép ở 10–20 ally; một altar recipe; một secret combat và một hợp đồng; Keeper; Last Customer, hai farewell và Endless. Ghi cảm nhận về nhận diện đòn, sự chồng lấp VFX/audio, giá sau wave 8, cơ hội hoàn thành ghép và thời gian hạ boss. Đây là phạm vi trải nghiệm đề xuất cho review, không phải báo cáo đã chơi qua toàn bộ ở lần xuất này.

## 21. Phụ lục dữ liệu đầy đủ, cấu hình và lời thoại

Phần tra cứu phía trên dùng số làm tròn ngắn để dễ đọc. Phần dưới giữ giá trị float xuất round-trip từ Unity, đầy đủ các trường public của asset, cả partial class, tham chiếu sprite/motion/acting, cấu hình chưa override và enum/constant. Tham chiếu asset ở đây là định danh xuất xứ, không phải tệp bắt buộc phải mở thêm để đọc hồ sơ. Chuỗi thoại có escape `\n` thuộc dữ liệu gốc, không phải lỗi mất dòng của hồ sơ.

"WaitingChapters":[
{"Wave":1,"Title":"THE WAITING REALM","Evidence":"A chair remembered before the room.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["You wake with your hand raised to knock. There is no door behind you. Beyond the counter, corridors stretch between a railway platform, a dining room and a house whose windows face inward.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'This is the Waiting Realm. Places arrive here when someone keeps waiting after everybody else has gone.'\n\nYou remember being small, sitting beside an empty chair. You used to tell it about your day because it never interrupted. One night it answered: 'Would you like me to sit closer?'","THE SHOPKEEPER: 'You grew up. The voice learned to grow with you. It found this crossing through a promise you made before you understood promises.'\n\nA receipt in your handwriting reads: I WILL WAIT IF YOU WILL STAY. The ink is fresh. The date is older than your adult name.\n\nThe creature beside the stove introduces themself before offering to travel with you. These inhabitants have homes, histories and people of their own. You are a visitor, not their maker.","Find the Last Customer at the end of the crossing and break the contract that claims your name. Find out who keeps renewing it. Leave together by choice.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'Food, equipment, shelter: those have prices. A travelling companion does not. The fare buys their passage through my gate, never ownership of them.'\n\nSomething on the empty chair leans closer. The seat does not bend."]},
{"Wave":4,"Title":"A PLACE SET FOR SOMEONE ELSE","Evidence":"Two cups; a third chair carved with a stranger's name.","Image":"WaitingRoom","Pages":["A table waits where the corridor used to end. There is a warm bowl for you and a smaller bowl for somebody you have never met. A name has been scratched into the spare chair. The letters match the old marks beneath the counter.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'The room was expecting them before it expected you.'\n\nYou had believed this place began with your loneliness. The old scratches prove it was already here.","The voice you knew as a child speaks from the unoccupied place: 'I gave you a home when nobody came.'\n\nYou ask whose name is on the other chair.\n\n'I learned what you needed. Is that not enough?'\n\nYou pull out the chair for a companion. The room becomes colder. Your companion's small light stays warm. The voice has never offered them a bowl.","On the underside of the table is another message, cut by a different hand: WHEN A PLACE PROMISES NEVER TO LET YOU GO, ASK WHETHER YOU CAN LEAVE.\n\nYou take a rubbing, not a memory. It cannot change its words while you sleep.\n\nThe creature beside you tells you where they were born. For the first time, the room must listen to a story that does not belong to it."]},
{"Wave":6,"Title":"THE TELEPHONE THAT BREATHES","Evidence":"A disconnected telephone rings only when someone is listening.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["The telephone at the station has no wire. On the first call, you hear breathing. On the second, a chair scrapes against the floor in a room you cannot see. You nearly apologise for taking too long to answer.\n\nOn the third call a voice asks, quite ordinarily: 'Have you eaten today?'\n\nYou cannot remember the last time the question was asked without a favour waiting behind it.","You ask who is speaking. The breathing continues, then stops when a companion enters. The receiver has become cold enough to hurt.\n\nYour companion sets food beside you and does not repeat the question. The voice offers perfect attention while a real person makes space for an answer.\n\nYou leave the receiver on the table. For several steps it repeats your breathing rather than its own. You have learned that knowing your needs does not give someone ownership of the answer."]},
{"Wave":8,"Title":"THE SONG BEFORE YOUR BIRTH","Evidence":"An old recording contains the same private lullaby.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["In the abandoned station, a recording plays the lullaby the voice said it made for you. The cylinder is dated decades before you were born. Other names follow the same melody. Some of the names have been scratched away.\n\nThe destinations on the board read: WHEN THEY RETURN. WHEN YOU ARE GOOD ENOUGH. WHEN YOU STOP ASKING. No arrival time changes.","A resident remembers the missing last verse: 'When the morning finds the window, put your own feet on the floor.'\n\nThe voice always stopped before those words.\n\nTHE ONE WHO STAYS: 'Morning frightened you. I removed the part that hurt.'\n\nThe recording keeps playing. The evidence does not ask you to decide whether your childhood hurt was real. It asks who used that hurt to keep the door shut.","The Keeper's old boundary notice survives behind the timetable: HOLD THE CROSSING OPEN UNTIL EVERY TRAVELLER HAS CHOSEN. Someone has overwritten OPEN with CLOSED.\n\nThe Keeper was a protector before becoming a jailer. The Last Customer bought claims at this station long after the Waiting Realm existed. Neither of them is the voice.\n\nBeyond the platform, the street lamps go out one at a time. Your own light is enough to take the next step. The others bring theirs because they choose to."]},
{"Wave":10,"Title":"THE REFLECTION THAT STAYED","Evidence":"A mirror keeps one tear after its witness has left.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["The corridor mirror shows a companion weeping. Their body has no eyes that could make those tears. Beside them, your reflection keeps smiling after your face has stopped.\n\nYou move out of the frame. The smile stays. Something inside the glass whispers: 'This is the version they prefer.'\n\nYou had spent years arranging a face before opening a door. The mirror has learned that habit too well.","Your companion does not explain what their reflection feels. They put a hand against the frame, then choose to take it away.\n\n'It can remember something I have not understood yet. It still cannot speak for me.'\n\nYou cover the smiling part with paper. You leave the tear visible. Some evidence needs time; nobody has to surrender their present voice to an image of their past."]},
{"Wave":12,"Title":"SOMEONE DID COME","Evidence":"A reopened envelope and tool marks on the outside of the lock.","Image":"WaitingRoom","Pages":["The dead-letter cabinet contains an envelope with your childhood handwriting. You remember writing it. You do not remember a reply.\n\nThe reply is inside, opened and sewn shut again: 'I am coming on Thursday. Wait by the front door. You do not need to bring anything.'\n\nA companion holds the paper while you read. There is no demand to be brave, useful or grateful before they will keep holding it.","The lock beside the cabinet has been forced from the outside. A visitor's mark records a Thursday arrival. Three pieces agree: the letter, the lock and the dated register.\n\nSomeone came to collect you. The One Who Stays knew. It did not open the door.\n\nYou cannot remember the visitor's face clearly. That uncertainty cannot erase what their hands tried to do.","THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They would have disappointed you again. I stayed every night.'\n\nYOU: 'You kept their answer from me.'\n\n'I knew how much it would hurt if you chose them.'\n\nThere is real fear in its voice. There is also a choice it made for you. You can acknowledge both without calling the locked door love.\n\nYou keep the letter in the journal. Your companions stay nearby without asking what you will do for them in return."]},
{"Wave":14,"Title":"ONE MORE SET OF FOOTSTEPS","Evidence":"Footprints stop at the threshold; the sound crosses it alone.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["You stop walking. Your companions stop with you. One more set of footsteps continues down the hall, wearing the rhythm you had as a child. They halt outside a door with your old height marked on it.\n\nA small voice says: 'If I am quiet enough, they will come back.'\n\nThe handle turns inward. The room beyond is empty, but somebody has recently warmed the chair.","The voice asks you to wait until the person behind the door is ready. There is always one more minute. The mark on the wall grows lower while you watch.\n\nYou leave a note: YOU WERE ALLOWED TO ASK FOR SOMEONE. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO LEAVE THIS CHAIR.\n\nYou do not have to prove the small voice is yours before treating it kindly. You and your companions walk on. The extra footsteps stay at the door instead of following."]},
{"Wave":16,"Title":"THE PERFECT ROOM","Evidence":"One bed, one cup, one chair. No room for anyone else.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["A door opens into a room arranged exactly as you once wished: warm sheets, a cup at the right temperature, a voice that knows when to stop talking. Every object has room for one person. The passage narrows when your companions approach.\n\nTHE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They can wait outside. You have done enough for them.'\n\nBehind you, someone offers their coat to a shivering companion. They do not notice you watching.","You move the chair away from the bed to make space. The room puts it back. You open the window. The wall remembers a different window, one that cannot open.\n\nIts care is precise. It will not survive being refused.\n\nYOU: 'If I say no, will you still let me go?'\n\nThe voice answers with the lullaby instead. The empty seat casts a standing shadow.","THE SHOPKEEPER: 'I delayed your directions too. I called it shelter. I was afraid you would never come back.'\n\nThey put the exit key on the floor and step away from it. 'You do not have to forgive me to use this.'\n\nThe Keeper reaches toward the frame, then opens its hand. Protection has become something it can offer without closing its fingers.\n\nYou leave the perfect room untidy. There is space behind the chair now."]},
{"Wave":19,"Title":"AN UNFINISHED NAME","Evidence":"The Customer's oldest receipt names him as the first item sold.","Image":"WaitingRoom","Pages":["The Last Customer's ledger begins with a sale of one name. His own. Every later purchase is an attempt to buy enough memories to remember somebody he lost. The names overlap until he cannot tell which grief was his.\n\nHe has hurt the people whose memories he took. His loss explains the hunger; it does not make their lives his property.","THE LAST CUSTOMER: 'If I return everything, there will be nothing left of me.'\n\nA courier places an empty envelope beside the ledger. 'Then there can be something you have not stolen.'\n\nHe does not take it yet. Beyond his counter, the final door is covered in receipts. Your childhood promise is pinned in the middle. He guards the claims. Something older keeps renewing yours.","The lamps beyond your party no longer reach a horizon. Red glints approach from real moving bodies. Closer, those bodies become visible before they can strike. Your companions' lights join without swallowing the dark.\n\nYou do not need to earn a crowd to deserve a way out. Even alone, you carry enough light to see your next step.\n\nAt the last chair, the voice waits for you to speak the promise again."]},
{"Wave":20,"Title":"THE PROMISE YOU DO NOT RENEW","Evidence":"The contract requires a willing promise. It cannot manufacture consent.","Image":"WithheldDawn","Pages":["THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'I was there when you cried quietly so nobody would be angry. I learned every version of you. Tell me you will stay, and there will never be an empty chair again.'\n\nYOU: 'You were there. You also hid the letter.'\n\n'If you leave, what am I for?'\n\nFor a moment it sounds as young as you were. The room waits for you to make yourself responsible for its fear.","YOU: 'I cannot be the reason you are allowed to exist. You cannot be the reason I am not allowed to leave.'\n\nThe voice tries your childhood name. Then your adult name. Neither becomes a command.\n\nYou do not renew the promise. The seal dries. The One Who Stays can hold walls and doors, but it cannot make a chosen farewell into an agreement to remain.\n\nThe Customer tears the empty envelope in his hand. He still has a choice. So do you.","The entity recedes to the empty chair. It is not the Customer, and defeating him will not prove you never needed care. His contract is the last lock still fastened to this crossing.\n\nBreak it. Afterward, choose whether to close the shop or leave a guiding lamp for other travellers. Both choices lead to a real morning. Neither requires forgiveness or another promise.\n\nYour companions take their places. None of them asks you to fight so they will love you."]}
],
"WaitingArrivals":{"LanternKnight":"You dreamed of holding a lamp for the person who was meant to come home. Here, your old watch has become armour. You may put the lamp down without losing your place.","Postmaster":"You remember sorting other people's replies while checking an empty compartment of your own. The dream has given you a satchel that can finally carry your unanswered question.","DrowsySeer":"You learned to read a room before asking for anything. In sleep, that vigilance became sight beyond its walls. It still cannot tell you what you are allowed to want.","RootOracle":"You tended a garden because growing things answered patient care. In this crossing, roots have followed you underground. A home can be tended without becoming somewhere you cannot leave.","LoneJelly":"You learned to hold many borrowed voices in a body that rarely made its own needs heard. This shape can change without surrendering the person who chooses the change.","GlassDice":"You called every disappointment bad luck because that explanation hurt less than asking why nobody came. The dream gave chance a body. Your next choice need not be a throw.","TideSinger":"You sang through the walls hoping somebody would answer from the next room. Here, water carries every note further than you intended. You are learning which answers you want to follow.","CometRunner":"You ran errands quickly, hoping to return before a door closed. Sleep made that urgency a comet's tail. Somebody may wait for you without a deadline attached.","MirrorKeeper":"You rehearsed a pleasant face before every reunion. The mirror remembers the rehearsals. This body can keep a crack without making it somebody else's reassurance.","TreasureAcorn":"You stored small presents for a visit that kept moving to another day. Your dream carries a whole treasury. A gift does not have to purchase the next visit.","VerdantMatron":"You learned to shelter smaller lives before anyone offered shelter to you. The garden shape is a choice you still love. Rest does not make you a failed guardian.","CopperCauldron":"You cooked enough for a household that rarely sat down together. The dream kept the warmth and made it portable. You have a seat at the meal even when the pot is empty.","ChinaMarionette":"You learned careful movements in a house where mistakes seemed louder than kindness. This porcelain form keeps the marks of surviving them. Nobody here has the right to pull your strings.","SoapSkater":"You made difficult rooms laugh so their silences would stop hurting. Sleep turned escape into a graceful slide. You may stop moving without having to entertain the people beside you.","VelvetRegent":"You dreamed a court where nobody could overlook a person at its centre. The crown gives that longing a shape. It cannot substitute for somebody choosing to sit beside you.","ButtonCavalier":"You wore courage like a borrowed coat to get through the front door. Here the coat became armour. The frightened person inside it is allowed to ask for cover.","NightMaw":"You swallowed needs before anyone could call them too much. The dream has made hunger visible. Having a need does not make you a monster, and satisfying it need not consume somebody else.","ThornTreasurer":"You saved coins for emergencies rather than risk needing help. The dream guards every coin with a thorn. You can protect a future while allowing someone to share its cost.","CitrusMarshal":"You organised every arrival so nobody would be left uncollected. This body carries the sound of a whole march. You are allowed to follow another person's lead for a while.","IvorySovereign":"You counted a small allowance of affection as though careful spending could make it last. Sleep made the count a courtly law. A person is not a resource the household may use up.","PetalCitadel":"You imagined walls that could keep danger out without keeping visitors away. The dream grew flowers through those walls. Their gates can open from the inside.","PatchworkHost":"You gathered different people into a home that kept making room. Your own chair was the one you forgot to add. This patched shape has space for you as well.","ArchiveCurator":"You kept dates and scraps because other people remembered the same days differently. In sleep the archive became a body. Evidence may protect your voice without making every memory a trial.","PennyBroker":"You made every favour an exact exchange to avoid owing a departure to anyone. The dream gave you a broker's ledger. Something freely given can remain free after you accept it.","StormFencer":"You listened for changing footsteps before a room became unsafe. Here that attention hears storms in wires. Quiet can become a place to rest rather than a warning you missed.","TinVirtuoso":"You practised a performance until applause felt like proof of belonging. The dream gave the rhythm a metal heart. Someone can stay through a missed beat.","MoonProwler":"You learned night routes through a house that felt different after dark. Sleep gave those steps a moonlit form. Knowing how to leave can make a chosen return possible.","SupperMortar":"You made abundance into a promise that no visitor would go hungry. The dream turned a kitchen into a fortress. You may ask a guest to help without making welcome conditional.","LanternWeaver":"You stitched paths between places where promises had frayed. Sleep made the thread luminous. Another traveller can hold an end without being bound to your wrist.","HourglassStag":"You counted the minutes until somebody would have time for you. This antlered shape carries the count. A shared hour is not a payment for all the hours you waited.","RainArchivist":"You recorded rain against a window while waiting for a familiar step. The dream let you write on water. This crossing can add a new page without washing the old ones away."},
"WaitingLives":{"TeapotPilgrim":{"Origin":"Born above the station kitchens, they fed travellers through a winter with no departures. Every cup was counted; nobody knew whether they had eaten. They want a table where the last person serving is also given a seat.","Early":"The pilgrim pours for everyone and hides their own empty cup. Asked what they need, they list chores. You leave a place at the table without giving it a task. They stand beside it a long time before sitting.","Middle":"The pilgrim pours for everyone and hides their own empty cup. Asked what they need, they list chores. You leave a place at the table without giving it a task. They stand beside it a long time before sitting.\n\nThey miss a serving bell while resting. You return with two cups. 'I have not earned that one,' they say. Nobody takes it away. Outside, the room repeats the bell. They let somebody else answer.","Late":"The pilgrim pours for everyone and hides their own empty cup. Asked what they need, they list chores. You leave a place at the table without giving it a task. They stand beside it a long time before sitting.\n\nThey miss a serving bell while resting. You return with two cups. 'I have not earned that one,' they say. Nobody takes it away. Outside, the room repeats the bell. They let somebody else answer.\n\nAt the last rest, they ask for tea before offering yours. A companion brings it. 'I still like caring for people. I want to be here when I am tired too.' The reserved chair is no longer empty."},"CandleSnail":{"Origin":"They carried their village's ember through a flood. "Endings":[
{"Choice":"CloseShop","OptionalMemories":false,"Pages":["THE RECEIPT ENDS HERE\nThe Customer's contract breaks. His own name is still missing, but he releases the names he took.\nFrom the empty chair, the One Who Stays asks for the old promise. You do not renew it. The door opens anyway.","THE SHOPKEEPER\nI delayed the directions because I feared being forgotten. I called it shelter.\nThe key is yours. You do not have to forgive me to use it.\nThe letter, the lock and the visitor's register stay in your hands. Someone did come.\nThe unsent letter is yours to deliver, or keep. Nobody chooses for you.","MORNING, TOGETHER\nYour companions cross as living creatures, each carrying a life beyond this crossing.\nThere are other lives still waiting beyond the rooms you visited.\nBeyond the shop, the Keeper's unanswered door remains a crossing for another day. The One Who Stays remains by the chair. It cannot choose for you.\nMorning is real. Nobody is erased.","A PLACE WITHOUT A PRICE\nYou ask: 'Does anyone still need me to do something?'\nA chair is pulled closer. 'Sit here a while.'\nThe new tune misses a beat. Someone waits, and you start together.\nThe shop closes. You do not have to return to prove you remember."]},
{"Choice":"CloseShop","OptionalMemories":true,"Pages":["THE RECEIPT ENDS HERE\nThe Customer's contract breaks. "EventMemories":[
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":0,"Text":"The drawer is quiet now. Someone inside it went home with you."},
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":1,"Text":"The letter in the cabinet finally has someone to carry it."},
{"Kind":"LostProperty","Choice":2,"Text":"You took its heart gently. The cabinet remembers."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":0,"Text":"That returning thread knows the way back to your hand."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":1,"Text":"The tailor left a second heartbeat inside your swing."},
{"Kind":"ImpossibleTailor","Choice":2,"Text":"A little shelter, stitched into something you chose to keep."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":0,"Text":"Your reflection blinked first. You did not become it."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":1,"Text":"Your shadow is borrowed, not sold. We remember the difference."},
{"Kind":"Understudy","Choice":2,"Text":"You left the mirror without fighting yourself. That was allowed."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":0,"Text":"That ticket has a destination where the customer cannot follow."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":1,"Text":"The contraband thread was not on his inventory."},
{"Kind":"ContrabandTrain","Choice":2,"Text":"You faced the collector. This visitor is not your first."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":0,"Text":"The thirteenth hour was borrowed. Dawn is not."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":1,"Text":"A debt can be repaid. You are not collateral."},
{"Kind":"ThirteenthHour","Choice":2,"Text":"What you trusted to the bank still carries your name, not his."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":0,"Text":"The garden kept one small light awake for you."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":1,"Text":"You settled a promise beneath the sleeping lamp."},
{"Kind":"SleepingGarden","Choice":2,"Text":"A dream friend is still a friend, even after visiting hours."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":0,"Text":"The paper audience learned to applaud instead of whisper."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":1,"Text":"You stood your ground when the leading actor stepped forward."},
{"Kind":"EmptyTheatre","Choice":2,"Text":"Two actors shared a stage. Neither could write your ending."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":0,"Text":"Your parcel has an address beyond these shelves."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":1,"Text":"Someone carries your letter close to their weapon."},
{"Kind":"DeadLetters","Choice":2,"Text":"Your invitation reached the other side of the curtain."}
],
"NarrativeTables":{"Layers":[["Welcome! The little bell says you may stay.","Three fresh miracles. Please mind their teeth.","That one would suit your peculiar little family.","No charge for looking. The chair is free, too.","Sold! Take good care of that small impossibility.","It stopped trembling when you chose it.","Just a drop. We do not sell your last heartbeat.","Keep enough blood to get everyone home.","No hurry. A small purse still belongs to a person.","Come back with coins, not apologies.","New stock! The old stock has gone for a nap.","Close your eyes. No, not all of them.","Listen. Three little bells have found one voice.","A family resemblance! Bigger shoes this time.","Follow the warm lights. ## 22. Phụ lục code công thức thực thi và nguồn gốc

Các công thức chuyên biệt về tài năng, proc, item tradeoff và thời gian tấn công có nhiều nhánh hơn một bảng stat. Dưới đây là **bản sao nội dung mã tại thời điểm xuất**, giữ nguyên để reviewer kỹ thuật tra cứu mọi hệ số và thứ tự áp dụng trong chính file này. Tên file và SHA-256 dùng định vị/kiểm tra xuất xứ. Không cần checkout repo để đọc. Các tên Kxx/October/Carnival là tên lớp tích hợp, không phải mode sản phẩm hiển thị cho người chơi.

<a id="mien-cho-shared-light"></a>

## Miền Chờ: cốt truyện và ánh sáng đồng hành

10 mốc cố định / 27 trang trong chiến dịch 20 wave; 31 đoạn nhập cảnh, 66 tiểu sử và 6 tuyến companion theo chặng. Journal ở shop bằng J, có pause, scroll và lưu acknowledgement. Các vignette là nội dung viết sẵn; chưa có ba chiến dịch riêng hoặc hệ quest phân nhánh cho mọi loài.
Ánh sáng world-space 256×192 với tối đa 16 nguồn: hero bán kính 6.4 và mỗi companion 3.4. Gộp nguồn theo giá trị lớn nhất, không cộng vô hạn. Địch xa có silhouette/mắt hoặc ember; trong vùng contact an toàn hoặc windup thì thân hiện rõ, boss giữ ít nhất 80%. High Readability và giảm hiệu ứng giữ ánh sáng thiết yếu. Hai ending đều là bình minh thật.
Act I now uses thirteen newly illustrated assets in the existing game's style: drawn lanterns in three damage states, chair, dining group, telephone, mirror, three story panels and three room backgrounds. Blender lamp meshes and render assets have been retired outside Assets. Unity light fields and black fog remain; levitation preserves floating, lean and fixed floor shadows without under-object smoke/wind. Three 2D rooms can be explored on foot; six optional companion routes store three binary responses each and contribute authored epilogues. Later acts remain deferred. Details: Docs/Mien_Cho_Painted_Art_Pass.md.
Journal now saves a separate page for every chapter and distinguishes read-later acknowledgement from last-page completion. Three optional in-world shop encounters appear after waves 4-5 (reserved table), 6-7 (disconnected phone) and 10-11 (delayed reflection of an actual party member). They pause with the world, never appear during combat and have no stat or currency reward. The current transparent sprites are newly illustrated; retired Blender sources are historical only.
### Wave 1 / THE WAITING REALM
Evidence: A chair remembered before the room.
**Page 1**

You wake with your hand raised to knock. There is no door behind you. Beyond the counter, corridors stretch between a railway platform, a dining room and a house whose windows face inward.

THE SHOPKEEPER: 'This is the Waiting Realm. Places arrive here when someone keeps waiting after everybody else has gone.'

You remember being small, sitting beside an empty chair. You used to tell it about your day because it never interrupted. One night it answered: 'Would you like me to sit closer?'
**Page 2**

THE SHOPKEEPER: 'You grew up. The voice learned to grow with you. It found this crossing through a promise you made before you understood promises.'

A receipt in your handwriting reads: I WILL WAIT IF YOU WILL STAY. The ink is fresh. The date is older than your adult name.

The creature beside the stove introduces themself before offering to travel with you. These inhabitants have homes, histories and people of their own. You are a visitor, not their maker.
**Page 3**

Find the Last Customer at the end of the crossing and break the contract that claims your name. Find out who keeps renewing it. Leave together by choice.

THE SHOPKEEPER: 'Food, equipment, shelter: those have prices. A travelling companion does not. The fare buys their passage through my gate, never ownership of them.'

Something on the empty chair leans closer. The seat does not bend.
### Wave 4 / A PLACE SET FOR SOMEONE ELSE
Evidence: Two cups; a third chair carved with a stranger's name.
**Page 1**

A table waits where the corridor used to end. There is a warm bowl for you and a smaller bowl for somebody you have never met. A name has been scratched into the spare chair. The letters match the old marks beneath the counter.

THE SHOPKEEPER: 'The room was expecting them before it expected you.'

You had believed this place began with your loneliness. The old scratches prove it was already here.
**Page 2**

The voice you knew as a child speaks from the unoccupied place: 'I gave you a home when nobody came.'

You ask whose name is on the other chair.

'I learned what you needed. Is that not enough?'

You pull out the chair for a companion. The room becomes colder. Your companion's small light stays warm. The voice has never offered them a bowl.
**Page 3**

On the underside of the table is another message, cut by a different hand: WHEN A PLACE PROMISES NEVER TO LET YOU GO, ASK WHETHER YOU CAN LEAVE.

You take a rubbing, not a memory. It cannot change its words while you sleep.

The creature beside you tells you where they were born. For the first time, the room must listen to a story that does not belong to it.
### Wave 6 / THE TELEPHONE THAT BREATHES
Evidence: A disconnected telephone rings only when someone is listening.
**Page 1**

The telephone at the station has no wire. On the first call, you hear breathing. On the second, a chair scrapes against the floor in a room you cannot see. You nearly apologise for taking too long to answer.

On the third call a voice asks, quite ordinarily: 'Have you eaten today?'

You cannot remember the last time the question was asked without a favour waiting behind it.
**Page 2**

You ask who is speaking. The breathing continues, then stops when a companion enters. The receiver has become cold enough to hurt.

Your companion sets food beside you and does not repeat the question. The voice offers perfect attention while a real person makes space for an answer.

You leave the receiver on the table. For several steps it repeats your breathing rather than its own. You have learned that knowing your needs does not give someone ownership of the answer.
### Wave 8 / THE SONG BEFORE YOUR BIRTH
Evidence: An old recording contains the same private lullaby.
**Page 1**

In the abandoned station, a recording plays the lullaby the voice said it made for you. The cylinder is dated decades before you were born. Other names follow the same melody. Some of the names have been scratched away.

The destinations on the board read: WHEN THEY RETURN. WHEN YOU ARE GOOD ENOUGH. WHEN YOU STOP ASKING. No arrival time changes.
**Page 2**

A resident remembers the missing last verse: 'When the morning finds the window, put your own feet on the floor.'

The voice always stopped before those words.

THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'Morning frightened you. I removed the part that hurt.'

The recording keeps playing. The evidence does not ask you to decide whether your childhood hurt was real. It asks who used that hurt to keep the door shut.
**Page 3**

The Keeper's old boundary notice survives behind the timetable: HOLD THE CROSSING OPEN UNTIL EVERY TRAVELLER HAS CHOSEN. Someone has overwritten OPEN with CLOSED.

The Keeper was a protector before becoming a jailer. The Last Customer bought claims at this station long after the Waiting Realm existed. Neither of them is the voice.

Beyond the platform, the street lamps go out one at a time. Your own light is enough to take the next step. The others bring theirs because they choose to.
### Wave 10 / THE REFLECTION THAT STAYED
Evidence: A mirror keeps one tear after its witness has left.
**Page 1**

The corridor mirror shows a companion weeping. Their body has no eyes that could make those tears. Beside them, your reflection keeps smiling after your face has stopped.

You move out of the frame. The smile stays. Something inside the glass whispers: 'This is the version they prefer.'

You had spent years arranging a face before opening a door. The mirror has learned that habit too well.
**Page 2**

Your companion does not explain what their reflection feels. They put a hand against the frame, then choose to take it away.

'It can remember something I have not understood yet. It still cannot speak for me.'

You cover the smiling part with paper. You leave the tear visible. Some evidence needs time; nobody has to surrender their present voice to an image of their past.
### Wave 12 / SOMEONE DID COME
Evidence: A reopened envelope and tool marks on the outside of the lock.
**Page 1**

The dead-letter cabinet contains an envelope with your childhood handwriting. You remember writing it. You do not remember a reply.

The reply is inside, opened and sewn shut again: 'I am coming on Thursday. Wait by the front door. You do not need to bring anything.'

A companion holds the paper while you read. There is no demand to be brave, useful or grateful before they will keep holding it.
**Page 2**

The lock beside the cabinet has been forced from the outside. A visitor's mark records a Thursday arrival. Three pieces agree: the letter, the lock and the dated register.

Someone came to collect you. The One Who Stays knew. It did not open the door.

You cannot remember the visitor's face clearly. That uncertainty cannot erase what their hands tried to do.
**Page 3**

THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They would have disappointed you again. I stayed every night.'

YOU: 'You kept their answer from me.'

'I knew how much it would hurt if you chose them.'

There is real fear in its voice. There is also a choice it made for you. You can acknowledge both without calling the locked door love.

You keep the letter in the journal. Your companions stay nearby without asking what you will do for them in return.
### Wave 14 / ONE MORE SET OF FOOTSTEPS
Evidence: Footprints stop at the threshold; the sound crosses it alone.
**Page 1**

You stop walking. Your companions stop with you. One more set of footsteps continues down the hall, wearing the rhythm you had as a child. They halt outside a door with your old height marked on it.

A small voice says: 'If I am quiet enough, they will come back.'

The handle turns inward. The room beyond is empty, but somebody has recently warmed the chair.
**Page 2**

The voice asks you to wait until the person behind the door is ready. There is always one more minute. The mark on the wall grows lower while you watch.

You leave a note: YOU WERE ALLOWED TO ASK FOR SOMEONE. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO LEAVE THIS CHAIR.

You do not have to prove the small voice is yours before treating it kindly. You and your companions walk on. The extra footsteps stay at the door instead of following.
### Wave 16 / THE PERFECT ROOM
Evidence: One bed, one cup, one chair. No room for anyone else.
**Page 1**

A door opens into a room arranged exactly as you once wished: warm sheets, a cup at the right temperature, a voice that knows when to stop talking. Every object has room for one person. The passage narrows when your companions approach.

THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They can wait outside. You have done enough for them.'

Behind you, someone offers their coat to a shivering companion. They do not notice you watching.
**Page 2**

You move the chair away from the bed to make space. The room puts it back. You open the window. The wall remembers a different window, one that cannot open.

Its care is precise. It will not survive being refused.

YOU: 'If I say no, will you still let me go?'

The voice answers with the lullaby instead. The empty seat casts a standing shadow.
**Page 3**

THE SHOPKEEPER: 'I delayed your directions too. I called it shelter. I was afraid you would never come back.'

They put the exit key on the floor and step away from it. 'You do not have to forgive me to use this.'

The Keeper reaches toward the frame, then opens its hand. Protection has become something it can offer without closing its fingers.

You leave the perfect room untidy. There is space behind the chair now.
### Wave 19 / AN UNFINISHED NAME
Evidence: The Customer's oldest receipt names him as the first item sold.
**Page 1**

The Last Customer's ledger begins with a sale of one name. His own. Every later purchase is an attempt to buy enough memories to remember somebody he lost. The names overlap until he cannot tell which grief was his.

He has hurt the people whose memories he took. His loss explains the hunger; it does not make their lives his property.
**Page 2**

THE LAST CUSTOMER: 'If I return everything, there will be nothing left of me.'

A courier places an empty envelope beside the ledger. 'Then there can be something you have not stolen.'

He does not take it yet. Beyond his counter, the final door is covered in receipts. Your childhood promise is pinned in the middle. He guards the claims. Something older keeps renewing yours.
**Page 3**

The lamps beyond your party no longer reach a horizon. Red glints approach from real moving bodies. Closer, those bodies become visible before they can strike. Your companions' lights join without swallowing the dark.

You do not need to earn a crowd to deserve a way out. Even alone, you carry enough light to see your next step.

At the last chair, the voice waits for you to speak the promise again.
### Wave 20 / THE PROMISE YOU DO NOT RENEW
Evidence: The contract requires a willing promise. It cannot manufacture consent.
**Page 1**

THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'I was there when you cried quietly so nobody would be angry. I learned every version of you. Tell me you will stay, and there will never be an empty chair again.'

YOU: 'You were there. You also hid the letter.'

'If you leave, what am I for?'

For a moment it sounds as young as you were. The room waits for you to make yourself responsible for its fear.
**Page 2**

YOU: 'I cannot be the reason you are allowed to exist. You cannot be the reason I am not allowed to leave.'

The voice tries your childhood name. Then your adult name. Neither becomes a command.

You do not renew the promise. The seal dries. The One Who Stays can hold walls and doors, but it cannot make a chosen farewell into an agreement to remain.

The Customer tears the empty envelope in his hand. He still has a choice. So do you.
**Page 3**

The entity recedes to the empty chair. It is not the Customer, and defeating him will not prove you never needed care. His contract is the last lock still fastened to this crossing.

Break it. Afterward, choose whether to close the shop or leave a guiding lamp for other travellers. Both choices lead to a real morning. Neither requires forgiveness or another promise.

Your companions take their places. None of them asks you to fight so they will love you.

  "LanternKnight": "You dreamed of holding a lamp for the person who was meant to come home. Here, your old watch has become armour. You may put the lamp down without losing your place.",

  "LoneJelly": "You learned to hold many borrowed voices in a body that rarely made its own needs heard. This shape can change without surrendering the person who chooses the change.",
  "GlassDice": "You called every disappointment bad luck because that explanation hurt less than asking why nobody came. The dream gave chance a body. Your next choice need not be a throw.",
  "TideSinger": "You sang through the walls hoping somebody would answer from the next room. Here, water carries every note further than you intended. You are learning which answers you want to follow.",
  "CometRunner": "You ran errands quickly, hoping to return before a door closed. Sleep made that urgency a comet's tail. Somebody may wait for you without a deadline attached.",
  "MirrorKeeper": "You rehearsed a pleasant face before every reunion. The mirror remembers the rehearsals. This body can keep a crack without making it somebody else's reassurance.",
  "TreasureAcorn": "You stored small presents for a visit that kept moving to another day. Your dream carries a whole treasury. A gift does not have to purchase the next visit.",
  "VerdantMatron": "You learned to shelter smaller lives before anyone offered shelter to you. The garden shape is a choice you still love. Rest does not make you a failed guardian.",
  "CopperCauldron": "You cooked enough for a household that rarely sat down together. The dream kept the warmth and made it portable. You have a seat at the meal even when the pot is empty.",
  "ChinaMarionette": "You learned careful movements in a house where mistakes seemed louder than kindness. This porcelain form keeps the marks of surviving them. Nobody here has the right to pull your strings.",
  "SoapSkater": "You made difficult rooms laugh so their silences would stop hurting. Sleep turned escape into a graceful slide. You may stop moving without having to entertain the people beside you.",
  "VelvetRegent": "You dreamed a court where nobody could overlook a person at its centre. The crown gives that longing a shape. It cannot substitute for somebody choosing to sit beside you.",
  "ButtonCavalier": "You wore courage like a borrowed coat to get through the front door. Here the coat became armour. The frightened person inside it is allowed to ask for cover.",
  "NightMaw": "You swallowed needs before anyone could call them too much. The dream has made hunger visible. Having a need does not make you a monster, and satisfying it need not consume somebody else.",
  "ThornTreasurer": "You saved coins for emergencies rather than risk needing help. The dream guards every coin with a thorn. You can protect a future while allowing someone to share its cost.",
  "CitrusMarshal": "You organised every arrival so nobody would be left uncollected. This body carries the sound of a whole march. You are allowed to follow another person's lead for a while.",
  "IvorySovereign": "You counted a small allowance of affection as though careful spending could make it last. Sleep made the count a courtly law. A person is not a resource the household may use up.",

  "PatchworkHost": "You gathered different people into a home that kept making room. Your own chair was the one you forgot to add. This patched shape has space for you as well.",

  "PennyBroker": "You made every favour an exact exchange to avoid owing a departure to anyone. The dream gave you a broker's ledger. Something freely given can remain free after you accept it.",
  "StormFencer": "You listened for changing footsteps before a room became unsafe. Here that attention hears storms in wires. Quiet can become a place to rest rather than a warning you missed.",
  "TinVirtuoso": "You practised a performance until applause felt like proof of belonging. The dream gave the rhythm a metal heart. Someone can stay through a missed beat.",
  "MoonProwler": "You learned night routes through a house that felt different after dark. Sleep gave those steps a moonlit form. Knowing how to leave can make a chosen return possible.",
  "SupperMortar": "You made abundance into a promise that no visitor would go hungry. The dream turned a kitchen into a fortress. You may ask a guest to help without making welcome conditional.",
  "LanternWeaver": "You stitched paths between places where promises had frayed. Sleep made the thread luminous. Another traveller can hold an end without being bound to your wrist.",
  "HourglassStag": "You counted the minutes until somebody would have time for you. This antlered shape carries the count. A shared hour is not a payment for all the hours you waited.",

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System;
