````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class BossPartRules
    {
        public static float Damage(UnitState boss, int part) => part == 0 ? boss.LeftPartDamage : part == 1 ? boss.RightPartDamage : boss.CenterPartDamage;
        public static float BrokenAt(UnitState boss, int part) => part == 0 ? boss.LeftPartBrokenAt : part == 1 ? boss.RightPartBrokenAt : boss.CenterPartBrokenAt;
        public static bool Broken(UnitState boss, int part) => BrokenAt(boss, part) >= 0;
        public static float Durability(UnitState boss) => Durability(boss, 0);
        public static float Durability(UnitState boss, int part)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition);
            return boss.Definition.Health * (entry == null ? 0.2f : entry.Organs[part].Durability);
        }
        public static int HitZone(Vector2 direction) => Mathf.Abs(direction.y) > Mathf.Abs(direction.x) * 1.3f ? 2 : direction.x >= 0 ? 0 : 1;
        public static bool Has(UnitState boss, BossOrganRole role, bool broken)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition);
            if (entry == null) return false;
            for (int part = 0; part < entry.Organs.Length; part++)
                if ((entry.Organs[part].Role & role) != 0 && Broken(boss, part) == broken) return true;
            return false;
        }
        public static int BulletCount(UnitState boss)
        {
            int count = CombatSimulation.BossBulletCount(boss.Definition.BossPattern);
            if (BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition) == null) return Mathf.Max(3, count - (boss.LeftPartBroken ? 4 : 0) - (boss.RightPartBroken ? 2 : 0));
            return Has(boss, BossOrganRole.Volley, true) || boss.LeftPartBroken && boss.RightPartBroken ? Mathf.Max(3, Mathf.CeilToInt(count * 0.4f)) : count;
        }
        public static int NextOrgan(UnitState boss)
        {
            for (int step = 0; step < 3; step++)
            {
                int part = (boss.BossVolley + step) % 3;
                if (!Broken(boss, part)) return part;
            }
            return -1;
        }
        public static Vector2 Position(UnitState boss, int part)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition);
            return entry == null ? boss.Position : boss.Position + AnimatedOffset(boss, part) * boss.Definition.BodyHeight + Vector2.up * boss.BodyLift;
        }
        public static Vector2 AnimatedOffset(UnitState boss, int part)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition);
            if (entry == null) return Vector2.zero;
            BossOrganDefinition organ = entry.Organs[part];
            Vector2 offset = organ.Offset;
            float time = boss.BossPoseTime;
            float phase = time * 1.45f + part * 2.1f + boss.Definition.BossPattern * 0.4f;
            if ((organ.Role & (BossOrganRole.Tempo | BossOrganRole.Pulse)) != 0)
                offset += new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(phase) * 0.11f, Mathf.Sin(phase) * 0.065f);
            else if ((organ.Role & (BossOrganRole.Volley | BossOrganRole.Pool | BossOrganRole.Props)) != 0)
                offset += new Vector2(Mathf.Sin(phase * 0.7f) * 0.035f, Mathf.Sin(phase) * 0.055f + 0.035f);
            if (boss.ActiveBossOrgan == part && !Broken(boss, part))
            {
                float age = time - boss.BossOrganReleaseAt;
                if ((organ.Role & BossOrganRole.Lash) != 0 && age >= 0 && age < 0.75f)
                    offset += boss.TelegraphDirection * Mathf.Sin(age / 0.75f * Mathf.PI) * 0.26f;
            }
            return offset;
        }
        public static Vector2 VolleyOrigin(UnitState boss)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition);
            if (entry != null)
                for (int part = 0; part < entry.Organs.Length; part++)
                    if ((entry.Organs[part].Role & BossOrganRole.Volley) != 0 && !Broken(boss, part)) return Position(boss, part);
            return boss.Position;
        }
        public static float CycleAdjustment(UnitState boss) => (Has(boss, BossOrganRole.Tempo, true) ? 0.75f : 0) - (Has(boss, BossOrganRole.Rupture, true) ? 0.35f : 0);
        public static float MovementMultiplier(UnitState boss) => Has(boss, BossOrganRole.Locomotion, true) ? 0.6f : 1;
        public static float VolleyAngle(UnitState boss, int index, int count, float time)
        {
            float aim = Mathf.Atan2(boss.TelegraphDirection.y, boss.TelegraphDirection.x);
            int pattern = boss.Definition.BossPattern;
            if (pattern == 5) return aim + (index - (count - 1) * 0.5f) * 0.095f;
            if (pattern == 6) return index * Mathf.PI * 2 / count + Mathf.Sin(time) * 0.3f;
            if (pattern == 7) return aim + (index % 5 - 2) * 0.17f + index / 5 * 0.08f;
            if (pattern == 8) return index * Mathf.PI * 2 / count + boss.BossVolley * 0.22f;
            if (pattern == 9) return aim + Mathf.Sin(index * 1.7f) * 0.8f;
            return CombatSimulation.BossBulletAngle(boss, index, time);
        }
        public static bool Allows(UnitState boss, ExpandedFieldKind kind)
        {
            if (!boss.Definition.IsBoss) return true;
            if (BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition) != null)
            {
                BossOrganRole role = kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle ? BossOrganRole.Lash : kind == ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp ? BossOrganRole.Props : kind == ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool ? BossOrganRole.Pool : BossOrganRole.None;
                return role == BossOrganRole.None || !Has(boss, role, true);
            }
            if (boss.LeftPartBroken && kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle) return false;
            if (boss.RightPartBroken && (kind == ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool)) return false;
            return true;
        }
        public static string Description => "Hit from either side to break its organ. Left: fewer shots, no lashes. Right: no props or pools, smaller shockwaves. Both broken: core shockwaves.";
        public static string Describe(UnitDefinition boss)
        {
            BossAnatomyEntry entry = BossAnatomy.For(boss);
            if (entry == null) return Description;
            string result = "BREAKABLE PARTS\nSide hits target side organs. Vertical hits target the centre.\n";
            foreach (BossOrganDefinition part in entry.Organs) result += "\n" + part.Name + ": " + part.BreakSummary;
            return result;
        }
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private void DamageBossPart(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source, Vector2 direction, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || !target.Definition.IsBoss || source == Faction.Enemy || direction.sqrMagnitude < 0.001f) return;
            int part = BossAnatomy.For(target.Definition) == null ? direction.x >= 0 ? 0 : 1 : BossPartRules.HitZone(direction);
            if (BossPartRules.Broken(target, part)) return;
            if (part == 0) target.LeftPartDamage += damage;
            else if (part == 1) target.RightPartDamage += damage;
            else target.CenterPartDamage += damage;
            if (BossPartRules.Damage(target, part) < BossPartRules.Durability(target, part)) return;
            if (part == 0) target.LeftPartBrokenAt = Elapsed;
            else if (part == 1) target.RightPartBrokenAt = Elapsed;
            else target.CenterPartBrokenAt = Elapsed;
            if (BossPartRules.Has(target, BossOrganRole.Vacuum, true) && target.StolenCoins > 0)
            {
                DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, target.Position, target.StolenCoins); target.StolenCoins = 0;
            }
            target.ExposedUntil = Mathf.Max(target.ExposedUntil, Elapsed + 1.1f);
            target.TelegraphUntil = 0;
            target.ActiveBossSignature = -1;
            target.BossRecoveryUntil = Mathf.Max(target.BossRecoveryUntil, Elapsed + 0.65f);
            target.NextBossPattern = Mathf.Max(target.NextBossPattern, Elapsed + 0.9f);
            Vector2 outward = part == 0 ? Vector2.left : part == 1 ? Vector2.right : Vector2.down;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.BossPhase, BossPartRules.Position(target, part), Faction.Enemy, value: part + 1, direction: outward, subjectId: target.Id, subject: target, cause: cause));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool MoveBossSignature(UnitState boss)
        {
            boss.BossPoseTime = Elapsed;
            if (boss.BossSkillUntil <= boss.BossSkillStarted || Elapsed < boss.BossSkillStarted) return false;
            if (Elapsed >= boss.BossSkillUntil)
            {
                boss.Position = ClampPosition(boss.AbilityTarget, boss.Definition.Radius);
                boss.BodyLift = 0; boss.BossSkillStarted = boss.BossSkillUntil = -100;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.BossLanded, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subjectId: boss.Id, subject: boss));
                return true;
            }
            float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - boss.BossSkillStarted) / (boss.BossSkillUntil - boss.BossSkillStarted));
            boss.Position = Vector2.Lerp(boss.AbilityOrigin, boss.AbilityTarget, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, progress));
            boss.BodyLift = Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * Mathf.Min(1.15f, boss.Definition.BodyHeight * 0.24f);
            return true;
        }

        private void ResolveBossSignature(UnitState boss)
        {
            int pattern = boss.Definition.BossPattern;
            int variation = boss.ActiveBossSignature;
            Vector2 target = boss.AbilityTarget;
            Vector2 heading = boss.TelegraphDirection.sqrMagnitude > 0.001f ? boss.TelegraphDirection : Vector2.down;
            Vector2 across = new Vector2(-heading.y, heading.x);
            bool enraged = boss.Health < boss.Definition.Health * 0.5f;
            if (BossEncounterRules.Leaps(pattern, variation))
            {
                boss.AbilityOrigin = boss.Position;
                boss.BossSkillStarted = Elapsed; boss.BossSkillUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, target, enraged ? 5.4f : 4.5f, 1.1f, 1.6f);
                if (variation == 1)
                    for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + across * index * 2, 0.65f, 1.65f + Mathf.Abs(index) * 0.22f, 0.35f);
                return;
            }
            int strokes = enraged ? 4 : 3;
            switch (pattern)
            {
                case 0:
                    for (int index = 0; index < strokes; index++)
                        Danger(variation == 0 ? ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp : ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, target + (variation == 0 ? across : heading) * ((index - 1) * 2), variation == 0 ? 0.95f : 0.35f, 0.95f + index * 0.3f, 0.4f);
                    break;
                case 1:
                    for (int index = 0; index < strokes; index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 direction = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (index - 1) * 38) * heading;
                        Danger(variation == 0 ? ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle : ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, boss, variation == 0 ? boss.Position + direction * 7 : target + across * ((index - 1) * 1.8f), variation == 0 ? 0.34f : 0.85f, 0.9f + index * 0.25f, variation == 0 ? 0.45f : 1.8f);
                    }
                    break;
                case 3:
                    for (int index = 0; index < strokes; index++)
                        Danger(variation == 0 ? ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle : ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, boss, target + across * ((index - 1) * 2), variation == 0 ? 0.4f : 1.05f, 0.9f + index * 0.35f, variation == 0 ? 0.4f : 1.7f);
                    break;
                case 4:
                    for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 offset = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index * 90 + variation * 45) * Vector2.right * 2.4f;
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + offset, 0.8f, 1 + index * 0.18f, 0.4f);
                    }
                    if (variation == 1) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, boss, target, 1.1f, 1.5f, 1.6f);
                    break;
                case 5:
                    for (int index = 0; index < strokes; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + across * ((index - 1) * 2.1f), 0.85f, 0.9f + index * 0.25f, 0.4f);
                    break;
                case 7:
                    for (int index = 0; index < (variation == 0 ? 2 : strokes); index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 direction = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (index - 0.5f) * 46) * heading;
                        Danger(variation == 0 ? ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle : ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, variation == 0 ? boss.Position + direction * 7 : target + across * ((index - 1) * 2), variation == 0 ? 0.38f : 0.8f, 1 + index * 0.28f, 0.45f);
                    }
                    break;
                case 8:
                    for (int index = 0; index < strokes; index++)
                        Danger(variation == 0 ? ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave : ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, variation == 0 ? boss.Position : target + across * ((index - 1) * 1.9f), variation == 0 ? 6 - index * 0.45f : 0.8f, 0.9f + index * 0.65f, variation == 0 ? 1.5f : 0.4f);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum MorphGeometry { Line, Disc, Ring, Crescent, Seal }
    public sealed class MorphStrike
    {
        public BuildMorphKind Kind;
        public MorphGeometry Geometry;
        public UnitState Source;
        public Vector2 Position, End, Direction;
        public float Radius, Width, At, Until, Created, Budget, Slow, Pull, Cone = -.2f;
        public int Stage, MaxTargets;
        public bool Resolved;
        public CombatCause Cause;
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly List<MorphStrike> morphStrikes = new List<MorphStrike>();
        private readonly List<UnitState> morphVictims = new List<UnitState>();
        private readonly List<UnitState> morphPins = new List<UnitState>();
        public IReadOnlyList<MorphStrike> MorphStrikes => morphStrikes;
        public int BuildMorphReleases { get; private set; }
        private void ClearBuildMorphs()
        {
            morphStrikes.Clear(); morphVictims.Clear(); morphPins.Clear(); BuildMorphReleases = 0;
            foreach (UnitState unit in units) { unit.MorphAttacks = 0; unit.NextMorph = 0; unit.LastMorphAt = -100; }
        }

        private float ReleaseBuildMorph(UnitState source, float damage, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (source.Faction == Faction.Enemy || !source.Alive || source.Definition.BuildMorphStage <= 0 || cause.Depth != 0) return damage;
            source.MorphAttacks = Mathf.Min(3, source.MorphAttacks + 1);
            if (source.MorphAttacks < 3 || source.NextMorph > Elapsed || morphStrikes.Count > 88) return damage;
            BuildMorphKind kind = source.Definition.BuildMorph;
            if (BuildMorphs.Get(kind) == null) return damage;
            UnitState target = units.Find(u => u.Id == source.AttackTargetId && CanHit(source.Faction, u));
            if (target == null) return damage;
            int stage = Mathf.Clamp(source.Definition.BuildMorphStage, 1, 3), start = morphStrikes.Count;
            Vector2 origin = source.Position, point = target.Position;
            Vector2 direction = source.AttackDirection.sqrMagnitude > .001f ? source.AttackDirection.normalized : Vector2.right;
            Vector2 side = new Vector2(-direction.y, direction.x);
            CombatCause root = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, source.Id, "build-" + kind.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), 1);
            void Strike(MorphGeometry geometry, Vector2 at, Vector2 end, float radius, float delay, float width = .16f, float slow = 0, float pull = 0)
            {
                morphStrikes.Add(new MorphStrike { Kind = kind, Geometry = geometry, Source = source, Position = at, End = end, Direction = direction,
                    Radius = radius, Width = width, Created = Elapsed, At = Elapsed + delay, Until = Elapsed + delay + .34f, Stage = stage,
                    MaxTargets = 2 + stage, Slow = slow, Pull = pull, Cause = root });
            }
            switch (kind)
            {
                case BuildMorphKind.Thread:
                    morphPins.Clear(); morphPins.Add(target);
                    for (int pin = 0; pin < stage + 1; pin++)
                    {
                        UnitState next = null; float best = 2.7f * 2.7f;
                        foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                        {
                            float d = (enemy.Position - morphPins[morphPins.Count - 1].Position).sqrMagnitude;
                            if (!CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || morphPins.Contains(enemy) || d >= best) continue;
                            next = enemy; best = d;
                        }
                        if (next == null) break;
                        morphPins.Add(next);
                    }
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point, point, .42f, .12f);
                    for (int i = 1; i < morphPins.Count; i++) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, morphPins[i - 1].Position, morphPins[i].Position, 0, .18f + i * .08f, .15f, .18f);
                    if (stage >= 2 && morphPins.Count > 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, morphPins[morphPins.Count - 1].Position, point, 0, .54f, .17f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Cinder:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 2 + stage; i++) Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, Vector2.Lerp(origin, point, (i + 1f) / (2 + stage)), point, .42f + stage * .07f, .08f + i * .1f);
                    if (stage == 3)
                        for (int sign = -1; sign <= 1; sign += 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point, point + direction * 1.5f + side * sign * 1.15f, 0, .65f, .24f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Clockwork:
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point - side * .45f, point, .78f, .18f);
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point + side * .45f, point, .78f, .38f);
                    if (stage >= 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - direction * 1.3f, point + direction * 1.3f, 0, .56f, .25f);
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - side * 1.6f, point + side * 1.6f, 0, .65f, .25f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Porcelain:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point, point, .75f + stage * .17f, .12f + i * .24f, slow: .35f);
                    if (stage >= 2)
                        for (int sign = -1; sign <= 1; sign += 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point + side * sign * 1.2f, point, .58f, .46f, slow: .35f);
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, point, point, 1.9f, .72f, .26f, .35f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Constellation:
                    for (int i = 0; i < stage + 2; i++)
                    {
                        Vector2 ray = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, i * 360f / (stage + 2) + source.Id * 17 % 60) * Vector2.right;
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point + ray * (1.5f + stage * .2f), point, 0, .2f + i * .08f, .13f);
                    }
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, point, point, 1.3f, .7f, .2f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Paper:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 1 + stage; i++)
                    {
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Crescent, origin, origin, .9f + i * .72f, .12f + i * .12f, .3f, pull: -.2f);
                        morphStrikes[morphStrikes.Count - 1].Cone = stage == 3 ? -.35f : .15f;
                    }
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Mirror:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 1 + stage; i++)
                    {
                        Vector2 from = origin + side * ((i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * (.6f + .15f * i));
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, from, point + direction * .7f, 0, .18f + i * .16f, .15f);
                    }
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Chorus:
                    for (int i = 0; i < stage + 1; i++) Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, origin, origin, .9f + i * .85f, .12f + i * .16f, .43f);
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, point, point, .8f, .78f, .35f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Magnet:
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Disc, point, point, 1 + stage * .2f, .12f, slow: .2f, pull: .3f);
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, point, point, .7f + stage * .2f, .48f, .45f);
                    if (stage >= 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - side * 1.6f, point + side * 1.6f, 0, .62f, .22f);
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - direction * 1.8f, point + direction * 1.8f, 0, .74f, .22f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Tide:
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, origin, point + direction, 0, .12f, .28f);
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point + direction + side * .45f, origin + side * .45f, 0, .48f, .28f);
                    if (stage >= 2) Strike(MorphGeometry.Crescent, origin, origin, Mathf.Clamp((point - origin).magnitude, 1, 4), .64f, .35f);
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - side * 1.8f, point + side * 1.8f, 0, .78f, .33f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Frost:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 2 + stage; i++)
                    {
                        Vector2 ray = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, i * 360f / (2 + stage)) * Vector2.right;
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point, point + ray * (1.2f + stage * .25f), 0, .18f + i * .06f, .17f, .45f);
                    }
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Ring, point, point, 2.1f, .68f, .3f, .45f);
                    break;
                case BuildMorphKind.Seal:
                    Strike(MorphGeometry.Seal, point, point, .8f + stage * .12f, .26f);
                    if (stage >= 2)
                    {
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - side * 1.2f, point + side * 1.2f, 0, .48f, .18f);
                        Strike(MorphGeometry.Line, point - direction * 1.2f, point + direction * 1.2f, 0, .6f, .18f);
                    }
                    if (stage == 3) Strike(MorphGeometry.Seal, point, point, 1.7f, .8f);
                    break;
            }
            int count = morphStrikes.Count - start;
            if (count == 0) return damage;
            float budget = Mathf.Max(0, damage) * (.6f + stage * .2f) / count;
            for (int i = start; i < morphStrikes.Count; i++) morphStrikes[i].Budget = budget;
            source.MorphAttacks = 0; source.NextMorph = Elapsed + 2.4f; source.LastMorphAt = Elapsed;
            BuildMorphReleases++; RecordActivation(root);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.BuildMorphCast, point, source.Faction, stage, direction, subject: source, cause: root));
            return damage * .72f;
        }

        public static bool MorphContains(MorphStrike strike, UnitState enemy)
        {
            float body = enemy.Definition.Radius;
            Vector2 offset = enemy.Position - strike.Position;
            if (strike.Geometry == MorphGeometry.Line)
            {
                Vector2 line = strike.End - strike.Position;
                Vector2 closest = strike.Position + line * Mathf.Clamp01(Vector2.Dot(offset, line) / Mathf.Max(.0001f, line.sqrMagnitude));
                return (enemy.Position - closest).sqrMagnitude <= Mathf.Pow(strike.Width + body, 2);
            }
            if (strike.Geometry == MorphGeometry.Seal)
            {
                Vector2 side = new Vector2(-strike.Direction.y, strike.Direction.x);
                return Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Dot(offset, strike.Direction)) <= strike.Radius + body && Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Dot(offset, side)) <= strike.Radius + body;
            }
            float distance = offset.magnitude;
            if (strike.Geometry == MorphGeometry.Disc) return distance <= strike.Radius + body;
            return Mathf.Abs(distance - strike.Radius) <= strike.Width + body && (strike.Geometry != MorphGeometry.Crescent || Vector2.Dot(offset.normalized, strike.Direction) >= strike.Cone);
        }

        private void ProcessBuildMorphs()
        {
            for (int i = morphStrikes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                MorphStrike strike = morphStrikes[i];
                if (!strike.Source.Alive || Elapsed >= strike.Until) { morphStrikes.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
                if (strike.Resolved || Elapsed < strike.At) continue;
                strike.Resolved = true; morphVictims.Clear();
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    if (!CanHit(strike.Source.Faction, enemy) || !MorphContains(strike, enemy)) continue;
                    // Nearest victims win deterministically; do not depend on spawn-list ordering.
                    int slot = morphVictims.Count;
                    float distance = (enemy.Position - strike.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    while (slot > 0)
                    {
                        UnitState previous = morphVictims[slot - 1]; float prior = (previous.Position - strike.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                        if (prior < distance || prior == distance && previous.Id < enemy.Id) break;
                        slot--;
                    }
                    if (slot >= strike.MaxTargets) continue;
                    morphVictims.Insert(slot, enemy);
                    if (morphVictims.Count > strike.MaxTargets) morphVictims.RemoveAt(morphVictims.Count - 1);
                }
                float share = strike.Budget / Mathf.Max(1, morphVictims.Count);
                foreach (UnitState enemy in morphVictims)
                {
                    // Secondary damage carries no weapon and cannot feed weapon hit recipes or itself.
                    ApplyDamage(enemy, share, strike.Source.Faction, BuildMorphs.Get(strike.Kind).Name, cause: strike.Cause);
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Definition.IsBoss) continue;
                    enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + strike.Slow);
                    if (strike.Pull == 0) continue;
                    Vector2 pull = (strike.Position - enemy.Position).normalized;
                    if (pull.sqrMagnitude < .001f) pull = strike.Direction;
                    enemy.Position = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + pull * strike.Pull * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance)), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                    spatial.Move(enemy);
                }
            }
        }
#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public float MorphAttackFixture(UnitState unit, float damage = 30) => ReleaseBuildMorph(unit, damage, NewCause(unit.Id));
#endif
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class BuildMorphProfile
    {
        public BuildMorphKind Kind;
        public int Points, Relics, Partners, Tier, Stage;
        public readonly List<string> Sources = new List<string>();
        public string Summary => BuildMorphs.Get(Kind).Name + " / " + BuildMorphs.StageName(Stage) + " / " + Points + (Stage < 3 ? "/" + BuildMorphs.NextThreshold(Stage) : "/6") + " craft";
        public string Explanation => BuildMorphs.Get(Kind).Pattern + "\n\n" + BuildMorphs.Get(Kind).Silhouette + "\n\nCRAFT SOURCES\n" + string.Join("\n", Sources) + "\n\nForms unlock at 2 / 4 / 6 craft with at least one compatible relic. Each different compatible relic grants 1, each different supporting weapon grants 1 (max 2), evolved tier grants 1 / 2. Duplicate copies do not add craft. A supporting weapon must be carried by another permanent party member.\nEvery third attack can release a form, at most once per 2.4 seconds. Its basic hit retains 72% damage; the remaining choreography shares one finite damage budget. No extra input required.";
    }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public BuildMorphProfile MorphProfile(WeaponDefinition weapon, int tier, bool companion)
        {
            var p = new BuildMorphProfile { Kind = BuildMorphs.For(weapon), Tier = Mathf.Clamp(tier, 1, 3) };
            if (p.Kind == BuildMorphKind.None) return p;
            var relicIds = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (ItemStack stack in State.Items)
            {
                ItemDefinition item = catalog.Item(stack.Id);
                if (item == null || item.EffectiveStacks(stack.Count) <= 0 || SecretItemSuspended(stack.Id) || !BuildMorphs.Affinity(p.Kind, item, companion) || !relicIds.Add(stack.Id)) continue;
                p.Relics++; p.Sources.Add("+1 " + item.Name);
            }
            var partners = new HashSet<string>();
            void Partner(WeaponDefinition candidate)
            {
                if (candidate == null || candidate.Id == weapon.Id || !BuildMorphs.Supports(p.Kind, candidate) || !partners.Add(candidate.Id) || p.Partners >= 2) return;
                p.Partners++; p.Sources.Add("+1 supporting " + RunUICopy.WeaponName(candidate.Id));
            }
            Partner(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon);
            foreach (RosterEntry entry in State.Roster) Partner(catalog.Weapon(entry.WeaponId));
            if (p.Tier > 1) p.Sources.Add("+" + (p.Tier - 1) + " evolved recruit tier");
            p.Points = p.Relics + p.Partners + p.Tier - 1;
            p.Stage = catalog.ExpansionRevision > 0 ? BuildMorphs.Stage(p.Points, p.Relics) : 0;
            if (p.Sources.Count == 0) p.Sources.Add("No compatible sources yet.");
            if (p.Relics == 0) p.Sources.Add("Needs at least one compatible relic.");
            return p;
        }
        private void PrepareBuildMorphs()
        {
            void Apply(UnitDefinition unit, bool companion)
            {
                if (unit == null) return;
                BuildMorphProfile p = MorphProfile(unit.Weapon, companion ? unit.CombatTier : 1, companion);
                unit.BuildMorph = p.Kind; unit.BuildMorphStage = p.Stage;
            }
            Apply(CombatCatalog.Champion, false);
            foreach (UnitDefinition unit in CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions) Apply(unit, true);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class CarnivalBalance
    {
        public static float ShopPrice(int wave)
        {
            float stage = Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1);
            return Mathf.Min(10000, (1 + stage * 0.12f + stage * stage * 0.009f) * (1 + Mathf.Min(0.2f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.01f)) * (1 + Mathf.Max(0, wave - 7) * .065f));
        }

        public static float EnemyHealth(int wave) => 1.2f * (1 + Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1) / 12f, 1.45f)) * (1 + Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0, wave - 4) / 16f, 1.4f) * 1.4f);
        public static float EnemyDensity(int wave) => 1 + Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.13f);
        public static float SpawnInterval(int wave) => Mathf.Max(0.25f, (1.4f - Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(1, wave)) * 0.035f) / (1 + Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.18f));
        public static float BossBulk(int wave) => Mathf.Lerp(4.6f, 7.5f, Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 4) / 16f));
        public static float EnemySpeed(int wave) => 1.08f * (1 + 1.8f * (1 - Mathf.Exp(-Mathf.Max(0, wave - 1) * 0.05f)));
        public static float EnemyDamage(int wave) => 1.15f * (1 + Mathf.Min(3, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 3) * 0.09f)) * (1 + Mathf.Min(1.4f, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 5) * 0.07f));
        public static float RecruitDamage(ItemRarity rarity) => 1 + (int)rarity * 0.18f;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private void ApplyCarnivalProjectilePayoff(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState target, UnitState source)
        {
            int tier = Mathf.Clamp(source.Definition.CombatTier, 1, 3);
            if (projectile.IsFragment || projectile.Cause.Depth > 0) return;
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.YoYo && target.Alive && !target.Definition.IsBoss)
            {
                target.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(target.Position, source.Position, (0.12f + tier * 0.07f) * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(target.Definition.KnockbackResistance))), target.Definition.Radius);
                target.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(target.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.18f); spatial.Move(target);
                if (tier >= 2)
                {
                    int caught = 0;
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    {
                        if (!CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || enemy == target || enemy.Definition.IsBoss || SegmentCircle(source.Position, target.Position, enemy.Position, enemy.Definition.Radius + 0.25f) < 0) continue;
                        enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.3f);
                        if (++caught >= tier) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic != CarnivalWeapon.Sewing || tier < 2 || projectile.Victims.Count != 1) return;
            UnitState previous = target; var visited = new HashSet<int>(projectile.Victims);
            for (int link = 0; link < tier - 1; link++)
            {
                UnitState next = null; float best = 1.8f * 1.8f;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    float distance = (enemy.Position - previous.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (!CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || visited.Contains(enemy.Id) || distance >= best) continue;
                    next = enemy; best = distance;
                }
                if (next == null) break;
                visited.Add(next.Id);
                CombatCause stitch = projectile.Cause.Child("sewing-stitch");
                fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.SewingLink, Source = source, Anchor = previous, Target = next, Start = previous.Position, Position = next.Position, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + 0.38f, Resolved = true, Cause = stitch });
                ApplyDamage(next, projectile.Damage * 0.18f, source.Faction, "Sewing stitch", cause: stitch);
                if (!next.Definition.IsBoss) next.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(next.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.25f);
                previous = next;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool ResolveCarnivalAttack(UnitState source, float damage, bool critical, CombatCause cause)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = source.Definition.Weapon;
            source.ExpandedBeat++;
            if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.BloomOrb || weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SatelliteDisc)
            {
                EmitProjectile(source, damage, critical, cause); return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.EchoBlade)
            {
                foreach (UnitState target in units)
                {
                    Vector2 offset = target.Position - source.Position;
                    if (CanHit(source.Faction, target) && offset.magnitude <= weapon.Range + target.Definition.Radius && Vector2.Dot(offset.normalized, source.AttackDirection) >= weapon.ConeDot)
                        ApplyWeaponDamage(target, damage * 0.7f, source.Faction, weapon.Element, weapon.Id, source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause);
                }
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.45f, 0.24f, 0.2f, cause);
                fields[fields.Count - 1].ImpactWeapon = weapon; fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = critical;
                return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.YoYo)
            {
                int previous = projectiles.Count;
                EmitProjectile(source, damage, critical, cause);
                for (int index = previous; index < projectiles.Count; index++)
                    fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.YoYoTether, Source = source, Projectile = projectiles[index], Start = source.Position, Position = projectiles[index].Position, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + weapon.ProjectileLifetime, Resolved = true });
            }
            else if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Sewing)
            {
                EmitProjectile(source, damage, critical, cause);
                UnitState target = units.Find(candidate => candidate.Id == source.AttackTargetId && candidate.Alive);
                if (target != null) fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.Link, Source = source, Target = target, Start = source.Position, Position = target.Position, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + 0.3f, Resolved = true });
            }
            else if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Magnet)
            {
                int pulled = 0;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    Vector2 offset = enemy.Position - source.Position;
                    if (!CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || offset.magnitude > weapon.Range || Vector2.Dot(offset.normalized, source.AttackDirection) < 0.55f) continue;
                    if (pulled++ >= 3 + Mathf.Clamp(source.Definition.CombatTier, 1, 3)) break;
                    float resistance = enemy.Definition.IsBoss ? 1 : Mathf.Clamp01(enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance);
                    Vector2 before = enemy.Position;
                    enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(enemy.Position, source.Position + source.AttackDirection * 1.4f, 0.65f * (1 - resistance)), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                    spatial.Move(enemy);
                    ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy, damage, source.Faction, weapon.Element, weapon.Id, source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause);
                    RegisterCooperationPull(source, enemy, before, cause);
                }
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.MagnetCone, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, 0, 0, 0.35f, cause);
            }
            else if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SpringHammer)
            {
                Vector2 point = source.Position + source.AttackDirection * Mathf.Min(weapon.Range * 0.7f, 2.3f);
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, point, source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range * 0.6f, damage, 0, 0.18f, cause);
                fields[fields.Count - 1].ImpactWeapon = weapon;
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Cause = cause; fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = critical;
            }
            else if (weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Projector)
            {
                UnitState target = units.Find(candidate => candidate.Id == source.AttackTargetId && candidate.Alive);
                Vector2 point = target == null ? source.Position + source.AttackDirection * weapon.Range * 0.6f : target.Position;
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Projector, source, point, source.AttackDirection, 1.15f * CompanionTierScaling.Body(source.Definition.CombatTier), damage * 0.4f, 0, 1.15f, cause);
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = critical;
            }
            else
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -35) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.55f, 0, 0.08f, cause);
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = critical;
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 35) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.55f, 0.18f, 0.1f, cause);
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = critical;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool MoveCarnivalEnemy(UnitState enemy, Vector2 offset, float delta)
        {
            EnemyBehavior behavior = enemy.Definition.Behavior;
            if (Elapsed >= enemy.NextBehavior)
            {
                enemy.NextBehavior = Elapsed + (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Charger ? 4.2f : 5.2f) + enemy.Id % 4 * 0.23f;
                enemy.AbilityOrigin = enemy.Position;
                enemy.AbilityTarget = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + Vector2.ClampMagnitude(offset, 4), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                enemy.AttackDirection = offset.normalized;
                enemy.AttackStarted = Elapsed; enemy.AttackWindup = behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hopper || behavior == EnemyBehavior.Burrower ? 0.42f : 0.7f;
                if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hopper || behavior == EnemyBehavior.Burrower)
                {
                    enemy.BehaviorUntil = Elapsed + 1.2f;
                    enemy.NextContact = enemy.NextAttack = enemy.BehaviorUntil;
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, enemy, enemy.AbilityTarget, 0.8f, 1.2f, 0.4f);
                }
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Charger)
                {
                    enemy.BehaviorUntil = Elapsed + 1.7f; enemy.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + 0.7f;
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, enemy.AbilityTarget, 0.28f, 0.7f, 0.5f);
                }
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.CoinThief)
                {
                    for (int index = pickups.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
                    {
                        PickupState pickup = pickups[index];
                        if (pickup.Kind != LootKind.Coin || pickup.Attracting || pickup.Value <= 0 || pickup.Value > 1000 - enemy.StolenCoins || (pickup.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > 4) continue;
                        enemy.StolenCoins += pickup.Value; pickups.RemoveAt(index);
                    }
                    if (enemy.StolenCoins > 0) enemy.AbilityFireAt = Elapsed + enemy.AttackWindup;
                }
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Puffer)
                {
                    enemy.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + 1;
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 2.5f, 1, 0.9f);
                }
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Spore)
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, enemy, ClampPosition(Champion.Position, 1), 1, 1.1f, 1.8f);
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Sweeper)
                    for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, enemy, Champion.Position + Vector2.right * ((index - 1) * 1.4f), 0.65f, 0.8f + index * 0.18f, 0.3f);
                else if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hydra)
                    enemy.AbilityFireAt = Elapsed + enemy.AttackWindup;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
            }
            if (enemy.AbilityFireAt > 0 && Elapsed >= enemy.AbilityFireAt)
            {
                enemy.AbilityFireAt = 0;
                EmitProjectile(enemy, enemy.Definition.Weapon.Damage, false, NewCause(enemy.Id));
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
            }
            if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hopper || behavior == EnemyBehavior.Burrower)
            {
                if (enemy.BehaviorUntil <= Elapsed) { enemy.BodyLift = 0; return false; }
                float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - (enemy.BehaviorUntil - 1.2f)) / 1.2f);
                float travel = Mathf.Clamp01((progress - 0.35f) / 0.65f);
                enemy.Position = Vector2.Lerp(enemy.AbilityOrigin, enemy.AbilityTarget, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, travel));
                enemy.BodyLift = Mathf.Sin(travel * Mathf.PI) * (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hopper ? 1.1f : -0.45f);
                return true;
            }
            if (behavior == EnemyBehavior.Charger && enemy.BehaviorUntil > Elapsed)
            {
                if (enemy.TelegraphUntil > Elapsed) return true;
                Vector2 direction = (enemy.AbilityTarget - enemy.AbilityOrigin).normalized;
                enemy.Position = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + direction * enemy.Definition.Speed * delta * 2.7f, enemy.Definition.Radius);
                enemy.Facing = direction;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class CarnivalHazards
    {
        public static bool IsHostile(ExpandedFieldKind kind) => kind == ExpandedFieldKind.OfficeHazard || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.ToyHazard || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Curtain || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool;

        public static float ShockRadius(ExpandedField field, float time) => field.Radius * Mathf.Clamp01((time - field.At) / Mathf.Max(0.05f, field.Until - field.At));

        public static bool Contains(ExpandedField field, Vector2 position, float bodyRadius, float time)
        {
            if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle)
            {
                Vector2 segment = field.Position - field.Start;
                float fraction = segment.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f ? 0 : Mathf.Clamp01(Vector2.Dot(position - field.Start, segment) / segment.sqrMagnitude);
                return Vector2.Distance(position, field.Start + segment * fraction) <= field.Radius + bodyRadius;
            }
            if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave)
                return Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Distance(position, field.Position) - ShockRadius(field, time)) <= 0.22f + bodyRadius;
            return Vector2.Distance(position, field.Position) <= field.Radius + bodyRadius;
        }
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private void Danger(ExpandedFieldKind kind, UnitState source, Vector2 destination, float radius, float delay, float duration, int organ = -1)
        {
            if (!BossPartRules.Allows(source, kind)) return;
            if (source.Definition.IsBoss && (BossPartRules.Has(source, BossOrganRole.Pulse, true) || BossAnatomy.For(source.Definition) == null && source.RightPartBroken) && kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave) radius *= 0.8f;
            int count = 0;
            foreach (ExpandedField field in fields) if (CarnivalHazards.IsHostile(field.Kind)) count++;
            if (count >= 48) return;
            Field(kind, source, ClampPosition(destination, radius), (destination - source.Position).normalized, radius, source.Definition.Weapon.Damage, delay, duration, NewCause(source.Id));
            if (organ >= 0)
            {
                ExpandedField field = fields[fields.Count - 1]; field.SourceOrgan = organ; field.Start = BossPartRules.Position(source, organ);
                field.Direction = (field.Position - field.Start).normalized;
            }
        }

        private bool ResolveBossBodyAttack(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (BossAnatomy.For(boss.Definition) != null) return ResolveAnatomyAttack(boss);
            if (boss.LeftPartBroken && boss.RightPartBroken)
            {
                Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, 4.5f, 0.9f, 1.4f);
                return false;
            }
            int pattern = boss.Definition.BossPattern;
            if (pattern < 5 && boss.BossVolley % 3 != 2) return false;
            Vector2 target = ClampPosition(Champion.Position, 1.2f);
            Vector2 direction = (target - boss.Position).normalized;
            switch (pattern % 5)
            {
                case 0:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, boss.Position + direction * 5, 0.42f, 0.65f, 0.45f);
                    for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + new Vector2((index - 1) * 1.6f, 0), 0.8f, 0.9f + index * 0.2f, 0.4f);
                    break;
                case 1:
                    for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 lash = (Vector2)(Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (index - 1) * 28) * direction);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, boss.Position + lash * 6, 0.32f, 0.8f + index * 0.16f, 0.5f);
                    }
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, boss, target, 1.1f, 1.3f, 1.6f);
                    break;
                case 2:
                    foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups)
                        if (pickup.Kind == LootKind.Coin && (pickup.Position - boss.Position).sqrMagnitude < 36)
                            pickup.Position = Vector2.Lerp(pickup.Position, boss.Position, 0.35f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, 5, 0.8f, 1.4f);
                    break;
                case 3:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, 6, 0.6f, 1.8f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, 6, 1.4f, 1.8f);
                    break;
                default:
                    for (int index = 0; index < 5; index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 offset = (Vector2)(Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index * 72) * Vector2.right) * 2;
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + offset, 0.7f, 0.85f + index * 0.15f, 0.45f);
                    }
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, target, 0.4f, 0.7f, 0.4f);
                    break;
            }
            return pattern != 7;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private void ProcessCarnivalHero(float delta, HeroMechanic mechanic)
        {
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle || mechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw)
            {
                if (Elapsed < heroReadyAt) return;
                bool threat = false;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    threat |= enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 6.25f;
                if (!threat) return;
                CombatCause pulse = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child(mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle ? "root-ward" : "solo-whirl");
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude > 6.25f) continue;
                    ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * (mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle ? 1 : 0.8f), Faction.Champion, mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle ? DamageElement.Frost : DamageElement.Physical, "Personal ward", cause: pulse);
                    if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle && enemy.Alive && !enemy.Definition.IsBoss)
                    {
                        Vector2 direction = (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized;
                        enemy.Position = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + direction * 0.35f * (1 - enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                        spatial.Move(enemy);
                    }
                }
                heroReadyAt = Elapsed + 2; HeroActivations++; Champion.LastSupport = Elapsed;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse, Champion.Position, Faction.Champion, 2.5f, subject: Champion, element: mechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle ? DamageElement.Frost : DamageElement.Physical, cause: pulse));
                return;
            }
            float moved = Vector2.Distance(Champion.Position, Champion.PreviousPosition);
            float required = mechanic == HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard ? 2 : mechanic == HeroMechanic.TideCollector ? 8 : mechanic == HeroMechanic.GlassGambler ? 6 : 10;
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.ClockRunner) heroCharge += moved;
            else if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard) heroCharge = moved > 0.001f ? 0 : heroCharge + delta;
            else
            {
                int count = events.Count;
                for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
                    if (events[index].Kind == CombatEventKind.Pickup && events[index].Loot == LootKind.Coin)
                        heroCharge += Mathf.Max(0, events[index].Value);
            }
            heroCharge = Mathf.Min(required, heroCharge);
            if (heroCharge < required || Elapsed < heroReadyAt) return;
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard)
            {
                int reflected = 0;
                foreach (ProjectileState projectile in projectiles)
                {
                    if (projectile.Faction != Faction.Enemy || (projectile.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude > 9 || reflected >= 3) continue;
                    projectile.Faction = Faction.Champion; projectile.HostileMotion = HostileShot.Straight;
                    projectile.Velocity = -projectile.Velocity; projectile.SourceUnitId = Champion.Id;
                    projectile.Cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("mirror-guard"); projectile.Color = new Color(0.4f, 1, 0.8f);
                    projectile.Victims.Clear(); reflected++;
                }
                if (reflected == 0) return;
            }
            else if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.TreasureTax)
            {
                Gold = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)Gold + 1);
                Heal(1, NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("treasure-tax"));
            }
            else
            {
                CombatCause cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("hero-" + mechanic);
                if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.TideCollector) Heal(3, cause);
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude > 9) continue;
                    if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.GlassGambler)
                        ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 0.7f, Faction.Champion, DamageElement.Arcane, "Lucky burst", cause: cause);
                    else if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.ClockRunner)
                        enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + (enemy.Definition.IsBoss ? 0.5f : 1.4f));
                    else
                    {
                        Vector2 direction = (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized;
                        enemy.Position = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + direction * 0.5f * (1 - enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                        spatial.Move(enemy);
                    }
                }
            }
            heroCharge = 0; heroReadyAt = Elapsed + 4; HeroActivations++; Champion.LastSupport = Elapsed;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse, Champion.Position, Faction.Champion, 3, subject: Champion, element: DamageElement.Arcane, cause: NewCause(Champion.Id)));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

    public enum LootKind { Coin, Egg, Heart, Chest }

    public readonly struct CombatCause
    {
        public readonly int RootId;
        public readonly int SourceUnitId;
        public readonly string ItemId;
        public readonly int Depth;
        public CombatCause(int rootId, int sourceUnitId, string itemId = "", int depth = 0)
        {
            RootId = rootId; SourceUnitId = sourceUnitId; ItemId = itemId; Depth = depth;
        }
        public CombatCause Child(string itemId) => new CombatCause(RootId, SourceUnitId, itemId, Depth + 1);
    }

    {

        public float Cooldown;
        public float Chance = 1f;
    }

    public sealed class ActiveProc
    {
        public ProcRule Rule;
        public int Stacks;
    }
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ArcaneBrigade

    public enum CombatEventKind { Windup, Fire, Hit, Kill, Pickup, Heal, ChestOpened, Proc, SignatureMark, SignaturePulse, SignatureBurst, Support, Dodge, BossLanded, ProjectileReturn, ProjectilePierce, ProjectileSplit, ProjectileBounce, Knockback, LootDrop, BossPhase, ContactWindup, StatusApplied, LootAttract, MimicWake, BuildMorphCast, HeroIdentityCast }

    public readonly struct CombatEvent
    {
        public readonly CombatEventKind Kind;
        public readonly Vector2 Position;

        public CombatEvent(CombatEventKind kind, Vector2 position, Faction faction, float value = 0f, Vector2 direction = default, WeaponDefinition weapon = null, bool critical = false, DamageElement element = DamageElement.Physical, int subjectId = 0, UnitState subject = null, CombatCause cause = default, LootKind loot = LootKind.Coin)
        {
            Kind = kind;
            Position = position;
            Faction = faction;
            Value = value;
            Direction = direction;
            Weapon = weapon;

    }
````
