````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ContributionEntry
    {
        public string UnitId;
        public string WeaponId;
        public string EffectId;
        public int Tier;
        public float Damage;
        public float Healing;
        public int Coins;
        public int Activations;
        public int Kills;
        public string Key => UnitId + "/" + WeaponId + "/" + Tier + "/" + EffectId;
    }

    public static class ContributionLedger
    {
        public static void Merge(List<ContributionEntry> destination, IReadOnlyList<ContributionEntry> source)
        {
            foreach (ContributionEntry entry in source)
            {
                ContributionEntry existing = destination.Find(candidate => candidate.Key == entry.Key);
                if (existing == null)
                {
                    existing = new ContributionEntry { UnitId = entry.UnitId, WeaponId = entry.WeaponId, EffectId = entry.EffectId, Tier = entry.Tier }; destination.Add(existing);
                }
                existing.Damage = Mathf.Min(1e12f, existing.Damage + entry.Damage);
                existing.Healing = Mathf.Min(1e12f, existing.Healing + entry.Healing);
                existing.Coins = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)existing.Coins + entry.Coins);
                existing.Activations = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)existing.Activations + entry.Activations);
                existing.Kills = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)existing.Kills + entry.Kills);
            }
        }

        public static string Describe(IReadOnlyList<ContributionEntry> entries)
        {
            if (entries == null || entries.Count == 0) return "No measured contributions yet.\n";
            var lines = new List<string>();
            foreach (ContributionEntry entry in entries)
                lines.Add(entry.UnitId + " / " + entry.WeaponId + " / " + entry.EffectId + "\nEffective damage " + entry.Damage.ToString("0.#") + " · heal " + entry.Healing.ToString("0.#") + " · kills " + entry.Kills + " · coin " + entry.Coins + " · activations " + entry.Activations);
            return string.Join("\n\n", lines) + "\nCounts actual HP lost/restored only; excludes overkill, VFX and duplicate connector damage.\n";
        }
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly List<ContributionEntry> contributions = new List<ContributionEntry>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, ContributionEntry> contributionIndex = new Dictionary<string, ContributionEntry>();
        public IReadOnlyList<ContributionEntry> Contributions => contributions;

        private ContributionEntry Contribution(CombatCause cause)
        {
            UnitState source = null;
            foreach (UnitState candidate in units) if (candidate.Id == cause.SourceUnitId) { source = candidate; break; }
            string unitId = source == null ? "ARENA" : source.Definition.Id;
            string weaponId = source == null ? "" : source.Definition.Weapon.Id;
            string effectId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(cause.ItemId) ? "primary" : cause.ItemId;
            int tier = source == null ? 0 : source.Definition.CombatTier;
            string key = unitId + "/" + weaponId + "/" + tier + "/" + effectId;
            if (contributionIndex.TryGetValue(key, out ContributionEntry entry)) return entry;
            entry = new ContributionEntry { UnitId = unitId, WeaponId = weaponId, EffectId = effectId, Tier = tier };
            contributionIndex.Add(key, entry); contributions.Add(entry); return entry;
        }

        private void RecordDamage(CombatCause cause, float actual) { Contribution(cause).Damage += actual; }
        private void RecordHealing(CombatCause cause, float actual) { if (actual > 0) { Contribution(cause).Healing += actual; IdentityRecordHealing(actual, cause); } }
        private void RecordActivation(CombatCause cause) { ContributionEntry entry = Contribution(cause); entry.Activations = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)entry.Activations + 1); }
        private void RecordKill(CombatCause cause) { ContributionEntry entry = Contribution(cause); entry.Kills = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)entry.Kills + 1); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class EnemyInteractionRules
    {
        public static bool CanBlock(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState target) => projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy && target.Alive && target.Faction == Faction.Enemy && target.Id != projectile.SourceUnitId && target.EntranceUntil <= 0 && (target.Definition.IsBoss || target.Definition.BodyHeight >= 1.2f);
        public static bool HasCollateral(ExpandedFieldKind kind) => kind == ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle;
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly List<UnitState> deathReactions = new List<UnitState>();
        private readonly List<UnitState> heavyNeighbours = new List<UnitState>();
        private void SeparateFromHeavyEnemy(UnitState unit, float delta)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || unit.Definition.IsBoss || unit.Definition.BodyHeight >= 1.2f || unit.BodyLift != 0 || unit.EntranceUntil > Elapsed) return;
            Vector2 extent = Vector2.one * (maximumRadius + unit.Definition.Radius);
            spatial.Query(unit.Position - extent, unit.Position + extent, heavyNeighbours, true);
            foreach (UnitState neighbour in heavyNeighbours)
            {
                if (neighbour == unit || !neighbour.Alive || neighbour.Faction != Faction.Enemy || neighbour.EntranceUntil > Elapsed || !neighbour.Definition.IsBoss && neighbour.Definition.BodyHeight < 1.2f) continue;
                Vector2 offset = unit.Position - neighbour.Position;
                float clearance = unit.Definition.Radius + neighbour.Definition.Radius;
                if (offset.sqrMagnitude >= clearance * clearance) continue;
                Vector2 direction = offset.sqrMagnitude < 0.00001f ? (unit.Id % 2 == 0 ? Vector2.left : Vector2.right) : offset.normalized;
                unit.Position = ClampPosition(unit.Position + direction * Mathf.Min(clearance - offset.magnitude, delta * 1.4f), unit.Definition.Radius);
            }
        }
        private void QueueDeathReaction(UnitState target)
        {
            if (catalog.ExpandedContent && target.Faction == Faction.Enemy && target.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Puffer && deathReactions.Count < 32) deathReactions.Add(target);
        }
        private void ProcessDeathReactions()
        {
            int count = Mathf.Min(8, deathReactions.Count);
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                UnitState source = deathReactions[index];
                Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, source, source.Position, 1.6f, 0.6f, 0.3f);
            }
            deathReactions.RemoveRange(0, count);
        }
        private void ProcessHostileCollateral(ExpandedField field)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || !EnemyInteractionRules.HasCollateral(field.Kind)) return;
            foreach (UnitState target in units)
            {
                if (!target.Alive || target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || target == field.Source || field.CollateralVictims.Contains(target.Id) || !CarnivalHazards.Contains(field, target.Position, target.Definition.Radius, Elapsed)) continue;
                field.CollateralVictims.Add(target.Id);
                float damage = Mathf.Min(field.Damage * 0.6f, target.Definition.Health * (target.Definition.IsBoss ? 0.015f : 0.12f));
                ApplyDamage(target, damage, Faction.Enemy, "Hostile collision", (target.Position - field.Position).normalized, cause: field.Cause.Child("hostile-collateral"));
                if (target.Alive && !target.Definition.IsBoss)
                {
                    target.Position = ClampPosition(target.Position + (target.Position - field.Position).normalized * 0.2f * (1 - target.Definition.KnockbackResistance), target.Definition.Radius);
                    spatial.Move(target);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool MoveMutatedEnemy(UnitState enemy)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || enemy.Variant != null && enemy.Variant.Summoned || enemy.Definition.EvolutionStage == 0 || enemy.Definition.Mutation == EnemyMutation.None || catalog.RunWave <= 1) return false;
            if (enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil > enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted && enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted >= 0)
                return AdvanceMutationTravel(enemy);
            if (enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt > 0)
            {
                if (Elapsed < enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt) return true;
                enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt = 0; enemy.TelegraphUntil = 0;
                enemy.EvolutionRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 0.45f;
                enemy.EvolutionCasts++;
                ResolveMutation(enemy);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
                return true;
            }
            if (enemy.EvolutionRecoveryUntil > Elapsed) return true;
            if (enemy.NextEvolutionAttack < 0) enemy.NextEvolutionAttack = Elapsed + 2.5f + enemy.Id % 7 * 0.35f;
            if (Elapsed < enemy.NextEvolutionAttack || enemy.PendingAttack || enemy.TelegraphUntil > Elapsed || enemy.BehaviorUntil > Elapsed || enemy.ContactImpactAt > 0) return false;
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Mimic && !enemy.Awakened) return false;
            Vector2 offset = Champion.Position - enemy.Position;
            if (offset.sqrMagnitude > 56.25f) return false;
            int charging = 0;
            foreach (UnitState other in units) if (other.Alive && (other.EvolutionReleaseAt > Elapsed || other.Variant != null && other.Variant.ReleaseAt > Elapsed)) charging++;
            if (charging >= 4) { enemy.NextEvolutionAttack = Elapsed + 0.4f + enemy.Id % 5 * 0.08f; return false; }
            enemy.NextEvolutionAttack = Elapsed + 7.5f + enemy.Id % 5 * 0.35f;
            enemy.EvolutionOrigin = enemy.Position;
            enemy.EvolutionTarget = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + Vector2.ClampMagnitude(offset, 4), enemy.Definition.Radius);
            enemy.AttackDirection = offset.sqrMagnitude > 0.001f ? offset.normalized : Vector2.down;
            enemy.AttackStarted = Elapsed; enemy.AttackWindup = 0.85f;
            enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt = enemy.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + enemy.AttackWindup;
            enemy.NextAttack = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextAttack, enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt + 0.6f);
            enemy.NextBehavior = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextBehavior, enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt + 1.5f);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
            return true;
        }

        private bool AdvanceMutationTravel(UnitState enemy)
        {
            EnemyMutation kind = enemy.Definition.Mutation;
            float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted) / Mathf.Max(0.01f, enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil - enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted));
            enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.Lerp(enemy.EvolutionOrigin, enemy.EvolutionTarget, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, progress)), enemy.Definition.Radius);
            bool jumps = kind == EnemyMutation.SootPounce || kind == EnemyMutation.MimicLunge || kind == EnemyMutation.KegRebound;
            enemy.BodyLift = kind == EnemyMutation.BellEruption ? -Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * 0.5f : jumps ? Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * 0.85f : 0;
            if (progress < 1) return true;
            enemy.BodyLift = 0; enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted = enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil = -100;
            if (enemy.EvolutionRepeats > 0)
            {
                enemy.EvolutionRepeats--;
                Vector2 heading = enemy.AttackDirection;
                Vector2 target = kind == EnemyMutation.RamBackstep ? enemy.Position + heading * 4 : enemy.Position + Vector2.ClampMagnitude(Champion.Position - enemy.Position, 2.3f);
                BeginMutationTravel(enemy, target, kind == EnemyMutation.RamBackstep ? 0.65f : 0.8f);
                Danger(kind == EnemyMutation.RamBackstep ? ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle : ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.EvolutionTarget, kind == EnemyMutation.RamBackstep ? 0.25f : 1.6f, kind == EnemyMutation.RamBackstep ? 0.15f : 0.8f, 0.6f);
            }
            else enemy.EvolutionRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 0.45f;
            return true;
        }

        private void BeginMutationTravel(UnitState enemy, Vector2 target, float duration)
        {
            enemy.EvolutionOrigin = enemy.Position; enemy.EvolutionTarget = ClampPosition(target, enemy.Definition.Radius);
            enemy.EvolutionTravelStarted = Elapsed; enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil = Elapsed + duration;
            enemy.NextAttack = enemy.NextBehavior = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextBehavior, enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil + 0.7f);
        }

        private void MutationVolley(UnitState enemy, int count, float spread, HostileShot motion, bool radial = false)
        {
            if (catalog.RunWave <= 1) return;
            float aim = Mathf.Atan2(enemy.AttackDirection.y, enemy.AttackDirection.x);
            CombatCause cause = NewCause(enemy.Id).Child("mutation-volley");
            for (int index = 0; index < count && projectiles.Count < 4096; index++)
            {
                float angle = radial ? index * Mathf.PI * 2 / count + aim : aim + (index - (count - 1) * 0.5f) * spread;
                Vector2 heading = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle), Mathf.Sin(angle));
                Vector2 origin = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + heading * enemy.Definition.Radius * 0.8f, 0.05f);
                float speed = motion == HostileShot.Accelerate ? 2.2f : 1.8f;
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Faction = Faction.Enemy, SourceUnitId = enemy.Id, Position = origin, PreviousPosition = origin, Velocity = heading * speed, LaunchVelocity = heading * speed, HostileMotion = motion, Damage = enemy.Definition.Weapon.Damage, Remaining = 4.5f, Radius = 0.09f, VisualWidth = enemy.Definition.Mutation == EnemyMutation.FurnaceFan ? 0.38f : 0.27f, Sprite = EnemyEvolutionLibrary.Fragment(enemy.Definition, index), Color = new Color(1, 0.25f, 0.4f), SourceName = enemy.Definition.DisplayName + " mutation", Cause = cause });
            }
        }

        private void ResolveMutation(UnitState enemy)
        {
            Vector2 target = enemy.EvolutionTarget;
            Vector2 heading = enemy.AttackDirection;
            Vector2 side = new Vector2(-heading.y, heading.x);
            switch (enemy.Definition.Mutation)
            {
                case EnemyMutation.SootPounce:
                case EnemyMutation.MimicLunge:
                    BeginMutationTravel(enemy, target, 0.7f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, target, enemy.Definition.Mutation == EnemyMutation.MimicLunge ? 1.9f : 1.4f, 0.7f, 0.8f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.BatCrossfire:
                    BeginMutationTravel(enemy, enemy.Position + side * (enemy.Id % 2 == 0 ? 1.8f : -1.8f), 0.45f);
                    MutationVolley(enemy, 3, 0.28f, HostileShot.Hook);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.BristleRush:
                    BeginMutationTravel(enemy, target, 0.6f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, target, 0.24f, 0.25f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.RuneSpiral:
                    MutationVolley(enemy, 6, 0, HostileShot.Hook, true);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.MothMolting:
                    for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index += 2) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, enemy, target + side * index, 0.65f, 0.6f, 1.4f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.SirenEcho:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 2.7f, 0.25f, 1.2f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 2.2f, 1.05f, 1.2f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.DoorSlam:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, enemy.Position + heading * 3, 0.5f, 0.3f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.MagnetSalvo:
                    foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups)
                        if (pickup.Kind == LootKind.Coin && !pickup.Attracting && (pickup.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 9)
                            pickup.Position = Vector2.Lerp(pickup.Position, enemy.Position, 0.45f);
                    MutationVolley(enemy, 4, 0.2f, HostileShot.Weave);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.CurtainCollapse:
                    for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, enemy, target + side * ((index - 1) * 1.3f), 0.65f, 0.6f + index * 0.2f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.FurnaceFan:
                    MutationVolley(enemy, 5, 0.22f, HostileShot.Accelerate);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.CabinetScissor:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, target + side * 1.2f, 0.32f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, target - side * 1.2f, 0.32f, 0.7f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.KegRebound:
                    enemy.EvolutionRepeats = 1; BeginMutationTravel(enemy, target, 0.8f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, target, 1.6f, 0.8f, 0.8f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.RamBackstep:
                    enemy.EvolutionRepeats = 1; BeginMutationTravel(enemy, enemy.Position - heading * 1.1f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.CoinBarrage:
                    for (int index = pickups.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
                    {
                        PickupState coin = pickups[index];
                        if (coin.Kind != LootKind.Coin || coin.Attracting || coin.Value <= 0 || coin.Value > 1000 - enemy.StolenCoins || (coin.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > 9) continue;
                        enemy.StolenCoins += coin.Value; pickups.RemoveAt(index);
                    }
                    if (enemy.StolenCoins > 0) MutationVolley(enemy, Mathf.Min(5, 2 + enemy.StolenCoins / 3), 0.23f, HostileShot.Drift);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.PufferEcho:
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 3, 0.25f, 1.1f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 1.7f, 1.1f, 0.8f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.SporeGarden:
                    for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
                    {
                        Vector2 offset = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index * 120) * Vector2.right * 1.25f;
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, enemy, target + offset, 0.65f, 0.65f + index * 0.18f, 1.6f);
                    }
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.CombRake:
                    for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, target + side * index * 1.1f, 0.2f, 0.3f + (index + 1) * 0.2f, 0.35f);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.HydraWeave:
                    MutationVolley(enemy, 5, 0.21f, HostileShot.Weave);
                    break;
                case EnemyMutation.BellEruption:
                    BeginMutationTravel(enemy, target, 0.9f);
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, target, 2.3f, 0.9f, 1.1f);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private sealed class AshRemnant { public Vector2 Position; public float Until; }
        private readonly List<AshRemnant> ashRemnants = new List<AshRemnant>();
        public void ConfigureEnemyVariantCapture()
        {
            if (!RunPaths.K7Capture) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Enemy variant fixture requires isolated capture mode");
            catalog.EnemyBudget = 24; nextSpawn = float.PositiveInfinity;
            catalog.EnableArenaToys = catalog.EnableSpectacles = catalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
        }
        private EnemyVariantState NewEnemyVariant(UnitState enemy) => new EnemyVariantState { NextSpecial = Elapsed + 2.2f + enemy.Id % 5 * 0.3f, NextAffix = Elapsed + 4 + enemy.Id % 7 * 0.25f, AssignedAt = Elapsed };
        private void ClearEnemyVariants()
        {
            ashRemnants.Clear();
            foreach (UnitState unit in units)
                if (unit.Variant != null) { unit.Variant.ReleaseAt = 0; unit.Variant.RecoveryUntil = 0; unit.Variant.TravelEnd = -100; unit.Variant.DecoyUntil = 0; }
        }
        private void InitializeEnemyVariant(UnitState enemy)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || enemy.Variant == null || enemy.Variant.Affix != EnemyAffix.None || enemy.SwarmMinion || enemy.Variant.Summoned || enemy.Definition.IsBoss || catalog.RunWave < 5) return;
            int affixed = 0;
            foreach (UnitState other in units) if (other.Alive && other.Variant != null && other.Variant.Affix != EnemyAffix.None) affixed++;
            uint seed = unchecked((uint)runSeed ^ (uint)enemy.Id * 2654435761u ^ (uint)catalog.RunWave * 2246822519u);
            seed ^= seed >> 16;
            int chance = Mathf.Min(24, 8 + catalog.RunWave - 5);
            if (affixed >= 4 || seed % 100 >= chance) return;
            uint kind = (seed / 100) % 100;
            enemy.Variant.Affix = kind < 35 ? EnemyAffix.BlackSmoke : kind < 60 ? EnemyAffix.BlueFlame : kind < 85 ? EnemyAffix.RedFlame : kind < 95 ? EnemyAffix.Blackfire : EnemyAffix.TwinFlame;
            EmpowerEnemyVariant(enemy);
        }
        private void EmpowerEnemyVariant(UnitState enemy)
        {
            UnitDefinition boosted = System.Array.Find(catalog.AffixedEnemies, unit => unit.Id == enemy.Definition.Id);
            if (boosted == null || boosted == enemy.Definition) return;
            float healthRatio = enemy.Health / Mathf.Max(1, enemy.Definition.Health);
            enemy.Definition = boosted; enemy.Health = boosted.Health * healthRatio;
            maximumRadius = Mathf.Max(maximumRadius, boosted.Radius); maximumSpeed = Mathf.Max(maximumSpeed, boosted.Speed);
        }
        private void RememberVariantDeath(UnitState target)
        {
            if (target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || target.Definition.IsBoss) return;
            if (target.Variant == null || !target.Variant.Summoned)
            {
                if (ashRemnants.Count == 24) ashRemnants.RemoveAt(0);
                ashRemnants.Add(new AshRemnant { Position = target.Position, Until = Elapsed + 7 });
            }
            foreach (UnitState follower in units)
                if (follower.Alive && follower.Variant != null && follower.Variant.LeaderId == target.Id)
                {
                    follower.Variant.LeaderLost = true;
                    follower.Variant.NextSpecial = Elapsed + 3;
                    follower.Variant.RecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                }
        }
        private int ActiveSpecialists()
        {
            int active = 0;
            foreach (UnitState unit in units) if (unit.Alive && unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy && unit.Definition.SpecialEnemy != SpecialEnemyKind.None && (unit.Variant == null || !unit.Variant.Summoned)) active++;
            return active;
        }
        private bool MoveEnemyVariant(UnitState enemy)
        {
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            if (state == null || !catalog.ExpandedContent) return false;
            if (state.Summoned && Elapsed - state.AssignedAt > 12)
            {
                enemy.Alive = false;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Kill, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subjectId: enemy.Id, subject: enemy));
                return true;
            }
            if (state.TravelEnd > state.TravelStart && state.TravelStart >= 0)
            {
                float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - state.TravelStart) / Mathf.Max(0.01f, state.TravelEnd - state.TravelStart));
                enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.Lerp(state.Origin, state.Target, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, progress)), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                enemy.BodyLift = !state.CastingAffix && enemy.Definition.SpecialEnemy == SpecialEnemyKind.LostLanternSoul ? Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * 0.65f : 0;
                if (progress >= 1) { state.TravelStart = state.TravelEnd = -100; state.RecoveryUntil = Mathf.Max(state.RecoveryUntil, Elapsed + 0.65f); enemy.BodyLift = 0; }
                return true;
            }
            if (state.ReleaseAt > 0)
            {
                if (Elapsed < state.ReleaseAt) return true;
                state.ReleaseAt = 0; enemy.TelegraphUntil = 0; state.RecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 0.6f;
                if (state.CastingAffix) { state.AffixCasts++; ResolveEnemyAffix(enemy); }
                else { state.SpecialCasts++; ResolveSpecialEnemy(enemy); }
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
                return true;
            }
            if (state.RecoveryUntil > Elapsed) return true;
            if (state.Summoned && state.LeaderId > 0 && !state.LeaderLost)
            {
                UnitState leader = UnitWithId(state.LeaderId);
                if (leader != null && !leader.Alive) leader = null;
                if (leader != null)
                {
                    bool flanking = Elapsed - state.AssignedAt > 3 && leader.Variant.SpecialCasts % 2 == 0;
                    Vector2 side = new Vector2(-leader.Facing.y, leader.Facing.x) * (enemy.Id % 2 == 0 ? -1 : 1);
                    Vector2 formation = flanking ? Champion.Position + side * 1.6f : leader.Position + side * 0.9f - leader.Facing * 0.5f;
                    float delta = Mathf.Clamp(Elapsed - state.LastMovement, 0, 0.1f); state.LastMovement = Elapsed;
                    enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(enemy.Position, formation, enemy.Definition.Speed * delta), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                    enemy.Facing = (Champion.Position - enemy.Position).normalized;
                    return true;
                }
                state.LeaderLost = true;
            }
            if (catalog.RunWave <= 1 || state.Summoned || state.LeaderLost || enemy.PendingAttack || enemy.EvolutionReleaseAt > 0 || enemy.EvolutionTravelUntil > Elapsed || enemy.EvolutionRecoveryUntil > Elapsed || enemy.BehaviorUntil > Elapsed || enemy.TelegraphUntil > Elapsed || enemy.ContactImpactAt > 0) return false;
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Mimic && !enemy.Awakened) return false;
            bool blackfire = state.Affix == EnemyAffix.Blackfire;
            bool affixReady = state.Affix != EnemyAffix.None && Elapsed >= state.NextAffix && (!blackfire || !state.BlackfireSpent && enemy.Health < enemy.Definition.Health * 0.4f);
            bool specialReady = enemy.Definition.SpecialEnemy != SpecialEnemyKind.None && Elapsed >= state.NextSpecial;
            if (!affixReady && !specialReady || (Champion.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > 64) return false;
            int casting = 0;
            foreach (UnitState other in units) if (other.Alive && (other.EvolutionReleaseAt > Elapsed || other.Variant != null && other.Variant.ReleaseAt > Elapsed)) casting++;
            if (casting >= 4) return false;
            state.CastingAffix = affixReady;
            state.Heading = (Champion.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > 0.001f ? (Champion.Position - enemy.Position).normalized : Vector2.down;
            state.Target = ClampPosition(enemy.Position + Vector2.ClampMagnitude(Champion.Position - enemy.Position, 4.5f), enemy.Definition.Radius);
            state.Origin = enemy.Position;
            state.ReleaseAt = Elapsed + (blackfire && affixReady ? 1.2f : 1);
            if (affixReady) state.NextAffix = Elapsed + 9 + enemy.Id % 3;
            else state.NextSpecial = Elapsed + 6.5f + enemy.Id % 4 * 0.4f;
            enemy.AttackStarted = Elapsed; enemy.AttackWindup = state.ReleaseAt - Elapsed;
            enemy.AttackDirection = state.Heading; enemy.Facing = state.Heading; enemy.TelegraphUntil = state.ReleaseAt;
            enemy.NextAttack = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextAttack, state.ReleaseAt + 1.3f); enemy.NextBehavior = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextBehavior, state.ReleaseAt + 1.6f);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, enemy.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: enemy, weapon: enemy.Definition.Weapon));
            return true;
        }
        private void VariantTravel(UnitState enemy, Vector2 destination, float duration)
        {
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            state.Origin = enemy.Position; state.Target = ClampPosition(destination, enemy.Definition.Radius);
            state.TravelStart = Elapsed; state.TravelEnd = Elapsed + duration;
            enemy.NextAttack = Mathf.Max(enemy.NextAttack, state.TravelEnd + 0.7f);
        }
        private void SmokeFeint(UnitState enemy)
        {
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            state.DecoyPosition = enemy.Position; state.DecoyUntil = Elapsed + 1.6f;
            Vector2 side = new Vector2(-state.Heading.y, state.Heading.x) * (enemy.Id % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
            VariantTravel(enemy, enemy.Position + side * 1.7f, 0.55f);
        }
        private void VariantVolley(UnitState enemy, int count, bool blue, float power = 1)
        {
            if (catalog.RunWave <= 1) return;
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            Vector2 origin = enemy.Position;
            if (enemy.Definition.SpecialEnemy == SpecialEnemyKind.LostLanternSoul)
                origin += new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(Elapsed * 1.3f), Mathf.Sin(Elapsed * 1.3f)) * 0.65f;
            CombatCause cause = NewCause(enemy.Id).Child(state.CastingAffix ? "enemy-affix" : "special-enemy");
            for (int index = 0; index < count && projectiles.Count < 4096; index++)
            {
                Vector2 direction = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (index - (count - 1) * 0.5f) * 19) * state.Heading;
                Sprite sprite = EnemyAffixLibrary.Effect(blue ? 1 : 2, index * 0.11f);
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Faction = Faction.Enemy, SourceUnitId = enemy.Id, Position = origin, PreviousPosition = origin, Velocity = direction * 1.65f, LaunchVelocity = direction * 1.65f, HostileMotion = blue ? HostileShot.Hook : HostileShot.Accelerate, Damage = enemy.Definition.Weapon.Damage * power, Remaining = 3.2f, Radius = 0.085f, Sprite = sprite, VisualWidth = 0.29f, Color = blue ? new Color(0.45f, 0.9f, 1) : new Color(1, 0.42f, 0.2f), SourceName = enemy.Definition.DisplayName + (state.CastingAffix ? " affix" : " special"), Cause = cause });
            }
        }
        private void RedCharge(UnitState enemy)
        {
            Vector2 target = enemy.Variant.Target;
            VariantTravel(enemy, target, 0.8f);
            Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, target, 0.23f, 0.25f, 0.45f);
        }
        private void ResolveEnemyAffix(UnitState enemy)
        {
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            switch (state.Affix)
            {
                case EnemyAffix.BlackSmoke: SmokeFeint(enemy); break;
                case EnemyAffix.BlueFlame: VariantVolley(enemy, 3, true, 0.75f); break;
                case EnemyAffix.RedFlame: RedCharge(enemy); state.RecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.4f; break;
                case EnemyAffix.Blackfire:
                    state.BlackfireSpent = true;
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, enemy.Position, 2.6f, 0.45f, 1.1f);
                    break;
                case EnemyAffix.TwinFlame:
                    if (state.AffixCasts % 2 == 1) VariantVolley(enemy, 3, true, 0.75f); else RedCharge(enemy);
                    break;
            }
        }
        private void ResolveSpecialEnemy(UnitState enemy)
        {
            EnemyVariantState state = enemy.Variant;
            bool evolved = enemy.Definition.EvolutionStage > 0;
            switch (enemy.Definition.SpecialEnemy)
            {
                case SpecialEnemyKind.SmokeWraith:
                    SmokeFeint(enemy);
                    if (evolved) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, state.DecoyPosition + state.Heading * 2.2f, 0.18f, 0.85f, 0.3f);
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.BlueFlameFiend: VariantVolley(enemy, evolved ? 4 : 3, true); break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.RedFlameBerserker:
                    RedCharge(enemy);
                    if (evolved) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, enemy, state.Origin, 0.55f, 0.6f, 1.2f);
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.TwinFlameFurnace:
                    if (state.SpecialCasts % 2 == 1) VariantVolley(enemy, evolved ? 4 : 3, true); else { RedCharge(enemy); if (evolved) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, state.Target, 1.6f, 0.8f, 0.8f); }
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.AshSwallower:
                    for (int index = ashRemnants.Count - 1; index >= 0 && state.AshMeals < 3; index--)
                    {
                        AshRemnant remnant = ashRemnants[index];
                        if (remnant.Until < Elapsed || (remnant.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > 12.25f) continue;
                        ashRemnants.RemoveAt(index); state.AshMeals++;
                    }
                    VariantVolley(enemy, 1 + state.AshMeals, false, 0.65f + state.AshMeals * 0.15f);
                    if (evolved && state.AshMeals > 0) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, enemy, state.Target, 0.6f, 0.8f, 1.2f);
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.LostLanternSoul:
                    if (state.SpecialCasts % 2 == 1) VariantVolley(enemy, evolved ? 3 : 2, true);
                    else { VariantTravel(enemy, state.Target, 0.8f); Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, enemy, state.Target, evolved ? 1.8f : 1.3f, 0.8f, 0.7f); }
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.SmokingCoffin:
                    if (enemy.Health < enemy.Definition.Health * 0.5f) state.CoffinBroken = true;
                    if (state.CoffinBroken) { RedCharge(enemy); state.NextSpecial = Elapsed + 4.5f; }
                    else
                    {
                        SummonVariantChildren(enemy, evolved ? 3 : 2, false);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, enemy, enemy.Position + state.Heading * 2.2f, 0.25f, 0.6f, 0.35f);
                    }
                    break;
                case SpecialEnemyKind.EmberProcession:
                    if (!state.ProcessionLeader) { state.ProcessionLeader = true; SummonVariantChildren(enemy, 2, true); }
                    VariantVolley(enemy, evolved ? 3 : 2, false, 0.8f);
                    break;
            }
        }
        private void SummonVariantChildren(UnitState source, int count, bool procession)
        {
            if (catalog.RunWave <= 1) return;
            int summons = 0, enemies = 0;
            foreach (UnitState other in units) if (other.Alive && other.Faction == Faction.Enemy) { enemies++; if (other.Variant != null && other.Variant.Summoned) summons++; }
            for (int index = 0; index < count && summons < 12 && enemies < Mathf.Min(240, catalog.EnemyBudget); index++, summons++, enemies++)
            {
                UnitDefinition definition = procession ? source.Definition : SwarmDefinition();
                Vector2 offset = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index * 110 + source.Id) * Vector2.right * 1.1f;
                Vector2 position = ClampPosition(source.Position + offset, definition.Radius);
                if ((position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude < 2.25f) continue;
                UnitState child = Spawn(definition, Faction.Enemy, position);
                child.Health *= 0.35f; child.SwarmMinion = true; child.EntranceUntil = Elapsed + 0.55f;
                child.Variant.Summoned = true; child.Variant.LeaderId = procession ? source.Id : 0;
                child.NextAttack = child.NextContact = Elapsed + 1.1f;
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class EnemyVariantState
    {
        public EnemyAffix Affix;
        public bool CastingAffix;
        public float ReleaseAt;
        public float RecoveryUntil;
        public float NextAffix;
        public float NextSpecial;
        public float TravelStart = -100;
        public float TravelEnd = -100;
        public Vector2 Origin;
        public Vector2 Target;
        public Vector2 Heading;
        public int AffixCasts;
        public int SpecialCasts;
        public int AshMeals;
        public bool BlackfireSpent;
        public bool Summoned;
        public bool ProcessionLeader;
        public int LeaderId;
        public bool LeaderLost;
        public bool CoffinBroken;
        public float DecoyUntil;
        public Vector2 DecoyPosition;
        public float AssignedAt;
        public float LastMovement;
        public bool Busy(float time) => ReleaseAt > 0 || RecoveryUntil > time || TravelEnd > time;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum ExpandedFieldKind { Tea, Iron, Fuse, Strike, Link, Photo, Echo, OfficeHazard, ToyHazard, Curtain, Ink, Projector, MagnetCone, YoYoTether, SewingLink, Tentacle, Shockwave, FallingProp, ShadowPool }
    public sealed class ExpandedField
    {
        public ExpandedFieldKind Kind;
        public Vector2 Position;
        public Vector2 Start;
        public Vector2 Direction;
        public float Radius;
        public float At;
        public float Created;
        public float Until;
        public float NextTick;
        public float Damage;
        public UnitState Source;
        public UnitState Target;
        public CombatCause Cause;
        public bool Resolved;
        public ProjectileState Projectile;
        public WeaponDefinition ImpactWeapon;
        public bool Critical;
        public UnitState Anchor;
        public int SourceOrgan = -1;
        public readonly HashSet<int> CollateralVictims = new HashSet<int>();
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly List<ExpandedField> fields = new List<ExpandedField>();
        public IReadOnlyList<ExpandedField> ExpandedFields => fields;
        public int ExpandedPayoffs { get; private set; }
        private float treasureUntil;
        private float nextRepair;
        private bool bossMotifConsumed;
        private void ResetExpansion() { ClearExpansion(); ExpandedPayoffs = 0; bossMotifConsumed = false; }
        private void ClearExpansion() { fields.Clear(); treasureUntil = nextRepair = 0; ClearSpectacle(); deathReactions.Clear(); ClearCooperation(); ClearEnemyVariants(); ClearBuildMorphs(); ClearOctoberBosses(); }

        private void Field(ExpandedFieldKind kind, UnitState source, Vector2 position, Vector2 direction, float radius, float damage, float delay, float duration, CombatCause cause, UnitState target = null)
        {
            int depth = kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse || kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike ? cause.Depth : cause.Depth + 1;
            fields.Add(new ExpandedField { Kind = kind, Source = source, Position = position, Start = source == null ? position : source.Position, Direction = direction, Radius = radius, Damage = damage, Created = Elapsed, At = Elapsed + delay, Until = Elapsed + delay + duration, NextTick = Elapsed + delay, Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, cause.SourceUnitId, "expanded-" + kind.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), depth), Target = target });
        }

        private bool ResolveExpandedAttack(UnitState source, float damage, bool critical, CombatCause cause)
        {
            ResolveCooperationAttack(source, damage, cause);
            WeaponDefinition weapon = source.Definition.Weapon;
            if (weapon.Mechanic != CarnivalWeapon.None && source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return ResolveCarnivalAttack(source, damage, critical, cause);
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.None || source.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return false;
            source.ExpandedBeat++;
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Tea || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Fish || weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox)
            {
                EmitProjectile(source, damage, critical, cause); return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Alarm)
            {
                UnitState target = UnitWithId(source.AttackTargetId);
                if (target != null && !target.Alive) target = null;
                if (target != null) Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse, source, ClampPosition(target.Position, 0.3f), source.AttackDirection, source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 1.8f : 1.5f, damage, 0.9f, 0.25f, cause);
                return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Camera)
            {
                int count = 0;
                foreach (UnitState target in units)
                {
                    Vector2 delta = target.Position - source.Position;
                    if (!CanHit(source.Faction, target) || delta.sqrMagnitude > weapon.Range * weapon.Range || Vector2.Dot(delta.normalized, source.AttackDirection) < 0.55f || count >= (source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 4 : 3)) continue;
                    target.CameraWeakUntil = target.ExposedUntil = Elapsed + 2f; target.WeaknessSourceId = source.Id;
                    ApplyDamage(target, damage, source.Faction, "Sleep camera", source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause: cause);
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Photo, source, target.Position, source.AttackDirection, 0.42f, 0, 0, 0.22f, cause); count++;
                }
                RecordActivation(new CombatCause(cause.RootId, source.Id, "camera-weakspot", 1)); return true;
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Scissors)
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -18) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.65f, 0, 0.05f, cause);
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 18) * source.AttackDirection, weapon.Range, damage * 0.65f, 0.12f, 0.1f, cause); return true;
            }
            foreach (UnitState target in units)
            {
                Vector2 delta = target.Position - source.Position;
                if (!CanHit(source.Faction, target) || delta.magnitude > weapon.Range + target.Definition.Radius || Vector2.Dot(delta.normalized, source.AttackDirection) < weapon.ConeDot) continue;
                bool burning = target.BurnUntil > Elapsed;
                ApplyWeaponDamage(target, damage, source.Faction, weapon.Element, weapon.Id, source.AttackDirection, weapon, critical, cause);
                if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Hammer && source.ExpandedBeat % 3 == 0 && burning)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, source.AttackDirection, 1.1f, damage * 0.3f, 0.1f, 0.12f, cause);
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Iron)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Iron, source, source.Position + source.AttackDirection, source.AttackDirection, source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 0.55f : 0.4f, damage * 0.3f, 0, 1.4f, cause);
            else if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Hammer && source.ExpandedBeat % 3 == 0)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, source.Position + source.AttackDirection * 0.8f, source.AttackDirection, 1.7f, damage * 0.55f, 0.1f, 0.16f, cause);
            return true;
        }

        private int MoveExpandedProjectile(ProjectileState projectile, float delta)
        {
            if (projectile.Weapon == null) return 0;
            ExpandedWeapon family = projectile.Weapon.Family;
            projectile.Age += delta;
            if ((family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox || projectile.Weapon.HomingOutbound && !projectile.Returning) && projectile.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
            {
                UnitState nearest = null; float best = 16;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    float distance = (enemy.Position - projectile.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || projectile.Victims.Contains(enemy.Id) || distance >= best) continue;
                    nearest = enemy; best = distance;
                }
                if (nearest != null) projectile.Velocity = Vector2.Lerp(projectile.Velocity, (nearest.Position - projectile.Position).normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed, Mathf.Clamp01(delta * 4));
            }
            if ((family != ExpandedWeapon.Fish && !projectile.Weapon.SecretRecall) || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return 0;
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SatelliteDisc)
            {
                if (projectile.Age < 0.55f) return 0;
                if (projectile.Age < 1.55f)
                {
                    UnitState target = UnitWithId(projectile.OrbitTargetId);
                    if (target != null && !target.Alive) target = null;
                    if (target != null) projectile.OrbitCenter = target.Position;
                    Vector2 radius = projectile.Position - projectile.OrbitCenter;
                    Vector2 outward = radius.sqrMagnitude < 0.001f ? Vector2.right : radius.normalized;
                    Vector2 tangent = new Vector2(-outward.y, outward.x);
                    projectile.Velocity = (tangent + outward * Mathf.Clamp((0.85f - radius.magnitude) * 2, -1.5f, 1.5f)).normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            if (projectile.Age > 0.7f && !projectile.Returning)
            {
                projectile.Returning = true;
                ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileReturn, projectile);
            }
            if (!projectile.Returning) return 0;
            UnitState owner = UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            if (owner != null && !owner.Alive) owner = null;
            if (owner == null) return -1;
            Vector2 offset = owner.Position - projectile.Position;
            if (offset.sqrMagnitude < Mathf.Pow(Mathf.Max(0.2f, projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed * delta), 2) || projectile.Remaining <= 0) return -1;
            projectile.Velocity = offset.normalized * projectile.Weapon.ProjectileSpeed;
            return 0;
        }

        private void OnExpandedProjectileHit(ProjectileState projectile, UnitState target)
        {
            if (projectile.Weapon == null || projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return;
            UnitState source = UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            if (source == null) return;
            ApplyCarnivalProjectilePayoff(projectile, target, source);
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.BloomOrb && !projectile.IsFragment)
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 1.5f, projectile.Damage * 0.45f, 0.28f, 0.35f, projectile.Cause.Child("moonseed-bloom"));
                fields[fields.Count - 1].Critical = projectile.Critical;
                fields[fields.Count - 1].ImpactWeapon = projectile.Weapon;
            }
            ExpandedWeapon family = projectile.Weapon.Family;
            if (projectile.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Sewing && target.Alive)
            {
                bool freshlyPinned = target.ChillUntil <= Elapsed;
                target.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(target.ChillUntil, Elapsed + (target.Definition.IsBoss ? 0.15f : 0.35f));
                if (freshlyPinned) events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.StatusApplied, target.Position, target.Faction, element: DamageElement.Frost, cause: projectile.Cause));
            }
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.Tea && !projectile.IsFragment)
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Tea, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 0.7f * (catalog.TeaCoasterStacks > 0 ? 1.4f : 1), projectile.Damage * 0.25f * (catalog.TeaCoasterStacks > 0 ? 0.8f : 1), 0, 1.8f, projectile.Cause);
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow && projectile.Victims.Count == 1)
            {
                UnitState previous = target; var visited = new HashSet<int> { target.Id };
                for (int link = 0; link < (source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 ? 3 : 2); link++)
                {
                    UnitState next = null; float best = 4;
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    {
                        float distance = (enemy.Position - previous.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                        if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || visited.Contains(enemy.Id) || distance >= best) continue;
                        next = enemy; best = distance;
                    }
                    if (next == null) break;
                    var linkField = new ExpandedField { Kind = ExpandedFieldKind.Link, Start = previous.Position, Position = next.Position, At = Elapsed, Until = Elapsed + 0.24f, Resolved = true };
                    fields.Add(linkField); visited.Add(next.Id);
                    ApplyDamage(next, projectile.Damage * 0.25f, source.Faction, "Zipper tether", cause: projectile.Cause.Child("zipper-link")); previous = next;
                }
            }
            if (family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox && projectile.FinalNote)
            {
                StampState ownedMark = null;
                foreach (StampState mark in stamps.Values) if (mark.Target == target && mark.Expires > Elapsed) { ownedMark = mark; break; }
                if (ownedMark != null) ownedMark.Expires = Mathf.Max(ownedMark.Expires, Elapsed + 0.6f);
                if (catalog.ChorusStacks > 0)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, target.Position, Vector2.zero, 1.3f, projectile.Damage * Mathf.Min(0.7f, 0.35f * catalog.ChorusStacks), 0.3f, 0.18f, projectile.Cause);
            }
        }

        private void ProcessExpansion(float delta)
        {
            ProcessCooperation();
            ProcessDeathReactions();
            ProcessExpandedRelics(); ProcessBossMotif();
            for (int index = fields.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                ExpandedField field = fields[index];
                if (Elapsed > field.Until) { fields.RemoveAt(index); continue; }
                bool ink = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Ink;
                if (Elapsed < field.At || field.Resolved || Elapsed < field.NextTick || (field.Damage <= 0 && !ink)) continue;
                bool heat = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Tea || field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Iron;
                if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike && field.Source != null && field.Source.Definition.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.RibbonWheel) field.Position = field.Source.Position;
                field.NextTick = Elapsed + (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave ? 0.05f : 0.4f); field.Resolved = !heat && !ink && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.Projector && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave && field.Kind != ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool;
                ExpandedPayoffs++;
                if (field.Source == null || field.Source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) RecordActivation(field.Cause);
                if (CarnivalHazards.IsHostile(field.Kind))
                {
                    ProcessHostileCollateral(field);
                    if (Champion.Alive && CarnivalHazards.Contains(field, Champion.Position, Champion.Definition.Radius, Elapsed))
                    {
                        ApplyDamage(Champion, Mathf.Min(field.Damage, Champion.Definition.Health * 0.08f), Faction.Enemy, field.Kind.ToString(), cause: field.Cause);
                        field.Resolved = true;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy) continue;
                    Vector2 offset = enemy.Position - field.Position;
                    bool inside = field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Iron ? SegmentCircle(field.Position - field.Direction, field.Position + field.Direction, enemy.Position, field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius) >= 0 : offset.sqrMagnitude <= (field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius) * (field.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius);
                    if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Strike) inside &= Vector2.Dot(offset.normalized, field.Direction) >= 0.8f;
                    if (!inside) continue;
                    if (ink) { enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.6f); continue; }
                    if (field.Kind == ExpandedFieldKind.Projector && field.Source != null && field.Source.Definition.CombatTier >= 2 && !enemy.Definition.IsBoss)
                    {
                        enemy.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(enemy.Position, field.Position, 0.12f * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(enemy.Definition.KnockbackResistance))), enemy.Definition.Radius);
                        enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + 0.25f); spatial.Move(enemy);
                    }
                    ApplyDamage(enemy, field.Damage, field.Source == null ? Faction.Companion : field.Source.Faction, field.Cause.ItemId, field.Direction, field.ImpactWeapon != null ? field.ImpactWeapon : field.Cause.Depth == 0 && field.Source != null ? field.Source.Definition.Weapon : null, critical: field.Critical, cause: field.Cause);
                    if (heat && enemy.Alive)
                    {
                        enemy.BurnUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.BurnUntil, Elapsed + 0.6f); enemy.BurnCause = field.Cause.Child("heat-status");
                        if (catalog.ThermalInk && enemy.VisibleMarks > 0 && Elapsed >= enemy.NextThermal)
                        {
                            enemy.NextThermal = Elapsed + 0.9f; ApplyDamage(enemy, field.Damage * 0.4f, Faction.Companion, "Thermal ink", cause: field.Cause.Child("thermal-ink"));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void ProcessExpandedRelics()
        {
            int original = events.Count;
            for (int index = 0; index < original; index++)
            {
                CombatEvent trigger = events[index];
                if (catalog.TreasureStacks > 0 && trigger.Kind == CombatEventKind.ChestOpened && trigger.Cause.Depth == 0)
                {
                    treasureUntil = Elapsed + 4; Heal(3 * catalog.TreasureStacks, trigger.Cause.Child("treasure-ribbon")); RecordActivation(trigger.Cause.Child("treasure-ribbon"));
                }
                if (catalog.RepairStacks > 0 && trigger.Kind == CombatEventKind.Kill && trigger.Faction == Faction.Enemy && trigger.Cause.ItemId != null && trigger.Cause.ItemId.StartsWith("arena-") && Elapsed >= nextRepair)
                {
                    nextRepair = Elapsed + 0.6f; Heal(catalog.RepairStacks, trigger.Cause.Child("repair-coupon")); RecordActivation(trigger.Cause.Child("repair-coupon"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool MoveExpandedEnemy(UnitState enemy, float delta)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Standard) return false;
            Vector2 offset = Champion.Position - enemy.Position;
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior >= EnemyBehavior.Hopper) return MoveCarnivalEnemy(enemy, offset, delta);
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Mimic && !enemy.Awakened)
            {
                if (offset.sqrMagnitude > 9f && enemy.Health >= enemy.Definition.Health) return true;
                enemy.Awakened = true;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.MimicWake, enemy.Position, enemy.Faction, subject: enemy));
                enemy.BehaviorUntil = Elapsed + 0.8f;
                enemy.TelegraphUntil = enemy.BehaviorUntil;
            }
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Magnet && Elapsed >= enemy.NextBehavior)
            {
                enemy.NextBehavior = Elapsed + 4f;
                enemy.BehaviorUntil = Elapsed + 1.2f;
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Link, enemy, enemy.Position, Vector2.zero, 3f, 0, 0, 1.2f, NewCause(enemy.Id));
            }
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Magnet && enemy.BehaviorUntil > Elapsed)
                foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups)
                    if (pickup.Kind == LootKind.Coin && (pickup.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 9f)
                        pickup.Position = Vector2.MoveTowards(pickup.Position, enemy.Position, delta * 1.5f);
            if (enemy.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Curtain && Elapsed >= enemy.NextBehavior)
            {
                enemy.NextBehavior = Elapsed + 6f;
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Curtain, enemy, ClampPosition(Champion.Position, 0.8f), Vector2.right, 1.2f, 5f, 1.3f, 0.3f, NewCause(enemy.Id));
            }
            return false;
        }

        private void ProcessBossMotif()
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent || Boss == null || !Boss.Alive || bossMotifConsumed || Boss.Health > Boss.Definition.Health * 0.5f) return;
            bossMotifConsumed = true;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.BossPhase, Boss.Position, Boss.Faction, subject: Boss));
            CombatCause cause = NewCause(Boss.Id);
            if (Boss.Definition.Motif == BossMotif.Office)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.OfficeHazard, Boss, ClampPosition(Champion.Position + Vector2.right * ((index - 1) * 3f), 1.3f), Vector2.up, 1.1f, 8, 1.6f + index * 0.25f, 0.3f, cause);
            }
            else if (Boss.Definition.Motif == BossMotif.Toys)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < 4; index++)
                {
                    Vector2 direction = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index * 90f) * Vector2.right;
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.ToyHazard, Boss, ClampPosition(Boss.Position + direction * 3f, 1.4f), direction, 1.2f, 7, 1.5f, 0.3f, cause);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Curtain, Boss, ClampPosition(Champion.Position + Vector2.left * 1.8f, 1.2f), Vector2.up, 1f, 6, 1.8f, 0.3f, cause);
                Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Curtain, Boss, ClampPosition(Champion.Position + Vector2.right * 1.8f, 1.2f), Vector2.up, 1f, 6, 1.8f, 0.3f, cause);
            }
        }

        private float ExpandedDamage(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source, Vector2 direction, WeaponDefinition weapon)
        {
            if (!catalog.ExpandedContent) return damage;
            if (target.Definition.IsBoss && target.BossRecoveryUntil > Elapsed && source != Faction.Enemy) damage *= 1.15f;
            if (source != Faction.Enemy && weapon != null && target.Definition.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Door && direction.sqrMagnitude > 0.01f && Vector2.Dot(direction.normalized, target.Facing) < -0.45f)
                damage *= 0.5f;
            return damage;
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public void ExpandedDamageFixture(UnitState target, float damage, Vector2 direction, WeaponDefinition weapon) => ApplyDamage(target, damage, Faction.Companion, direction: direction, weapon: weapon, cause: NewCause(Champion.Id));
#endif
    }
}
````

````csharp
                if (IdentityId == "PetalCitadel") return "PETALS " + string.Join(" / ", catalog.HeroPetals);

        }

        private HeroIdentityGlyph IdentityGlyph(MorphGeometry shape, Vector2 at, Vector2 end, float radius, float duration = .6f, float delay = 0)
        {

                Direction = (end - at).sqrMagnitude > .001f ? (end - at).normalized : Champion.Facing,

        private void IdentityHit(MorphGeometry shape, Vector2 at, Vector2 end, float radius, float budget, float delay = .2f, int maxTargets = 3, DamageElement element = DamageElement.Physical, float slow = 0, float push = 0)
        {

                Direction = (end - at).sqrMagnitude > .001f ? (end - at).normalized : Champion.Facing,
                Budget = budget, Targets = Mathf.Clamp(maxTargets, 1, 5), Element = element, Slow = slow, Push = push, Cause = IdentityCause() });

        private void ResolveIdentityStrikes()

            {

                identityStrikes.RemoveAt(i); identityTargets.Clear();
                foreach (UnitState u in units)
                {
                    if (!CanHit(Faction.Champion, u)) continue;
                    float distance = Vector2.Distance(u.Position, s.Position), r = u.Definition.Radius;
                    bool inside = s.Shape == MorphGeometry.Line ? SegmentCircle(s.Position, s.End, u.Position, s.Width + r) >= 0 :
                        s.Shape == MorphGeometry.Ring ? Mathf.Abs(distance - s.Radius) <= s.Width + r :

        private UnitState IdentityTarget(Vector2 origin, float range = 8, int preference = 0)
        {

                float next = (u.Position - origin).sqrMagnitude;
                if (preference == 1 && u.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile) next -= 80;
                if (preference == 2) next -= Mathf.Min(90, u.Health / Mathf.Max(1, IdentityPower));
                if (next < score) { best = u; score = next; }

        private void IdentityShot(Vector2 from, Vector2 direction, float totalDamage, int count = 1, float spread = 16, DamageElement element = DamageElement.Physical, int homingTarget = 0, Sprite sprite = null)

                    Element = element, SourceName = HeroIdentities.For(IdentityId).Name, SourceUnitId = Champion.Id,

            else if (mode == 1) IdentityHit(MorphGeometry.Crescent, at, at + dir, Mathf.Min(4, Vector2.Distance(at, target.Position) + .5f), budget, element: element);

        private void IdentityPerform(float budget, int wanted)
        {

            float weights = 0; for (int i=0;i<count;i++) weights += Mathf.Max(1,identityPerformers[(identityCycle+i)%identityPerformers.Count].Definition.Weapon.Damage);

        private void IdentityEcho(UnitState performer, UnitState target, float budget, bool fromHero = false)

        private float IdentityDamage(UnitState target, float damage, Faction source, CombatCause cause)

        private float IdentityAttackDamage(UnitState source, float damage)

    }
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public HeroIdentityDefinition HeroIdentityDefinition => HeroIdentities.For(State.ChampionId);
        public bool CanConfigureHero => State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && !SecretRoomOpen && State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Reward;
        public bool ChooseHeroApproach(int approach)
        {
            if (!CanConfigureHero || approach < 0 || approach > 2 || State.HeroIdentity.Approach == approach) return false;
            State.HeroIdentity.Approach = approach; Notice = HeroIdentityDefinition.Approaches[approach] + " ready for the next battle."; return true;
        }
        public bool CycleFeaturedFriend()
        {
            if (!CanConfigureHero || State.ChampionId != "PatchworkHost" || State.Roster.Count == 0) return false;
            var h = State.HeroIdentity; int index = State.Roster.FindIndex(r => r.UnitId == h.LeadUnit && r.WeaponId == h.LeadWeapon);
            RosterEntry next = State.Roster[(index + 1) % State.Roster.Count]; h.LeadUnit = next.UnitId; h.LeadWeapon = next.WeaponId;
            Notice = "Featured: " + catalog.Unit(next.UnitId).DisplayName + " / " + RunUICopy.WeaponName(next.WeaponId); return true;
        }
        public bool CycleMemoryOrgan(int slot)
        {
            if (!CanConfigureHero || State.ChampionId != "LoneJelly" || slot < 0 || slot >= 3) return false;
            var available = new List<string>(); foreach (string id in State.AbsorbedSkills) if (!available.Contains(id)) available.Add(id);
            if (available.Count == 0) return false;
            int current = available.IndexOf(State.HeroIdentity.Organs[slot]);
            for (int offset = 1; offset <= available.Count; offset++)
            {
                string next = available[(current + offset) % available.Count];
                if (Array.IndexOf(State.HeroIdentity.Organs, next) >= 0) continue;
                State.HeroIdentity.Organs[slot] = next; Notice = "Memory organ: " + catalog.Unit(next).DisplayName; return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        public bool RerollHeroDie()

            State.Gold -= 6; State.HeroIdentity.DiceRerollWave = State.Wave;
            State.HeroIdentity.DiceFace = 1 + (State.HeroIdentity.DiceFace - 1 + 1 + Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, 5)) % 6;
            Notice = "Next die face: " + State.HeroIdentity.DiceFace; return true;
        }
        public int HeroOrderDeposit => (int)Math.Min(40, 8L + State.Wave);

            int approach = State.HeroIdentity.Approach;
            var preferred = Array.FindAll(pool, u => approach == 0 ? u.Passive == PassiveKind.HealChampion || Array.Exists(u.CompanionModifiers ?? Array.Empty<StatModifier>(), m => m.Effect == ItemEffect.Health || m.Effect == ItemEffect.Armor) : approach == 1 ? u.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee : u.Passive != PassiveKind.None || (u.CompanionModifiers?.Length ?? 0) > 0);

        public bool PlaceHeroOrder()
        {
            var h = State.HeroIdentity;

            var candidates = new List<ItemDefinition>();
            RelicCategory category = (RelicCategory)h.Approach;
            foreach (ItemDefinition i in catalog.Items)
                if (i.Category == category && i.UnlockWave <= (long)State.Wave + 1 && i.ShopWeight > 0 && ReviewBalance.ExclusivePool(i) == ShopPool.Gold && OctoberItemEligible(i) && StackCount(i.Id) < i.StackLimit) candidates.Add(i);
            if (candidates.Count == 0) { Notice = "No eligible forward order in this category."; return false; }
            ItemDefinition item = candidates[Next(ref State.ShopRandom, candidates.Count)];
            int basePrice = Mathf.CeilToInt(item.Price * .85f * (1 + (int)item.Rarity * .4f) * CarnivalBalance.ShopPrice(State.Wave + 1));
            h.OrderPrice = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.CeilToInt(basePrice * (1 - Mathf.Clamp(Bonus(ItemEffect.Discount) + Bonus(ItemEffect.RelicDiscount), -1, .5f))));
            h.OrderDeposit = HeroOrderDeposit; State.Gold -= h.OrderDeposit; h.OrderItem = item.Id;
            h.OrderPlacedWave = State.Wave; h.OrderWave = State.Wave + 1;

            if (item == null || StackCount(item.Id) >= item.StackLimit)
            { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + h.OrderDeposit); h.OrderItem = ""; h.OrderDeposit = 0; Notice = "Forward order unavailable: investment refunded."; return; }
            if (State.Offers.Count == 0) return;
            var old = State.Offers[State.Offers.Count - 1];
            State.Offers[State.Offers.Count - 1] = new ShopOffer { Token = old.Token, Kind = OfferKind.Item, Id = h.OrderItem, Price = h.OrderPrice, Currency = ShopCurrency.Gold };

            CombatCatalog.HeroFood = State.OctoberFood; CombatCatalog.HeroDrinks = State.OctoberDrinks; CombatCatalog.HeroWallet = State.Gold;
            CombatCatalog.HeroLeadUnit = h.LeadUnit; CombatCatalog.HeroLeadWeapon = h.LeadWeapon;

        private void ValidateHeroIdentity(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {

            var seen = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (string id in h.Organs) if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && (catalog.Unit(id) == null || snapshot.AbsorbedSkills == null || !snapshot.AbsorbedSkills.Contains(id) || !seen.Add(id))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid equipped hero memory");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(h.LeadUnit) && (!Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, u => u.Id == h.LeadUnit) || catalog.Weapon(h.LeadWeapon) == null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid featured performer");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(h.OrderItem) && (snapshot.ChampionId != "PennyBroker" || catalog.Item(h.OrderItem) == null || h.OrderPrice < 1 || h.OrderWave < 1 || h.OrderDeposit < 1)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid forward order item");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class HostileBallistics
    {
        public static Vector2 Velocity(HostileShot motion, Vector2 launch, float age, int identity)
        {
            float speed = Mathf.Min(2.4f, launch.magnitude);
            float turn = motion switch
            {
                HostileShot.Weave => Mathf.Sin(age * 3.2f) * 26,
                HostileShot.Hook => Mathf.Min(age, 1.8f) * (identity % 2 == 0 ? 28 : -28),
                HostileShot.Drift => Mathf.Sin(age * 1.4f) * 48,
                _ => 0
            };
            if (motion == HostileShot.Accelerate) speed *= Mathf.Lerp(0.35f, 1, Mathf.Clamp01(age / 1.5f));
            return (Vector2)(Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, turn) * launch.normalized) * speed;
        }

        public static void Advance(ProjectileState projectile, float delta)
        {
            if (projectile.HostileMotion == HostileShot.Straight) return;
            if (projectile.LaunchVelocity.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f) projectile.LaunchVelocity = projectile.Velocity;
            projectile.HostileAge += delta;
            projectile.Velocity = Velocity(projectile.HostileMotion, projectile.LaunchVelocity, projectile.HostileAge, projectile.Id);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private void ProcessOutgoingCollision(UnitState source)
        {
            if (source.Faction == Faction.Champion || source.Definition.CollisionDamage <= 0 || Elapsed < source.NextCollision) return;
            bool struck = false;
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
            {
                if (!enemy.Alive || enemy.Faction != Faction.Enemy || enemy.EntranceUntil > Elapsed || enemy.BodyLift > 0.4f) continue;
                float reach = source.Definition.Radius + enemy.Definition.Radius;
                if ((source.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude > reach * reach) continue;
                ApplyDamage(enemy, source.Definition.CollisionDamage, source.Faction, "Collision", (enemy.Position - source.Position).normalized, cause: NewCause(source.Id));
                struck = true;
            }
            if (struck) source.NextCollision = Elapsed + source.Definition.CollisionFrequency;
        }
        private void StrikeChampionCollision(UnitState enemy)
        {
            float contact = Champion.Definition.CollisionDamage + (relicStanding ? 20 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillRecovery) : 0) + (!relicMoved ? 16 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillPower) : 0);
            if (Elapsed < enemy.NextCollision || contact <= 0) return;
            enemy.NextCollision = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(0.15f, Champion.Definition.CollisionFrequency);
            ApplyDamage(enemy, contact, Faction.Champion, "Champion collision", (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized, cause: NewCause(Champion.Id));
        }
    }
}
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/K10StatRules.cs | SHA-256 05b0fde9f994423421aa09d0a90359c86279ffe05ffc7424d1ee30addea09b86</summary>

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class K10StatRules
    {
        public static readonly string[] Names = { "Score multiplier", "Collision damage", "Flat melee damage", "Flat ranged damage", "Attack range", "Dodge", "Income", "Bullet pierce", "Bullet split", "Bullet bounce chance", "Bullet size", "Bullet speed", "Bullet travel distance", "Knockback", "Champion size", "Companion size", "Enemy count", "Enemy health", "Enemy speed", "Heart healing", "Chest quality", "Recruit discount", "Relic discount", "Shop rarity", "Health correction", "Damage correction", "Speed correction", "Armor correction", "Healing correction", "Collision frequency" };
        public static bool Percentage(ItemEffect effect) => effect != ItemEffect.CollisionDamage && effect != ItemEffect.MeleeDamage && effect != ItemEffect.RangedDamage && effect != ItemEffect.Income && effect != ItemEffect.BulletPierce && effect != ItemEffect.BulletSplit && effect != ItemEffect.HeartHealing;
        public static string Name(ItemEffect effect)
        {
            if (effect == ItemEffect.ChestReach) return "Chest opening radius";
            int index = (int)effect - (int)ItemEffect.ScoreMultiplier;
            return index >= 0 && index < Names.Length ? Names[index] : "Invalid effect";
        }
        public static float Factor(float bonus, float minimum = 0.1f, float maximum = 10f) => Mathf.Clamp(1 + bonus, minimum, maximum);
        public static float MaximumHealth(RunSession session, RunCatalog catalog)
            => catalog.Unit(session.State.ChampionId).ReferenceHero == "Card Queen" ? 12 : catalog.Unit(session.State.ChampionId).ReferenceHero == "Periwinky" ? Mathf.Clamp(session.State.Gold, 20, 400) : OctoberBalance.MaximumHealth((catalog.Unit(session.State.ChampionId).Health + session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Health)) * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.HealthCorrection)), session.State.Wave);

        public static void ApplyUnit(RunSession session, RunCatalog catalog, UnitDefinition unit, UnitDefinition source, WeaponDefinition original, int tier, bool companion)
        {
            if (catalog.StatRevision == 0) return;
            ModifierScope scope = companion ? ModifierScope.Companions : ModifierScope.Champion;
            WeaponDefinition weapon = unit.Weapon;
            ItemEffect flat = weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile ? ItemEffect.RangedDamage : ItemEffect.MeleeDamage;
            weapon.Damage = Mathf.Max(0, original.Damage + OctoberBalance.FlatDamage(session.Bonus(flat, scope), session.State.Wave)) * session.DamageMultiplier(source, tier, companion) * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.DamageCorrection, scope));
            float range = Factor(OctoberBalance.Soften(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.AttackRange, scope), .5f, .15f), .4f, 1.8f);
            weapon.Range *= range;
            weapon.ProjectileSpeed *= Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletSpeed, scope));
            weapon.ProjectileLifetime *= range * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletDistance, scope)) / Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletSpeed, scope));
            float size = Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletSize, scope), 0.25f, 4);
            weapon.ProjectileVisualWidth *= size;
            weapon.ProjectileRadius *= size;
            weapon.ProjectilePierce = Mathf.Clamp(weapon.ProjectilePierce + Mathf.FloorToInt(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletPierce, scope)), 0, 64);
            weapon.ProjectileSplit = Mathf.Clamp(weapon.ProjectileSplit + Mathf.FloorToInt(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletSplit, scope)), 0, 6);
            weapon.ProjectileBounceChance = Mathf.Clamp01(weapon.ProjectileBounceChance + session.Bonus(ItemEffect.BulletBounce, scope));
            weapon.PushDistance = Mathf.Min(.45f, weapon.PushDistance * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Knockback, scope), .1f, 2));
            float body = Factor(session.Bonus(companion ? ItemEffect.CompanionSize : ItemEffect.BodySize), 0.4f, 2.5f);
            unit.BodyHeight *= body;
            unit.BodyScale = body;
            unit.Radius *= body;
            unit.Speed *= Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.SpeedCorrection, scope));
            unit.CollisionDamage = Mathf.Max(0, unit.CollisionDamage + session.Bonus(ItemEffect.CollisionDamage, scope)) * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Damage, scope) + session.Bonus(companion ? ItemEffect.CompanionDamage : ItemEffect.ChampionDamage, scope)) * Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.DamageCorrection, scope));
            unit.CollisionFrequency = Mathf.Clamp(unit.CollisionFrequency / Factor(session.Bonus(ItemEffect.CollisionFrequency, scope)), 0.15f, 4);
            if (!companion) unit.Health = MaximumHealth(session, catalog);
        }
    }
}
````
