````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float heroCharge;
        private float heroReadyAt;
        public int HeroActivations { get; private set; }
        public float HeroCharge => heroCharge;
        public float HeroCooldownRemaining => Mathf.Max(0, heroReadyAt - Elapsed);
        private void ResetHeroMechanic() { heroCharge = heroReadyAt = 0; HeroActivations = 0; }
        private void ProcessHeroMechanic(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (HeroIdentityEnabled) return;
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || !Champion.Alive || Phase != RunPhase.Combat) return;
            HeroMechanic mechanic = Champion.Definition.HeroMechanic;
            if (mechanic >= HeroMechanic.RootedOracle) { ProcessCarnivalHero(deltaTime, mechanic); return; }
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.None) return;
            float moved = Vector2.Distance(Champion.Position, Champion.PreviousPosition);
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride) heroCharge = Mathf.Min(12, heroCharge + moved);
            else if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.DreamBreath) heroCharge = moved > 0.001f ? 0 : Mathf.Min(2, heroCharge + deltaTime);
            else
            {
                int originalEvents = events.Count;
                for (int index = 0; index < originalEvents; index++)
                {
                    CombatEvent pickup = events[index];
                    if (pickup.Kind == CombatEventKind.Pickup && pickup.Loot == LootKind.Coin) heroCharge = Mathf.Min(6, heroCharge + Mathf.Max(0, pickup.Value));
                }
            }
            float required = mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride ? 12 : mechanic == HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress ? 6 : 2;
            if (heroCharge < required || Elapsed < heroReadyAt) return;
            UnitState target = mechanic == HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress ? FindTarget(Champion, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Range) : null;
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress && target == null) return;
            if (mechanic != HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress)
            {
                float reach = mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride ? 2.4f : 3;
                bool threat = false;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units) threat |= enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= reach * reach;
                if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.DreamBreath)
                    foreach (ProjectileState projectile in projectiles) threat |= projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (projectile.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 9;
                if (!threat) return;
            }
            heroCharge = 0; heroReadyAt = Elapsed + (mechanic == HeroMechanic.DreamBreath ? 7 : 4); HeroActivations++;
            Champion.LastSupport = Elapsed;
            CombatCause cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("hero-" + mechanic);
            Contribution(cause).Activations++;
            if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress)
            {
                Vector2 previousDirection = Champion.AttackDirection;
                Champion.AttackDirection = (target.Position - Champion.Position).normalized;
                EmitProjectile(Champion, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 0.7f, false, cause);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, Champion.Position, Faction.Champion, direction: Champion.AttackDirection, weapon: Champion.Definition.Weapon, subject: Champion, cause: cause));
                Champion.AttackDirection = previousDirection;
            }
            else
            {
                float radius = mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride ? 2.4f : 3;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= radius * radius)
                    {
                        if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride) ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 0.65f, Faction.Champion, DamageElement.Ember, Champion.Definition.DisplayName, (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized, Champion.Definition.Weapon, cause: cause);
                        else enemy.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(enemy.ChillUntil, Elapsed + (enemy.Definition.IsBoss ? 0.6f : 1.5f));
                    }
                if (mechanic == HeroMechanic.DreamBreath)
                {
                    int removed = 0;
                    for (int index = projectiles.Count - 1; index >= 0 && removed < 3; index--)
                        if (projectiles[index].Faction == Faction.Enemy && (projectiles[index].Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 9) { projectiles.RemoveAt(index); removed++; }
                }
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse, Champion.Position, Faction.Champion, radius, subject: Champion, element: mechanic == HeroMechanic.LanternStride ? DamageElement.Ember : DamageElement.Frost, cause: cause));
            }
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Support, Champion.Position, Faction.Champion, subject: Champion, cause: cause));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class K11HeroRules
    {
        public static bool Eligible(UnitDefinition champion, UnitDefinition companion)
        {
            if (companion.GiftOnly) return false;
            if (champion.HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw && champion.ReferenceHero != "Capped Gallant") return false;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(companion.ExclusiveHero)) return companion.ExclusiveHero == champion.ReferenceHero;
            if (champion.ReferenceHero == "Belle") return true;
            foreach (string theme in champion.RecruitThemes)
                if (Array.IndexOf(companion.Tags, theme) >= 0) return true;
            return false;
        }
        public static RosterEntry Starter(RunCatalog catalog, UnitDefinition champion)
        {
            string unit = champion.Id == "LanternKnight" ? "TeapotPilgrim" : champion.Id == "Postmaster" ? "BrassAcorn" : "HoodWisp";
            string weapon = champion.Id == "LanternKnight" ? "SpoonSabre" : champion.Id == "Postmaster" ? "InkPistol" : "SnowGlobeOrb";
            if (champion.HeroMechanic >= HeroMechanic.RootedOracle || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(champion.ReferenceHero) && champion.Id != "LanternKnight" && champion.Id != "Postmaster" && champion.Id != "DrowsySeer")
            {
                UnitDefinition candidate = Array.Find(catalog.Companions, ally => !ally.SpecialRecruit && Eligible(champion, ally));
                if (candidate == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("No themed starter: " + champion.Id);
                unit = candidate.Id; weapon = champion.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? "SpoonSabre" : "InkPistol";
            }
            if (catalog.Unit(unit) == null || catalog.Weapon(weapon) == null || !Eligible(champion, catalog.Unit(unit))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid themed starting brigade: " + champion.Id);
            return new RosterEntry { UnitId = unit, WeaponId = weapon };
        }
        public static string Describe(UnitDefinition champion) => Describe(champion.HeroMechanic);
        public static string Describe(HeroMechanic mechanic)
        {
            return mechanic switch
            {
                HeroMechanic.LanternStride => "LANTERN STRIDE: travel 12 units to charge a melee pulse within 2.4 units; deals 65% weapon damage, minimum 4-second cooldown. Holds one pulse until an enemy is nearby. No charge in shops or while paused.",
                HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress => "PARCEL EXPRESS: collect 6 gold to charge an automatic parcel volley; deals 70% weapon damage, minimum 4-second cooldown. Passive gold and income do not count.",
                HeroMechanic.DreamBreath => "DREAM BREATH: stand still for 2 seconds to chill enemies within 3 units and remove up to 3 nearby hostile bullets; 7-second cooldown. Waits for nearby danger. Moving interrupts charge; grants no invulnerability.",
                HeroMechanic.RootedOracle => "Stationary in combat. Whole-arena pickup and a slowing ward. Walks in shops.",
                HeroMechanic.SoloMaw => "No companions. Growing attacks and an automatic whirl. Shops sell relics only.",
                HeroMechanic.GlassGambler => "Collect 6 gold to burst nearby enemies. High luck and critical chance; low health.",
                HeroMechanic.TideCollector => "Collect 8 gold to heal 3 health and push nearby enemies back.",
                HeroMechanic.ClockRunner => "Travel 10 units to release a slowing pulse. Moving charges it; shops do not.",
                HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard => "Stand still for 2 seconds to reflect up to 3 nearby bullets. Moving resets charge.",
                HeroMechanic.TreasureTax => "Every 10 collected gold grants 1 extra gold and a small healing pulse.",
                _ => ""
            };
        }
    }
}
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/K8CombatProjectiles.cs | SHA-256 bcc12b6cdae316b1d48c0fc862f386f07c37d1b9d79f73267ff7b55681e0bac5</summary>

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool AdvanceCombatProjectile(ProjectileState projectile, float deltaTime)
        {
            if (projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy && catalog.RunWave == 1) return false;
            if (projectile.Remaining <= 0f) return false;
            if (projectile.Cause.RootId == 0) projectile.Cause = NewCause(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            UnitState source = UnitWithId(projectile.SourceUnitId);
            Vector2 start = projectile.LaunchSegment ? projectile.PreviousPosition : projectile.Position;
            Vector2 destination = projectile.Position + projectile.Velocity * Mathf.Min(deltaTime, projectile.Remaining);
            projectile.PreviousPosition = start;
            projectile.LaunchSegment = false;
            projectile.Remaining -= deltaTime;
            Vector2 half = catalog.ArenaSize * 0.5f;
            while (true)
            {
                float wallFraction = ProjectileWallFraction(start, destination, half, out Vector2 normal);
                UnitState hit = null;
                float hitFraction = wallFraction;
                Vector2 padding = Vector2.one * (maximumRadius + projectile.Radius);
                spatial.Query(Vector2.Min(start, destination) - padding, Vector2.Max(start, destination) + padding, projectileCandidates);
                foreach (UnitState target in projectileCandidates)
                {
                    bool interceptor = projectile.Faction == Faction.Enemy && target.Alive && target.Faction == Faction.Companion && catalog.CompanionInterceptor;
                    bool blocker = catalog.ExpandedContent && EnemyInteractionRules.CanBlock(projectile, target);
                    if ((!CanHit(projectile.Faction, target) && !interceptor && !blocker) || projectile.Victims.Contains(target.Id)) continue;
                    float fraction = SegmentCircle(start, destination, target.Position, target.Definition.Radius + projectile.Radius);
                    if (fraction >= 0f && fraction < hitFraction) { hitFraction = fraction; hit = target; }
                }
                Vector2 impact = hit == null && wallFraction > 1f ? destination : Vector2.Lerp(start, destination, hitFraction);
                projectile.Position = impact;
                NotifyArenaToyHit(source, start, impact, projectile.Radius, projectile.Velocity.normalized, projectile.Cause);
                if (hit == null && wallFraction > 1f) return projectile.Remaining > 0f;
                float travelLeft = (destination - impact).magnitude;
                if (hit == null)
                {
                    if (projectile.RicochetsRemaining <= 0 || projectile.Returning) return false;
                    projectile.RicochetsRemaining--;
                    projectile.Velocity = new Vector2(normal.x == 0f ? projectile.Velocity.x : -projectile.Velocity.x, normal.y == 0f ? projectile.Velocity.y : -projectile.Velocity.y);
                    projectile.Cause = projectile.Cause.Child("projectile-bounce");
                    ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileBounce, projectile);
                }
                else
                {
                    int previousVictims = projectile.Victims.Count;
                    projectile.Victims.Add(hit.Id);
                    if (EnemyInteractionRules.CanBlock(projectile, hit))
                    {
                        ApplyDamage(hit, Mathf.Min(projectile.Damage * 0.35f, hit.Definition.Health * 0.015f), Faction.Enemy, "Blocked hostile shot", projectile.Velocity.normalized, cause: projectile.Cause.Child("hostile-block"));
                        return false;
                    }
                    ApplyWeaponDamage(hit, projectile.Damage, projectile.Faction, projectile.Element, projectile.SourceName, projectile.Velocity.normalized, projectile.Weapon, projectile.Critical, projectile.Cause);
                    OnExpandedProjectileHit(projectile, hit);
                    if (Phase != RunPhase.Combat) return false;
                    if (hit.Faction == Faction.Companion) return false;
                    if (projectile.SplitOnImpact) SplitCombatProjectile(projectile);
                    if (projectile.Weapon != null && (projectile.Weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Fish || projectile.Weapon.SecretRecall) && projectile.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
                    {
                        if (!projectile.Returning) ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileReturn, projectile);
                        projectile.Returning = true;
                        return projectile.Remaining > 0f;
                    }
                    bool guaranteed = projectile.Weapon != null && projectile.Weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow;
                    bool randomBounce = projectile.Weapon != null && projectile.RandomBounces > 0 && projectile.Weapon.ProjectileBounceChance > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < projectile.Weapon.ProjectileBounceChance;
                    if (randomBounce && projectile.RicochetsRemaining <= 0) projectile.RicochetsRemaining = 1;
                    bool ricochet = (guaranteed || randomBounce) && TryCombatRicochet(projectile);
                    if (ricochet && randomBounce) projectile.RandomBounces--;
                    if (!ricochet && (projectile.Weapon == null || previousVictims >= projectile.Weapon.ProjectilePierce)) return false;
                    if (!ricochet) ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectilePierce, projectile);
                }
                start = projectile.Position;
                destination = start + projectile.Velocity.normalized * travelLeft;
                if (travelLeft <= 0.000001f) return projectile.Remaining > 0f;
            }
        }

        private bool TryCombatRicochet(ProjectileState projectile)
        {
            if (projectile.RicochetsRemaining <= 0) return false;
            UnitState nearest = null;
            float best = 9f;
            foreach (UnitState target in units)
            {
                if (!CanHit(projectile.Faction, target) || projectile.Victims.Contains(target.Id)) continue;
                float distance = (target.Position - projectile.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                if (distance >= best) continue;
                best = distance;
                nearest = target;
            }
            if (nearest == null) return false;
            projectile.RicochetsRemaining--;
            projectile.Velocity = (nearest.Position - projectile.Position).normalized * projectile.Velocity.magnitude;
            projectile.Damage *= 0.7f;
            projectile.Cause = projectile.Cause.Child("projectile-ricochet");
            ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileBounce, projectile);
            return true;
        }

        private void SplitCombatProjectile(ProjectileState projectile)
        {
            projectile.SplitOnImpact = false;
            if (projectile.Remaining <= 0f) return;
            ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind.ProjectileSplit, projectile);
            int count = Mathf.Clamp(projectile.SplitCount > 0 ? projectile.SplitCount : 2, 1, 6);
            for (int branch = 0; branch < count && projectiles.Count < 4096; branch++)
            {
                float spread = projectile.SplitCount > 0 ? 45 : 30;
                float angle = count == 1 ? 25 : Mathf.Lerp(-spread, spread, branch / (float)(count - 1));
                Vector2 velocity = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, angle) * projectile.Velocity;
                var fragment = new ProjectileState
                {
                    Id = ++nextId, Faction = projectile.Faction, Position = projectile.Position, PreviousPosition = projectile.Position,
                    Velocity = velocity, Damage = projectile.Damage * 0.35f, Remaining = projectile.Remaining,
                    Color = projectile.Color, Element = projectile.Element, SourceName = projectile.SourceName,
                    Sprite = projectile.Sprite, VisualWidth = projectile.VisualWidth * 0.7f, Critical = projectile.Critical,
                    SourceUnitId = projectile.SourceUnitId, Cause = projectile.Cause.Child("projectile-split"),
                    Weapon = projectile.Weapon, IsFragment = true, Radius = projectile.Radius * (projectile.SplitCount > 0 ? 0.7f : 1), SplitCount = 0, RandomBounces = 0
                };
                fragment.Victims.UnionWith(projectile.Victims);
                projectiles.Add(fragment);
            }
        }

        private void ProjectileAudioEvent(CombatEventKind kind, ProjectileState projectile)
        {
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(kind, projectile.Position, projectile.Faction, weapon: projectile.Weapon, cause: projectile.Cause));
        }

        private static float ProjectileWallFraction(Vector2 start, Vector2 end, Vector2 half, out Vector2 normal)
        {
            Vector2 delta = end - start;
            float nearest = 2f;
            normal = Vector2.zero;
            if (Mathf.Abs(start.x) > half.x || Mathf.Abs(start.y) > half.y) return 0f;
            if (delta.x != 0f && Mathf.Abs(end.x) >= half.x)
            {
                float fraction = (Mathf.Sign(delta.x) * half.x - start.x) / delta.x;
                if (fraction >= 0f && fraction <= 1f) { nearest = fraction; normal = Vector2.right; }
            }
            if (delta.y != 0f && Mathf.Abs(end.y) >= half.y)
            {
                float fraction = (Mathf.Sign(delta.y) * half.y - start.y) / delta.y;
                if (fraction >= 0f && fraction <= nearest)
                {
                    normal = Mathf.Abs(fraction - nearest) < 0.000001f ? (normal + Vector2.up).normalized : Vector2.up;
                    nearest = fraction;
                }
            }
            return nearest;
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public void K8CombatIncomingDamageFixture(float damage) => ApplyDamage(Champion, damage, Faction.Enemy);
        public void K8CombatSignatureFixture(UnitState source, CombatCause cause) => AdvanceSignatureBeat(source, source.Definition.Weapon.Damage, cause, source.Definition.Weapon.SignatureBeats);

        public ProjectileState K8CombatProjectileFixture(UnitState source, Vector2 position, Vector2 velocity, float damage, int ricochets = 0, bool split = false, CombatCause cause = default)
        {
            var projectile = new ProjectileState
            {
                Id = ++nextId, Faction = source.Faction, Position = position, PreviousPosition = position,
                Velocity = velocity, Damage = damage, Remaining = 2f, SourceUnitId = source.Id,
                Weapon = source.Definition.Weapon, Element = source.Definition.Weapon.Element,
                Cause = cause.RootId == 0 ? NewCause(source.Id) : cause, RicochetsRemaining = ricochets, SplitOnImpact = split
            };
            projectiles.Add(projectile);
            return projectile;
        }
#endif
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool captureCustomerDefeat;
        public void DefeatCustomerCapture()
        {
            if ((!RunPaths.K7Capture && !MienChoCapture.Requested) || Boss?.Definition.Id != NightmareRules.CustomerId) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Customer fixture requires isolated capture mode");
            captureCustomerDefeat = true;
        }
        private bool ProcessLastCustomer(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (boss.Definition.Id != NightmareRules.CustomerId) return false;
            if (captureCustomerDefeat)
            {
                captureCustomerDefeat = false;
                ApplyDamage(boss, boss.Health + 1, Faction.Champion, "Customer diagnostic", cause: NewCause(Champion.Id), injectedDamage: true);
                return true;
            }
            boss.BossPoseTime = Elapsed;
            if (boss.TelegraphUntil > 0)
            {
                if (Elapsed < boss.TelegraphUntil) return true;
                boss.TelegraphUntil = 0;
                Vector2 target = boss.AbilityTarget;
                Vector2 across = new Vector2(-boss.TelegraphDirection.y,boss.TelegraphDirection.x);
                int attack = boss.BossVolley % 6;
                bool enraged = boss.Health < boss.Definition.Health * .45f;
                if (BossPartRules.Broken(boss,boss.ActiveBossOrgan))
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave,boss,target,2.4f,.9f,1.1f);
                else switch (attack)
                {
                    case 0:
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp,boss,target,1.25f,.85f,.45f,0);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave,boss,target,3.4f,1.05f,1.4f,0);
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle,boss,target + across * index * 2.4f,.35f,.8f + (index + 1) * .35f,.5f,1);
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        for (int index = 0; index < (enraged ? 6 : 4); index++)
                        {
                            float angle = index * 2.39996f;
                            Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp,boss,target + new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle),Mathf.Sin(angle)) * (index == 0 ? 0 : 2.5f),.75f,.9f + index * .22f,.4f,2);
                        }
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle,boss,target + across * 2,.4f,.8f,.65f,2);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle,boss,target - across * 2,.4f,1.3f,.65f,2);
                        break;
                    case 4:
                        for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp,boss,target + across * index * 2.2f,.85f,1 + Mathf.Abs(index) * .4f,.4f,0);
                        boss.AbilityOrigin = boss.Position; boss.AbilityTarget = ClampPosition(target,2);
                        boss.BossSkillStarted = Elapsed; boss.BossSkillUntil = Elapsed + .85f;
                        break;
                    default:
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool,boss,target,1.15f,1.2f,2,2);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle,boss,target + across * 3,.4f,.9f,.5f,1);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle,boss,target - across * 3,.4f,1.3f,.5f,1);
                        break;
                }
                boss.BossVolley++; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed - boss.AttackWindup; boss.BossRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.7f;
                boss.NextBossPattern = Elapsed + (enraged ? 3.9f : 4.8f);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire,boss.Position,Faction.Enemy,subject:boss));
            }
            if (Elapsed < boss.NextBossPattern) return true;
            boss.ActiveBossOrgan = boss.BossVolley % 6 / 2;
            boss.TelegraphDirection = (Champion.Position - boss.Position).normalized;
            boss.AbilityTarget = ClampPosition(Champion.Position,1);
            boss.AttackWindup = 1.25f; boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + 1.25f;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup,boss.Position,Faction.Enemy,subject:boss));
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class MeleeTactics
    {
        public static Vector2 Engage(UnitState unit, UnitState target)
        {
            Vector2 near = unit.Position - target.Position;
            if (near.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f) near = -unit.Facing;
            if (near.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f) near = Vector2.left;
            if (unit.PendingAttack && near.magnitude >= unit.Definition.Radius + target.Definition.Radius && near.magnitude <= Mathf.Max(unit.Definition.Radius + target.Definition.Radius, unit.Definition.Weapon.Range * 0.7f)) return unit.Position;
            float side = (unit.Id % 3 - 1) * 0.24f;
            Vector2 anchored = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(unit.MeleeApproachAngle), Mathf.Sin(unit.MeleeApproachAngle));
            if (unit.MeleeApproachTarget != target.Id || near.magnitude > unit.Definition.Weapon.Range * 1.5f && Vector2.Dot(near.normalized, anchored) < 0.5f)
            {
                unit.MeleeApproachTarget = target.Id; unit.MeleeApproachAngle = Mathf.Atan2(near.y, near.x) + side;
            }
            Vector2 direction = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(unit.MeleeApproachAngle), Mathf.Sin(unit.MeleeApproachAngle));
            float distance = Mathf.Max(unit.Definition.Radius + target.Definition.Radius + 0.04f, unit.Definition.Weapon.Range * 0.55f);
            return target.Position + direction * distance;
        }
        public static void Aim(UnitState unit, UnitState target, float delta)
        {
            if (!unit.PendingAttack || target == null || !target.Alive) return;
            float lead = Mathf.Clamp(unit.ImpactTime - unit.AttackStarted, 0, 0.18f);
            Vector2 desired = target.Position + Vector2.ClampMagnitude(target.Velocity * lead, 0.3f) - unit.Position;
            if (desired.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f) return;
            float current = Mathf.Atan2(unit.AttackDirection.y, unit.AttackDirection.x) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;
            float next = Mathf.Atan2(desired.y, desired.x) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;
            float angle = Mathf.MoveTowardsAngle(current, next, 300 * delta) * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
            unit.AttackDirection = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle), Mathf.Sin(angle)); unit.Facing = unit.AttackDirection;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum SpectacleKind { PaperParade, GildedTrap, WanderingEclipse }
    public sealed class MidwaveSpectacle
    {
        public SpectacleKind Kind;
        public Vector2 Origin;
        public Vector2 Position;
        public float Started;
        public float NextReward;
        public float NextThreat;
        public bool Claimed;
        public bool Dangerous;
        public int RewardDrops;
        public const float Duration = 10;
        public float Age(float time) => Mathf.Max(0, time - Started);
        public bool Active(float time) => time >= Started && time < Started + Duration;
        public static bool Eligible(int wave, bool boss) => wave >= 5 && wave % 2 == 1 && !boss;
        public static SpectacleKind Select(int wave, int seed) => (SpectacleKind)((wave / 2 + (seed % 3 + 3) % 3) % 3);
        public bool Contains(Vector2 point)
        {
            Vector2 offset = point - Position;
            if (Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) if ((offset + Vector2.right * index * 1.2f).sqrMagnitude <= 0.75f * 0.75f) return true;
                return false;
            }
            return Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap ? Mathf.Abs(offset.x) <= 1.15f && Mathf.Abs(offset.y) <= 0.8f : offset.sqrMagnitude <= (Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? 0.75f * 0.75f : 1.15f * 1.15f);
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        public MidwaveSpectacle Spectacle { get; private set; }
        private bool spectacleCompleted;
        private void ClearSpectacle() { Spectacle = null; spectacleCompleted = false; }
        private void ProcessSpectacle()
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableSpectacles || !MidwaveSpectacle.Eligible(catalog.RunWave, catalog.Boss != null) || spectacleCompleted) return;
            if (Spectacle == null)
            {
                if (Elapsed < catalog.WaveDuration * 0.4f) return;
                float side = (runSeed & 1) == 0 ? -1 : 1;
                Vector2 point = ClampPosition(Champion.Position + new Vector2(side * 3.8f, side * 1.8f), 2);
                Spectacle = new MidwaveSpectacle { Kind = MidwaveSpectacle.Select(catalog.RunWave, runSeed), Origin = point, Position = point, Started = Elapsed, NextReward = Elapsed + 2, NextThreat = Elapsed + 2 };
            }
            MidwaveSpectacle show = Spectacle;
            float age = show.Age(Elapsed);
            if (age >= MidwaveSpectacle.Duration) { spectacleCompleted = true; show.Dangerous = false; return; }
            float travel = Mathf.Clamp01((age - 2) / 8);
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade) show.Position = ClampPosition(show.Origin + Vector2.right * Mathf.Lerp(-6, 6, travel), 0.8f);
            else if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.WanderingEclipse) show.Position = ClampPosition(show.Origin + new Vector2(Mathf.Lerp(-3, 3, travel), Mathf.Sin(travel * Mathf.PI * 2) * 1.1f), 1.2f);
            show.Dangerous = age >= 2 && (show.Kind != SpectacleKind.GildedTrap || Mathf.Repeat(age - 2, 2.4f) < 0.65f);
            bool inside = show.Contains(Champion.Position);
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap && age >= 2 && inside && !show.Claimed)
            {
                show.Claimed = true; DropLoot(LootKind.Chest, show.Position, 10); show.RewardDrops++;
            }
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade && Elapsed >= show.NextReward && show.RewardDrops < 12)
            {
                show.NextReward = Elapsed + 0.65f; show.RewardDrops++; DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, show.Position - Vector2.right * 0.9f, 1);
            }
            if (!inside || !show.Dangerous || Elapsed < show.NextThreat || !Champion.Alive) return;
            show.NextThreat = Elapsed + 1;
            ApplyDamage(Champion, Mathf.Min(show.Kind == SpectacleKind.PaperParade ? 5 : show.Kind == SpectacleKind.GildedTrap ? 4 : 2, Champion.Definition.Health * 0.05f), Faction.Enemy, "Midwave " + show.Kind, cause: NewCause(0).Child("spectacle"));
            if (show.Kind == SpectacleKind.WanderingEclipse && show.RewardDrops < 8)
            {
                show.RewardDrops++; DropLoot(LootKind.Coin, show.Position, 2);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public bool EndingPending => State.Nightmare?.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn;
        public bool EndingChoicePending => EndingPending && State.Nightmare.NarrativeRevision > 0 && State.Nightmare.EndingPage == 0 && State.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen;
        public bool ChooseFarewell(NightmareFarewell choice)
        {
            if (!EndingChoicePending || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory || choice != NightmareFarewell.CloseShop && choice != NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight) return false;
            State.Nightmare.Farewell = choice;
            return true;
        }
        private void RememberNightmareChoice(SecretEventKind kind, int option, bool resolved)
        {
            State.Nightmare ??= new NightmareProgress();
            State.Nightmare.Choices[(int)kind] = option;
            State.Nightmare.ChoiceMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
            if (resolved) State.Nightmare.ResolvedMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
        }
        private void PrepareNightmare()
        {
            State.Nightmare ??= new NightmareProgress();
            State.Nightmare.Depth = NightmareRules.Depth(State.Wave);
            NightmareAssets assets = NightmareAssets.Current;
            if (assets == null || assets.Customer == null || !NightmareRules.FinalHall(State,catalog)) return;
            State.Nightmare.NarrativeRevision = 1;
            State.Nightmare.Ending = NightmareEndingStage.Customer;
            CombatCatalog.Boss = BuildEnemy(assets.Customer,1 + State.Difficulty * .2f);
            CombatCatalog.Boss.Health = assets.Customer.Health * (1 + State.Difficulty * .2f);
            CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 0;
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
            CombatCatalog.ExpandedContent = true;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(28,20);
            CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 0;
        }
        private void ValidateNightmare(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            MienChoStory.Validate(snapshot);
            NightmareProgress progress = snapshot?.Nightmare;
            if (progress == null) return;
            int finalPage = progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight ? 5 : 4;
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision < 0 || progress.NarrativeRevision > 1 || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NightmareFarewell), progress.Farewell) || progress.NarrativeRevision == 0 && progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid farewell revision");
            if (progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen && (!progress.CustomerDefeated || snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory && !snapshot.Endless)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Farewell requires actual victory");
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision > 0 && progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.EndingPage > 0 && progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen) throw new InvalidOperationException("Farewell must be chosen before dawn pages");
            if (progress.NarrativeRevision > 0 && progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete && progress.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.Unchosen || progress.Farewell != NightmareFarewell.Unchosen && progress.Ending != NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.Ending != NightmareEndingStage.Complete) throw new InvalidOperationException("Inconsistent farewell stage");
            if (progress.Depth < 0 || progress.Depth > 4 || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NightmareEndingStage),progress.Ending) || progress.EndingPage < 0 || progress.EndingPage > finalPage || progress.LastWhisperWave < 0 || progress.LastWhisperWave > snapshot.Wave || progress.WhisperCursor < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid nightmare journal");
            if (progress.ChoiceMask < 0 || progress.ChoiceMask > 255 || progress.ResolvedMask < 0 || (progress.ResolvedMask & ~progress.ChoiceMask) != 0 || progress.Choices == null || progress.Choices.Length != 8 || Array.Exists(progress.Choices,choice => choice < -1 || choice > 2)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid nightmare memory");
            for (int index = 0; index < progress.Choices.Length; index++)
                if (((progress.ChoiceMask & (1 << index)) != 0) != (progress.Choices[index] >= 0)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Inconsistent nightmare choice memory");
            if (progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && progress.EndingPage >= finalPage || progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete && progress.EndingPage != finalPage) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ending page boundary");
            if ((progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn || progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete) && !progress.CustomerDefeated) throw new InvalidOperationException("Dawn requires defeating the Last Customer");
            if (progress.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Dawn && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ending phase");
        }
        public bool AdvanceEnding()
        {
            if (!EndingPending || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory || EndingChoicePending) return false;
            int finalPage = State.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight ? 5 : 4;
            State.Nightmare.EndingPage = Mathf.Min(finalPage,State.Nightmare.EndingPage + 1);
            if (State.Nightmare.EndingPage == finalPage) State.Nightmare.Ending = NightmareEndingStage.Complete;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class OctoberBalance
    {
        public const int AllySoftLimit = 15;
        public const float WaveSeconds = 45;
        public static float Crowd(int count) => Mathf.Clamp01((count - 10) / (float)(AllySoftLimit - 10));
        public static float NewAllyChance(int count, int wave = 4)
        {
            float crowd = Mathf.Clamp01((count - 6) / (float)(AllySoftLimit - 6));
            float chance = count < 6 ? .85f : Mathf.Lerp(.55f, .02f, 1 - (1 - crowd) * (1 - crowd));
            return wave <= 3 ? Mathf.Max(.7f, chance) : chance;
        }
        public static float RecruitChance(int count) => Mathf.Lerp(1, .32f, Crowd(count));
        public static float Late(int wave) => Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 8) / 12f);
        public static float Soften(float bonus, float knee, float slope) => bonus > knee ? knee + (bonus - knee) * slope : bonus;
        public static float MaximumHealth(float raw, int wave) => Mathf.Clamp(Soften(raw, 250, Mathf.Lerp(1, .25f, Late(wave))), 1, Mathf.Lerp(2000, 600, Late(wave)));
        public static float FlatDamage(float bonus, int wave) => Soften(bonus, 10, Mathf.Lerp(1, .35f, Late(wave)));
        public static float EndlessHealth(int wave, bool endless) => endless ? Mathf.Pow(1.16f, Mathf.Min(200, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 19))) : 1;
        public static float EndlessDamage(int wave, bool endless) => endless ? Mathf.Pow(1.075f, Mathf.Min(200, Mathf.Max(0, wave - 19))) : 1;
        public static float Push(UnitDefinition target, float requested) => target.IsBoss ? 0 : Mathf.Clamp(requested, 0, .45f) * (1 - Mathf.Clamp01(target.KnockbackResistance));
        public static void CompileAlly(UnitDefinition unit, int wave)
        {
            WeaponDefinition w = unit.Weapon; float late = Late(wave);
            w.Cooldown = Mathf.Max(.28f, w.Cooldown * Mathf.Lerp(1.12f, 1.35f, late));
            w.Windup = Mathf.Min(w.Windup, w.Cooldown * .35f); w.Recovery = Mathf.Min(w.Recovery, w.Cooldown * .4f);
            float before = w.Range;
            w.Range = Mathf.Clamp(w.Range * Mathf.Lerp(1, .86f, late), .4f, w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? 3.4f : 8);
            w.Damage *= Mathf.Lerp(1, .83f, late) * (w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.Sqrt(2.2f / Mathf.Max(2.2f, before)), .68f, 1) : 1);
            w.SignatureRadius = Mathf.Min(w.SignatureRadius, 3.2f); w.PushDistance = Mathf.Clamp(w.PushDistance, 0, .45f);
            w.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Clamp(w.ProjectileCount, 1, 10);
            w.ProjectileLifetime = Mathf.Min(w.ProjectileLifetime, 9 / Mathf.Max(1, w.ProjectileSpeed));
            unit.Speed = Mathf.Min(unit.Speed, 10);
            unit.CollisionDamage = Mathf.Min(unit.CollisionDamage, Mathf.Lerp(200, 80, late));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private sealed class OctoberShot { public UnitState Boss; public Vector2 Position, Direction; public float At, Speed; public HostileShot Motion; public CombatCause Cause; }
        private readonly List<OctoberShot> octoberShots = new List<OctoberShot>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, float> octoberBossAt = new Dictionary<int, float>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, int> octoberBossCast = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        private void ClearOctoberBosses() { octoberShots.Clear(); octoberBossAt.Clear(); octoberBossCast.Clear(); }
        private void ProcessOctoberBoss(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (boss.EntranceUntil > Elapsed || boss.Health <= 0) return;
            if (!octoberBossAt.TryGetValue(boss.Id, out float at)) at = 3.5f;
            if (Elapsed < at || octoberShots.Count > 240) return;
            int cast = octoberBossCast.TryGetValue(boss.Id, out int n) ? n : 0;
            octoberBossCast[boss.Id] = cast + 1;
            int identity = boss.Definition.Id == "OutsideStageKeeper" ? 11 : boss.Definition.Id == NightmareRules.CustomerId ? 12 : boss.Definition.BossPattern;
            int pattern = (cast + identity) % 6;
            Vector2 aim = (Champion.Position - boss.Position).normalized;
            float angle = Mathf.Atan2(aim.y, aim.x) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;
            CombatCause cause = NewCause(boss.Id).Child("boss-encore-" + pattern);
            bool reduceEncoreBullets = false;
            int volleyIndex = 0;
            void Shot(Vector2 origin, float degrees, float when, float speed, HostileShot motion = HostileShot.Straight)
            {
                if (reduceEncoreBullets && ++volleyIndex % 3 != 0) return;
                octoberShots.Add(new OctoberShot { Boss = boss, Position = origin, Direction = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, degrees) * Vector2.right, At = Elapsed + .9f + when, Speed = speed, Motion = motion, Cause = cause });
            }
            Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, boss.Definition.Radius + .5f, .9f, 0);
            reduceEncoreBullets = ResolveIdentityEncore(boss, cast, identity, Shot);
            if (reduceEncoreBullets) { boss.EncoreWindupUntil = Elapsed + 1.05f; boss.EncoreRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.5f; }
            switch (pattern)
            {
                case 0:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) { Shot(boss.Position, angle + i * 19 + identity * 7, i * .045f, 2.05f, HostileShot.Weave); Shot(boss.Position, angle - i * 19 - identity * 7 + 180, i * .045f, 1.8f); } break;
                case 1:
                    for (int wave = 0; wave < 3; wave++) for (int i = -4; i <= 4; i++) if (i != (wave % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1)) Shot(boss.Position, angle + i * 12 + wave * 4, wave * .4f, 2.15f, wave == 2 ? HostileShot.Accelerate : HostileShot.Straight); break;
                case 2:
                    for (int wave = 0; wave < 2; wave++) for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) if (i % 8 >= 2) Shot(boss.Position, angle + i * 15 + wave * 7.5f, wave * .65f, wave == 0 ? 1.7f : 2.2f); break;
                case 3:
                    for (int arm = 0; arm < 4; arm++) for (int i = -3; i <= 3; i++) Shot(boss.Position, arm * 90 + identity * 11 + i * 6, Mathf.Abs(i) * .08f, 1.85f, HostileShot.Weave); break;
                case 4:
                    for (int i = 0; i < 28; i++) if (i % 7 != 0) Shot(boss.Position, angle + i * 360f / 28, i * .018f, 1.65f, HostileShot.Hook); break;
                case 5:
                    for (int i = -6; i <= 6; i++) if (i != 0 && i != 1)
                    {
                        Vector2 origin = ClampPosition(Champion.Position + new Vector2(i * .8f, 4.5f), .3f);
                        Shot(origin, -90 + (i % 2 == 0 ? 9 : -9), Mathf.Abs(i) * .06f, 1.85f, HostileShot.Drift);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, origin, .3f, .9f, 0);
                    } break;
            }
            octoberBossAt[boss.Id] = Elapsed + (boss.Definition.Id == "OutsideStageKeeper" ? 4.2f : 5.2f) + (boss.Health > boss.Definition.Health * .5f ? 1 : 0);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss, cause: cause));
            if (boss.Definition.Id != "OutsideStageKeeper" && boss.Definition.Id != NightmareRules.CustomerId && cast % 3 == 2)
            {
                boss.OctoberLungeFrom = boss.Position; boss.OctoberLungeTo = ClampPosition(Champion.Position - aim * .8f, boss.Definition.Radius);
                boss.OctoberLungeAt = Elapsed + 1.1f; boss.OctoberLungeUntil = boss.OctoberLungeAt + .55f;
                Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.OctoberLungeTo, 2.2f, 1.7f, .5f);
            }
        }
        private bool MoveOctoberBoss(UnitState unit)
        {
            if (!unit.Definition.IsBoss || unit.OctoberLungeUntil <= Elapsed || unit.OctoberLungeAt <= 0) return false;
            if (Elapsed < unit.OctoberLungeAt) return true;
            float p = Mathf.Clamp01((Elapsed - unit.OctoberLungeAt) / .55f);
            unit.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.Lerp(unit.OctoberLungeFrom, unit.OctoberLungeTo, p * p * (3 - 2 * p)), unit.Definition.Radius); return true;
        }
        private void ProcessOctoberShots()
        {
            for (int i = octoberShots.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                OctoberShot shot = octoberShots[i];
                if (!shot.Boss.Alive) { octoberShots.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
                if (shot.At > Elapsed) continue;
                octoberShots.RemoveAt(i); if (projectiles.Count >= 1200) continue;
                Vector2 origin = shot.Position + shot.Direction * shot.Boss.Definition.Radius * .7f;
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, Position = origin, PreviousPosition = origin, Velocity = shot.Direction * shot.Speed, LaunchVelocity = shot.Direction * shot.Speed,
                    Damage = shot.Boss.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .7f, Faction = Faction.Enemy, SourceUnitId = shot.Boss.Id, SourceName = shot.Boss.Definition.DisplayName + " encore volley", Cause = shot.Cause,
                    Remaining = 7, Color = new Color(1, .32f, .48f), Radius = .075f, VisualWidth = .2f, Sprite = catalog.Projectile, HostileMotion = shot.Motion, Element = DamageElement.Arcane });
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private sealed class PoisonNote { public UnitState Target, Source; public float At, Damage; public CombatCause Cause; }
        private readonly List<PoisonNote> octoberPoison = new List<PoisonNote>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, List<UnitState>> octoberTalents = new Dictionary<string, List<UnitState>>();
        private readonly List<UnitState> noOctoberUnits = new List<UnitState>();
        private float octoberHurtAt = -100, octoberRebateAt, octoberTickAt, octoberMoveTime, octoberResponseAt, octoberSpiritAt;
        private int octoberInjuries, octoberHearts, octoberChests;
        private bool octoberRecoveryUsed;
        private int octoberDodges;
        public int OctoberHeartsCollected => octoberHearts;
        public int OctoberChestsOpened => octoberChests;
        public int OctoberInjuries => octoberInjuries;
        public int OctoberDodges => octoberDodges;
        private string ReferenceHero => Champion?.Definition.ReferenceHero ?? "";
        private List<UnitState> OctoberUnits(string talent) => octoberTalents.TryGetValue(talent, out List<UnitState> list) ? list : noOctoberUnits;
        private bool HasOctober(string talent) => OctoberUnits(talent).Count > 0;
        private bool OctoberTrait(UnitState u, string talent) => u.Definition.ReferenceCompanion == talent || u == Champion && System.Array.IndexOf(catalog.OctoberMemories, talent) >= 0;
        private void ResetOctoberCombat()
        {
            octoberPoison.Clear(); octoberTalents.Clear(); octoberDodges = octoberInjuries = octoberHearts = octoberChests = 0;
            octoberRecoveryUsed = false; octoberHurtAt = -100; octoberRebateAt = octoberTickAt = octoberMoveTime = octoberResponseAt = octoberSpiritAt = 0;
            foreach (UnitState u in units)
            {
                u.MountId = u.RiderId = u.OctoberAttacks = u.OctoberKills = 0; u.OctoberNext = 0;
                string name = u.Definition.ReferenceCompanion;
                if (u.Faction != Faction.Companion || string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) continue;
                if (!octoberTalents.ContainsKey(name)) octoberTalents.Add(name, new List<UnitState>());
                octoberTalents[name].Add(u);
            }
            foreach (string name in catalog.OctoberMemories ?? System.Array.Empty<string>())
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) continue;
                if (!octoberTalents.ContainsKey(name)) octoberTalents.Add(name, new List<UnitState>());
                if (!octoberTalents[name].Contains(Champion)) octoberTalents[name].Add(Champion);
            }
            foreach (UnitState pony in OctoberUnits("Pony"))
            {
                if (pony == Champion) continue;
                UnitState rider = null; float best = float.PositiveInfinity;
                foreach (UnitState u in units)
                {
                    if (u.Faction != Faction.Companion || u == pony || u.MountId != 0 || u.Definition.ReferenceCompanion == "Pony") continue;
                    float distance = (u.Position - pony.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (distance < best) { best = distance; rider = u; }
                }
                if (rider != null) { rider.MountId = pony.Id; pony.RiderId = rider.Id; }
            }
        }
        private bool OctoberBlocksAttack(UnitState unit)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return false;
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Champion && (ReferenceHero == "Card King" || ReferenceHero == "Sassy Senior" || ReferenceHero == "Clementie" || ReferenceHero == "Anby" || ReferenceHero == "Frosty" && (unit.Position - unit.PreviousPosition).sqrMagnitude < .000001f)) return true;
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Companion && ReferenceHero == "Billy") return true;
            string t = unit.Definition.ReferenceCompanion;
            return t == "Big Cabbage" || t == "Little Cabbage" || t == "Domestic Spiked Ball" || t == "\"Triumphant Return\" Daniel" && Elapsed < 30;
        }
        private float OctoberCycle(UnitState unit)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return 1;
            float bonus = HasOctober("Athlete") && Elapsed - octoberHurtAt < 4 ? .1f : 0;
            if (OctoberTrait(unit, "Fierce Fighter") || OctoberTrait(unit, "\"Bullied\" Sophia")) bonus += Mathf.Min(.2f, unit.OctoberAttacks * .01f);
            if (OctoberTrait(unit, "Hopping Zombie")) bonus += Mathf.Min(.15f, Kills / 8 * .01f);
            if (System.Array.IndexOf(unit.Definition.Tags, "gauntlet") >= 0 && HasOctober("Masked Wrestler")) bonus += Mathf.Min(.15f, octoberInjuries * .01f);
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Champion && HasOctober("Evil")) { int kills = 0; foreach (UnitState u in OctoberUnits("Evil")) kills += u.OctoberKills; bonus += Mathf.Min(.2f, kills / 8 * .02f); }
            return 1 / (1 + bonus);
        }
        private float OctoberAttackDamage(UnitState source, float damage)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || source.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return damage;
            if (OctoberTrait(source, "\"Triumphant Return\" Daniel") && Elapsed >= 30) damage *= 3;
            if (source.Faction == Faction.Champion && ReferenceHero == "Frosty") damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(1.2f, CompanionCount * .12f);
            if (ReferenceHero == "Box Shell" && Elapsed >= 25 && source.Faction != Faction.Enemy) damage *= source.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? 1.4f : .75f;
            return damage;
        }
        private bool ResolveOctoberAttack(UnitState source, float damage, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (IdentityMortar(source, damage)) return true;
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || source != Champion || ReferenceHero != "Burgerboo") return false;
            UnitState target = UnitWithId(source.AttackTargetId);
            if (target != null && !CanHit(source.Faction, target)) target = null;
            if (target == null) return true;
            int count = Mathf.Min(2, Mathf.Max(1, source.Definition.Weapon.ProjectileCount));
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Fuse, source, target.Position + Vector2.right * (i - (count - 1) * .5f) * .9f, source.AttackDirection, 1.1f, damage / count, .85f, .3f, cause);
            return true;
        }
        private float OctoberIncoming(float damage)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics) return damage;
            if (ReferenceHero == "Card Queen") return 1;
            if (HasOctober("\"Colorful Fantasy\" Pinky") && Elapsed - octoberHurtAt >= 6) damage *= .75f;
            return damage;
        }
        private bool FollowOctoberMount(UnitState rider)
        {
            if (rider.MountId <= 0) return false;
            UnitState mount = UnitWithId(rider.MountId);
            if (mount != null && !mount.Alive) mount = null;
            if (mount == null) { rider.MountId = 0; rider.BodyLift = 0; return false; }
            rider.Position = ClampPosition(mount.Position + Vector2.up * mount.Definition.BodyHeight * .35f, rider.Definition.Radius);
            rider.BodyLift = mount.Definition.BodyHeight * .25f; rider.Velocity = mount.Velocity; return true;
        }
        private Vector2 OctoberEnemyTarget(UnitState enemy)
        {
            if (!enemy.Definition.IsBoss && catalog.EnableHeroMechanics && Mathf.Repeat(Elapsed, 6) < 2)
                foreach (UnitState decoy in OctoberUnits("\"Unstoppable\" Paul")) if (decoy.Alive && (decoy.Position - enemy.Position).sqrMagnitude < 64) return decoy.Position;
            return Champion.Position;
        }
        private void OctoberEcho(UnitState source, float scale, CombatCause cause, int count = 1)
        {
            if (!source.Alive || Elapsed < source.OctoberNext || projectiles.Count >= 1000) return;
            UnitState target = FindTarget(source, Mathf.Min(8, Mathf.Max(3, source.Definition.Weapon.Range)));
            if (target == null) return;
            source.OctoberNext = Elapsed + .7f;
            Vector2 direction = (target.Position - source.Position).normalized;
            count = Mathf.Clamp(count, 1, 3);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId, SourceUnitId = source.Id, SourceName = source.Definition.DisplayName + " response", Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, source.Id, "companion-response", 1),
                Faction = source.Faction, Position = source.Position, PreviousPosition = source.Position, Velocity = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (i - (count - 1) * .5f) * 18) * direction * 6, Remaining = 1.4f, Damage = source.Definition.Weapon.Damage * scale / count,
                Color = new Color(.45f, .95f, .88f), Element = source.Definition.Weapon.Element, Sprite = catalog.Projectile, VisualWidth = .18f, Radius = .06f, IsFragment = true });
        }
        private void OctoberWeave(UnitState source, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (morphStrikes.Count > 85) return;
            var pins = new List<UnitState>(3); Vector2 point = source.Position;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                UnitState next = null; float best = i == 0 ? 36 : 9;
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                {
                    float distance = (enemy.Position - point).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) && !pins.Contains(enemy) && distance < best) { next = enemy; best = distance; }
                }
                if (next == null) break; pins.Add(next); point = next.Position;
            }
            float budget = source.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .45f / Mathf.Max(1, pins.Count); point = source.Position;
            for (int i = 0; i < pins.Count; i++)
            {
                Vector2 end = pins[i].Position; float delay = .18f + i * .08f;
                morphStrikes.Add(new MorphStrike { Kind = BuildMorphKind.Thread, Geometry = MorphGeometry.Line, Source = source, Position = point, End = end,
                    Direction = (end - point).normalized, Width = .12f, Created = Elapsed, At = Elapsed + delay, Until = Elapsed + delay + .34f,
                    Budget = budget, MaxTargets = 1, Stage = 1, Cause = cause.Child("lantern-weave") });
                point = end;
            }
        }
        private void ProcessOctoberCombat(float delta, Vector2 movement)
        {
            if (!catalog.EnableHeroMechanics || !Champion.Alive || Phase != RunPhase.Combat) return;
            int original = events.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < original; i++)
            {
                CombatEvent e = events[i]; UnitState source = UnitWithId(e.Cause.SourceUnitId);
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Fire && e.Faction != Faction.Enemy && e.Cause.Depth == 0)
                {
                    if (source != null) source.OctoberAttacks = Mathf.Min(1000, source.OctoberAttacks + 1);
                    if (e.Faction == Faction.Champion)
                    {
                        foreach (UnitState mage in OctoberUnits("Grey Mage")) OctoberEcho(mage, .65f, e.Cause);
                        if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && ReferenceHero == "Billy" && e.Critical)
                            foreach (UnitState ally in units) if (ally.Faction == Faction.Companion && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .5) OctoberEcho(ally, 1, e.Cause);
                    }
                    if (source != null && OctoberTrait(source, "\"Naming Demon\" Yan") && source.OctoberAttacks % 3 == 0) OctoberEcho(source, .25f, e.Cause);
                    if (source != null && OctoberTrait(source, "Original:TeacupCricket") && source.OctoberAttacks % 5 == 0) OctoberEcho(source, .4f, e.Cause);
                    if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && source == Champion && ReferenceHero == "Original:LanternWeaver" && source.OctoberAttacks % 4 == 0)
                        OctoberWeave(source, e.Cause);
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Hit && e.Faction == Faction.Enemy && e.Cause.Depth == 0 && source != null && source.Faction != Faction.Enemy && e.Subject != null)
                {
                    if (OctoberTrait(source, "Camo Shroom") && !e.Subject.Definition.IsBoss) e.Subject.ChillUntil = Mathf.Max(e.Subject.ChillUntil, Elapsed + .4f);
                    if (OctoberTrait(source, "Attractive Witch") && !e.Subject.Definition.IsBoss) { e.Subject.Position = ClampPosition(Vector2.MoveTowards(e.Subject.Position, source.Position, OctoberBalance.Push(e.Subject.Definition, .25f)), e.Subject.Definition.Radius); spatial.Move(e.Subject); }
                    if ((OctoberTrait(source, "Mummy") || ReferenceHero == "Gulpy" && (source == Champion || System.Array.IndexOf(source.Definition.Tags, "archive") >= 0)) && octoberPoison.Count < 128)
                        octoberPoison.Add(new PoisonNote { Source = source, Target = e.Subject, At = Elapsed + 1, Damage = source.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .25f, Cause = e.Cause.Child("companion-poison") });
                    if (OctoberTrait(source, "Fierce Fighter") && source.OctoberAttacks % 3 == 0 && Elapsed >= source.OctoberNext) { source.OctoberNext = Elapsed + 1; Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, source, e.Position, e.Direction, .8f, source.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .15f, .1f, .2f, e.Cause.Child("fighter-blast")); }
                    if (OctoberTrait(source, "TV Head") && e.Critical && Elapsed >= octoberRebateAt && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .25) { octoberRebateAt = Elapsed + .8f; Gold = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)Gold + 1); }
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Kill && e.Faction == Faction.Enemy)
                {
                    if (source != null) source.OctoberKills++;
                    if (ReferenceHero == "Omnom") Heal(1, e.Cause.Child("night-maw-meal"));
                    if (source != null && OctoberTrait(source, "Peach") && e.Cause.Depth == 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .3) Heal(1, e.Cause.Child("peach-mercy"));
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Hit && e.Faction == Faction.Champion)
                {
                    octoberInjuries++; octoberHurtAt = Elapsed;
                    if (HasOctober("Clown") && Elapsed >= octoberSpiritAt) { octoberSpiritAt = Elapsed + 1; Heal(1, e.Cause.Child("clown-comfort")); }
                    if (HasOctober("\"Misfortune\" Emily") && Elapsed >= octoberRebateAt) { octoberRebateAt = Elapsed + 2; Gold = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)Gold + 3); }
                    if (HasOctober("\"Enduring Suffering\" Dorothy") && !octoberRecoveryUsed && ReferenceHero != "Card Queen") { octoberRecoveryUsed = true; Champion.Definition.Health = Mathf.Max(1, Champion.Definition.Health - 2); Heal(Champion.Definition.Health, e.Cause.Child("dorothy-recovery")); }
                    if (ReferenceHero == "The Big Pot") catalog.PassiveHeal = Mathf.Min(6, catalog.PassiveHeal + .15f);
                    if (ReferenceHero == "Porcelain Doll") Champion.Definition.CollisionDamage = Mathf.Min(80, Champion.Definition.CollisionDamage + 1);
                    if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && (ReferenceHero == "Card Queen" || ReferenceHero == "Sassy Senior")) Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, Champion, Champion.Position, Vector2.zero, 3, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * 2, .08f, .2f, e.Cause.Child("royal-retort"));
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Dodge)
                {
                    octoberDodges++;
                    if (ReferenceHero == "Sir Purrcival") catalog.TreasureDetection = Mathf.Min(3, catalog.TreasureDetection + .02f);
                    if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && ReferenceHero == "Anby") { Champion.OctoberNext = 0; OctoberEcho(Champion, 2, e.Cause); }
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Pickup && e.Loot == LootKind.Heart)
                {
                    octoberHearts++;
                    if (HasOctober("Original:RibbonOtter")) Heal(1, e.Cause.Child("otter-ribbon"));
                }
                if (e.Kind == CombatEventKind.ChestOpened)
                {
                    octoberChests++;
                    if (ReferenceHero == "Original:RainArchivist" || ReferenceHero == "Gulpy") Heal(4, e.Cause.Child("rain-receipt"));
                    if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && ReferenceHero == "Original:RainArchivist" && octoberChests % 3 == 0) { Champion.OctoberNext = 0; OctoberEcho(Champion, 1, e.Cause, 3); }
                }
            }
            for (int i = octoberPoison.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                PoisonNote p = octoberPoison[i]; if (!p.Target.Alive || !p.Source.Alive) { octoberPoison.RemoveAt(i); continue; }
                if (Elapsed < p.At) continue; octoberPoison.RemoveAt(i); ApplyDamage(p.Target, p.Damage, p.Source.Faction, "Living toy poison", cause: p.Cause);
            }
            if (movement.sqrMagnitude > .01f) octoberMoveTime += delta;
            if (ReferenceHero == "Nekomata" && octoberMoveTime >= 3) { octoberMoveTime -= 3; Gold = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)Gold + 2); }
            if (Elapsed >= octoberTickAt)
            {
                octoberTickAt = Elapsed + 1;
                if (ReferenceHero == "Omnom") ApplyDamage(Champion, 1, Faction.Enemy, "Night Maw hunger", cause: NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("hunger"), injectedDamage: true, healthCost: true);
                if (ReferenceHero == "Frosty" && movement.sqrMagnitude < .001f) Heal(Champion.Definition.Health * .05f, NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("frost-rest"));
                if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && ReferenceHero == "Steel Shell" && Mathf.FloorToInt(Elapsed) % 3 == 0) Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, Champion, Champion.Position, Vector2.zero, 2.2f, Champion.Definition.CollisionDamage, .25f, .3f, NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("steel-resonance"));
                if (!HeroIdentityEnabled && ReferenceHero == "Original:HourglassStag" && Mathf.FloorToInt(Elapsed) % 6 == 0)
                {
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Echo, Champion, Champion.Position, Vector2.zero, 2.5f, Champion.Definition.Weapon.Damage * .65f, .1f, .35f, NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("hourglass-ring"));
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units) if (enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && !enemy.Definition.IsBoss && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude < 9) enemy.ChillUntil = Elapsed + .7f;
                }
                foreach (UnitState u in OctoberUnits("Domestic Spiked Ball")) u.Definition.CollisionDamage = 18 + Mathf.Min(20, octoberInjuries);
            }
            foreach (UnitState nurse in OctoberUnits("Young Lady"))
                if (Elapsed >= nurse.OctoberNext) { nurse.OctoberNext = Elapsed + 5; DropLoot(LootKind.Heart, nurse.Position, 1); }
            if (HasOctober("\"Overtime King\" Philip") && Elapsed >= octoberResponseAt) { octoberResponseAt = Elapsed + 5; ApplyDamage(Champion, .5f, Faction.Enemy, "Overtime exhaustion", cause: NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("overtime-cost"), injectedDamage: true, healthCost: true); }
        }
    }
}
````
