````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot
    {
        public int LeafPurchases, OctoberRefreshes, OctoberDrinks, OctoberFood, OctoberHearts, OctoberChests;
        public List<StatModifier> OctoberGains = new List<StatModifier>();
        public List<string> AbsorbedSkills = new List<string>();
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        private string OctoberHero => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).ReferenceHero ?? "";
        private bool OctoberAbsorbs => OctoberHero == "Wise" || OctoberHero == "Capped Gallant";
        private void ValidateOctoberState(RunSnapshot r)
        {
            if (r == null) return;
            if (r.LeafPurchases < 0 || r.OctoberRefreshes < 0 || r.OctoberDrinks < 0 || r.OctoberFood < 0 || r.OctoberHearts < 0 || r.OctoberChests < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid character progress");
            if ((r.OctoberGains?.Count ?? 0) > 128 || (r.AbsorbedSkills?.Count ?? 0) > 2048 || (r.AchievementEvidence?.Count ?? 0) > 512) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid character journal size");
            foreach (StatModifier m in r.OctoberGains ?? new List<StatModifier>()) if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemEffect), m.Effect) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ModifierScope), m.Scope) || !float.IsFinite(m.Value)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid character modifier");
            foreach (string id in r.AbsorbedSkills ?? new List<string>()) if (!Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, u => u.Id == id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid companion memory");
            var keys = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (AchievementMetric m in r.AchievementEvidence ?? new List<AchievementMetric>()) if (m == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(m.Id) || !float.IsFinite(m.Value) || m.Value < 0 || !keys.Add(m.Id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid achievement evidence");
        }
        private int Talent(string name)
        {
            int count = 0; foreach (RosterEntry r in State.Roster) if (catalog.Unit(r.UnitId).ReferenceCompanion == name) count++;
            if (State.AbsorbedSkills != null) foreach (string id in State.AbsorbedSkills) if (catalog.Unit(id)?.ReferenceCompanion == name) count++;
            return count;
        }
        private int BondLevel(string id) => BondCounts.TryGetValue(id, out int count) ? catalog.Bonds[Array.FindIndex(catalog.Bonds, b => b.Id == id)].ActiveLevel(count) : 0;
        private float OctoberBonus(ItemEffect effect, ModifierScope scope)
        {
            float value = 0; bool hero = scope == ModifierScope.Champion, ally = scope == ModifierScope.Companions;
            if (State.OctoberGains != null) foreach (StatModifier m in State.OctoberGains) if (m.Effect == effect && RunModifierRules.Applies(m.Scope, scope)) value += m.Value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Damage && (hero || ally)) value += .05f * Talent("Chieftain") + .2f * Talent("\"Quick Production\" Tao");
            if (effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed && (hero || ally)) value += .05f * Talent("Cheer Bunny") + .1f * Talent("\"Quick Production\" Tao");
            if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += 5 * Talent("Floofy") + 4 * Talent("Hopping Zombie");
            if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value += .08f * (Talent("Floofy") - Talent("Phantom"));
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Income) value += 4 * Talent("Judge") * BondLevel("clover") + 15 * Talent("\"Overtime King\" Philip");
            if ((effect == ItemEffect.MeleeDamage || effect == ItemEffect.RangedDamage) && (hero || ally)) value += State.OctoberFood * Talent("\"Art of Food\" Roshi");
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Health && hero) value -= Mathf.Min(20, State.OctoberFood * .5f * Talent("\"Art of Food\" Roshi"));
            if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemySpeed) value += .1f * Talent("\"Quick Production\" Tao");
            if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Projectiles) value += Mathf.Min(3, Talent("Matchstick Head") * BondLevel("morning"));
            switch (OctoberHero)
            {
                case "Mr. Work": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += 5; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .05f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Heal) value += .2f; break;
                case "Derpy Wolf": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .2f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value -= .15f; if (hero && (effect == ItemEffect.Crit || effect == ItemEffect.Dodge)) value += .1f; break;
                case "Sassy Senior": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.Damage) value += Mathf.Min(.5f, Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.Luck)) * .5f); break;
                case "Baggy": if (effect == ItemEffect.Discount) value += .3f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Pickup) value += 1000; if (hero && (effect == ItemEffect.Dodge || effect == ItemEffect.TreasureDetection)) value -= 1; break;
                case "Red Scale": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += State.OctoberDrinks * 2; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value -= Mathf.Min(.4f, State.OctoberDrinks * .02f); if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyCount) value += Mathf.Min(.4f, State.OctoberDrinks * .02f); break;
                case "Gulpy": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed || effect == ItemEffect.EnemySpeed) value += .15f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += State.OctoberChests; break;
                case "Steel Shell": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage) value += 3 * BondLevel("gauntlet"); break;
                case "Box Shell": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.RangedDamage) value += 3; if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.MeleeDamage) value -= 2; break;
                case "Omnom": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed || effect == ItemEffect.EnemySpeed) value += Mathf.Min(.5f, .1f * (1 + State.Wave / 4)); break;
                case "Periwinky": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.Damage) value -= .2f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage) value += 10; break;
                case "Jade Cabbage": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Projectiles) value += Mathf.Min(6, State.LeafPurchases); if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value -= State.LeafPurchases * 2; break;
                case "The Big Pot": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage) value += 8; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value += BondLevel("morning") * .15f; if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemySpeed) value += .1f; break;
                case "Porcelain Doll": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.HealCorrection) value += 1.5f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value -= .25f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Heal) value += BondLevel("hide") * .4f; break;
                case "Slippy": if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.Damage) value -= .35f; if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.Knockback) value += 1; if (effect == ItemEffect.Income) value += 4 * BondLevel("gear"); if (effect == ItemEffect.TreasureDetection) value += .2f; break;
                case "Card King": if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyCount) value += .15f; break;
                case "Sir Purrcival": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Dodge) value += .35f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.HealthCorrection) value -= .35f; break;
                case "Clementie": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.HealthCorrection) value += .5f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .2f; if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.AttackSpeed) value -= .25f; break;
                case "Bloom Shell": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Health) value += 10; if ((hero || ally) && (effect == ItemEffect.RangedDamage || effect == ItemEffect.MeleeDamage)) value += 2; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value += .15f; if ((hero || ally) && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .05f; break;
                case "Belle": if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyHealth) value += .35f; if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyCount) value += .2f; break;
                case "Wise": if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemyHealth) value += .04f * (State.AbsorbedSkills?.Count ?? 0); break;
                case "Nicole": if (effect == ItemEffect.Discount) value += .2f; if (effect == ItemEffect.Income) value += State.OctoberRefreshes; if (effect == ItemEffect.Luck) value += Mathf.Min(1, State.OctoberRefreshes * .01f); break;
                case "Anby": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Dodge) value += .2f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage) value += 12; break;
                case "Billy": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Crit) value += .1f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Projectiles) value += 2; break;
                case "Nekomata": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .2f; if (effect == ItemEffect.Income) value -= State.Roster.Count; break;
                case "Burgerboo": if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.Armor) value += .4f; if (hero && effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed) value += .15f; if (effect == ItemEffect.EnemySpeed) value += .2f; break;
            }
            return value;
        }
        public bool OctoberItemEligible(ItemDefinition item)
        {
            if (OctoberHero == "Belle" || item.ShopThemes == null || item.ShopThemes.Length == 0) return true;
            foreach (string theme in catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).RecruitThemes) if (Array.IndexOf(item.ShopThemes, theme) >= 0) return true;
            return false;
        }
        private void OctoberPurchase(UnitDefinition unit)
        {
            string talent = unit.ReferenceCompanion;
            if (OctoberHero == "Jade Cabbage" && talent == "Little Cabbage") State.LeafPurchases++;
            if (talent == "\"Expert Nurturer\" Daisy") State.Eggs = BoundedCounter((long)State.Eggs + 6);
            if (talent == "\"The Creator\" Roger") State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 100);
            if (talent == "\"GLHF\" Nia")
            {
                int pick = Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, 4); State.OctoberGains.Add(new StatModifier { Effect = new[] { ItemEffect.Damage, ItemEffect.MoveSpeed, ItemEffect.Luck, ItemEffect.Armor }[pick], Scope = pick == 2 ? ModifierScope.Run : pick == 3 ? ModifierScope.Champion : ModifierScope.Team, Value = pick == 3 ? .12f : .06f });
            }
            string[] gifts = talent == "\"Pet Master\" Lisa" ? new[] { "MonsterMarble", "MonsterMarble", "MonsterMarble", "MonsterMarble" } : talent == "\"Shove Around\" Bella" ? new[] { "BalloonMallet", "BalloonMallet" } : talent == "\"Smug and Satisfied\" Jake" ? new[] { "TeacupCricket", "RibbonOtter" } : Array.Empty<string>();
            foreach (string id in gifts)
            {
                if (OctoberAbsorbs) { if (State.AbsorbedSkills.Count < 2048) State.AbsorbedSkills.Add(id); continue; }
                if (State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit || catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw) break;
                UnitDefinition friend = catalog.Unit(id); if (friend == null) continue;
                var choices = new List<WeaponDefinition>(); foreach (WeaponDefinition w in catalog.Weapons) if (RecruitWeaponEligible(id, w) && !State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == w.Id)) choices.Add(w);
                if (choices.Count == 0) continue; var entry = new RosterEntry { UnitId = id, WeaponId = choices[Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, choices.Count)].Id }; State.Roster.Add(entry); RememberVariant(entry);
            }
        }
        private void OctoberBoughtRelic(ItemDefinition item)
        {
            if (OctoberHero == "Red Scale" && item.Category == RelicCategory.Drink) State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 1 + Mathf.Min(15, Mathf.FloorToInt(MaximumHealth() / 10)));
            if (OctoberHero != "Periwinky" || item.ReferenceName != "Spiky Yoga Ball" || State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit) return;
            string id = "BristleBall";
            var pool = Array.FindAll(catalog.Weapons, w => RecruitWeaponEligible(id, w) && !State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == w.Id));
            if (pool.Length == 0) return;
            var entry = new RosterEntry { UnitId = id, WeaponId = pool[Next(ref State.WeaponRandom, pool.Length)].Id };
            State.Roster.Add(entry); RememberVariant(entry);
        }
        private void OctoberSettled(CombatSimulation battle)
        {
            State.OctoberHearts = BoundedCounter((long)State.OctoberHearts + battle.OctoberHeartsCollected);
            State.OctoberChests = BoundedCounter((long)State.OctoberChests + battle.OctoberChestsOpened);
            void Gain(ItemEffect effect, float value)
            {
                if (value <= 0) return;
                StatModifier existing = State.OctoberGains.Find(m => m.Effect == effect && m.Scope == ModifierScope.Champion);
                if (existing == null) State.OctoberGains.Add(new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Scope = ModifierScope.Champion, Value = value });
                else existing.Value = Mathf.Min(effect == ItemEffect.CollisionDamage ? 80 : 6, existing.Value + value);
            }
            if (OctoberHero == "The Big Pot") Gain(ItemEffect.Heal, battle.OctoberInjuries * .15f);
            if (OctoberHero == "Porcelain Doll") Gain(ItemEffect.CollisionDamage, battle.OctoberInjuries);
            if (OctoberHero == "Sassy Senior") Gain(ItemEffect.Luck, battle.OctoberHeartsCollected * .02f);
            if (OctoberHero == "Sir Purrcival") Gain(ItemEffect.TreasureDetection, battle.OctoberDodges * .02f);
            RunAchievements.Mark(State.AchievementEvidence, "battle-gold", battle.Gold);
        }
        private int OctoberOfferTier(string id)
        {
            int merge = OctoberMergeTier(id); if (merge > 0) return merge;
            if (OctoberHero == "Card King" && !State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id)) return 2;
            if (State.Roster.Count >= 7 || State.Wave < 4 || State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id)) return 1;
            int roll = Next(ref State.ShopRandom, 100);
            return State.Wave >= 10 && State.Roster.Count <= 3 && roll < 18 ? 3 : roll < (State.Roster.Count <= 3 ? 55 : 30) ? 2 : 1;
        }
        private void OctoberRefreshed()
        {
            State.OctoberRefreshes++;
            State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + Mathf.Min(6, 2 * Talent("Smiley Fox")));
        }
        private int OctoberMergeTier(string id)
        {
            if (catalog.Unit(id).ReferenceCompanion == "Evil") return 0;
            for (int tier = 2; tier >= 1; tier--) if (State.Roster.FindAll(r => r.UnitId == id && r.Tier == tier).Count >= 2) return tier;
            return 0;
        }
        private List<RosterEntry> AltarMaterials(AltarRecipe recipe)
        {
            var found = new List<RosterEntry>();
            foreach (string id in new[] { recipe.FirstUnit, recipe.SecondUnit, recipe.ThirdUnit })
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) continue;
                RosterEntry chosen = null;
                foreach (RosterEntry r in State.Roster) if (r.UnitId == id && r.Tier >= recipe.MinimumMaterialTier && !found.Contains(r) && (chosen == null || r.Tier < chosen.Tier)) chosen = r;
                if (chosen == null) return null; found.Add(chosen);
            }
            return found;
        }
        private void CompileOctoberRoster()
        {
            CombatCatalog.OctoberMemories = (State.AbsorbedSkills ?? new List<string>()).ConvertAll(id => catalog.Unit(id).ReferenceCompanion).ToArray();
            CombatCatalog.OctoberHealingReceived = K10StatRules.Factor(Bonus(ItemEffect.HealCorrection));
            foreach (UnitDefinition unit in CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions)
            {
                WeaponDefinition w = unit.Weapon; string t = unit.ReferenceCompanion ?? "";
                if (t == "Alien") w.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.4f, State.OctoberDrinks * .04f);
                if (t == "Student") { w.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Min(10, w.ProjectileCount + 2); w.Damage *= .65f; }
                if (t == "\"Unstoppable\" Paul") unit.CollisionDamage += 40;
                if (t == "Vengeful Spirit") unit.CriticalChance = Mathf.Min(1, unit.CriticalChance + .15f);
                if (t == "Iron Swordsman") w.Cooldown /= 1 + Mathf.Min(.3f, Talent(t) * .1f);
                if (t == "Prince") w.ProjectileCount += Mathf.Min(3, Talent("Princess"));
                if (t == "Princess") w.Range *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.24f, Talent("Prince") * .08f);
                if (t == "Smiley Fox") w.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.3f, State.OctoberRefreshes * .03f);
                if (t == "Pointy Hat Witch") w.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.3f, State.OctoberChests * .02f);
                if (t == "Phantom") w.Range *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.2f, State.OctoberHearts * .02f);
                if (t == "Pirate") w.Cooldown /= 1 + Mathf.Min(.2f, State.OctoberChests * .02f);
                if (t == "Jungle Folk") { int n = BondLevel("hide") + BondLevel("hare"); w.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.5f, n * .1f); w.Range *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.2f, n * .05f); }
                if (t == "\"Cars ARE My Kids\" Chris") { int n = Mathf.Min(3, Talent("Pony")); w.Damage *= 1 + n * .3f; unit.CollisionDamage += n * 5; }
                if (t == "Inflatable Hammer") { w.Damage *= .3f; w.PushDistance = .45f; }
                if (t == "Little Cabbage" || t == "Big Cabbage" || t == "Domestic Spiked Ball") { w.Damage = 0; unit.CollisionDamage = t == "Little Cabbage" ? 12 : t == "Big Cabbage" ? 24 : 18; }
                bool Tagged(string tag) => Array.IndexOf(unit.Tags, tag) >= 0;
                if (Tagged("fruit")) w.Cooldown /= 1 + Mathf.Min(.24f, Talent("Applehead") * .08f);
                if (Tagged("gear")) { float bonus = Mathf.Min(.25f, Talent("Bullhorn Warrior") * .08f + Talent("Intelligent Construct") * .04f); w.Cooldown /= 1 + bonus; unit.Speed *= 1 + bonus; }
                if (Tagged("rune") && Talent("Little Witch") > 0) { w.Cooldown *= 1.15f; w.ProjectileVisualWidth *= 1.3f; w.ProjectilePierce += 2; }
                if (Tagged("shoe") && Talent("Monkey King") > 0) { w.Cooldown /= 1.1f; unit.Speed *= 1.1f; }
                if (Tagged("lantern-guild") && Talent("Original:SpindleWren") > 0) w.Range *= 1.08f;
                if (Tagged("knight") && OctoberHero == "Sir Purrcival") w.Damage *= 1.3f;
                if (Tagged("regal") && OctoberHero == "Card Queen") w.ProjectileCount++;
                if (Talent("\"Formatting Pixie\" Quentin") > 0) { unit.BodyHeight *= .88f; unit.Radius *= .88f; }
                if (OctoberHero == "Card King")
                {
                    UnitDefinition main = CombatCatalog.Champion; w.Damage *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.5f, Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.ChampionDamage, ModifierScope.Champion)));
                    w.Cooldown /= 1 + Mathf.Min(.3f, Mathf.Max(0, Bonus(ItemEffect.AttackSpeed, ModifierScope.Champion)));
                    unit.CriticalChance = Mathf.Max(unit.CriticalChance, main.CriticalChance); w.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Min(10, w.ProjectileCount + Mathf.Max(0, main.Weapon.ProjectileCount - 1));
                }
                if (OctoberHero == "Clementie") unit.CollisionDamage += CombatCatalog.Champion.Speed * 1.5f;
                if (OctoberHero == "Frosty") { w.Damage *= Mathf.Max(.65f, 1 - State.Roster.Count * .02f); unit.BodyHeight *= Mathf.Max(.75f, 1 - State.Roster.Count * .01f); }
                w.Range = Mathf.Min(w.Range, w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? 3.4f : 8); w.Cooldown = Mathf.Max(.28f, w.Cooldown);
            }
            if (OctoberHero == "Periwinky") CombatCatalog.Champion.Health = Mathf.Clamp(State.Gold, 20, 400);
            if (OctoberHero == "Card Queen") CombatCatalog.Champion.Health = 12;
            if (OctoberHero == "Billy") CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileSplit = 0;
            if (OctoberHero == "Omnom" || OctoberHero == "Card Queen") CombatCatalog.PassiveHeal = 0;
            if (OctoberHero == "Burgerboo") { CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileCount = Mathf.Min(2, CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileCount); CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectilePierce = 0; }
            if (OctoberHero == "Clementie") CombatCatalog.CompanionLeash = 1.8f;
            if (OctoberHero == "Anby") CombatCatalog.Champion.CollisionDamage *= 2;
            if (OctoberHero == "Frosty") { CombatCatalog.Champion.BodyHeight *= 1 + Mathf.Min(.35f, State.Roster.Count * .02f); CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileSplit = Mathf.Max(1, CombatCatalog.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileSplit); }
        }
    }
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/OutsideStageCombat.cs | SHA-256 f6dc33d8e5a9e5ef57962e1b7e7a2c58f45c617513fc3840c6acaffaaf5351bb</summary>

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private bool ProcessOutsideStage(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (boss.Definition.Id != "OutsideStageKeeper") return false;
            boss.BossPoseTime = Elapsed;
            if (boss.TelegraphUntil > 0)
            {
                if (Elapsed < boss.TelegraphUntil) return true;
                boss.TelegraphUntil = 0;
                int pattern = boss.BossVolley % 6;
                int part = pattern / 2;
                Vector2 target = boss.AbilityTarget;
                Vector2 across = new Vector2(-boss.TelegraphDirection.y, boss.TelegraphDirection.x);
                if (BossPartRules.Broken(boss, part)) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.Position, 3.2f, 0.65f, 1.3f);
                else switch (pattern)
                {
                    case 0:
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target, 1.05f, 0.75f, 0.4f, 0);
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, target, 3.1f, 0.85f, 1.4f, 0);
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, target + across * index * 1.7f, 0.32f, 0.35f + (index + 1) * 0.3f, 0.4f, 0);
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, target, 0.6f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 1);
                        foreach (PickupState coin in pickups) if (!coin.Attracting) coin.Position = Vector2.Lerp(coin.Position, boss.Position, 0.25f);
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        for (int index = -1; index <= 1; index += 2) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, target + across * index * 2.2f, 0.45f, index < 0 ? 0.4f : 0.95f, 0.4f, 1);
                        break;
                    case 4:
                        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.ShadowPool, boss, target + across * (index - 1) * 2.2f, 0.8f, 0.7f + index * 0.2f, 1.5f, 2);
                        break;
                    case 5:
                        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, target + across * (index - 1) * 2, 0.65f, 0.85f + index * 0.3f, 0.4f, 2);
                        break;
                }
                boss.BossVolley++; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed - boss.AttackWindup;
                boss.BossRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.2f;
                boss.NextBossPattern = Elapsed + (boss.Health < boss.Definition.Health * 0.35f ? 2.8f : 3.5f);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
                return true;
            }
            if (Elapsed < boss.NextBossPattern) return true;
            int phase = boss.Health < boss.Definition.Health * 0.35f ? 2 : boss.Health < boss.Definition.Health * 0.7f ? 1 : 0;
            if (boss.BossVolley % 6 > phase * 2 + 1) boss.BossVolley += 6 - boss.BossVolley % 6;
            boss.ActiveBossOrgan = boss.BossVolley % 6 / 2;
            boss.ActiveBossSignature = -1;
            boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.AttackWindup = 1.35f;
            boss.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + boss.AttackWindup;
            boss.TelegraphDirection = (Champion.Position - boss.Position).normalized;
            boss.AbilityTarget = ClampPosition(Champion.Position, 1);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, BossPartRules.Position(boss, boss.ActiveBossOrgan), Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum OutsideStageStatus { Unseen, Declined, Fighting, Reward, Completed }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        private void ValidateOutsideStage(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            if (snapshot == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing run");
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(OutsideStageStatus), snapshot.OutsideStage) || snapshot.OutsideTransfers < 0 || snapshot.OutsideTransfers > 1000 || snapshot.LastOutsideTransferWave < 0 || snapshot.LastOutsideTransferWave > snapshot.Wave) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid outside-stage progress");
            if (snapshot.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Fighting && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid challenge phase");
            if (snapshot.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Reward) return;
            if (snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || snapshot.OutsideRewards == null || snapshot.OutsideRewards.Count != 3 || new HashSet<string>(snapshot.OutsideRewards).Count != 3) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid prismatic choices");
            foreach (string id in snapshot.OutsideRewards)
            {
                ItemDefinition item = catalog.Item(id); UnitDefinition ally = catalog.Unit(id);
                if (item != null && item.Rarity == ItemRarity.Rainbow) continue;
                if (ally == null || ally.Rarity != ItemRarity.Rainbow || catalog.Unit(snapshot.ChampionId).HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid prismatic reward");
            }
        }
        public bool OutsideChallengeAvailable => !SecretRoomOpen && State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Unseen && State.OutsideTransfers >= 3 && OutsideStageAssets.Current != null;
        public void RegisterOutsideTransfer()
        {
            if (State.LastOutsideTransferWave >= State.Wave) return;
            State.LastOutsideTransferWave = State.Wave;
            State.OutsideTransfers = Mathf.Min(1000, State.OutsideTransfers + 1);
        }
        public bool DeclineOutsideStage()
        {
            if (!OutsideChallengeAvailable) return false;
            State.OutsideStage = OutsideStageStatus.Declined; return true;
        }
        public bool AcceptOutsideStage()
        {
            if (!OutsideChallengeAvailable) return false;
            State.OutsideStage = OutsideStageStatus.Fighting;
            State.Phase = SessionPhase.Combat;
            return true;
        }
        private void PrepareOutsideStage()
        {
            if (State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Fighting) return;
            OutsideStageAssets assets = OutsideStageAssets.Current;
            if (assets == null || assets.Boss == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing outside-stage encounter");
            CombatCatalog.Boss = BuildEnemy(assets.Boss, 1 + Mathf.Max(0, State.Wave - 13) * 0.06f);
            CombatCatalog.Boss.Health = assets.Boss.Health * 20 * (1 + State.Difficulty * 0.25f + Mathf.Max(0, State.Wave - 13) * 0.08f) * OctoberBalance.EndlessHealth(State.Wave, State.Endless);
            CombatCatalog.Boss.BodyHeight = assets.Boss.BodyHeight * 1.75f;
            CombatCatalog.Boss.Weapon.Damage *= 2.8f; CombatCatalog.Boss.ContactDamage *= 2.5f;
            CombatCatalog.Boss.KnockbackResistance = 1;
            CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 0;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(22, 12);
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
            CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 0;
        }
        private bool SettleOutsideStage(CombatSimulation simulation)
        {
            if (State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Fighting) return false;
            State.Health = simulation.Champion.Health;
            State.CombatSeconds += simulation.Elapsed;
            State.LastDamageSource = simulation.LastDamageSource;
            State.LastDamageKind = simulation.LastDamageKind;
            State.LastDamageAmount = simulation.LastDamageAmount;
            ContributionLedger.Merge(State.Contributions, simulation.Contributions);
            if (simulation.Phase == RunPhase.Defeat) { State.Phase = SessionPhase.Defeat; return true; }
            if (!simulation.BossDefeated || simulation.Boss == null || simulation.Boss.Definition.Id != "OutsideStageKeeper") throw new InvalidOperationException("Outside-stage victory requires its boss");
            State.Health = MaximumHealth();
            State.OutsideStage = OutsideStageStatus.Reward; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Shop;
            var choices = new List<string> { "RainbowCrown", "RainbowHeart", "RainbowThread", "RainbowPrism" };
            if (catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic != HeroMechanic.SoloMaw)
            {
                choices.Insert(0, "RainbowTailor"); choices.Insert(1, "RainbowBell");
            }
            State.OutsideRewards = new List<string>();
            uint seed = unchecked((uint)State.Seed ^ 0x728a53b1);
            while (State.OutsideRewards.Count < 3)
            {
                seed = unchecked(seed * 1664525 + 1013904223);
                int index = (int)(seed % (uint)choices.Count);
                State.OutsideRewards.Add(choices[index]); choices.RemoveAt(index);
            }
            if (catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic != HeroMechanic.SoloMaw && !State.OutsideRewards.Exists(id => id == "RainbowTailor" || id == "RainbowBell")) State.OutsideRewards[2] = "RainbowTailor";
            return true;
        }
        public bool ClaimOutsideStageReward(int index)
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Reward || State.OutsideRewards == null || State.OutsideRewards.Count != 3 || index < 0 || index >= 3) return false;
            string id = State.OutsideRewards[index];
            float previousMaximum = MaximumHealth();
            ItemDefinition item = catalog.Item(id);
            if (item != null && item.Rarity == ItemRarity.Rainbow)
            {
                ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(candidate => candidate.Id == id);
                if (stack != null) return false;
                State.Items.Add(new ItemStack { Id = id, Count = 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                UnitDefinition ally = catalog.Unit(id);
                if (State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit) return false;
                if (ally == null || ally.Rarity != ItemRarity.Rainbow || catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw) return false;
                var entry = new RosterEntry { UnitId = id, WeaponId = ally.Weapon.Id, Tier = 1 };
                State.Roster.Add(entry); RememberVariant(entry); OctoberPurchase(ally);
            }
            State.OutsideStage = OutsideStageStatus.Completed;
            RecountBonds();
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(MaximumHealth(), State.Health + Mathf.Max(0, MaximumHealth() - previousMaximum));
            State.OutsideRewards.Clear();
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public int NewRecruitLimit => State.Wave <= 3 ? 2 : 1;
        public int CompanionLimit => OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit;
        public const int CompanionPurchaseLimit = 3;
        public int CompanionPurchasesRemaining => Math.Max(0, CompanionPurchaseLimit - State.NewRecruitsThisWave);
        public int NewRecruitsRemaining => Math.Min(CompanionPurchasesRemaining, Math.Max(0, NewRecruitLimit - State.NewSpeciesRecruitsThisWave));
        public bool OwnsCompanionSpecies(string id) => State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id) || (State.AbsorbedSkills?.Contains(id) ?? false);
        // Source shop matters, not currency or the companion's catalog rarity.
        private bool CountsTowardRecruitLimit(ShopOffer offer) => offer != null && offer.Kind == OfferKind.Companion && !State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer);
        private bool CountsAsNewRegularRecruit(ShopOffer offer) => offer != null && offer.Kind == OfferKind.Companion &&
            !State.SpecialOffers.Contains(offer) && !OwnsCompanionSpecies(offer.Id);
        public bool RecruitQuotaBlocks(ShopOffer offer) => CountsTowardRecruitLimit(offer) &&
            (CompanionPurchasesRemaining == 0 || NewRecruitsRemaining == 0 && !OwnsCompanionSpecies(offer.Id));
        public bool CompanionCapacityBlocks(ShopOffer offer)
        {
            if (offer == null || offer.Kind != OfferKind.Companion || OctoberAbsorbs || State.Roster.Count < CompanionLimit) return false;
            int tier = Math.Clamp(offer.Tier, 1, 3);
            return tier >= catalog.MaximumTier || catalog.Unit(offer.Id)?.ReferenceCompanion == "Evil" || State.Roster.FindAll(r => r.UnitId == offer.Id && r.Tier == tier).Count < 2;
        }
        public string RecruitmentSummary => "NEW SPECIES: " + NewRecruitsRemaining + "/" + NewRecruitLimit +
            " remaining. COMPANION PURCHASES: " + CompanionPurchasesRemaining + "/3 remaining this round, including star-upgrade copies. Dream-shop recruits use neither quota. Brigade limit: 15 bodies; immediate merges remain possible when full.";
        public string RecruitQuotaDenial => CompanionPurchasesRemaining == 0 ? "3 COMPANIONS BOUGHT THIS ROUND" : "NEW SPECIES LIMIT: " + NewRecruitLimit + " THIS ROUND";
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float relicPulseAt;
        private float relicSecondAt;
        private float relicEchoAt;
        private int relicProcessedEvents;
        private bool relicMoved;
        private bool relicStanding;
        private int relicLastKills;
        private float relicDamageLoss;
        private bool lotusActive;
        private readonly List<UnitState> phantomWeapons = new List<UnitState>();
        public int RelicCount(RelicMechanic mechanic) => catalog.RelicStacks != null && (int)mechanic < catalog.RelicStacks.Length ? catalog.RelicStacks[(int)mechanic] : 0;

        private void ResetRelics()
        {
            relicPulseAt = 3; relicSecondAt = 1; relicEchoAt = 0; relicMoved = false;
            relicLastKills = relicProcessedEvents = 0; relicDamageLoss = 0; phantomWeapons.Clear();
            lotusActive = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FreshLotus) > 0;
            if (lotusActive) AdjustLotus(1);
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0) Champion.Definition.Weapon.Cooldown = Mathf.Max(.1f,Champion.Definition.Weapon.Cooldown / 6);
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SixWeapons) == 0) return;
            for (int index = 0; index < 6; index++)
            {
                UnitDefinition template = catalog.RelicWeapons.Length == 6 ? catalog.RelicWeapons[index] : Champion.Definition;
                phantomWeapons.Add(new UnitState { Id = Champion.Id, Faction = Faction.Champion, Definition = template, Alive = true, NextAttack = index * .13f });
            }
        }

        private bool RelicBlocksAttack(UnitState unit)
        {
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return false;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SixWeapons) > 0) return true;
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Champion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CollisionOnly) > 0) return true;
            return unit.Faction == Faction.Companion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0;
        }

        private void AdjustLotus(int direction)
        {
            int count = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FreshLotus);
            foreach (UnitState ally in units)
                if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
                {
                    ally.Definition.Weapon.ProjectilePierce += direction * 3 * count;
                    ally.Definition.CriticalChance += direction * .3f * count;
                }
        }

        private float RelicAttackDamage(UnitState unit, float damage)
        {
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy) return damage;
            float flat = !relicMoved ? 16 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillPower) : 0;
            float hoard = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HoardPower);
            float purse = 1 + hoard * ((catalog.RelicWallet + (long)Gold) / 5) * .01f;
            float initial = 1 + hoard * (catalog.RelicWallet / 5) * .01f;
            float result = Mathf.Max(0,damage + flat) * Mathf.Max(.05f,1 - relicDamageLoss) * purse / initial;
            return RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StatFloor) > 0 ? Mathf.Max(damage,result) : result;
        }

        private void RelicGain(ItemEffect effect, float value, ModifierScope? scope = null)
        {
            if (value == 0) return;
            catalog.RelicGain?.Invoke(new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Value = value, Scope = scope ?? RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(effect) });
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Health) { Champion.Definition.Health += value; Champion.Health = Mathf.Min(Champion.Definition.Health,Champion.Health + Mathf.Max(0,value)); }
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Armor) catalog.Armor += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Heal) catalog.PassiveHeal += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Luck) catalog.Luck += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Crit) foreach (UnitState ally in units) if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy) ally.Definition.CriticalChance += value;
            if (effect == ItemEffect.Damage)
                foreach (UnitState ally in units) if (ally.Faction != Faction.Enemy) ally.Definition.Weapon.Damage *= Mathf.Max(.05f,1 + value);
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Proc,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,value,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-growth")));
        }

        private void RelicHit(UnitState target, Faction source, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (target == Champion)
            {
                if (lotusActive) { AdjustLotus(-1); lotusActive = false; }
                relicDamageLoss += .05f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower);
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower) > 0) catalog.RelicGain?.Invoke(new StatModifier { Effect = ItemEffect.Damage, Scope = ModifierScope.Team, Value = -.05f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.FragilePower) });
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PanicMagnet) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .05) foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups) pickup.Attracting = true;
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.RetortVolley) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .3) RelicVolley(8,12 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.RetortVolley));
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HurtGrowth) > 0)
                {
                    ItemEffect[] effects = { ItemEffect.Health, ItemEffect.Heal, ItemEffect.Armor, ItemEffect.Damage, ItemEffect.Luck, ItemEffect.Crit };
                    int choice = combatRandom.Next(effects.Length);
                    float[] values = { 4,.08f,.015f,.02f,.02f,.01f };
                    RelicGain(effects[choice],values[choice] * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.HurtGrowth));
                }
            }
            else if (target.Faction == Faction.Enemy && source == Faction.Champion && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.IncomePoison) > 0 && cause.Depth == 0)
            {
                if (target.RelicPoisonUntil <= Elapsed) target.RelicPoisonAt = Elapsed + 1;
                target.RelicPoisonUntil = Elapsed + 4;
            }
        }

        private void RelicPickup(PickupState pickup)
        {
            if (pickup.Kind != LootKind.Coin) return;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinMending) > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .15) Heal(2 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinMending),NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-coin-heal"));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinLightning) > 0) RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(4,catalog.Luck * 50) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.CoinLightning),1,"curio-coin-strike");
        }

        private void RelicChest()
        {
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestOnlyRecovery) > 0) Heal(30 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestOnlyRecovery),NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-chest-heal"));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLuck) > 0) RelicGain(ItemEffect.Luck,.06f * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLuck));
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLightning) > 0) RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(8,catalog.TreasureDetection * 100) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.ChestLightning),combatRandom.Next(1,4),"curio-chest-strike");
        }

        private void RelicStrike(float damage, int count, string id)
        {
            var enemies = new List<UnitState>();
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units) if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.EntranceUntil <= 0) enemies.Add(enemy);
            for (int index = 0; index < count && enemies.Count > 0; index++)
            {
                int choice = combatRandom.Next(enemies.Count); UnitState enemy = enemies[choice]; enemies.RemoveAt(choice);
                CombatCause cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child(id);
                ApplyDamage(enemy,damage,Faction.Champion,id,cause:cause);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse,enemy.Position,Faction.Champion,damage,cause:cause));
            }
        }

        private void RelicVolley(int count, float damage)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = Champion.Definition.Weapon;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                float angle = index * Mathf.PI * 2 / count; Vector2 direction = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(angle),Mathf.Sin(angle));
                projectiles.Add(new ProjectileState { Id = ++nextId,Faction = Faction.Champion,Position = Champion.Position,PreviousPosition = Champion.Position,Velocity = direction * 5,Damage = damage,Remaining = 2,Color = new Color(.55f,.9f,1),Sprite = catalog.Projectile,VisualWidth = .35f,Radius = .12f,SourceUnitId = Champion.Id,Weapon = weapon,Cause = NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-retort") });
            }
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,weapon:weapon,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-retort")));
        }

        private void StepRelics(float deltaTime, Vector2 movement)
        {
            relicProcessedEvents = events.Count;
            relicStanding = movement.sqrMagnitude < .001f;
            if (!relicStanding) relicMoved = true;
            if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillRecovery) > 0 && relicStanding) Heal(3 * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.StillRecovery) * deltaTime,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-still-heal"));
            if (Kills / 10 > relicLastKills && RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SoloOverdrive) > 0) Heal((Kills / 10 - relicLastKills) * 3,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-overdrive-heal"));
            relicLastKills = Kills / 10;
            foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.RelicPoisonUntil > Elapsed && enemy.RelicPoisonAt <= Elapsed)
                { enemy.RelicPoisonAt = Elapsed + 1; ApplyDamage(enemy,Mathf.Max(1,catalog.RelicIncome),Faction.Champion,"curio-poison",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-poison")); }
            if (Elapsed >= relicSecondAt)
            {
                relicSecondAt = Elapsed + 1;
                if (RelicCount(RelicMechanic.BleedingAlarm) > 0) ApplyDamage(Champion,RelicCount(RelicMechanic.BleedingAlarm),Faction.Enemy,"Bleeding alarm",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-cost"),injectedDamage:true);
            }
            if (Elapsed >= relicPulseAt)
            {
                relicPulseAt = Elapsed + 3;
                int gamble = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.GambleRecovery);
                if (gamble > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .5) Heal(20 * gamble,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-gamble"));
                if (gamble > 0 && combatRandom.NextDouble() < .5) ApplyDamage(Champion,8 * gamble,Faction.Enemy,"Gamble sandwich",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-cost"),injectedDamage:true);
                foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                    if (enemy.Alive && enemy.Faction == Faction.Enemy && enemy.EntranceUntil <= 0)
                    {
                        float damage = RelicCount(RelicMechanic.SorrowPulse) * Champion.Definition.Health * .2f + RelicCount(RelicMechanic.VoidPulse) * enemy.Health * .15f;
                        if (damage > 0) ApplyDamage(enemy,damage,Faction.Champion,"Curio pulse",cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-pulse"));
                    }
            }
            foreach (UnitState phantom in phantomWeapons)
            {
                if (Elapsed < phantom.NextAttack) continue;
                WeaponDefinition weapon = phantom.Definition.Weapon;
                UnitState target = FindTarget(Champion,Mathf.Max(5,weapon.Range));
                if (target == null) continue;
                phantom.Position = Champion.Position; phantom.AttackDirection = (target.Position - Champion.Position).normalized;
                phantom.NextAttack = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(.2f,weapon.Cooldown);
                if (weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile) EmitProjectile(phantom,RelicAttackDamage(phantom,weapon.Damage),false,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold"));
                else
                    foreach (UnitState enemy in units)
                        if (CanHit(Faction.Champion,enemy) && (enemy.Position - Champion.Position).magnitude <= weapon.Range + enemy.Definition.Radius)
                            ApplyWeaponDamage(enemy,RelicAttackDamage(phantom,weapon.Damage),Faction.Champion,weapon.Element,"Phantom weapon",(enemy.Position - Champion.Position).normalized,weapon,false,NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold"));
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire,Champion.Position,Faction.Champion,direction:phantom.AttackDirection,weapon:weapon,cause:NewCause(Champion.Id).Child("curio-sixfold")));
            }
        }

        private void ProcessRelicEchoes()
        {
            int end = events.Count;
            for (int index = relicProcessedEvents; index < end; index++)
            {
                CombatEvent action = events[index];
                if (action.Kind != CombatEventKind.Fire || action.Faction != Faction.Champion || action.Cause.Depth != 0 || Elapsed < relicEchoAt || RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PrismEcho) == 0) continue;
                relicEchoAt = Elapsed + .15f;
                RelicStrike(Mathf.Max(2,catalog.RelicRanged * 2) * RelicCount(RelicMechanic.PrismEcho),1,"curio-prism");
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class ReviewBalance
    {
        public static ShopPool ExclusivePool(ItemDefinition item)
        {
            if (item.Pools != ShopPool.Both) return item.Pools;
            return item.AltarCurrency == ShopCurrency.Health || item.SignatureRole != SignatureRelicKind.None ? ShopPool.Eggs : ShopPool.Gold;
        }
        public static float RelicValue(ItemEffect effect, float value)
        {
            if (value <= 0) return value;
            return effect switch
            {
                ItemEffect.Damage or ItemEffect.ChampionDamage or ItemEffect.CompanionDamage or ItemEffect.DamageCorrection => Mathf.Max(0.2f, value * 2),
                ItemEffect.AttackSpeed or ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed => Mathf.Max(0.18f, value * 2),
                ItemEffect.MeleeDamage or ItemEffect.RangedDamage => Mathf.Max(4, value * 2),
                ItemEffect.CollisionDamage => Mathf.Max(10, value * 2),
                ItemEffect.Health => Mathf.Max(24, value * 2),
                ItemEffect.Armor => Mathf.Max(0.22f, value * 1.8f),
                ItemEffect.Dodge => Mathf.Max(0.08f, value * 1.5f),
                ItemEffect.MoveSpeed => Mathf.Max(0.1f, value * 1.5f),
                ItemEffect.Crit => Mathf.Max(0.1f, value * 1.6f),
                ItemEffect.AttackRange or ItemEffect.BulletSize or ItemEffect.Knockback => Mathf.Max(0.25f, value * 1.8f),
                ItemEffect.Heal => Mathf.Max(1, value * 1.8f),
                ItemEffect.Pickup => Mathf.Max(1.25f, value * 1.8f),
                ItemEffect.BulletSplit or ItemEffect.BulletPierce or ItemEffect.Projectiles => Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.Ceil(value * 1.5f)),
                _ => value
            };
        }
        public static Vector2 ShopHalfExtents(float viewHeight) => new Vector2(viewHeight * 16 / 9f - 0.8f, viewHeight - 0.65f);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable] public sealed class AchievementMetric { public string Id; public float Value; }
    public sealed class JourneyAchievement
    {
        public string Id, Name, Description, Metric;
        public float Goal;
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot
    {
        public List<AchievementMetric> AchievementEvidence = new List<AchievementMetric>();
    }
    public static class RunAchievements
    {
        public static List<JourneyAchievement> Definitions(RunCatalog catalog)
        {
            var entries = new List<JourneyAchievement>();
            void Add(string id, string name, string description, string metric, float goal) => entries.Add(new JourneyAchievement { Id = "journal-" + id, Name = name, Description = description, Metric = metric, Goal = goal });
            foreach (UnitDefinition u in catalog.Champions)
            {
                Add("dawn-" + u.Id, u.DisplayName + " / First dawn", "Finish a normal journey with " + u.DisplayName + ".", "win-" + u.Id, 1);
                Add("master-" + u.Id, u.DisplayName + " / Night keeper", "Finish Sleepless or harder with " + u.DisplayName + ".", "master-" + u.Id, 1);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < RunMeta.DifficultyNames.Length; i++) Add("difficulty-" + i, RunMeta.DifficultyNames[i] + " / Dawn", "Finish a normal journey at this difficulty or harder.", "difficulty", i + 1);
            int[] scores = { 10000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 1000000 };
            foreach (int goal in scores) Add("score-" + goal, "Receipt worth " + goal.ToString("N0"), "Earn this score in one journey. Endless counts.", "score", goal);
            foreach (int goal in new[] { 200, 500, 800 }) Add("gold-" + goal, "A purse of " + goal, "Collect this much combat gold in one wave.", "battle-gold", goal);
            // Stable IDs preserve earned records while the new goals fit the fifteen-body cap.
            foreach (int previousGoal in new[] { 10, 15, 20 })
            {
                int goal = previousGoal == 10 ? 8 : previousGoal == 15 ? 12 : 15;
                Add("party-" + previousGoal, goal + " names on the ticket", "Own this many companions at one time.", "party", goal);
            }
            Add("health", "A well stitched heart", "Reach 120 maximum HP.", "health", 120);
            Add("fragile", "One last thread", "Enter combat with at most 1 maximum HP.", "one-health", 1);
            Add("armor", "Porcelain fortress", "Reach 0.75 armor before the incoming damage cap.", "armor", .75f);
            Add("regen", "Warm tea forever", "Reach 5 passive HP regeneration per second.", "regen", 5);
            Add("reach", "Across the counter", "Reach 5 units of compiled champion weapon range.", "range", 5);
            Add("projectiles", "A pocket of stars", "Reach 6 compiled projectiles.", "projectiles", 6);
            Add("crit", "Every seam exposed", "Reach 100% critical chance.", "crit", 1);
            Add("damage", "Two promises", "Reach +100% champion damage before diminishing returns.", "damage", 1);
            Add("luck", "A four leaf receipt", "Reach +50% luck.", "luck", .5f);
            Add("dodge", "Between the raindrops", "Reach 60% dodge before the dodge cap.", "dodge", .6f);
            Add("tempo", "A quicker clock", "Reach +70% attack speed before diminishing returns.", "tempo", .7f);
            Add("speed", "Wind in the ribbons", "Reach 6.5 compiled movement speed.", "speed", 6.5f);
            Add("income", "The shop pays you", "Reach 80 wave income.", "income", 80);
            Add("score-bonus", "A signed receipt", "Reach +20% score multiplier.", "score-bonus", .2f);
            Add("body", "Room to grow", "Increase champion body size by at least 20%.", "body", 1.2f);
            Add("wave12", "Still open at midnight", "Clear wave 12.", "cleared", 12);
            Add("wave30", "The long staircase", "Clear endless wave 30.", "endless-cleared", 30);
            Add("pony", "A seat for a friend", "Enter combat with a Pony and another ally.", "rider", 1);
            Add("nursery", "Your first leaf", "Buy a nursery Sprout.", "sprouts", 1);
            Add("memory", "A room of borrowed voices", "Absorb 8 companion memories in one run.", "memories", 8);
            Add("keeper", "A hand released", "Defeat the Outside Keeper.", "keeper", 1);
            Add("farewell", "Leave a light", "Complete a nightmare farewell.", "farewell", 1);
            Add("three-star", "One weapon remembered", "Own a three star companion.", "three-star", 1);
            Add("bonds", "A well woven brigade", "Activate 5 different bonds together.", "bonds", 5);
            return entries;
        }
        public static void Mark(List<AchievementMetric> evidence, string id, float value)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(value) || value < 0) return;
            AchievementMetric metric = evidence.Find(m => m.Id == id);
            if (metric == null) evidence.Add(new AchievementMetric { Id = id, Value = value }); else metric.Value = Mathf.Max(metric.Value, value);
        }
        public static float Progress(List<AchievementMetric> evidence, JourneyAchievement definition) => Mathf.Min(definition.Goal, evidence?.Find(m => m.Id == definition.Metric)?.Value ?? 0);
        public static void Observe(RunSession session, RunCatalog catalog, CheckpointCatalog compiled)
        {
            RunSnapshot r = session.State; r.AchievementEvidence ??= new List<AchievementMetric>();
            void Set(string id, float value) => Mark(r.AchievementEvidence, id, value);
            Set("party", r.Roster.Count); Set("sprouts", r.LeafPurchases); Set("memories", r.AbsorbedSkills?.Count ?? 0);
            Set("three-star", r.Roster.Exists(e => e.Tier == 3) ? 1 : 0);
            Set("rider", r.Roster.Count > 1 && r.Roster.Exists(e => catalog.Unit(e.UnitId).ReferenceCompanion == "Pony") ? 1 : 0);
            Set("health", compiled.Champion.Health); Set("one-health", compiled.Champion.Health <= 1 ? 1 : 0);
            Set("armor", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Armor)); Set("regen", compiled.PassiveHeal); Set("range", compiled.Champion.Weapon.Range);
            Set("projectiles", compiled.Champion.Weapon.ProjectileCount); Set("crit", compiled.Champion.CriticalChance);
            Set("damage", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Damage, ModifierScope.Champion) + session.Bonus(ItemEffect.ChampionDamage, ModifierScope.Champion));
            Set("luck", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Luck)); Set("dodge", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.Dodge)); Set("tempo", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.AttackSpeed, ModifierScope.Champion));
            Set("speed", compiled.Champion.Speed); Set("income", r.LastIncome); Set("score-bonus", session.Bonus(ItemEffect.ScoreMultiplier));
            Set("body", compiled.Champion.BodyHeight / Mathf.Max(.01f, catalog.Unit(r.ChampionId).BodyHeight));
            int bonds = 0; foreach (BondDefinition b in catalog.Bonds) if (session.BondCounts.TryGetValue(b.Id, out int count) && b.ActiveLevel(count) > 0) bonds++;
            Set("bonds", bonds);
        }
        public static void Credit(PlayerProfile profile, RunSnapshot run, RunCatalog catalog)
        {
            if (catalog == null) return;
            profile.AchievementEvidence ??= new List<AchievementMetric>();
            foreach (AchievementMetric m in run.AchievementEvidence ?? new List<AchievementMetric>()) Mark(profile.AchievementEvidence, m.Id, m.Value);
            void Set(string id, float value) => Mark(profile.AchievementEvidence, id, value);
            bool won = run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory && !run.Endless;
            if (won) { Set("win-" + run.ChampionId, 1); Set("difficulty", run.Difficulty + 1); if (run.Difficulty >= 4) Set("master-" + run.ChampionId, 1); }
            int cleared = run.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop || run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory ? run.Wave : run.Wave - 1;
            Set("cleared", cleared); if (run.Endless) Set("endless-cleared", cleared);
            Set("score", RunMeta.Score(run)); Set("keeper", run.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Reward || run.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Completed ? 1 : 0);
            Set("farewell", run.Nightmare?.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete ? 1 : 0);
            foreach (JourneyAchievement d in Definitions(catalog)) if (Progress(profile.AchievementEvidence, d) >= d.Goal) RunMeta.Add(profile.Achievements, d.Id);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class RunRecord
    {
        public string Id;
        public string ParentId;
        public string Nickname;
        public string FinishedUtc;
        public int Score;
        public RunSnapshot Build;
        public string Key => Build.ChampionId + "/" + Build.Difficulty + "/" + (Build.Endless ? "endless" : "normal") + "/" + Build.ChallengeId;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ScoreRecord
    {
        public string Key;
        public string RunId;
        public int Score;
        public int Hall;
    }

    public static class RunMeta
    {
        public const int HistoryLimit = 50;
        public static readonly string[] DifficultyNames = { "Peaceful", "Wandering", "Restless", "Nightmare", "Sleepless", "Beyond the Lamp" };
        public static readonly string[] ChallengeIds = { "", "night-shift", "first-light", "small-brigade" };
        public static readonly string[] ChallengeNames = { "Free journey", "Night shift · until dawn", "First light · clear hall 10", "Small brigade · win with ≤ 6 companions" };
        public static int ChallengeSeed(int index) => 610026 + index * 7919;
        public static int UnlockedDifficulty(PlayerProfile profile)
        {
            int unlocked = 0;
            while (unlocked < DifficultyNames.Length - 1 && profile.Achievements.Contains("clear-difficulty-" + unlocked)) unlocked++;
            return unlocked;
        }
        public static int Score(RunSnapshot run, int liveKills = 0, bool liveBoss = false)
        {
            int cleared = Mathf.Max(0, run.Wave - Mathf.Max(1, run.StartHall));
            if (run.Wave >= run.StartHall && (run.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop || run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory)) cleared++;
            long value = (long)cleared * 1000 + ((long)run.TotalKills + liveKills) * 10 + ((long)run.BossKills + (liveBoss ? 1 : 0)) * 500;
            if (run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory) value += 5000;
            float build = float.IsFinite(run.BuildScoreMultiplier) && run.BuildScoreMultiplier > 0 ? run.BuildScoreMultiplier : 1;
            return RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)(value * (100 + run.Difficulty * 20) / 100 * (double)Mathf.Clamp(build, 0.1f, 100)));
        }
        public static string Nickname(RunSnapshot run)
        {
            ContributionEntry strongest = null;
            foreach (ContributionEntry entry in run.Contributions)
                if (entry.Damage > 0 && (strongest == null || entry.Damage > strongest.Damage || entry.Damage == strongest.Damage && string.CompareOrdinal(entry.Key, strongest.Key) < 0)) strongest = entry;
            string weapon = strongest?.WeaponId;
            if (weapon == "TeapotPopgun" || weapon == "DreamIron") return "Scorched tea party";
            if (weapon == "BellFork" || weapon == "MusicBox") return "Debt-collecting bells";
            if (weapon == "DreamStamp") return "Relentless returns office";
            if (weapon == "SleepCamera") return "Midnight photo booth";
            if (weapon == "CrescentBow") return "Threads through dreams";
            if (weapon == "RubberHammer") return "Dream repair workshop";
            return "Things that refuse to sleep";
        }
        public static string ChainEvidence(string effect)
        {
            switch (effect)
            {
                case "harvest-receipt": return "signature-harvest";
                case "reflective-ink": case "office-lens": case "office-lens-exposure": case "carbon-exposure": return "signature-office";
                case "thermal-ink": return "signature-tea";
                case "scratch-record": return "signature-chorus";
                case "treasure-ribbon": return "signature-treasure";
                case "repair-coupon": return "signature-toys";
                default: return null;
            }
        }
        public static void Discover(PlayerProfile profile, RunSnapshot run, RunCatalog catalog = null)
        {
            foreach (RosterEntry entry in run.Roster)
            {
                Add(profile.SeenUnits, entry.UnitId); Add(profile.SeenWeapons, entry.WeaponId);
                Add(profile.SeenTiers, entry.WeaponId + "/" + entry.Tier);
            }
            foreach (RosterEntry entry in run.AcquiredVariants)
            {
                Add(profile.SeenUnits, entry.UnitId); Add(profile.SeenWeapons, entry.WeaponId);
                Add(profile.SeenTiers, entry.WeaponId + "/" + entry.Tier);
            }
            if (catalog != null)
            {
                string weapon = catalog.Unit(run.ChampionId).Weapon.Id;
                Add(profile.SeenWeapons, weapon); Add(profile.SeenTiers, weapon + "/1");
            }
            foreach (ItemStack stack in run.Items) Add(profile.SeenItems, stack.Id);
            foreach (string boss in run.DefeatedBosses) Add(profile.SeenBosses, boss);
            foreach (ContributionEntry entry in run.Contributions)
            {
                string chain = ChainEvidence(entry.EffectId);
                if (chain != null && (entry.Activations > 0 || entry.Damage > 0 || entry.Healing > 0 || entry.Coins > 0)) Add(profile.SeenChains, chain);
            }
        }
        public static void Credit(PlayerProfile profile, RunSnapshot run)
        {
            if (run.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory && run.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat || profile.CompletedRuns.Contains(run.RunId)) return;
            Add(profile.CompletedRuns, run.RunId);
            profile.TotalKills = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)profile.TotalKills + run.TotalKills);
            if (run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory && !run.Endless)
            {
                profile.Wins = RunSession.BoundedCounter((long)profile.Wins + 1);
                Add(profile.Achievements, "Brigade dawn");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(run.ChallengeId)) Add(profile.Achievements, "clear-difficulty-" + run.Difficulty);
            }
            bool challenge = run.ChallengeId == "night-shift" && run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory || run.ChallengeId == "first-light" && (run.Wave > 10 || run.Wave == 10 && run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory) || run.ChallengeId == "small-brigade" && run.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory && run.Roster.Count <= 6;
            if (challenge) Add(profile.Achievements, "challenge-" + run.ChallengeId);
            var record = new RunRecord { Id = run.RunId, ParentId = run.ParentRunId, Nickname = Nickname(run), FinishedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"), Score = Score(run), Build = JsonUtility.FromJson<RunSnapshot>(JsonUtility.ToJson(run)) };
            profile.History.Insert(0, record);
            if (profile.History.Count > HistoryLimit) profile.History.RemoveAt(profile.History.Count - 1);
            ScoreRecord best = profile.Records.Find(entry => entry.Key == record.Key);
            if (best == null) { best = new ScoreRecord { Key = record.Key }; profile.Records.Add(best); }
            if (best.RunId == null || record.Score > best.Score) { best.Score = record.Score; best.Hall = run.Wave; best.RunId = run.RunId; }
        }
        public static void Add(List<string> destination, string id) { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && !destination.Contains(id)) destination.Add(id); }
        public static bool CosmeticUnlocked(PlayerProfile profile, int bundle) => bundle == 0 || bundle == 1 && profile.BestWave >= 5 || bundle == 2 && profile.SeenBosses.Count >= 3;
        public static string CosmeticName(int bundle) => bundle == 1 ? "Night office" : bundle == 2 ? "Paper stage" : "Lost-and-found shop";
    }
}
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/RunModifierRules.cs | SHA-256 89a536590f3b35a84c30d92c97d1e2c5fe53b35f89a77ae1defc87ac35c0f8d4</summary>

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class RunModifierRules
    {
        public static ModifierScope DefaultScope(ItemEffect effect)
        {
            if (effect == ItemEffect.ChestReach) return ModifierScope.Run;
            switch (effect)
            {
                case ItemEffect.Health: case ItemEffect.Heal: case ItemEffect.Armor: case ItemEffect.ChampionDamage: case ItemEffect.Dodge: case ItemEffect.BodySize: case ItemEffect.HeartHealing: case ItemEffect.HealthCorrection: case ItemEffect.ArmorCorrection: case ItemEffect.HealCorrection: return ModifierScope.Champion;
                case ItemEffect.CompanionDamage: case ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed: case ItemEffect.CompanionSize: return ModifierScope.Companions;
                case ItemEffect.Pickup: case ItemEffect.Roam: case ItemEffect.Interceptor: case ItemEffect.Interest: case ItemEffect.Discount: case ItemEffect.Luck: case ItemEffect.TreasureDetection: case ItemEffect.ScoreMultiplier: case ItemEffect.Income: case ItemEffect.EnemyCount: case ItemEffect.EnemyHealth: case ItemEffect.EnemySpeed: case ItemEffect.ChestQuality: case ItemEffect.RecruitDiscount: case ItemEffect.RelicDiscount: case ItemEffect.ShopRarity: return ModifierScope.Run;
                default: return ModifierScope.Team;
            }
        }

        public static bool Applies(ModifierScope source, ModifierScope target) => source == target || (source == ModifierScope.Team && (target == ModifierScope.Champion || target == ModifierScope.Companions));

        public static string ScopeName(ModifierScope scope)
        {
            switch (scope)
            {
                case ModifierScope.Champion: return "Champion";
                case ModifierScope.Companions: return "Companions";
                case ModifierScope.Run: return "Run";
                default: return "Team";
            }
        }

        public static string RarityName(ItemRarity rarity)
        {
            switch (rarity)
            {
                case ItemRarity.Uncommon: return "UNCOMMON";
                case ItemRarity.Rare: return "RARE";
                case ItemRarity.Mythic: return "MYTHIC";
                case ItemRarity.Crimson: return "CRIMSON";
                case ItemRarity.Rainbow: return "PRISMATIC";
                default: return "COMMON";
            }
        }

        public static Color RarityColor(ItemRarity rarity)
        {
            switch (rarity)
            {
                case ItemRarity.Uncommon: return new Color(0.25f, 0.7f, 1f);
                case ItemRarity.Rare: return new Color(0.75f, 0.6f, 1f);
                case ItemRarity.Mythic: return new Color(1f, 0.76f, 0.35f);
                case ItemRarity.Crimson: return new Color(1f, 0.16f, 0.27f);
                case ItemRarity.Rainbow: return new Color(0.58f, 1f, 0.92f);
                default: return new Color(0.82f, 0.85f, 0.92f);
            }
        }

        public static string DescribeCompanion(UnitDefinition unit, int tier)
        {
            string description = "";
            foreach (StatModifier modifier in unit.CompanionModifiers ?? new StatModifier[0])
                description += ScopeName(modifier.Scope) + " / " + ModifierName(modifier.Effect) + ": " + ValueText(modifier.Effect, modifier.Value * UnitDefinition.ModifierScale(tier)) + "\n";
            return description + "Tier 1/2/3 traits ×1/2/4; merging three units reduces support sources.\n";
        }

        public static string Describe(ItemDefinition item, int stacks)
            => RelicDescriptions.Describe(item, stacks);
        private static string LegacyDescribe(ItemDefinition item, int stacks)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ReferenceName)) return item.Description + "\nOwned: " + item.EffectiveStacks(stacks);
            string description = RarityName(item.Rarity) + " · " + (item.Stacking == StackPolicy.Unique ? "Unique" : "Stackable") + "\n";
            foreach (StatModifier modifier in item.EffectiveModifiers)
                if (modifier.Value != 0) description += ScopeName(modifier.Scope) + " / " + ModifierName(modifier.Effect) + ": " + ValueText(modifier.Effect, modifier.Value) + " × " + item.EffectiveStacks(stacks) + " = " + ValueText(modifier.Effect, modifier.Value * item.EffectiveStacks(stacks)) + "\n";
            return description;
        }

        public static string ModifierName(ItemEffect effect)
        {
            switch (effect)
            {
                case ItemEffect.Damage: case ItemEffect.ChampionDamage: case ItemEffect.CompanionDamage: return "Damage";
                case ItemEffect.AttackSpeed: case ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed: return "Attack speed";
                case ItemEffect.MoveSpeed: return "Movement speed";
                case ItemEffect.Crit: return "Critical chance";
                case ItemEffect.Projectiles: return "Projectile count";
                case ItemEffect.Health: return "Maximum health";
                case ItemEffect.Pickup: return "Pickup radius";
                case ItemEffect.Roam: return "Patrol radius";
                case ItemEffect.Interceptor: return "Companion bullet interception";
                case ItemEffect.Heal: return "Healing per second";
                case ItemEffect.Interest: return "Interest cap";
                case ItemEffect.Armor: return "Armor";
                case ItemEffect.Discount: return "Gold shop discount";
                case ItemEffect.Luck: return "Luck";
                case ItemEffect.TreasureDetection: return "Treasure detection";
                default: return K10StatRules.Name(effect);
            }
        }

        public static string ValueText(ItemEffect effect, float value)
        {
            bool percent = effect == ItemEffect.Damage || effect == ItemEffect.ChampionDamage || effect == ItemEffect.CompanionDamage || effect == ItemEffect.AttackSpeed || effect == ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed || effect == ItemEffect.MoveSpeed || effect == ItemEffect.Crit || effect == ItemEffect.Discount;
            if (effect >= ItemEffect.ScoreMultiplier) percent = K10StatRules.Percentage(effect);
            return (percent ? value * 100 : value).ToString("+0.###;-0.###;0") + (percent ? "%" : "");
        }

        public static void Validate(RunCatalog catalog)
        {
            if (catalog.ContentRevision < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid content revision");
            foreach (UnitDefinition champion in catalog.Champions)
                foreach (StatModifier modifier in champion.ChampionModifiers ?? new StatModifier[0]) ValidateModifier(modifier, champion.Id);
            foreach (UnitDefinition companion in catalog.Companions)
                foreach (StatModifier modifier in companion.CompanionModifiers ?? new StatModifier[0]) ValidateModifier(modifier, companion.Id);
            foreach (BondDefinition bond in catalog.Bonds)
            {
                if (bond == null || bond.Threshold < 1 || !float.IsFinite(bond.Value) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemEffect), bond.Effect)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid bond");
                int previous = bond.Threshold;
                foreach (BondThresholdBonus bonus in bond.ExtraBonuses ?? new BondThresholdBonus[0])
                {
                    if (bonus == null || bonus.Threshold <= previous || !float.IsFinite(bonus.Value)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid bond milestone");
                    previous = bonus.Threshold;
                }
            }
            if (catalog.RerollPrice < 0 || catalog.RerollPriceStep < 0 || catalog.EconomyRevision < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid economy tuning");
            if (catalog.AltarRevision < 0 || !float.IsFinite(catalog.AltarBaseChance) || catalog.AltarBaseChance < 0 || catalog.AltarBaseChance > 1 || !float.IsFinite(catalog.AltarChancePerEgg) || catalog.AltarChancePerEgg < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid altar tuning");
            foreach (ItemDefinition item in catalog.Items)
            {
                if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SignatureRelicKind), item.SignatureRole)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid signature relic role: " + item.Id);
                if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemRarity), item.Rarity) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(StackPolicy), item.Stacking) || item.ShopWeight < 0 || item.MaximumStacks < 0 || item.MaximumStacks > 100000 || (catalog.EconomyRevision > 0 && (item.Pools == 0 || (item.Pools & ~ShopPool.Both) != 0))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid item policy: " + item.Id);
                if (catalog.AltarRevision > 0 && (item.AltarPrice < 1 || (item.AltarCurrency != ShopCurrency.Eggs && item.AltarCurrency != ShopCurrency.Health))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid altar price/currency: " + item.Id);
                foreach (StatModifier modifier in item.EffectiveModifiers)
                {
                    ValidateModifier(modifier, item.Id);
                }
            }
            var ids = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();
            foreach (ProcRule rule in catalog.ProcRules ?? new ProcRule[0])
            {
                if (rule == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Id) || !ids.Add(rule.Id) || catalog.Item(rule.ItemId) == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ProcTrigger), rule.Trigger) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ProcAction), rule.Action) || !float.IsFinite(rule.Power) || rule.Power <= 0 || !float.IsFinite(rule.Radius) || rule.Radius < 0 || !float.IsFinite(rule.Cooldown) || rule.Cooldown < 0 || !float.IsFinite(rule.Chance) || rule.Chance < 0 || rule.Chance > 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid proc authoring");
            }
            ids.Clear();
            foreach (AltarRecipe recipe in catalog.Recipes)
                if (recipe == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(recipe.Id) || !ids.Add(recipe.Id) || !Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, unit => unit.Id == recipe.FirstUnit) || !Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, unit => unit.Id == recipe.SecondUnit) || !Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, unit => unit.Id == recipe.ResultUnit) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(recipe.ThirdUnit) && !Array.Exists(catalog.Companions, unit => unit.Id == recipe.ThirdUnit) || recipe.EggCost < 0 || recipe.MinimumMaterialTier < 1 || recipe.MinimumMaterialTier > catalog.MaximumTier || recipe.ResultTier < 1 || recipe.ResultTier > catalog.MaximumTier) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid recipe identity/tier/cost");
            ids.Clear();
            foreach (BuildLinkRule rule in catalog.BuildLinks ?? new BuildLinkRule[0])
            {
                if (rule == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Id) || !ids.Add(rule.Id) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Name) || rule.ItemIds == null || rule.ItemIds.Length < 2) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid build link");
                var sources = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();
                foreach (string id in rule.ItemIds) if (catalog.Item(id) == null || !sources.Add(id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid build link source");
            }
        }

        private static void ValidateModifier(StatModifier modifier, string id)
        {
            if (modifier == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ItemEffect), modifier.Effect) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ModifierScope), modifier.Scope) || !float.IsFinite(modifier.Value)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid modifier: " + id);
            ModifierScope expected = DefaultScope(modifier.Effect);
            if (expected != ModifierScope.Team && modifier.Scope != expected || expected == ModifierScope.Team && modifier.Scope == ModifierScope.Run) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported modifier scope: " + id);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class RunPaths
    {
        private static string diagnosticRoot;
        public static bool K7Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k7-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K7B => K7Capture && Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k7b") >= 0;
        public static bool K6Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k6-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K5Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k5-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K4Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k4-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K4FinalCapture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k4-final-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool QualityCapture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-quality-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K3FinalCapture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k3-final-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K2Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k2-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool AltarCapture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-altar-capture") >= 0;
        public static bool K32Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k32-capture") >= 0 || AltarCapture;
        public static bool K3Capture => Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k3-capture") >= 0 || K32Capture;
        public static bool Diagnostic => MienChoCapture.Requested || HeroIdentityCapture.Requested || Application.isBatchMode || FullRunPlayerCapture.Requested || Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(), "-arcane-k1-capture") >= 0 || K2Capture || K3Capture || K3FinalCapture || QualityCapture || K4Capture || K4FinalCapture || K5Capture || K6Capture || K7Capture;
        public static string Root
        {
            get
            {
                if (!Diagnostic) return Application.persistentDataPath;
                if (diagnosticRoot == null) diagnosticRoot = Path.Combine(Application.temporaryCachePath, "ArcaneBrigadeDiagnostics", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
                return diagnosticRoot;
            }
        }
    }
}
````
