````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class RunTransactionReceipt
    {
        public const int HistoryLimit = 8;
        public int Id;
        public int Hall;
        public string Title;
        public List<string> Changes = new List<string>();
        public string Description => "Hall " + Hall + " · #" + Id + "\n" + string.Join("\n", Changes);
    }

    public static class RunTransaction
    {
        public static bool TryCommit(RunSession session, RunCatalog catalog, string title, Func<bool> operation, Func<bool> persist, out string error)
        {
            error = "";
            RunSnapshot before = JsonUtility.FromJson<RunSnapshot>(JsonUtility.ToJson(session.State));
            try
            {
                if (before.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop) return false;
                if (before.NextReceipt == int.MaxValue) throw new InvalidOperationException("Transaction counter exhausted");
                RunBuildReadModel previous = RunBuildReadModel.Capture(session, catalog, before.Health);
                if (!operation()) { session.Restore(before); return false; }
                session.Validate(session.State);
                RunBuildReadModel current = RunBuildReadModel.Capture(session, catalog, session.State.Health);
                var receipt = new RunTransactionReceipt { Id = ++session.State.NextReceipt, Hall = session.State.Wave, Title = title };
                Change(receipt, "Gold", before.Gold.ToString(), session.State.Gold.ToString());
                Change(receipt, "Eggs", before.Eggs.ToString(), session.State.Eggs.ToString());
                Change(receipt, "Current HP", before.Health.ToString("0.###"), session.State.Health.ToString("0.###"));
                Change(receipt, "Shop reroll", before.RerollsThisShop.ToString(), session.State.RerollsThisShop.ToString());
                RosterChanges(receipt, before.Roster, session.State.Roster, catalog);
                for (int index = 0; index < before.Roster.Count; index++)
                {
                    int currentIndex = session.State.Roster.FindIndex(entry => Same(before.Roster[index], entry));
                    if (currentIndex >= 0)
                        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> stat in previous.Companions[index].CombatValues)
                            Change(receipt, previous.Companions[index].Name + " / " + before.Roster[index].WeaponId + " / " + stat.Key, stat.Value, current.Companions[currentIndex].CombatValues[stat.Key]);
                }
                var itemIds = new HashSet<string>();
                foreach (ItemStack stack in before.Items) itemIds.Add(stack.Id);
                foreach (ItemStack stack in session.State.Items) itemIds.Add(stack.Id);
                var orderedIds = new List<string>(itemIds);
                orderedIds.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                foreach (string id in orderedIds)
                    Change(receipt, catalog.Item(id).Name + " ×", Count(before.Items, id).ToString(), Count(session.State.Items, id).ToString());
                foreach (var row in previous.Stats)
                { var next = current.Stats.Find(r => r.Name == row.Name); if (next != null) Change(receipt,row.Name,row.Summary,next.Summary); }
                foreach(var delta in ShopStatSnapshot.Compare(previous.ShopStats,current.ShopStats))receipt.Changes.Add(delta.ActorName+" / "+delta.Caption);
                if (previous.Bonds != current.Bonds) receipt.Changes.Add("Bonds before:\n" + previous.Bonds + "Bonds sau:\n" + current.Bonds);
                session.State.Receipts.Add(receipt);
                while (session.State.Receipts.Count > RunTransactionReceipt.HistoryLimit) session.State.Receipts.RemoveAt(0);
                session.Validate(session.State);
                if (!persist()) { session.Restore(before); return false; }
                session.PublishShopStatChanges(previous.ShopStats,current.ShopStats);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                session.Restore(before);
                error = "Transaction failed: " + exception.Message;
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static int Count(List<ItemStack> stacks, string id) => stacks.Find(stack => stack.Id == id)?.Count ?? 0;

        private static void Change(RunTransactionReceipt receipt, string label, string before, string after)
        {
            if (before != after) receipt.Changes.Add(label + ": " + before + " → " + after);
        }

        private static void RosterChanges(RunTransactionReceipt receipt, List<RosterEntry> before, List<RosterEntry> after, RunCatalog catalog)
        {
            foreach (RosterEntry entry in before)
                if (!after.Exists(candidate => Same(entry, candidate))) receipt.Changes.Add("− " + RosterLabel(entry, catalog));
            foreach (RosterEntry entry in after)
                if (!before.Exists(candidate => Same(entry, candidate))) receipt.Changes.Add("+ " + RosterLabel(entry, catalog));
        }

        private static bool Same(RosterEntry first, RosterEntry second) => first.UnitId == second.UnitId && first.WeaponId == second.WeaponId && first.Tier == second.Tier;
        private static string RosterLabel(RosterEntry entry, RunCatalog catalog) => catalog.Unit(entry.UnitId).DisplayName + " · " + entry.WeaponId + " · tier " + entry.Tier;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        private void ApplySecretUnit(UnitDefinition unit, bool companion)
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null) return;
            WeaponDefinition weapon = unit.Weapon;
            foreach (SecretStitch stitch in Secret.Stitches)
            {
                if (StackCount(stitch.ItemId) == 0) continue;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 0 && weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile)
                {
                    weapon.SecretRecall = true; weapon.ProjectilePierce = 0; weapon.Damage *= 1.15f;
                    weapon.ProjectileLifetime = Mathf.Max(2, weapon.ProjectileLifetime);
                }
                if (stitch.Pattern == 1 && weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee) weapon.Cooldown *= 1.2f;
            }
            if (companion && Secret.AllyGifts.Exists(g => g.UnitId == unit.Id && g.WeaponId == weapon.Id)) weapon.Damage *= 1.2f;
        }
        private void PrepareSecretCombat()
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null || SecretEventAssets.Current == null) return;
            SecretEventAssets assets = SecretEventAssets.Current;
            CombatCatalog.SecretMeleeEcho = Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.Pattern == 1 && StackCount(t.ItemId) > 0);
            CombatCatalog.SecretWard = Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.Pattern == 2 && StackCount(t.ItemId) > 0);
            CombatCatalog.SecretMirrorEcho = StackCount("SecretMirror") > 0 && !SecretItemSuspended("SecretMirror");
            if (!SecretSolo && State.Roster.Count < OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit)
            {
                var allies = CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions.ToList();
                if (Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow))
                {
                    UnitDefinition shadow = BuildUnit(catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId), catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon, 1, true);
                    shadow.Id = "SecretTemporaryShadow"; shadow.DisplayName = "Borrowed Reflection"; shadow.Tint = new Color(.58f, .8f, 1, .8f);
                    shadow.HeroMechanic = HeroMechanic.None; shadow.Weapon.Damage *= .5f; shadow.Passive = PassiveKind.None; allies.Add(shadow);
                }
                if (Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.DreamFriend))
                {
                    UnitDefinition friend = assets.Rescues[2]; allies.Add(BuildUnit(friend, friend.Weapon, 1, true));
                }
                CombatCatalog.StartingCompanions = allies.ToArray();
            }
            if (!SecretFighting) return;
            CombatCatalog.EnableArenaToys = CombatCatalog.EnableSpectacles = CombatCatalog.EnableBossArenaPhase = false;
            CombatCatalog.ArenaSize = new Vector2(22, 12); CombatCatalog.ExtendedLoot = false; CombatCatalog.GoldPerKill = 0;
            CombatCatalog.ChestInterval = 100000; CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 0; CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 0;
            CombatCatalog.EnemyPool = Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>(); CombatCatalog.AffixedEnemies = Array.Empty<UnitDefinition>();
            CombatCatalog.Boss = null;
            int encounter = Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty ? 1 : Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.Understudy ? 2 : Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain ? 3 : 4 + Secret.Option;
            CombatCatalog.SecretEncounter = encounter;
            if (encounter == 4)
            {
                UnitDefinition paper = catalog.Enemies.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Material == BodyMaterial.Paper && !e.IsBoss) ?? catalog.Enemies[0];
                UnitDefinition enemy = BuildEnemy(paper, 1 + State.Wave * .12f);
                enemy.Health *= .65f; enemy.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; enemy.Behavior = EnemyBehavior.Standard;
                CombatCatalog.MeleeEnemy = CombatCatalog.RangedEnemy = enemy; CombatCatalog.EnemyPool = new[] { enemy };
                CombatCatalog.EnemyBudget = 32; CombatCatalog.SpawnInterval = .7f; CombatCatalog.WaveDuration = 28; return;
            }
            UnitDefinition source = encounter == 2 ? CombatCatalog.Champion : assets.Guardian;
            UnitDefinition actor = Clone(source); actor.Weapon = Clone(source.Weapon);
            actor.Id = encounter == 2 ? "SecretUnderstudy" : "SecretCabinetActor";
            actor.DisplayName = encounter == 2 ? "The Understudy" : encounter == 3 ? "The Contraband Collector" : encounter == 5 ? "The Leading Actor" : encounter == 6 ? "The Hostile Duet" : "The Cabinet Warden";
            actor.IsBoss = true; actor.HeroMechanic = HeroMechanic.None; actor.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; actor.Mutation = EnemyMutation.None;
            actor.Health = (650 + State.Wave * 140) * (1 + State.Difficulty * .2f) * (encounter == 5 ? 1.3f : 1);
            actor.BodyHeight = encounter == 2 ? 1.5f : 2.3f; actor.Radius = .65f; actor.Speed = encounter == 2 ? 1.15f : .6f;
            actor.ContactDamage = 5 + State.Wave * .12f; actor.ContactInterval = 1.3f; actor.KnockbackResistance = 1;
            actor.Tint = encounter == 2 ? new Color(.65f, .8f, 1) : Color.white;
            CombatCatalog.Boss = actor;
            if (encounter == 6)
            {
                UnitDefinition partner = BuildEnemy(catalog.Enemies.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile) ?? catalog.Enemies[0], 1 + State.Wave * .1f);
                partner.Id = "SecretSupportingActor"; partner.DisplayName = "The Supporting Actor";
                partner.Health = actor.Health * .5f; partner.SpecialEnemy = SpecialEnemyKind.None; partner.Mutation = EnemyMutation.None;
                partner.Weapon.Cooldown = 2.8f; partner.Weapon.ProjectileCount = 2; partner.Weapon.Damage = 7;
                CombatCatalog.SecretPartner = partner;
            }
        }
        private bool SettleSecretCombat(CombatSimulation simulation)
        {
            if (!SecretFighting) return false;
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(MaximumHealth(), simulation.Champion.Health); State.CombatSeconds += simulation.Elapsed;
            State.LastDamageSource = simulation.LastDamageSource; State.LastDamageKind = simulation.LastDamageKind; State.LastDamageAmount = simulation.LastDamageAmount;
            ContributionLedger.Merge(State.Contributions, simulation.Contributions);
            if (simulation.Phase == RunPhase.Defeat) { State.Phase = SessionPhase.Defeat; return true; }
            Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Reward; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Shop;
            Secret.Result = "THE PERFORMANCE IS OVER\nClaim your chosen gift. Your normal shop, stock and wave are waiting unchanged. Health spent in this encounter stays spent.";
            RecordSecret("Won the optional encounter."); return true;
        }
    }

    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float secretChampionAttack = -100, secretMirrorAt;
        private Vector2 secretMirrorDirection;
        private UnitState secretSecondActor;
        private float secretNextEcho;
        private void StartSecretCombat()
        {
            secretChampionAttack = -100; secretMirrorAt = 0; secretNextEcho = 0; secretSecondActor = null;
            if (catalog.SecretPartner != null)
            {
                secretSecondActor = Spawn(catalog.SecretPartner, Faction.Enemy, new Vector2(-3, 2));
                secretSecondActor.NextAttack = 3.5f;
            }
        }
        private bool SecretVictoryReady() => catalog.SecretEncounter == 6 ? BossDefeated && (secretSecondActor == null || !secretSecondActor.Alive) : catalog.Boss == null ? Elapsed >= catalog.WaveDuration : BossDefeated;

        private bool ProcessSecretBoss(UnitState boss)
        {
            if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 0) return false;
            boss.BossPoseTime = Elapsed;
            if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 2)
            {
                if (secretMirrorAt == 0 && Champion.AttackStarted > secretChampionAttack && Champion.AttackStarted > .05f)
                {
                    secretChampionAttack = Champion.AttackStarted; secretMirrorAt = Elapsed + .65f;
                    secretMirrorDirection = -Champion.AttackDirection;
                    boss.TelegraphDirection = secretMirrorDirection; boss.TelegraphUntil = secretMirrorAt; boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.AttackWindup = .65f;
                    events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
                }
                if (secretMirrorAt > 0 && Elapsed >= secretMirrorAt)
                {
                    secretMirrorAt = 0; boss.TelegraphUntil = 0; boss.AttackDirection = secretMirrorDirection;
                    WeaponDefinition w = boss.Definition.Weapon;
                    if (w.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile)
                        EmitProjectile(boss, Mathf.Min(12, 5 + catalog.RunWave * .25f), false, NewCause(boss.Id));
                    else
                        Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, boss, boss.Position, secretMirrorDirection, Mathf.Clamp(w.Range, 1.8f, 4), 8, 0, .2f, NewCause(boss.Id));
                    boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                    events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (boss.TelegraphUntil > 0 && Elapsed >= boss.TelegraphUntil)
            {
                boss.TelegraphUntil = 0; boss.BossOrganReleaseAt = Elapsed;
                if (boss.BossVolley++ % 2 == 0)
                {
                    Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.FallingProp, boss, boss.AbilityTarget, 1.2f, .45f, .3f);
                    if (catalog.SecretEncounter == 5) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Shockwave, boss, boss.AbilityTarget, 2.8f, .7f, .9f);
                }
                else for (int k = -1; k <= 1; k++) Danger(ExpandedFieldKind.Tentacle, boss, boss.AbilityTarget + Vector2.right * k * 1.7f, .35f, .35f + (k + 1) * .18f, .3f);
                boss.NextBossPattern = Elapsed + (catalog.SecretEncounter == 6 ? 4.2f : 3.5f); boss.BossRecoveryUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                if (secretSecondActor != null) secretSecondActor.NextAttack = Elapsed + 1.5f;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Fire, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
            }
            if (Elapsed >= boss.NextBossPattern && boss.TelegraphUntil == 0)
            {
                boss.AttackWindup = 1.1f; boss.AttackStarted = Elapsed; boss.TelegraphUntil = Elapsed + 1.1f;
                boss.AbilityTarget = Champion.Position; boss.TelegraphDirection = (Champion.Position - boss.Position).normalized;
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Windup, boss.Position, Faction.Enemy, subject: boss));
            }
            return true;
        }

        private void ProcessSecretEchoes()
        {
            if (!catalog.SecretMeleeEcho && !catalog.SecretMirrorEcho) return;
            // Snapshot events: secondary attacks never recursively create echoes.
            foreach (CombatEvent e in events.ToArray())
            {
                if (e.Kind != CombatEventKind.Fire || e.Faction == Faction.Enemy || e.Subject == null || e.Subject.Definition.Weapon == null) continue;
                UnitState source = e.Subject; WeaponDefinition w = source.Definition.Weapon;
                if (catalog.SecretMeleeEcho && w.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee)
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, w.Range, w.Damage * .3f, .26f, .18f, NewCause(source.Id).Child("secret-aftershock"));
                if (catalog.SecretMirrorEcho && source.Faction == Faction.Champion && Elapsed >= secretNextEcho)
                {
                    secretNextEcho = Elapsed + 4;
                    Field(ExpandedFieldKind.Strike, source, source.Position, source.AttackDirection, Mathf.Clamp(w.Range, 2, 5), w.Damage * .35f, .35f, .18f, NewCause(source.Id).Child("secret-mirror"));
                }
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class ArenaController
    {
        public SecretEventRoom SecretRoom { get; private set; }
        public bool SecretAction(Func<bool> operation, string title)
        {
            if (PresentationPaused || TransitionPending || HallExitPending) return false;
            RunSnapshot before = MergeReveal.Capture(session.State);
            var previousStats = before.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop ? RunBuildReadModel.Capture(session,runCatalog,before.Health).ShopStats : null;
            if (!operation()) return false;
            try { session.Validate(session.State); }
            catch { session.Restore(before); throw; }
            if (!PersistBoundary()) { session.Restore(before); return false; }
            if (previousStats != null && session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop) session.PublishShopStatChanges(previousStats,RunBuildReadModel.Capture(session,runCatalog,session.State.Health).ShopStats);
            bool battle = session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Combat;
            if (battle) Begin(); else Begin(true);
            CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId(battle ? "ui.cutin.boss" : "ui.confirm");
            return true;
        }
        public bool EnterSecret(SecretEventKind kind)
        {
            bool ok = SecretAction(() => session.EnterSecretEvent(kind), "Enter secret room");
            if (ok) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId(SecretEventAssets.EntryCues[(int)kind]);
            return ok;
        }
        public bool ChooseSecret(int option) => SecretAction(() => session.ChooseSecretEvent(option), "Secret agreement");
        public bool ClaimSecret() => SecretAction(session.ClaimSecretBattleReward, "Secret reward");
        public bool LeaveSecret() => SecretAction(session.LeaveSecretEvent, "Return from secret room");
        public bool SecretTarget(string item, string weapon = "") => SecretAction(() => session.SetSecretTarget(item, weapon), "Select secret target");
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public SecretEventProgress Secrets = new SecretEventProgress(); }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public bool SecretRoomOpen => State.Secrets != null && State.Secrets.Stage != SecretEventStage.Idle;
        public bool SecretFighting => State.Secrets?.Stage == SecretEventStage.Fighting;
        private SecretEventProgress Secret => State.Secrets ?? (State.Secrets = new SecretEventProgress());
        private bool SecretSolo => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.SoloMaw;
        public bool SecretItemSuspended(string id) => State.Secrets != null && (State.Secrets.Stitches.Exists(t => t.ItemId == id) || State.Secrets.Contracts.Exists(c => c.ItemId == id && (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel)));
        public bool SecretItemImproved(string id) => State.Secrets != null && State.Secrets.ImprovedItems.Contains(id);
        public IReadOnlyList<string> SecretTargets => State.Items.Where(s => !SecretItemSuspended(s.Id) && !Secret.Stitches.Exists(t => t.ItemId == s.Id) && !Secret.ImprovedItems.Contains(s.Id)).Select(s => s.Id).ToArray();

        public SecretEventKind[] SecretPortals()
        {
            if (SecretEventAssets.Current == null || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || SecretRoomOpen || State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Reward) return Array.Empty<SecretEventKind>();
            if (Secret.QueuedEvent >= 0 && Secret.VisitWave != State.Wave) return new[] { (SecretEventKind)Secret.QueuedEvent };
            if (Secret.Visits >= 2 || State.Wave < 3 || State.Wave % 4 != 3 || Secret.VisitWave == State.Wave) return Array.Empty<SecretEventKind>();
            var kinds = Enumerable.Range(0, 8).Where(k => (Secret.VisitedMask & (1 << k)) == 0).ToList();
            uint hash = unchecked((uint)State.Seed ^ (uint)State.Wave * 0x9e3779b9u);
            var result = new List<SecretEventKind>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 2 && kinds.Count > 0; i++)
            {
                hash = unchecked(hash * 1664525 + 1013904223); int pick = (int)(hash % (uint)kinds.Count);
                result.Add((SecretEventKind)kinds[pick]); kinds.RemoveAt(pick);
            }
            return result.ToArray();
        }

        public bool EnterSecretEvent(SecretEventKind kind)
        {
            if (!Array.Exists(SecretPortals(), k => k == kind)) return false;
            bool queued = Secret.QueuedEvent == (int)kind;
            Secret.Kind = kind; Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Choosing; Secret.Option = -1;
            Secret.VisitWave = State.Wave; Secret.VisitedMask |= 1 << (int)kind;
            if (queued) Secret.QueuedEvent = -1; else Secret.Visits++;
            Secret.TargetItem = SecretTargets.FirstOrDefault() ?? "";
            RosterEntry first = State.Roster.FirstOrDefault();
            Secret.TargetUnit = first?.UnitId ?? ""; Secret.TargetWeapon = first?.WeaponId ?? "";
            Secret.RewardId = ""; Secret.Result = "";
            return true;
        }

        public bool SetSecretTarget(string id, string weapon = "")
        {
            if (Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing || State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop) return false;
            if (weapon.Length > 0)
            {
                if (!State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == weapon)) return false;
                Secret.TargetUnit = id; Secret.TargetWeapon = weapon;
            }
            else
            {
                if (!SecretTargets.Contains(id)) return false;
                Secret.TargetItem = id;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private SecretChoice Choice(string title, string copy, bool enabled = true, string reward = "") => new SecretChoice { Title = title, Copy = copy + (catalog.Item(reward) == null ? "" : "\n\n" + catalog.Item(reward).Description), Enabled = enabled, RewardId = reward, Icon = catalog.Item(reward)?.Icon ?? catalog.Unit(reward)?.Body };
        public SecretChoice[] SecretChoices()
        {
            string item = Secret.TargetItem; bool owned = SecretTargets.Contains(item);
            bool contract = Secret.Contracts.Count == 0;
            string name = catalog.Item(item)?.Name ?? "Select an owned relic";
            int price = SecretTrainPrice;
            switch (Secret.Kind)
            {
                case SecretEventKind.LostProperty:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE HEART IN THE DRAWER", "Fight the cabinet warden. Rescue the Forgotten Patchwork; solo heroes receive its Wooden Heart. A full brigade receives the relic instead, or 25 gold if it is already capped. Defeat ends the run.", true, SecretSolo ? "SecretWoodHeart" : "SecretPatchBear"),
                        Choice("THE LETTER THAT KNOCKS", "Fight the cabinet warden. Rescue Folded Courier; solo heroes receive its Dead-Letter Key. A full brigade receives the relic instead, or 25 gold if it is already capped. A later letter remembers your choice. Defeat ends the run.", true, SecretSolo ? "SecretLetter" : "SecretPaperBird"),
                        Choice("TAKE THE ABANDONED HEART", "Leave the prisoners asleep and take a Wooden Heart relic. No battle. Team health support; no second claim.", CanSecretItem("SecretWoodHeart"), "SecretWoodHeart") };
                case SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("RECALL STITCH", name + ": replace this relic's stat modifiers with returning projectiles and +15% ranged damage; team projectiles lose pierce. One stitch per relic.", owned && HasSecretRanged),
                        Choice("AFTERSHOCK STITCH", name + ": replace its stat modifiers with a delayed melee echo at 30% damage; melee attacks take 20% longer. One stitch per relic.", owned && HasSecretMelee),
                        Choice("SHELTER STITCH", name + ": replace its stat modifiers with +18 maximum HP and 15% less incoming damage; team damage -8%. One stitch per relic.", owned) };
                case SecretEventKind.Understudy:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("FIGHT YOUR REFLECTION", "Your current build becomes a hostile understudy. It repeats your champion's basic attacks after 0.65s at their locked direction. Win: Glass Understudy relic. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretMirror"), "SecretMirror"),
                        Choice("LEND A RELIC", "Lend " + name + " for two normal victories. Its effects sleep while a temporary shadow ally fights with you. It returns automatically. Solo heroes or a full brigade gain +20% hero damage instead of an extra body.", owned && contract),
                        Choice("LEAVE A KIND REFLECTION", "Recover 20% maximum HP, then return. No battle or payment.") };
                case SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE BRASS-LOCKED CRATE", "Pay " + price + " gold for Smuggler's Ticket. See the relic below before buying. One deal only.", State.Gold >= price && CanSecretItem("SecretTicket"), "SecretTicket"),
                        Choice("THE THREAD-BOUND CRATE", "Trade one copy of " + name + " for Living Contraband Thread. The offered copy is consumed. One deal only.", owned && CanSecretItem("SecretThread"), "SecretThread"),
                        Choice("THE OWNER'S CRATE", "Challenge the train's collector. Win: Theatre Crown. No gold fee or ordinary-wave payout. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretCrown"), "SecretCrown") };
                case SecretEventKind.ThirteenthHour:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("BORROW AN EXTRA HOUR", "Borrow an Hourglass Advance relic for three normal victories. It vanishes when the third wave is settled. Only one active contract.", contract && StackCount("SecretHour") == 0, "SecretHour"),
                        Choice("ADVANCE ON TOMORROW", "Receive " + SecretLoan + " gold now. The bank takes 25% of normal-wave base income and interest for the next two victories. Kill loot is untouched.", contract),
                        Choice("DEPOSIT A RELIC", "Send " + name + " to the vault for two normal victories. Its stat effects sleep until it returns with +25% positive stat modifiers for this run.", contract && owned && CanImproveSecretItem(item)) };
                case SecretEventKind.SleepingGarden:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("WAKE THE PORCELAIN HEALER", "Restore all HP and gain a Sleeping-Lamb Brooch. No hidden payment or curse.", CanSecretItem("SecretDream"), "SecretDream"),
                        Choice("WAKE THE CONTRACT KEEPER", "Settle your current secret contract immediately: return lent/deposited relics, cancel income debt and release temporary gifts. No payment.", Secret.Contracts.Count > 0),
                        Choice(SecretSolo ? "WAKE A DREAM IN YOUR HEART" : "WAKE THE SLEEPING FRIEND", SecretSolo ? "Borrow a champion-damage dream for two normal victories. No companion is added." : "A porcelain Dream Lamb joins for two normal victories, then goes peacefully home. A full brigade gains +20% hero damage instead of an extra body.", contract) };
                case SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("THE PAPER CHORUS", "Survive a 28-second swarm performance. Reward: Theatre Crown. No ordinary income or kill loot is paid. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretCrown"), "SecretCrown"),
                        Choice("THE LEADING ACTOR", "Defeat one enlarged cabinet actor with deliberate, heavy attacks. Reward: Hourglass Advance to keep. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretHour"), "SecretHour"),
                        Choice("THE HOSTILE DUET", "Defeat a cabinet actor and its ranged supporting performer. Their volleys alternate. Reward: Living Contraband Thread. Defeat ends the run.", CanSecretItem("SecretThread"), "SecretThread") };
                default:
                    return new[] {
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT TO YOURSELF", "Post one copy of " + name + ". After two normal victories, it returns with +25% positive stat modifiers. Its effects sleep while away.", owned && contract && CanImproveSecretItem(item)),
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT TO A FRIEND", "Consume one copy of " + name + " to give " + (catalog.Unit(Secret.TargetUnit)?.DisplayName ?? "a chosen companion") + " / " + Secret.TargetWeapon + " +20% weapon damage for this run. This gift stays with that unit/weapon pairing; it does not follow a different weapon after merging.", owned && !SecretSolo && State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == Secret.TargetUnit && r.WeaponId == Secret.TargetWeapon) && !Secret.AllyGifts.Exists(g => g.UnitId == Secret.TargetUnit && g.WeaponId == Secret.TargetWeapon)),
                        Choice("ADDRESS IT OUTSIDE THE STAGE", (Secret.RescuedToy && !Secret.ThankYouClaimed ? "The rescued resident enclosed a thank-you: 15 gold. " : "") + "Send an invitation and receive a Dead-Letter Key. A secret theatre encounter waits in a later shop, even after the two-visit limit. The Keeper remembers your letter.", !Secret.LetterSent && CanSecretItem("SecretLetter"), "SecretLetter") };
            }
        }

        public int SecretTrainPrice => 25 + Mathf.Min(State.Wave, 30) * 3;
        public int SecretLoan => 30 + Mathf.Min(State.Wave, 30) * 3;
        private bool HasSecretRanged => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile || State.Roster.Exists(r => catalog.Weapon(r.WeaponId).Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile);
        private bool HasSecretMelee => catalog.Unit(State.ChampionId).Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee || State.Roster.Exists(r => catalog.Weapon(r.WeaponId).Kind == WeaponKind.Melee);
        private bool CanImproveSecretItem(string id) => catalog.Item(id) != null && catalog.Item(id).EffectiveModifiers.Any(m => m.Value > 0);
        private bool CanSecretItem(string id) => catalog.Item(id) != null && StackCount(id) < catalog.Item(id).StackLimit;
        private bool GiveSecretItem(string id)
        {
            if (!CanSecretItem(id)) return false;
            ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == id);
            if (stack == null) State.Items.Add(new ItemStack { Id = id, Count = 1 }); else stack.Count++;
            return true;
        }
        private void ConsumeSecretItem(string id)
        {
            ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == id); if (--stack.Count == 0) State.Items.Remove(stack);
        }
        private bool GiveSecretAlly(string id)
        {
            UnitDefinition unit = catalog.Unit(id); if (SecretSolo || unit == null || State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit) return false;
            RosterEntry existing = State.Roster.Find(r => r.UnitId == id && r.WeaponId == unit.Weapon.Id);
            if (existing != null) return false;
            var entry = new RosterEntry { UnitId = id, WeaponId = unit.Weapon.Id }; State.Roster.Add(entry); RememberVariant(entry); return true;
        }

        public bool ChooseSecretEvent(int option)
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing || option < 0 || option > 2) return false;
            SecretChoice choice = SecretChoices()[option]; if (!choice.Enabled) return false;
            Secret.Option = option; Secret.RewardId = choice.RewardId ?? "";
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,option,false);
            bool fight = Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty && option < 2 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.Understudy && option == 0 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain && option == 2 || Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre;
            if (fight) { Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Fighting; State.Phase = SessionPhase.Combat; return true; }
            switch (Secret.Kind)
            {
                case SecretEventKind.LostProperty: GiveSecretItem("SecretWoodHeart"); break;
                case SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor: Secret.Stitches.Add(new SecretStitch { ItemId = Secret.TargetItem, Pattern = option }); break;
                case SecretEventKind.Understudy:
                    if (option == 2) State.Health = Mathf.Min(MaximumHealth(), State.Health + MaximumHealth() * .2f);
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain:
                    if (option == 0) State.Gold -= SecretTrainPrice; else ConsumeSecretItem(Secret.TargetItem);
                    GiveSecretItem(choice.RewardId); break;
                case SecretEventKind.ThirteenthHour:
                    if (option == 0) { GiveSecretItem("SecretHour"); Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic, Remaining = 3, ItemId = "SecretHour" }); }
                    else if (option == 1) { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + SecretLoan); Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.IncomeDebt, Remaining = 2 }); }
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.SleepingGarden:
                    if (option == 0) { GiveSecretItem("SecretDream"); State.Health = MaximumHealth(); }
                    else if (option == 1) { foreach (SecretContract c in Secret.Contracts) FinishSecretContract(c); Secret.Contracts.Clear(); }
                    else Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.DreamFriend, Remaining = 2 });
                    break;
                case SecretEventKind.DeadLetters:
                    if (option == 0) Secret.Contracts.Add(new SecretContract { Kind = SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel, Remaining = 2, ItemId = Secret.TargetItem });
                    else if (option == 1) { ConsumeSecretItem(Secret.TargetItem); Secret.AllyGifts.Add(new SecretAllyGift { UnitId = Secret.TargetUnit, WeaponId = Secret.TargetWeapon }); }
                    else
                    {
                        GiveSecretItem("SecretLetter"); Secret.LetterSent = true;
                        if (Secret.RescuedToy && !Secret.ThankYouClaimed) { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 15); Secret.ThankYouClaimed = true; }
                        if ((Secret.VisitedMask & (1 << (int)SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre)) == 0) Secret.QueuedEvent = (int)SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre;
                    }
                    break;
            }
            Secret.Result = choice.Title + "\n" + choice.Copy; Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Reward; Secret.RewardId = "";
            RecountBonds();
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(State.Health, MaximumHealth());
            RecordSecret(choice.Title);
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,option,true);
            return true;
        }

        public bool LeaveSecretEvent()
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Choosing && Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Reward || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Secret.RewardId)) return false;
            RecordSecret(Secret.Stage == SecretEventStage.Reward ? "Returned to the unchanged shop." : "Left without a deal.");
            Secret.Stage = SecretEventStage.Idle; return true;
        }
        private bool SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable => catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId) != null && (SecretSolo || State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit || State.Roster.Exists(r => r.UnitId == Secret.RewardId && r.WeaponId == catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId).Weapon.Id));
        private string SecretCompanionFallback => Secret.RewardId == "SecretPaperBird" ? "SecretLetter" : "SecretWoodHeart";
        public string SecretRewardLabel => SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable ? CanSecretItem(SecretCompanionFallback) ? catalog.Item(SecretCompanionFallback).Name + " / RELIC INSTEAD" : "25 GOLD / BRIGADE FULL" : catalog.Item(Secret.RewardId)?.Name ?? catalog.Unit(Secret.RewardId)?.DisplayName;
        public bool ClaimSecretBattleReward()
        {
            if (State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || Secret.Stage != SecretEventStage.Reward || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Secret.RewardId)) return false;
            string id = Secret.RewardId;
            bool success;
            if (SecretCompanionRewardUnavailable)
            {
                if (CanSecretItem(SecretCompanionFallback)) { id = SecretCompanionFallback; success = GiveSecretItem(id); }
                else { State.Gold = BoundedCounter((long)State.Gold + 25); id = ""; success = true; }
            }
            else success = catalog.Item(id) != null ? GiveSecretItem(id) : GiveSecretAlly(id);
            if (!success) return false;
            if (Secret.Kind == SecretEventKind.LostProperty) Secret.RescuedToy = true;
            RememberNightmareChoice(Secret.Kind,Secret.Option,true);
            RecountBonds();
            Secret.RewardId = ""; RecordSecret("Received " + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? "25 gold / brigade full" : catalog.Item(id)?.Name ?? catalog.Unit(id)?.DisplayName));
            return true;
        }
        private void RecordSecret(string text)
        {
            Secret.Journal.Add("Hall " + State.Wave + " / " + SecretEventAssets.Titles[(int)Secret.Kind] + ": " + text);
            while (Secret.Journal.Count > 24) Secret.Journal.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        public float SecretBonus(ItemEffect effect, ModifierScope scope)
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null) return 0;
            float bonus = 0;
            foreach (SecretStitch stitch in Secret.Stitches)
            {
                if (StackCount(stitch.ItemId) == 0 || !RunModifierRules.Applies(ModifierScope.Team, scope)) continue;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 2 && effect == ItemEffect.Health && scope == ModifierScope.Champion) bonus += 18;
                if (stitch.Pattern == 2 && effect == ItemEffect.Damage) bonus -= .08f;
            }
            if ((SecretSolo || State.Roster.Count >= OctoberBalance.AllySoftLimit) && Secret.Contracts.Exists(c => c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.DreamFriend) && effect == ItemEffect.ChampionDamage && scope == ModifierScope.Champion) bonus += .2f;
            return bonus;
        }

        private void FinishSecretContract(SecretContract c)
        {
            if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic)
            {
                ItemStack stack = State.Items.Find(s => s.Id == c.ItemId); if (stack != null) ConsumeSecretItem(c.ItemId);
            }
            if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel && !Secret.ImprovedItems.Contains(c.ItemId)) Secret.ImprovedItems.Add(c.ItemId);
        }
        private void SettleSecretContracts()
        {
            if (State.Secrets == null || Secret.LastContractWave >= State.Wave) return;
            Secret.LastContractWave = State.Wave;
            foreach (SecretContract c in Secret.Contracts.ToArray())
            {
                if (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.IncomeDebt)
                {
                    int charge = Mathf.CeilToInt((State.LastIncome + State.LastInterest) * .25f); State.Gold = Mathf.Max(0, State.Gold - charge);
                    Secret.Journal.Add("Hall " + State.Wave + ": bank repayment " + charge + " gold.");
                }
                if (--c.Remaining > 0) continue;
                FinishSecretContract(c); Secret.Contracts.Remove(c); RecordSecret("Contract completed: " + c.Kind);
            }
            State.Health = Mathf.Min(State.Health, MaximumHealth());
            while (Secret.Journal.Count > 24) Secret.Journal.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        private void ValidateSecretEvents(RunSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            if (snapshot?.Secrets == null) return; // old saves migrate lazily
            SecretEventProgress s = snapshot.Secrets;
            bool invalid = !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretEventStage), s.Stage) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretEventKind), s.Kind) || s.Visits < 0 || s.Visits > 2 || s.VisitedMask < 0 || s.VisitedMask > 255 || s.VisitWave < 0 || s.VisitWave > snapshot.Wave || s.LastContractWave < 0 || s.LastContractWave > snapshot.Wave || s.QueuedEvent < -1 || s.QueuedEvent > 7 || s.Option < -1 || s.Option > 2;
            invalid |= s.Contracts == null || s.Stitches == null || s.AllyGifts == null || s.ImprovedItems == null || s.Journal == null;
            if (invalid) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret-event save");
            if (s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Fighting && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat || (s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Choosing || s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Reward) && snapshot.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret-event phase");
            if (s.Stage != SecretEventStage.Idle && snapshot.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Fighting || s.Contracts.Count > 1 || s.Stitches.Count > 8 || s.AllyGifts.Count > 8 || s.ImprovedItems.Count > 8 || s.Journal.Count > 24) throw new InvalidOperationException("Conflicting secret progress");
            foreach (SecretContract c in s.Contracts)
                if (c == null || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SecretContractKind), c.Kind) || c.Remaining < 1 || c.Remaining > 3 || (c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedRelic || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.BorrowedShadow || c.Kind == SecretContractKind.InsuredParcel) && (catalog.Item(c.ItemId) == null || !snapshot.Items.Exists(i => i.Id == c.ItemId))) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret contract");
            var seen = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (SecretStitch t in s.Stitches) if (t == null || catalog.Item(t.ItemId) == null || t.Pattern < 0 || t.Pattern > 2 || !seen.Add(t.ItemId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid relic stitch");
            seen.Clear(); foreach (string id in s.ImprovedItems) if (catalog.Item(id) == null || !seen.Add(id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid improved parcel");
            seen.Clear(); foreach (SecretAllyGift g in s.AllyGifts) if (g == null || catalog.Unit(g.UnitId) == null || catalog.Weapon(g.WeaponId) == null || !seen.Add(g.UnitId + "/" + g.WeaponId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid ally letter");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.RewardId) && catalog.Item(s.RewardId) == null && catalog.Unit(s.RewardId) == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid secret reward");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class ShopStatDelta
    {
        public string ActorKey, ActorName, Label, Message;
        public double Before, After;
        public bool LowerIsBetter, Neutral;
        public bool Positive => LowerIsBetter ? After < Before : After > Before;
        public string SignedChange => Math.Abs(After-Before)<.0001 && After!=Before ? (After>Before?"+":"")+(After-Before).ToString("G3") : (After-Before).ToString("+0.####;-0.####;0");
        public string Caption => Message ?? Label + " " + SignedChange + "  (" + Before.ToString("0.####") + " → " + After.ToString("0.####") + ")";
    }
    public sealed class ShopStatSnapshot
    {
        public sealed class Actor
        {
            public string Key, Name;
            public readonly Dictionary<string,double> Values=new Dictionary<string,double>();
            public readonly Dictionary<string,string> Info=new Dictionary<string,string>();
        }
        public readonly Dictionary<string,Actor> Actors=new Dictionary<string,Actor>();
        public static ShopStatSnapshot Capture(RunSession session,RunCatalog c,CheckpointCatalog a)
        {
            var snapshot=new ShopStatSnapshot();
            Actor Add(string key,UnitDefinition u,int tier)
            {
                var x=new Actor{Key=key,Name=u.DisplayName};snapshot.Actors.Add(key,x);var w=u.Weapon;
                x.Values["Damage"]=w.Damage;x.Values["Attacks/s"]=1/Mathf.Max(.001f,w.Cooldown);x.Values["Reach"]=w.Range;x.Values["Speed"]=u.Speed;
                x.Values["Crit %"]=u.CriticalChance*100;x.Values["Shots"]=w.ProjectileCount;x.Values["Pierce"]=w.ProjectilePierce;x.Values["Split"]=w.ProjectileSplit;
                x.Values["Bounce %"]=w.ProjectileBounceChance*100;x.Values["Bullet size"]=w.ProjectileRadius;x.Values["Bullet speed"]=w.ProjectileSpeed;
                x.Values["Travel distance"]=w.ProjectileLifetime*w.ProjectileSpeed;x.Values["Push"]=w.PushDistance;x.Values["Contact damage"]=u.CollisionDamage;
                x.Values["Contacts/s"]=1/Mathf.Max(.001f,u.CollisionFrequency);x.Values["Body size"]=u.BodyHeight;x.Values["Stars"]=tier;
                x.Values["Passive strength"]=u.PassiveStrength;x.Info["Form"]=u.BuildMorph+" / "+u.BuildMorphStage;
                return x;
            }
            Actor hero=Add("hero",a.Champion,1);hero.Values["Max HP"]=a.Champion.Health;hero.Values["Current HP"]=session.State.Health;
            hero.Values["Armor"]=a.Armor;hero.Values["Dodge %"]=a.Dodge*100;hero.Values["Regen HP/s"]=a.PassiveHeal;hero.Values["Heart healing"]=a.HeartHealing;
            hero.Values["Pickup"]=a.PickupRadius;hero.Values["Chest reach"]=a.ChestOpenRadius;
            hero.Values["Gold"]=session.State.Gold;hero.Values["Eggs"]=session.State.Eggs;
            foreach(ItemEffect effect in Enum.GetValues(typeof(ItemEffect)))
                if(RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(effect)==ModifierScope.Run)hero.Values["Run / "+RunModifierRules.ModifierName(effect)]=session.Bonus(effect);
            hero.Values["Next refresh cost"]=session.RerollCost;
            var identity=session.HeroIdentityDefinition;
            if(identity!=null)
            {
                var h=session.State.HeroIdentity;hero.Info["Approach"]=identity.Approaches[h.Approach];hero.Info["Featured"]=string.IsNullOrEmpty(h.LeadUnit)?"Automatic":c.Unit(h.LeadUnit).DisplayName+" / "+RunUICopy.WeaponName(h.LeadWeapon);
                hero.Info["Memories"]=string.Join(", ",Array.ConvertAll(h.Organs,id=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)?"Auto":c.Unit(id).DisplayName));hero.Info["Order"]=string.IsNullOrEmpty(h.OrderItem)?"":c.Item(h.OrderItem).Name;hero.Values["Next die face"]=h.DiceFace;
                if(session.State.ChampionId=="PetalCitadel")for(int i=0;i<4;i++)hero.Values[new[]{"Attack petal","Guard petal","Healing petal","Projectile petal"}[i]]=a.HeroPetals[i];
            }
            foreach(var stack in session.State.Items)hero.Values["Relic / "+c.Item(stack.Id).Name]=stack.Count;
            for(int i=0;i<session.State.Roster.Count;i++){var r=session.State.Roster[i];Add(r.UnitId+"|"+r.WeaponId,a.StartingCompanions[i],r.Tier);}
            return snapshot;
        }
        public static List<ShopStatDelta> Compare(ShopStatSnapshot before,ShopStatSnapshot after)
        {
            var changes=new List<ShopStatDelta>();
            foreach(var pair in after.Actors)
            {
                Actor next=pair.Value;
                if(!before.Actors.TryGetValue(pair.Key,out Actor previous)){changes.Add(new ShopStatDelta{ActorKey=next.Key,ActorName=next.Name,Label="Roster",Before=0,After=1,Message="JOINED / "+next.Values["Stars"]+" STAR"});continue;}
                foreach(var stat in next.Values)
                {
                    double old; if(!previous.Values.TryGetValue(stat.Key,out old)) { if(!stat.Key.StartsWith("Relic / ",StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue; old=0; }
                    if(!double.IsFinite(stat.Value) || old==stat.Value)continue;
                    changes.Add(new ShopStatDelta{ActorKey=next.Key,ActorName=next.Name,Label=stat.Key,Before=old,After=stat.Value,
                        LowerIsBetter=stat.Key=="Next refresh cost" || stat.Key=="Run / Enemy health" || stat.Key=="Run / Enemy count" || stat.Key=="Run / Enemy speed",
                        Neutral=stat.Key=="Body size" || stat.Key=="Next die face"});
                }
                foreach(var stat in previous.Values)if(stat.Key.StartsWith("Relic / ",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&!next.Values.ContainsKey(stat.Key))changes.Add(new ShopStatDelta{ActorKey=next.Key,ActorName=next.Name,Label=stat.Key,Before=stat.Value,After=0});
                foreach(var info in next.Info)if(previous.Info.TryGetValue(info.Key,out string old) && old!=info.Value)changes.Add(new ShopStatDelta{ActorKey=next.Key,ActorName=next.Name,Label=info.Key,Neutral=true,Message=info.Key+": "+(string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.Value)?"Cleared":info.Value)});
            }
            foreach(var pair in before.Actors)if(!after.Actors.ContainsKey(pair.Key))changes.Add(new ShopStatDelta{ActorKey=pair.Key,ActorName=pair.Value.Name,Label="Roster",Before=1,After=0,Neutral=true,Message="MERGED / LEFT ROSTER"});
            return changes;
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public int ShopStatRevision { get; private set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<ShopStatDelta> LastShopStatChanges { get; private set; } = Array.Empty<ShopStatDelta>();
        private void ResetShopStatFeedback() { LastShopStatChanges=Array.Empty<ShopStatDelta>();ShopStatRevision++; }
        public void PublishShopStatChanges(ShopStatSnapshot before,ShopStatSnapshot after)
        { LastShopStatChanges=ShopStatSnapshot.Compare(before,after);ShopStatRevision++; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private sealed class StampState
        {
            public UnitState Source;
            public UnitState Target;
            public int Count;
            public float Expires;
        }

        private sealed class SignaturePulse
        {
            public UnitState Source;
            public Vector2 Position;
            public Vector2 Direction;
            public float Damage;
            public float Radius;
            public float At;
            public CombatCause Cause;
        }

        private readonly Dictionary<long, StampState> stamps = new Dictionary<long, StampState>();
        private readonly List<long> expiredStamps = new List<long>();
        private readonly List<SignaturePulse> signaturePulses = new List<SignaturePulse>();
        public int PendingSignaturePulses => signaturePulses.Count;
        public int ActiveStampPairs => stamps.Count;
        public int BellWaves { get; private set; }
        public int UmbrellaOpenings { get; private set; }
        public int StampBursts { get; private set; }

        private void ClearSignatures()
        {
            stamps.Clear(); signaturePulses.Clear(); expiredStamps.Clear();
            BellWaves = UmbrellaOpenings = StampBursts = 0;
            foreach (UnitState unit in units) { unit.AttackBeat = unit.VisibleMarks = 0; unit.MarkVisibleUntil = unit.ExposedUntil = 0; }
        }

        private void AdvanceSignatureBeat(UnitState unit, float damage, CombatCause cause, int charge = 1)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = unit.Definition.Weapon;
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy || weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.None || weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Stamp) return;
            int beats = Mathf.Max(2, weapon.SignatureBeats);
            int total = unit.AttackBeat + Mathf.Clamp(charge, 1, beats);
            unit.AttackBeat = total % beats;
            if (total < beats) return;
            float radius = Mathf.Max(0.1f, weapon.SignatureRadius);
            if (weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Umbrella && unit.Definition.CombatTier >= 2) radius *= 1.25f;
            signaturePulses.Add(new SignaturePulse { Source = unit, Position = unit.Position, Direction = unit.AttackDirection, Damage = damage * Mathf.Max(0, weapon.SignatureScale), Radius = radius, At = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(0.05f, weapon.SignatureDelay), Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, unit.Id, weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell ? "bell-wave" : "umbrella-open", cause.Depth + 1) });
            if (weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell && unit.Definition.CombatTier >= 2)
                signaturePulses.Add(new SignaturePulse { Source = unit, Position = unit.Position, Direction = unit.AttackDirection, Damage = damage * Mathf.Max(0, weapon.SignatureScale) * 0.35f, Radius = radius, At = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(0.05f, weapon.SignatureDelay) + 0.3f, Cause = new CombatCause(cause.RootId, unit.Id, "bell-echo", cause.Depth + 1) });
        }

        private void AddStamp(UnitState source, UnitState target, float damage, CombatCause cause)
        {
            if (!target.Alive || target.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return;
            WeaponDefinition weapon = source.Definition.Weapon;
            long key = ((long)source.Id << 32) | (uint)target.Id;
            if (!stamps.TryGetValue(key, out StampState mark))
            {
                mark = new StampState { Source = source, Target = target }; stamps.Add(key, mark);
            }
            if (mark.Expires <= Elapsed) mark.Count = 0;
            mark.Count += catalog.ReflectiveInkStacks > 0 ? 2 : 1;
            mark.Expires = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(0.1f, weapon.MarkLifetime * (catalog.ReflectiveInkStacks > 0 ? 0.65f : 1));
            target.VisibleMarks = mark.Count; target.MarkVisibleUntil = mark.Expires;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignatureMark, target.Position, source.Faction, mark.Count, weapon: weapon, subjectId: target.Id, cause: cause.Child("stamp-mark")));
            if (mark.Count < Mathf.Max(2, weapon.SignatureBeats)) return;
            stamps.Remove(key); target.VisibleMarks = 0;
            StampBursts++;
            RecordActivation(cause.Child("stamp-burst"));
            if (catalog.ReflectiveInkStacks > 0 || catalog.OfficeLensStacks > 0)
            {
                target.ExposedUntil = Elapsed + 1.8f;
                RecordActivation(cause.Child(catalog.ReflectiveInkStacks > 0 ? "reflective-ink" : "office-lens-exposure"));
            }
            if (catalog.CarbonRibbon)
            {
                foreach (PickupState pickup in pickups)
                    if (pickup.Kind == LootKind.Coin && (pickup.Position - target.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 6.25f) pickup.Attracting = true;
                RecordActivation(cause.Child("carbon-collector"));
            }
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignatureBurst, target.Position, source.Faction, weapon.SignatureRadius, weapon: weapon, cause: cause.Child("stamp-burst")));
            ApplyDamage(target, damage * Mathf.Max(0, weapon.SignatureScale), source.Faction, "Dream stamp burst", weapon: weapon, cause: cause.Child("stamp-burst"));
            if (source.Definition.CombatTier < 2) return;
            UnitState neighbor = null; float best = weapon.SignatureRadius * weapon.SignatureRadius;
            foreach (UnitState candidate in units)
            {
                if (candidate == target || !candidate.Alive || candidate.Faction != Faction.Enemy) continue;
                float distance = (candidate.Position - target.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                if (distance >= best) continue;
                neighbor = candidate; best = distance;
            }
            if (neighbor == null) return;
            long neighborKey = ((long)source.Id << 32) | (uint)neighbor.Id;
            if (!stamps.TryGetValue(neighborKey, out StampState transferred))
            {
                transferred = new StampState { Source = source, Target = neighbor }; stamps.Add(neighborKey, transferred);
            }
            if (transferred.Expires <= Elapsed) transferred.Count = 0;
            transferred.Count = Mathf.Min(Mathf.Max(2, weapon.SignatureBeats) - 1, transferred.Count + 1);
            transferred.Expires = Elapsed + Mathf.Max(0.1f, weapon.MarkLifetime);
            neighbor.VisibleMarks = transferred.Count; neighbor.MarkVisibleUntil = transferred.Expires;
            events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignatureMark, neighbor.Position, source.Faction, transferred.Count, weapon: weapon, subjectId: neighbor.Id, cause: cause.Child("stamp-carbon")));
        }

        private void ProcessSignatures()
        {
            expiredStamps.Clear();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<long, StampState> pair in stamps)
                if (!pair.Value.Target.Alive || !pair.Value.Source.Alive || pair.Value.Expires <= Elapsed) expiredStamps.Add(pair.Key);
            foreach (long key in expiredStamps) stamps.Remove(key);
            foreach (UnitState unit in units)
            {
                unit.VisibleMarks = 0; unit.MarkVisibleUntil = 0;
            }
            foreach (StampState mark in stamps.Values)
                if (mark.Count > mark.Target.VisibleMarks) { mark.Target.VisibleMarks = mark.Count; mark.Target.MarkVisibleUntil = mark.Expires; }
            for (int index = signaturePulses.Count - 1; index >= 0; index--)
            {
                SignaturePulse pulse = signaturePulses[index];
                if (pulse.At > Elapsed) continue;
                signaturePulses.RemoveAt(index);
                if (!pulse.Source.Alive) continue;
                WeaponDefinition weapon = pulse.Source.Definition.Weapon;
                if (weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell) BellWaves++; else UmbrellaOpenings++;
                RecordActivation(pulse.Cause);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse, pulse.Position, pulse.Source.Faction, pulse.Radius, pulse.Direction, weapon, cause: pulse.Cause));
                foreach (UnitState target in units)
                {
                    Vector2 delta = target.Position - pulse.Position;
                    if (!target.Alive || target.Faction != Faction.Enemy || delta.sqrMagnitude > pulse.Radius * pulse.Radius) continue;
                    if (weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Umbrella && Vector2.Dot(delta.normalized, pulse.Direction) < 0) continue;
                    ApplyDamage(target, pulse.Damage, pulse.Source.Faction, weapon.Id + " payoff", pulse.Direction, weapon, cause: pulse.Cause);
                    if (target.Alive && weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell && target.VisibleMarks > 0 && catalog.ChorusStacks > 0 && pulse.Cause.ItemId == "bell-wave")
                        ApplyDamage(target, pulse.Damage * Mathf.Min(0.5f, catalog.ChorusStacks * 0.25f), pulse.Source.Faction, "Chorus marked target", cause: pulse.Cause.Child("scratch-record"));
                    if (target.Alive && weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell && catalog.CarbonRibbon)
                    {
                        target.ExposedUntil = Mathf.Max(target.ExposedUntil, Elapsed + 1.5f);
                        RecordActivation(pulse.Cause.Child("carbon-exposure"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public void SignatureBeatFixture(UnitState source) => AdvanceSignatureBeat(source, source.Definition.Weapon.Damage, NewCause(source.Id));
        public void StampFixture(UnitState source, UnitState target) => AddStamp(source, target, source.Definition.Weapon.Damage, NewCause(source.Id));
#endif
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private float nextHarvestBeat;
        public int HarvestBeats { get; private set; }

        private void ProcessSignatureRelics()
        {
            if (catalog.HarvestStacks <= 0 || Elapsed < nextHarvestBeat || !Champion.Alive) return;
            int count = events.Count;
            for (int index = 0; index < count; index++)
            {
                CombatEvent trigger = events[index];
                if (trigger.Kind != CombatEventKind.Pickup || trigger.Loot != LootKind.Coin || trigger.Cause.Depth != 0) continue;
                UnitState bell = null; float best = 36;
                foreach (UnitState source in units)
                {
                    if (!source.Alive || source.Faction == Faction.Enemy || source.Definition.Weapon.Signature != SignatureWeapon.Bell) continue;
                    float distance = (source.Position - Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude;
                    if (distance >= best) continue;
                    bell = source; best = distance;
                }
                if (bell == null) return;
                nextHarvestBeat = Elapsed + 0.35f;
                CombatCause cause = new CombatCause(trigger.Cause.RootId, bell.Id, "harvest-receipt", 1);
                AdvanceSignatureBeat(bell, bell.Definition.Weapon.Damage, cause, Mathf.Min(2, catalog.HarvestStacks));
                HarvestBeats++; RecordActivation(cause);
                events.Add(new CombatEvent(CombatEventKind.Proc, bell.Position, bell.Faction, cause: cause));
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Core/SpatialUnitIndex.cs | SHA-256 e7cab61408f7395daa06179f6c4f617882c71e2c4dd8af92b1e590a6d72c72af</summary>

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class SpatialUnitIndex
    {
        private static readonly System.Comparison<UnitState> identityComparison = Compare;
        private const float CellSize = 2f;
        private readonly Dictionary<Vector2Int, List<UnitState>> cells = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, List<UnitState>>();
        private readonly Stack<List<UnitState>> pool = new Stack<List<UnitState>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, Vector2Int> membership = new Dictionary<int, Vector2Int>();

        private static Vector2Int Cell(Vector2 position) => new Vector2Int(Mathf.FloorToInt(position.x / CellSize), Mathf.FloorToInt(position.y / CellSize));

        public void Rebuild(IReadOnlyList<UnitState> units)
        {
            foreach (List<UnitState> bucket in cells.Values) { bucket.Clear(); pool.Push(bucket); }
            cells.Clear();
            membership.Clear();
            foreach (UnitState unit in units) if (unit.Alive) Insert(unit, Cell(unit.Position));
        }

        private void Insert(UnitState unit, Vector2Int cell)
        {
            if (!cells.TryGetValue(cell, out List<UnitState> bucket))
            {
                bucket = pool.Count > 0 ? pool.Pop() : new List<UnitState>();
                cells.Add(cell, bucket);
            }
            bucket.Add(unit);
            membership[unit.Id] = cell;
        }

        public void Move(UnitState unit)
        {
            Vector2Int cell = Cell(unit.Position);
            if (membership.TryGetValue(unit.Id, out Vector2Int old))
            {
                if (cell == old) return;
                cells[old].Remove(unit);
            }
            Insert(unit, cell);
        }

        public void Query(Vector2 minimum, Vector2 maximum, List<UnitState> results, bool heavyEnemiesOnly = false)
        {
            results.Clear();
            Vector2Int first = Cell(minimum);
            Vector2Int last = Cell(maximum);
            for (int horizontal = first.x; horizontal <= last.x; horizontal++)
                for (int vertical = first.y; vertical <= last.y; vertical++)
                    if (cells.TryGetValue(new Vector2Int(horizontal, vertical), out List<UnitState> bucket))
                    {
                        if (!heavyEnemiesOnly) results.AddRange(bucket);
                        else for (int index = 0; index < bucket.Count; index++)
                        {
                            UnitState unit = bucket[index];
                            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy && (unit.Definition.IsBoss || unit.Definition.BodyHeight >= 1.2f)) results.Add(unit);
                        }
                    }
            results.Sort(identityComparison);
        }
        private static int Compare(UnitState first, UnitState second) => first.Id.CompareTo(second.Id);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private int swarmSpawns;
        private int swarmGoldKills;
        public int SwarmSpawnCount => swarmSpawns;
        private UnitDefinition SwarmDefinition()
        {
            UnitDefinition fallback = null;
            foreach (UnitDefinition candidate in catalog.EnemyPool)
                if (!candidate.IsBoss && candidate.SpecialEnemy == SpecialEnemyKind.None && candidate.Weapon.Kind != WeaponKind.Projectile && candidate.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Standard && (fallback == null || candidate.BodyHeight < fallback.BodyHeight)) fallback = candidate;
            return fallback ?? catalog.MeleeEnemy;
        }
        private UnitDefinition HerdDefinition()
        {
            var choices = new System.Collections.Generic.List<UnitDefinition>();
            foreach (UnitDefinition candidate in catalog.EnemyPool)
                if (!candidate.IsBoss && candidate.SpecialEnemy == SpecialEnemyKind.None && candidate.Weapon.Kind != WeaponKind.Projectile && candidate.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Standard && candidate.BodyHeight <= 1.15f && !choices.Contains(candidate)) choices.Add(candidate);
            return choices.Count == 0 ? SwarmDefinition() : choices[spawnRandom.Next(choices.Count)];
        }
        private int SwarmCoinValue(UnitState target)
        {
            if (target.Variant != null && target.Variant.Summoned) return 0;
            if (!target.SwarmMinion) return catalog.GoldPerKill;
            swarmGoldKills++;
            return swarmGoldKills % 3 == 0 ? catalog.GoldPerKill : 0;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed partial class CombatSimulation
    {
        private readonly System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int, int> tacticalClaims = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int, int>();
        private readonly System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int, float> tacticalDamage = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<int, float>();
        private float tacticalClaimTime = -1;
        private int tacticalGeneration = -1;
        private UnitState SelectCompanionTarget(UnitState source, float radius, bool attackOnly = false)
        {
            bool melee = source.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee;
            if (!attackOnly && melee && source.PendingAttack)
            {
                UnitState locked = units.Find(unit => unit.Id == source.AttackTargetId);
                if (locked != null && CanHit(source.Faction, locked) && (locked.Position - Champion.Position).magnitude <= CompanionMotion.Leash(source, catalog) + source.Definition.Weapon.Range * 0.65f) return locked;
            }
            if (tacticalClaimTime != Elapsed || tacticalGeneration != Generation)
            {
                tacticalClaimTime = Elapsed; tacticalGeneration = Generation; tacticalClaims.Clear(); tacticalDamage.Clear();
                foreach (UnitState ally in units)
                {
                    if (!ally.Alive || ally.Faction != Faction.Companion) continue;
                    if (ally.TacticalTargetId != 0) tacticalClaims[ally.TacticalTargetId] = tacticalClaims.TryGetValue(ally.TacticalTargetId, out int count) ? count + 1 : 1;
                    if (ally.PendingAttack) tacticalDamage[ally.AttackTargetId] = (tacticalDamage.TryGetValue(ally.AttackTargetId, out float committed) ? committed : 0) + ally.Definition.Weapon.Damage;
                }
            }
            Vector2 center = attackOnly || source.Definition.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile ? source.Position : Champion.Position;
            spatial.Query(center - Vector2.one * radius, center + Vector2.one * radius, targetCandidates);
            UnitState best = null;
            float bestScore = float.PositiveInfinity;
            foreach (UnitState enemy in targetCandidates)
            {
                if (!CanHit(source.Faction, enemy) || (enemy.Position - center).sqrMagnitude > radius * radius) continue;
                if (attackOnly && melee && (enemy.Position - source.Position).magnitude > source.Definition.Weapon.Range + enemy.Definition.Radius) continue;
                float claims = tacticalClaims.TryGetValue(enemy.Id, out int assignments) ? assignments : 0;
                if (source.TacticalTargetId == enemy.Id) claims = Mathf.Max(0, claims - 1);
                float committedDamage = tacticalDamage.TryGetValue(enemy.Id, out float expected) ? expected : 0;
                if (source.PendingAttack && source.AttackTargetId == enemy.Id) committedDamage -= source.Definition.Weapon.Damage;
                float score = (enemy.Position - source.Position).magnitude + claims * 0.55f + IdentityTargetScore(enemy);
                if (!enemy.Definition.IsBoss && committedDamage >= enemy.Health) score += 3;
                if (enemy.Id == source.TacticalTargetId) score -= Elapsed < source.TacticalRetargetAt ? 1.5f : 0.6f;
                if (score > bestScore || score == bestScore && best != null && enemy.Id >= best.Id) continue;
                bestScore = score; best = enemy;
            }
            if (!attackOnly)
            {
                int identifier = best == null ? 0 : best.Id;
                if (identifier != source.TacticalTargetId)
                {
                    if (tacticalClaims.TryGetValue(source.TacticalTargetId, out int oldCount)) tacticalClaims[source.TacticalTargetId] = Mathf.Max(0, oldCount - 1);
                    if (identifier != 0) tacticalClaims[identifier] = tacticalClaims.TryGetValue(identifier, out int newCount) ? newCount + 1 : 1;
                    source.TacticalRetargetAt = Elapsed + 0.55f;
                }
                source.TacticalTargetId = identifier;
                if (melee && source.PendingAttack && best != null) source.AttackTargetId = best.Id;
            }
            return best;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class WaveCadence
    {
        public static int SwarmBatch(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return wave == 2 ? 2 : 1;
            float beat = Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time - 0.6f), 12);
            int crest = Mathf.Min(36, Mathf.CeilToInt((3 + (wave - 3) / 2) * SwarmPressure(wave)));
            return beat < 6 ? crest : beat < 8 ? Mathf.Max(2, crest / 2) : 1;
        }
        public static float SwarmPressure(int wave) => 1 + 2 * Mathf.Clamp01((wave - 3) / 9f);
        public static float SwarmInterval(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            return Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time - 0.6f), 12) < 8 ? 0.9f : 2.8f;
        }
        public static float IntervalMultiplier(int wave, float time)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            float phase = Mathf.Repeat(Mathf.Max(0, time), 12);
            return phase < 7 ? 0.88f : phase < 9 ? Mathf.Lerp(0.88f, 1.45f, (phase - 7) / 2) : Mathf.Lerp(1.45f, 0.88f, (phase - 9) / 3);
        }
        public static float Envelope(int wave, float time, float duration)
        {
            if (wave < 3) return 1;
            float progress = Mathf.Clamp01(time / Mathf.Max(1, duration));
            float envelope = progress < 0.16f ? 1.35f : progress < 0.42f ? Mathf.Lerp(1.15f, 0.95f, (progress - 0.16f) / 0.26f) : progress < 0.67f ? 0.85f : progress < 0.84f ? 1.6f : progress < 0.94f ? 1 : 1.45f;
            return envelope * 0.7f;
        }
        public static Vector2 Attract(Vector2 position, Vector2 target, float travel, int identity)
        {
            Vector2 difference = target - position;
            if (difference.magnitude <= travel * 2) return Vector2.MoveTowards(position, target, travel);
            Vector2 forward = difference.normalized;
            Vector2 tangent = new Vector2(-forward.y, forward.x) * (identity % 2 == 0 ? 0.24f : -0.24f);
            return position + (forward + tangent).normalized * travel;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Flags]
    public enum BossOrganRole { None = 0, Lash = 1, Volley = 2, Props = 4, Pool = 8, Pulse = 16, Vacuum = 32, Locomotion = 64, Tempo = 128, Rupture = 256 }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class BossOrganDefinition
    {
        public string Id;
        public string Name;
        public string BreakSummary;
        public BossOrganRole Role;
        public Vector2 Offset;
        public float Height = 0.25f;
        public float Durability = 0.18f;
        public Sprite Rest;
        public Sprite Charged;
        public Sprite Release;
        public Sprite Scar;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class BossAnatomyEntry
    {
        public string BossId;
        public BossOrganDefinition[] Organs = new BossOrganDefinition[0];
    }

    public sealed class BossAnatomy : ScriptableObject
    {
        public BossAnatomyEntry[] Bosses = new BossAnatomyEntry[0];
        private static BossAnatomy cached;
        public static BossAnatomyEntry For(UnitDefinition boss)
        {
            if (boss == null || !boss.IsBoss) return null;
            if (boss.Id == NightmareRules.CustomerId) return NightmareAssets.Current?.Anatomy;
            if (boss.Id == "OutsideStageKeeper") return OutsideStageAssets.Current == null ? null : OutsideStageAssets.Current.Anatomy;
            if (cached == null) cached = Resources.Load<BossAnatomy>("BossAnatomy");
            if (cached == null) return null;
            foreach (BossAnatomyEntry entry in cached.Bosses) if (entry.BossId == boss.Id) return entry;
            return null;
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        public static void Invalidate() => cached = null;
    }
}
````
