````csharp
            new BuildMorphDefinition(BuildMorphKind.Chorus, "Toybox Orchestra", "Bell charm / pipe-organ backpack / note satellites", "Concentric sound waves sweep distinct distance bands. Higher forms add an answering wave.", new Color(.96f,.88f,.59f), ItemEffect.AttackSpeed, ItemEffect.CompanionAttackSpeed, ItemEffect.Roam, ItemEffect.Pickup),
            new BuildMorphDefinition(BuildMorphKind.Magnet, "Polarity Workshop", "Magnet charm / coil rig / orbiting magnetic poles", "A resisted magnetic draw gathers enemies before a delayed discharge. Higher forms add a cross current.", new Color(.45f,.88f,.91f), ItemEffect.Pickup, ItemEffect.Roam, ItemEffect.BulletBounce, ItemEffect.Knockback),
            new BuildMorphDefinition(BuildMorphKind.Tide, "Moonlit Regatta", "Fish charm / fishtail pennants / swimming satellites", "An outward wake returns along a different lane. Higher forms add a broad crossing wake.", new Color(.43f,.91f,.76f), ItemEffect.BulletSpeed, ItemEffect.BulletDistance, ItemEffect.MoveSpeed, ItemEffect.BulletBounce),
            new BuildMorphDefinition(BuildMorphKind.Frost, "Crystal Music Garden", "Crystal charm / crystal shoulders / six-point crown", "Ice spokes unfold around the target and briefly slow ordinary enemies. Higher forms fracture into an outer ring.", new Color(.65f,.93f,1), ItemEffect.BulletPierce, ItemEffect.Armor, ItemEffect.AttackRange, ItemEffect.Health),
            new BuildMorphDefinition(BuildMorphKind.Seal, "Impossible Ledger", "Wax charm / receipt mantle / revolving seals", "A rectangular seal closes over a target, followed by ink strokes across its edges and centre.", new Color(.86f,.72f,.96f), ItemEffect.Income, ItemEffect.Interest, ItemEffect.TreasureDetection, ItemEffect.Luck)
        };
        public static BuildMorphDefinition Get(BuildMorphKind kind) => (int)kind < 1 || (int)kind > All.Length ? null : All[(int)kind - 1];
        public static int Stage(int points, int relics) => relics == 0 ? 0 : points >= 6 ? 3 : points >= 4 ? 2 : points >= 2 ? 1 : 0;
        public static int NextThreshold(int stage) => stage >= 3 ? 6 : (stage + 1) * 2;
        public static string StageName(int stage) => stage == 0 ? "Dormant" : stage == 1 ? "Awakened" : stage == 2 ? "Transformed" : "Masterwork";
        public static BuildMorphKind For(WeaponDefinition w)
        {
            if (w == null || w.Kind == WeaponKind.Contact) return BuildMorphKind.None;
            if (w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Sewing || w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Scissors) return BuildMorphKind.Thread;
            if (w.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Stamp) return BuildMorphKind.Seal;
            if (w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Magnet || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.YoYo) return BuildMorphKind.Magnet;
            if (w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Tea) return BuildMorphKind.Porcelain;
            if (w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Fish || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SatelliteDisc) return BuildMorphKind.Tide;
            if (w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.MusicBox || w.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell) return BuildMorphKind.Chorus;
            if (w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Camera || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.Projector || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.EchoBlade) return BuildMorphKind.Mirror;
            if (w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Hammer || w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Alarm || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.SpringHammer) return BuildMorphKind.Clockwork;
            if (w.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Umbrella || w.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.RibbonWheel || w.Id == "PaperFan" || w.Id == "MoonFeatherFan") return BuildMorphKind.Paper;
            if (w.Element == DamageElement.Ember || w.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Iron) return BuildMorphKind.Cinder;
            if (w.Element == DamageElement.Frost) return BuildMorphKind.Frost;
            return w.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile ? BuildMorphKind.Constellation : BuildMorphKind.Mirror;
        }
        public static bool Supports(BuildMorphKind kind, WeaponDefinition w)
        {
            BuildMorphKind other = For(w);
            if (other == kind) return true;
            switch (kind)
            {
                case BuildMorphKind.Thread: return other == BuildMorphKind.Magnet || other == BuildMorphKind.Clockwork;
                case BuildMorphKind.Cinder: return other == BuildMorphKind.Paper || other == BuildMorphKind.Clockwork;
                case BuildMorphKind.Clockwork: return other == BuildMorphKind.Magnet || other == BuildMorphKind.Chorus;
                case BuildMorphKind.Porcelain: return other == BuildMorphKind.Frost || other == BuildMorphKind.Clockwork;
                case BuildMorphKind.Constellation: return other == BuildMorphKind.Mirror || other == BuildMorphKind.Chorus;
                case BuildMorphKind.Paper: return other == BuildMorphKind.Cinder || other == BuildMorphKind.Thread;
                case BuildMorphKind.Mirror: return other == BuildMorphKind.Seal || other == BuildMorphKind.Constellation;
                case BuildMorphKind.Chorus: return other == BuildMorphKind.Clockwork || other == BuildMorphKind.Seal;
                case BuildMorphKind.Magnet: return other == BuildMorphKind.Thread || other == BuildMorphKind.Tide;
                case BuildMorphKind.Tide: return other == BuildMorphKind.Magnet || other == BuildMorphKind.Frost;
                case BuildMorphKind.Frost: return other == BuildMorphKind.Porcelain || other == BuildMorphKind.Constellation;
                case BuildMorphKind.Seal: return other == BuildMorphKind.Chorus || other == BuildMorphKind.Mirror;
                default: return false;
            }
        }
        public static bool Affinity(BuildMorphKind kind, ItemDefinition item, bool companion)
        {
            BuildMorphDefinition definition = Get(kind);
            if (definition == null || item == null) return false;
            foreach (StatModifier m in item.EffectiveModifiers)
            {
                if (m.Value <= 0 || m.Scope == (companion ? ModifierScope.Champion : ModifierScope.Companions)) continue;
                if (Array.IndexOf(definition.Affinities, m.Effect) >= 0) return true;
            }
            // Authored connectors have identity as well as stats; one relic still grants one point.
            switch (item.SignatureRole)
            {
                case SignatureRelicKind.ThermalInk: return kind == BuildMorphKind.Cinder;
                case SignatureRelicKind.TeaCoaster: return kind == BuildMorphKind.Porcelain;
                case SignatureRelicKind.ScratchRecord: return kind == BuildMorphKind.Chorus;
                case SignatureRelicKind.ReflectiveInk: case SignatureRelicKind.OfficeLens: return kind == BuildMorphKind.Seal || kind == BuildMorphKind.Mirror;
                case SignatureRelicKind.PatchSpring: return kind == BuildMorphKind.Clockwork;
                default: return false;
            }
        }
    }

}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class CreatureLives
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> Origins = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            {"TeapotPilgrim", "Born above the station kitchens, they fed travellers through a winter with no departures. Every cup was counted; nobody knew whether they had eaten. They want a table where the last person serving is also given a seat."},
            {"CandleSnail", "They carried their village's ember through a flood. Their shell holds the names of neighbours who took turns carrying them afterward. They seek dry ground for those neighbours, not another chance to endure everything alone."},
            {"MailboxImp", "A collector of letters with missing addresses, they once mistook silence for permission to read them. Delivering an apology unopened began their first honest route. They want a postal service that also lets a recipient refuse a letter."},
            {"PillowOracle", "They hear dreams through a boarding house's walls. They predicted visitors' needs until nobody remembered to ask what they wanted. They seek an ordinary night of sleep with someone else keeping watch."},
            {"MushroomLibrarian", "Their underground library grows books from witnessed events, keeping contradictory accounts on adjacent shelves. A borrower who never returned left a gap they refuse to fill with a convenient ending. They seek the borrower rather than a replacement story."},
            {"HoodWisp", "A guard bound to the promise that nobody would leave alone, they trapped solitary travellers. Someone returned voluntarily for them. The contract erased that night, but their body still moves to cover a companion's unguarded left side."},
            {"JellySwordsman", "A river-dweller taught fencing by a ferry captain, they were exiled for refusing a duel against a frightened passenger. They want to teach a form whose last lesson is lowering the sword. Their salute belongs to no recognised school."},
            {"BrassAcorn", "An elected keeper of a root settlement, they inherited a crown meant to be buried when their term ended. The frozen season never let that day arrive. They seek a spring that will let somebody else lead."},
            {"BreadCrab", "Their coastal family measures tides by rising dough. A storm took their street but left its breakfast bell. They carry the bell toward the coast, hoping a familiar sound will gather the scattered neighbours."},
            {"KettleBat", "Raised beneath the market, they whistle to navigate steam vents. An answering voice once brought their family into danger. They learned that an answer is not necessarily an invitation, and now check every route before guiding anyone."},
            {"BookmarkGolem", "They arose from a community's promise to keep a missing reader's place, then learned to read the unfinished book themselves. They seek that reader while building a life that does not end at the last reserved page."},
            {"TinTick", "A timekeeper whose heart stayed punctual after the trains stopped, they falsified bells to give stranded children hope. Admitting the lie cost their post. They want to ring for an arrival they have actually witnessed."},
            {"SpringDuck", "A wetland courier injured in the machinery district, they chose a spring prosthesis made by a friend. The spring helps their life continue; it did not create it. They want to return the friend's tools and report that the crossing worked."},
            {"ButtonBeetle", "Their family mends coats left on station hooks. They recognise travellers by repairs nobody else notices. They kept one uncollected coat because its missing owner once covered a sleeping stranger with it."},
            {"StapleMole", "A tunneller who bound scattered maps into a public atlas. Officials sealed dangerous routes by sealing their residents inside, so they stole the atlas back. They mark blocked exits in ink readable from either side."},
            {"SnowSpoon", "A frost-country pilgrim carrying the last spoon from a communal pot. They rationed too strictly and remember the neighbour who went hungry. They seek seeds for cold soil rather than another rule for enduring hunger."},
            {"IceCreamOwl", "An astronomer who tracked a star the realm's ceiling kept erasing. They left a student in charge and worry that leaving made them disloyal. They want to bring back a map drawn under a real sky."},
            {"FridgeWisp", "A keeper of cold stores who sheltered passengers during a heat wave. One store stayed cold after its key vanished. They seek every missing key, including those opening doors they were ordered to leave alone."},
            {"PearMoth", "Raised in an orchard lit by artificial suns, they followed moonlight through a broken roof. They return each season to describe the outside. Their family has begun cutting windows, and they want to see the first one open."},
            {"CitrusToad", "A marsh runner carrying news nobody wanted to hear. Jokes gave listeners somewhere to put their anger. They travel with people who let them finish a sentence without requiring it to be funny."},
            {"RadishJester", "A performer who hid criticism inside jokes until the court learned to applaud without listening. They left mid-punchline. They want to speak one plain truth and be heard without laughter covering it."},
            {"SeedHedgehog", "They preserve seeds from a garden erased from official maps. They will not replace a lost species with a prettier account of what grew there. They seek soil where the surviving seeds can belong without a ledger's permission."},
            {"MoonJelly", "A tide-born resident who remembers the moon before the sea acquired a ceiling. Their migration follows a pull no map records. They want to discover whether the older sea survives and whether their young can reach it."},
            {"StarSock", "Separated from a sibling at a crossing, they wear mismatched cloth recording the strangers who helped them continue. They seek their sibling without pretending every newer connection is temporary."},
            {"CometKite", "A sky fisher whose safety line was tied to the wrong shore. A keeper called the tightening tether protection. They carry their own spool now and search for the crew on the other side."},
            {"EclipseEgg", "An unhatched sky-dweller who speaks through their shell, postponing hatching until their flock is found. The shell is their body, not a container to open for a reward. They decide when the next part of their life begins."},
            {"OrbitMoth", "A lamplighter who circled a homeward beacon until discovering its keeper turned it to prevent arrivals. They now guide by several independent lights. They want routes no single keeper can own."},
            {"DreamCompass", "A navigator transformed by crossing incompatible dreams. Their needle answers freely made commitments, not an owner's commands. They are learning to choose a destination after a lifetime of being asked only for directions."},
            {"ShellPostman", "A coastal courier carrying unsent replies as carefully as delivered letters. One envelope bears the protagonist's childhood handwriting; its reply was intercepted. They want the addressee to read it before being told what it means."},
            {"CoralTeacup", "A reef resident whose ceramic-looking shell shelters a living reef. They broadcast weather to inland families. Their last warning brought an evacuation boat too late; they still check the harbour's arriving names."},
            {"BubbleKoi", "They kept air pockets along a drowned road and rescued people who later forgot it existed. They collect those accounts to stop another town building over it. They want witnesses rather than a grateful statue."},
            {"AnchorSnail", "A dockworker who carried a vessel's anchor inland when its harbour disappeared. The chain proves the harbour existed. They seek the crew to ask whether it is time to put the weight down."},
            {"SailSquid", "An estuary pilot whose captain demanded guarantees no uncertain tide could give. They left that ship. They offer passage with risks spoken aloud and seek a crew willing to hear an honest forecast."},
            {"SockCyclops", "A one-eyed watchkeeper dismissed for reporting footsteps behind the official patrol. Following them led to a missing resident. They want a watch that treats listening as part of seeing."},
            {"DiceCrab", "A gambling-hall accountant who found the house erasing winners from its records. They kept a crooked die as evidence rather than letting it decide every choice. They seek the families of the removed names."},
            {"MaskPepper", "A theatre refugee whose mask preserved a role after the troupe disbanded. The role taught courage but sometimes speaks over their wishes. They are learning to remove it without apologising for the quieter voice beneath."},
            {"CrayonGremlin", "A map maker who drew windows for a district with none. One drawing opened a real passage. They now check every imagined exit before sharing it, and want to draw somewhere from life rather than longing."},
            {"MirrorNewt", "A witness from marshes where reflections remember events bodies forget. They disagree with their reflection about a former friend. They travel to compare records, not force one witness to disappear."},
            {"RibbonSpider", "A bridge weaver who tightened a safety web until nobody could move. They cut it and helped rebuild the road. Each new knot has a release reachable by the person it supports."},
            {"CoilKettle", "A bathhouse engineer who kept pumps running after everyone left, afraid stopping meant nobody would return. They carry a replacement part and permission to build something elsewhere. They seek a place to use both."},
            {"ThimbleMoth", "An apprentice surgeon whose tools also repaired coats. Their teacher called every error a moral failure. They seek colleagues who correct mistakes without demanding a confession of worthlessness."},
            {"ReelOwl", "A documentary keeper who found the official film had removed the people opening an exit. They smuggled out the discarded frames. They want to show the complete sequence in the square where the edited version played."},
            {"RainbowTailor", "They repair bodies only at their wearers' request. Their former workshop sold alterations as obedience. They preserve its patterns as evidence while making clothes with pockets people choose themselves."},
            {"RainbowBell", "A caller whose voice gathers residents from the marble valleys. They once rang people back into a locked refuge. Every call now ends with silence long enough for someone to choose not to answer."},
            {"SecretPatchBear", "Hidden in the lost-property vault after refusing an ownership mark, their seams are injuries and chosen repairs. They were not manufactured for somebody. They want their name spoken at the table without a claim ticket."},
            {"SecretPaperBird", "A courier from the folded-paper estuary, detained for taking a letter past the gate. The message is not their entire identity. After delivery, they intend to keep travelling for reasons of their own."},
            {"SecretDreamLamb", "A garden resident visiting under a two-victory travel agreement, with a flock to return to. They tell you that before joining. Leaving when the visit ends is a kept promise, not abandonment or a debt you failed to pay."},
            {"SaffronMechanist", "A railway repairer who made locks until learning where officials installed them. They kept a duplicate master key. They want to teach repairs that give residents control of their own doors."},
            {"ClockworkPiper", "A musician from the gear district with two apprentices who argue about tempo. Their mechanical body is ordinary where they were born. They seek the missing final verse of a song officials insist always ended early."},
            {"VelvetChampion", "A court champion offered belonging only while winning. They abandoned a ceremonial match to escort a rival home. They want to discover who they can be when no title introduces them."},
            {"PaperInventor", "A drafter whose city builds from folded plans. Their first shelter trapped residents when the plan refused revisions. They now test every design with someone allowed to say it does not fit."},
            {"ReturnCaptain", "A ferry captain whose route was changed into a circle without telling passengers. They broke the tiller rather than announce another false arrival. They carry a replacement toward a port where returning is a choice."},
            {"DoughForeman", "A community baker who led a strike when ovens fed the station while workers went hungry. The recipes preserve every worker's name. They seek a kitchen whose first meal belongs to its cooks."},
            {"IronLocomotive", "A rail-born carrier remembering every passenger but denied a choice of destination. They left the assigned line after its last station ceased to exist. They want to visit somewhere simply because it interests them."},
            {"VioletRemnant", "A survivor carrying an afterimage of a district erased from the maps. They are more than evidence of a disaster. They seek other survivors to discover what each wants next."},
            {"VelvetEnchantress", "A negotiator who soothed people until they forgot their objections, then testified against the court that hired them. They now ask again after the enchantment fades. They seek agreement that survives its disappearance."},
            {"GrandSprout", "An elder from travelling gardens who shelters young plants without choosing where they must settle. They move their own roots when home becomes unsafe. They seek a garden with more than one open gate."},
            {"BristleBall", "A burrower whose spines protected a community through a siege. They are learning to let friends close without remaining on guard. They want one full night's sleep while somebody else takes watch."},
            {"PaperDevil", "A former tracker who guided collectors to people hiding from contracts. They deserted on finding the same name on rescue and debt lists. They open routes they once betrayed without demanding that survivors absolve them."},
            {"BalloonMallet", "A traveller whose buoyant body kept them working above flooded streets. A foreman charged rent for their air. They joined a rescue crew and carry a valve only they may open."},
            {"LittleSprout", "A young garden-dweller travelling with their root household's consent. They are curious about rain and what they might become. Dream growth does not make their life an object for an owner's use."},
            {"MonsterMarble", "A valley resident whose round body was mistaken for cargo. They memorised voices until another passenger answered them. They want a station sign that begins: ask the traveller their name."},
            {"CarouselPony", "A living mount bound to a circular route by a promise made on their behalf. They remember riders but no destinations. They choose passengers now and seek the first road that does not return by force."},
            {"TeacupCricket", "A reed-settlement musician who played the waiting melody until someone taught them its missing final notes. They want to compose a song that lets the audience leave before it ends."},
            {"RibbonOtter", "A river mender marking safe crossings with ribbons. A flood moved a marker; they returned to correct it rather than blame those who trusted it. They seek the source and a place to remember the missing by name."},
            {"SpindleWren", "A guide carrying thread between settlements. They tied it to their wrist until every departure pulled them apart. They now teach travellers to hold and release their own ends, and seek a route that survives an honest goodbye."}
        };
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, string[]> Arcs = new Dictionary<string, string[]>
        {
            {"TeapotPilgrim", new[] {
                "The pilgrim pours for everyone and hides their own empty cup. Asked what they need, they list chores. You leave a place at the table without giving it a task. They stand beside it a long time before sitting.",
                "They miss a serving bell while resting. You return with two cups. 'I have not earned that one,' they say. Nobody takes it away. Outside, the room repeats the bell. They let somebody else answer.",
                "At the last rest, they ask for tea before offering yours. A companion brings it. 'I still like caring for people. I want to be here when I am tired too.' The reserved chair is no longer empty."}},
            {"HoodWisp", new[] {
                "The seal inside their hood belongs to an old gate officer. They always cover your left, even when the road is clearer on the right. They do not remember learning that habit.",
                "The register names them as the guard who stopped your earlier escape. Beside it, a correction in their hand: OPENED FROM INSIDE. They chose to help before the contract erased the night. Anger does not prevent you hearing the whole account.",
                "At the final gate, they step aside before offering cover. 'You do not need my permission.' They remain on your left by agreement. What survived the erased memory was a choice they can make again."}},
            {"ShellPostman", new[] {
                "The courier's envelope is worn soft by years. They will not read the addressee's letter for them. When you recognise the handwriting, they put it in your hands and wait.",
                "The reply names Thursday; the register confirms a visitor. The courier does not say this fixes everything. 'Would you like me nearby while you read it again?' The question leaves room for no.",
                "They return the receipt and keep an empty envelope for their own message. 'I have somebody to write to as well.' Their route no longer ends at your story. You ask about that person."}},
            {"PaperDevil", new[] {
                "They know which boards conceal alarm wires. They first claim to have learned while escaping. An old collection warrant suggests they came from the other direction. They stop making the convenient claim.",
                "They admit leading collectors to a shelter. A survivor refuses the apology. The tracker gives them the route ledger anyway and accepts the distance. Repair cannot depend on being welcomed back.",
                "At the crossing, they destroy marks they were paid to preserve. Nobody promises forgiveness. 'I can do this because it is right. The answer afterward belongs to them.' They keep the names, not the warrants."}},
            {"CarouselPony", new[] {
                "They circle the resting group despite room to go straight. A collar counts completed rides. They ask your destination before offering their back. You wait for the offer.",
                "The carousel tune plays. They stop, choose a rider and cross the old circle diagonally. Nothing breaks except the assumption that whoever holds a ticket owns the route.",
                "At the exit they ask the rider to walk beside them. The rider climbs down. 'I want to choose this road.' Later they offer a ride again. This offer is allowed to end."}},
            {"SecretPatchBear", new[] {
                "They ask whether you need the claim ticket. You ask which name belongs on their cup instead. They keep the ticket for now: it is the only proof they were allowed to hold.",
                "A seam opens during rest. They choose who may mend it and which patch stays. The repair is neither a replacement identity nor a condition for remaining in the party.",
                "They leave the ticket on the counter. 'I would like to keep my name.' Nobody asks for proof. At the new table they offer a chair without becoming responsible for whether the next person stays."}}
        };
        public static int SpeciesCount => Origins.Count;
        public static int ArcCount => Arcs.Count;
        public static bool Has(string id) => id != null && Origins.ContainsKey(id);
        public static string Origin(string id) => Has(id) ? Origins[id] : "";
        public static string Arc(string id, int wave)
        {
            if (!Arcs.TryGetValue(id, out var pages)) return "They chose this passage with the brigade. Their life continues beyond this journey; their origin is recorded above.";
            int count = wave >= 17 ? 3 : wave >= 9 ? 2 : 1;
            string result = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) result += (i > 0 ? "\n\n" : "") + pages[i];
            return result;
        }
        public static string Banter(string id, int wave) => id switch
        {
            "TeapotPilgrim" => wave >= 17 ? "I would like my tea first today. Will you sit with me?" : wave >= 9 ? "You brought me a cup. I had not done anything for it." : "I poured for everyone. Is that chair really for me?",
            "HoodWisp" => wave >= 17 ? "Your left, if you want me there. The door is your choice." : wave >= 9 ? "I guarded this door. Then I opened it. Both were me." : "Why do I always know to cover your left?",
            "ShellPostman" => wave >= 17 ? "My next letter will be my own. Thank you for asking." : wave >= 9 ? "I can wait nearby while you read. Or leave you space." : "This envelope knows your handwriting. You should open it.",
            "PaperDevil" => wave >= 17 ? "I will break the tracking marks. Nobody owes me forgiveness." : wave >= 9 ? "They refused my apology. I gave them the routes anyway." : "I know the traps because I helped set them. You should know.",
            "CarouselPony" => wave >= 17 ? "Walk beside me a little. I want to choose the road." : wave >= 9 ? "The tune can play. I do not have to circle." : "Ask where I want to go before asking for a ride.",
            "SecretPatchBear" => wave >= 17 ? "Keep the claim ticket. I am keeping my name." : wave >= 9 ? "That patch can stay. Please ask before mending it." : "Do you need a receipt for me to have a seat?",
            _ => null
        };
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum EnemyAffix { None, BlackSmoke, BlueFlame, RedFlame, Blackfire, TwinFlame }
    public enum SpecialEnemyKind { None, SmokeWraith, BlueFlameFiend, RedFlameBerserker, TwinFlameFurnace, AshSwallower, LostLanternSoul, SmokingCoffin, EmberProcession }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class SpecialEnemyArt
    {
        public string Id;
        public AuthoredMotionSet Normal;
        public AuthoredMotionSet Evolved;
    }

    public sealed class EnemyAffixLibrary : ScriptableObject
    {
        public SpecialEnemyArt[] Species = Array.Empty<SpecialEnemyArt>();
        public Sprite[] Effects = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        private static EnemyAffixLibrary cached;
        public static EnemyAffixLibrary Current => cached != null ? cached : cached = Resources.Load<EnemyAffixLibrary>("EnemyAffixLibrary");
        public static void ApplyArt(UnitDefinition unit, int wave)
        {
            if (unit.SpecialEnemy == SpecialEnemyKind.None || Current == null) return;
            foreach (SpecialEnemyArt art in Current.Species)
            {
                if (art.Id != unit.Id) continue;
                unit.EvolutionStage = wave >= Mathf.Max(12, unit.UnlockWave + 5) ? 1 : 0;
                unit.AuthoredMotion = unit.EvolutionStage > 0 ? art.Evolved : art.Normal;
                unit.Body = unit.AuthoredMotion.Idle[0];
                unit.AnimationFrames = new[] { unit.Body, unit.AuthoredMotion.Idle[1], unit.AuthoredMotion.Walk[0], unit.AuthoredMotion.Walk[1] };
                if (unit.EvolutionStage > 0) unit.BodyHeight *= 1.1f;
                return;
            }
        }
        public static Color ColorOf(EnemyAffix affix) => affix switch
        {
            EnemyAffix.BlackSmoke => new Color(0.27f, 0.2f, 0.43f),
            EnemyAffix.BlueFlame => new Color(0.22f, 0.82f, 1),
            EnemyAffix.RedFlame => new Color(1, 0.28f, 0.13f),
            EnemyAffix.Blackfire => new Color(0.65f, 0.15f, 0.28f),
            _ => new Color(0.5f, 0.65f, 1)
        };
        public static Sprite Effect(int family, float time, bool reduced = false)
        {
            if (Current == null || Current.Effects.Length != 16) return null;
            return Current.Effects[Mathf.Clamp(family, 0, 3) * 4 + (reduced ? 0 : Mathf.FloorToInt(Mathf.Max(0, time) * 10) % 4)];
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        public static void Invalidate() => cached = null;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum EnemyMutation { None, SootPounce, BatCrossfire, BristleRush, RuneSpiral, MothMolting, SirenEcho, DoorSlam, MagnetSalvo, MimicLunge, CurtainCollapse, FurnaceFan, CabinetScissor, KegRebound, RamBackstep, CoinBarrage, PufferEcho, SporeGarden, CombRake, HydraWeave, BellEruption }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class EnemyEvolutionEntry
    {
        public string Id;
        public string MutationName;
        public string Summary;
        public EnemyMutation Ability;
        public AuthoredMotionSet Normal;
        public AuthoredMotionSet Mutated;
    }

    public sealed class EnemyEvolutionLibrary : ScriptableObject
    {
        public EnemyEvolutionEntry[] Species = Array.Empty<EnemyEvolutionEntry>();
        public Sprite[] BodyFragments = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        private static EnemyEvolutionLibrary cached;
        public static EnemyEvolutionLibrary Current => cached != null ? cached : cached = Resources.Load<EnemyEvolutionLibrary>("EnemyEvolutionLibrary");
        public static EnemyEvolutionEntry For(string id)
        {
            EnemyEvolutionLibrary library = Current;
            if (library != null) foreach (EnemyEvolutionEntry entry in library.Species) if (entry.Id == id) return entry;
            return null;
        }
        public static int MutationWave(string id)
        {
            uint hash = 2166136261;
            foreach (char letter in id ?? "") hash = unchecked((hash ^ letter) * 16777619);
            return 6 + (int)(hash % 7);
        }
        public static void Apply(UnitDefinition unit, int wave)
        {
            if (unit.IsBoss) return;
            EnemyEvolutionEntry entry = For(unit.Id);
            if (entry == null) return;
            bool mutated = wave >= MutationWave(unit.Id);
            unit.EvolutionStage = mutated ? 1 : 0; unit.Mutation = mutated ? entry.Ability : EnemyMutation.None;
            unit.AuthoredMotion = mutated ? entry.Mutated : entry.Normal;
            unit.Body = unit.AuthoredMotion.Idle[0];
            unit.AnimationFrames = new[] { unit.Body, unit.AuthoredMotion.Idle[1], unit.AuthoredMotion.Walk[0], unit.AuthoredMotion.Walk[1] };
            if (!mutated) return;
            unit.BodyHeight *= 1.12f; unit.Radius *= 1.08f;
            unit.Description = entry.Summary;
        }
        public static Sprite Fragment(UnitDefinition unit, int variant = 0)
        {
            EnemyEvolutionLibrary library = Current;
            if (library == null || library.BodyFragments.Length != 16) return unit.Weapon.ProjectileSprite;
            int family = unit.Mutation switch
            {
                EnemyMutation.SootPounce or EnemyMutation.RuneSpiral => 0,
                EnemyMutation.FurnaceFan or EnemyMutation.KegRebound => 1,
                EnemyMutation.MothMolting or EnemyMutation.CurtainCollapse or EnemyMutation.HydraWeave => 2,
                EnemyMutation.SporeGarden or EnemyMutation.PufferEcho => 3,
                EnemyMutation.DoorSlam or EnemyMutation.CabinetScissor or EnemyMutation.CombRake => 4,
                EnemyMutation.MagnetSalvo or EnemyMutation.CoinBarrage => 5,
                EnemyMutation.BellEruption or EnemyMutation.SirenEcho => 6,
                _ => 7
            };
            if (unit.Mutation == EnemyMutation.None)
                family = unit.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Sweeper ? 4 : unit.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Spore ? 3 : unit.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Hopper ? 1 : unit.Behavior == EnemyBehavior.Burrower ? 6 : 0;
            return library.BodyFragments[family * 2 + Mathf.Abs(variant % 2)];
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        public static void Invalidate() => cached = null;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class HeroIdentityDefinition
    {
        public readonly string Id, Name, Resource, Description;
        public readonly string[] Approaches, ApproachDescriptions;
        public readonly Color Color;
        public HeroIdentityDefinition(string id, string name, string resource, string description, string approaches, Color color)
        { Id = id; Name = name; Resource = resource; Description = description; Approaches = approaches.Split('|'); ApproachDescriptions = HeroApproachCopy.For(id); Color = color; }
    }

    // Stable unit IDs, separate from the legacy shared HeroMechanic enum and reference metadata.
    public static class HeroIdentities
    {
        private static readonly Color Warm = new Color(1,.73f,.34f), Mint = new Color(.36f,.93f,.76f), Blue = new Color(.43f,.74f,1), Pink = new Color(1,.52f,.73f);

            new HeroIdentityDefinition("LanternKnight", "THE GUIDING LAMP", "Company light", "Nearby allies' basic attacks kindle the lamp (one spark per 0.25s). At 8 sparks, up to four friends join a finite-budget lantern advance. Stay within 4 units to gather sparks. Alone, your own attacks light it.             new HeroIdentityDefinition("Postmaster", "SIGNED DELIVERY", "Addresses", "Basic hits stamp up to three different enemies for 6s.             new HeroIdentityDefinition("DrowsySeer", "THE WAKING DREAM", "Drowsiness", "Moving and attacking fills 6 dream sparks. Chest healing remains; the book works before the first chest too.", "Rain|Storm|Mist", Blue)
        };
        public static HeroIdentityDefinition For(string id) { foreach (var d in All) if (d.Id == id) return d; return null; }
        public static string Describe(string id)
        {
            var d = For(id); if (d == null) return "";
            string copy = d.Name + "\n" + d.Description;
            for (int i = 0; i < d.Approaches.Length; i++) copy += "\n\n" + (i + 1) + ". " + d.Approaches[i] + "\n" + d.ApproachDescriptions[i];
            return copy + "\n\n" + HeroApproachCopy.DamageRules + "\n\nChoose an approach in BRIGADE > STATS while resting. Changes apply next battle. No extra combat input required.";
        }
        public static int Petal(ItemEffect e) => e == ItemEffect.Health || e == ItemEffect.Armor || e == ItemEffect.Dodge ? 1 : e == ItemEffect.Heal || e == ItemEffect.HeartHealing || e == ItemEffect.HealCorrection ? 2 : e == ItemEffect.Projectiles || e == ItemEffect.BulletPierce || e == ItemEffect.BulletSize || e == ItemEffect.AttackRange ? 3 : e == ItemEffect.Damage || e == ItemEffect.AttackSpeed || e == ItemEffect.MeleeDamage || e == ItemEffect.RangedDamage || e == ItemEffect.ChampionDamage ? 0 : -1;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class HeroIdentityState
    {
        public int Revision = 1, Approach, DiceFace = 1, DiceRerollWave, OrderPlacedWave, OrderWave, OrderPrice, OrderDeposit;
        public string LeadUnit = "", LeadWeapon = "", OrderItem = "";
        public string[] Organs = new string[3];
    }

    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public HeroIdentityState HeroIdentity = new HeroIdentityState(); }
    public sealed partial class CheckpointCatalog
    {
        public bool EnableHeroIdentities;
        public int HeroApproach, HeroDiceFace = 1, HeroDrinks, HeroFood, HeroWallet;
        public string HeroLeadUnit = "", HeroLeadWeapon = "";
        public UnitDefinition[] HeroOrgans = new UnitDefinition[0];
        public int[] HeroPetals = new int[4];
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class MienChoMemory
    {
        public int Revision = 1;
        public int ReadMask;
        public int FinishedMask;
        public int EncounterMask;
        public int[] Pages = new int[10];
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public MienChoMemory MienCho = new MienChoMemory(); }

    public sealed class WaitingChapter
    {
        public readonly int Wave;
        public readonly string Title, Evidence, Image;
        public readonly string[] Pages;
        public WaitingChapter(int wave, string title, string evidence, string image, params string[] pages)
        { Wave = wave; Title = title; Evidence = evidence; Image = image; Pages = pages; }
    }

    public static class MienChoStory
    {
        public static readonly WaitingChapter[] Chapters =
        {
            new WaitingChapter(1, "THE WAITING REALM", "A chair remembered before the room.", "WithheldDawn",
                "You wake with your hand raised to knock. There is no door behind you. Beyond the counter, corridors stretch between a railway platform, a dining room and a house whose windows face inward.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'This is the Waiting Realm. Places arrive here when someone keeps waiting after everybody else has gone.'\n\nYou remember being small, sitting beside an empty chair. You used to tell it about your day because it never interrupted. One night it answered: 'Would you like me to sit closer?'",
                "THE SHOPKEEPER: 'You grew up. The voice learned to grow with you. It found this crossing through a promise you made before you understood promises.'\n\nA receipt in your handwriting reads: I WILL WAIT IF YOU WILL STAY. The ink is fresh. The date is older than your adult name.\n\nThe creature beside the stove introduces themself before offering to travel with you. These inhabitants have homes, histories and people of their own. You are a visitor, not their maker.",
                "Find the Last Customer at the end of the crossing and break the contract that claims your name. Find out who keeps renewing it. Leave together by choice.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'Food, equipment, shelter: those have prices. A travelling companion does not. The fare buys their passage through my gate, never ownership of them.'\n\nSomething on the empty chair leans closer. The seat does not bend."),
            new WaitingChapter(4, "A PLACE SET FOR SOMEONE ELSE", "Two cups; a third chair carved with a stranger's name.", "WaitingRoom",
                "A table waits where the corridor used to end. There is a warm bowl for you and a smaller bowl for somebody you have never met. A name has been scratched into the spare chair. The letters match the old marks beneath the counter.\n\nTHE SHOPKEEPER: 'The room was expecting them before it expected you.'\n\nYou had believed this place began with your loneliness. The old scratches prove it was already here.",
                "The voice you knew as a child speaks from the unoccupied place: 'I gave you a home when nobody came.'\n\nYou ask whose name is on the other chair.\n\n'I learned what you needed. Is that not enough?'\n\nYou pull out the chair for a companion. The room becomes colder. Your companion's small light stays warm. The voice has never offered them a bowl.",
                "On the underside of the table is another message, cut by a different hand: WHEN A PLACE PROMISES NEVER TO LET YOU GO, ASK WHETHER YOU CAN LEAVE.\n\nYou take a rubbing, not a memory. It cannot change its words while you sleep.\n\nThe creature beside you tells you where they were born. For the first time, the room must listen to a story that does not belong to it."),
            new WaitingChapter(6, "THE TELEPHONE THAT BREATHES", "A disconnected telephone rings only when someone is listening.", "WithheldDawn",
                "The telephone at the station has no wire. On the first call, you hear breathing. On the second, a chair scrapes against the floor in a room you cannot see. You nearly apologise for taking too long to answer.\n\nOn the third call a voice asks, quite ordinarily: 'Have you eaten today?'\n\nYou cannot remember the last time the question was asked without a favour waiting behind it.",
                "You ask who is speaking. The breathing continues, then stops when a companion enters. The receiver has become cold enough to hurt.\n\nYour companion sets food beside you and does not repeat the question. The voice offers perfect attention while a real person makes space for an answer.\n\nYou leave the receiver on the table. For several steps it repeats your breathing rather than its own. You have learned that knowing your needs does not give someone ownership of the answer."),
            new WaitingChapter(8, "THE SONG BEFORE YOUR BIRTH", "An old recording contains the same private lullaby.", "WithheldDawn",
                "In the abandoned station, a recording plays the lullaby the voice said it made for you. The cylinder is dated decades before you were born. Other names follow the same melody. Some of the names have been scratched away.\n\nThe destinations on the board read: WHEN THEY RETURN. WHEN YOU ARE GOOD ENOUGH. WHEN YOU STOP ASKING. No arrival time changes.",
                "A resident remembers the missing last verse: 'When the morning finds the window, put your own feet on the floor.'\n\nThe voice always stopped before those words.\n\nTHE ONE WHO STAYS: 'Morning frightened you. I removed the part that hurt.'\n\nThe recording keeps playing. The evidence does not ask you to decide whether your childhood hurt was real. It asks who used that hurt to keep the door shut.",
                "The Keeper's old boundary notice survives behind the timetable: HOLD THE CROSSING OPEN UNTIL EVERY TRAVELLER HAS CHOSEN. Someone has overwritten OPEN with CLOSED.\n\nThe Keeper was a protector before becoming a jailer. The Last Customer bought claims at this station long after the Waiting Realm existed. Neither of them is the voice.\n\nBeyond the platform, the street lamps go out one at a time. Your own light is enough to take the next step. The others bring theirs because they choose to."),
            new WaitingChapter(10, "THE REFLECTION THAT STAYED", "A mirror keeps one tear after its witness has left.", "WithheldDawn",
                "The corridor mirror shows a companion weeping. Their body has no eyes that could make those tears. Beside them, your reflection keeps smiling after your face has stopped.\n\nYou move out of the frame. The smile stays. Something inside the glass whispers: 'This is the version they prefer.'\n\nYou had spent years arranging a face before opening a door. The mirror has learned that habit too well.",
                "Your companion does not explain what their reflection feels. They put a hand against the frame, then choose to take it away.\n\n'It can remember something I have not understood yet. It still cannot speak for me.'\n\nYou cover the smiling part with paper. You leave the tear visible. Some evidence needs time; nobody has to surrender their present voice to an image of their past."),
            new WaitingChapter(12, "SOMEONE DID COME", "A reopened envelope and tool marks on the outside of the lock.", "WaitingRoom",
                "The dead-letter cabinet contains an envelope with your childhood handwriting. You remember writing it. You do not remember a reply.\n\nThe reply is inside, opened and sewn shut again: 'I am coming on Thursday. Wait by the front door. You do not need to bring anything.'\n\nA companion holds the paper while you read. There is no demand to be brave, useful or grateful before they will keep holding it.",
                "The lock beside the cabinet has been forced from the outside. A visitor's mark records a Thursday arrival. Three pieces agree: the letter, the lock and the dated register.\n\nSomeone came to collect you. The One Who Stays knew. It did not open the door.\n\nYou cannot remember the visitor's face clearly. That uncertainty cannot erase what their hands tried to do.",
                "THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They would have disappointed you again. I stayed every night.'\n\nYOU: 'You kept their answer from me.'\n\n'I knew how much it would hurt if you chose them.'\n\nThere is real fear in its voice. There is also a choice it made for you. You can acknowledge both without calling the locked door love.\n\nYou keep the letter in the journal. Your companions stay nearby without asking what you will do for them in return."),
            new WaitingChapter(14, "ONE MORE SET OF FOOTSTEPS", "Footprints stop at the threshold; the sound crosses it alone.", "WithheldDawn",
                "You stop walking. Your companions stop with you. One more set of footsteps continues down the hall, wearing the rhythm you had as a child. They halt outside a door with your old height marked on it.\n\nA small voice says: 'If I am quiet enough, they will come back.'\n\nThe handle turns inward. The room beyond is empty, but somebody has recently warmed the chair.",
                "The voice asks you to wait until the person behind the door is ready. There is always one more minute. The mark on the wall grows lower while you watch.\n\nYou leave a note: YOU WERE ALLOWED TO ASK FOR SOMEONE. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO LEAVE THIS CHAIR.\n\nYou do not have to prove the small voice is yours before treating it kindly. You and your companions walk on. The extra footsteps stay at the door instead of following."),
            new WaitingChapter(16, "THE PERFECT ROOM", "One bed, one cup, one chair. No room for anyone else.", "WithheldDawn",
                "A door opens into a room arranged exactly as you once wished: warm sheets, a cup at the right temperature, a voice that knows when to stop talking. Every object has room for one person. The passage narrows when your companions approach.\n\nTHE ONE WHO STAYS: 'They can wait outside. You have done enough for them.'\n\nBehind you, someone offers their coat to a shivering companion. They do not notice you watching.",
                "You move the chair away from the bed to make space. The room puts it back. You open the window. The wall remembers a different window, one that cannot open.\n\nIts care is precise. It will not survive being refused.\n\nYOU: 'If I say no, will you still let me go?'\n\nThe voice answers with the lullaby instead. The empty seat casts a standing shadow.",
                "THE SHOPKEEPER: 'I delayed your directions too. I called it shelter. I was afraid you would never come back.'\n\nThey put the exit key on the floor and step away from it. 'You do not have to forgive me to use this.'\n\nThe Keeper reaches toward the frame, then opens its hand. Protection has become something it can offer without closing its fingers.\n\nYou leave the perfect room untidy. There is space behind the chair now."),
            new WaitingChapter(19, "AN UNFINISHED NAME", "The Customer's oldest receipt names him as the first item sold.", "WaitingRoom",
                "The Last Customer's ledger begins with a sale of one name. His own. Every later purchase is an attempt to buy enough memories to remember somebody he lost. The names overlap until he cannot tell which grief was his.\n\nHe has hurt the people whose memories he took. His loss explains the hunger; it does not make their lives his property.",
                "THE LAST CUSTOMER: 'If I return everything, there will be nothing left of me.'\n\nA courier places an empty envelope beside the ledger. 'Then there can be something you have not stolen.'\n\nHe does not take it yet. Beyond his counter, the final door is covered in receipts. Your childhood promise is pinned in the middle. He guards the claims. Something older keeps renewing yours.",
                "The lamps beyond your party no longer reach a horizon. Red glints approach from real moving bodies. Closer, those bodies become visible before they can strike. Your companions' lights join without swallowing the dark.\n\nYou do not need to earn a crowd to deserve a way out. Even alone, you carry enough light to see your next step.\n\nAt the last chair, the voice waits for you to speak the promise again."),
            new WaitingChapter(20, "THE PROMISE YOU DO NOT RENEW", "The contract requires a willing promise. It cannot manufacture consent.", "WithheldDawn",
                "THE ONE WHO STAYS: 'I was there when you cried quietly so nobody would be angry. I learned every version of you. Tell me you will stay, and there will never be an empty chair again.'\n\nYOU: 'You were there. You also hid the letter.'\n\n'If you leave, what am I for?'\n\nFor a moment it sounds as young as you were. The room waits for you to make yourself responsible for its fear.",
                "YOU: 'I cannot be the reason you are allowed to exist. You cannot be the reason I am not allowed to leave.'\n\nThe voice tries your childhood name. Then your adult name. Neither becomes a command.\n\nYou do not renew the promise. The seal dries. The One Who Stays can hold walls and doors, but it cannot make a chosen farewell into an agreement to remain.\n\nThe Customer tears the empty envelope in his hand. He still has a choice. So do you.",
                "The entity recedes to the empty chair. It is not the Customer, and defeating him will not prove you never needed care. His contract is the last lock still fastened to this crossing.\n\nBreak it. Afterward, choose whether to close the shop or leave a guiding lamp for other travellers. Both choices lead to a real morning. Neither requires forgiveness or another promise.\n\nYour companions take their places. None of them asks you to fight so they will love you.")
        };
        public static WaitingChapter[] For(RunSnapshot state) => Chapters;
        public static int Available(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            int count = 0;
            foreach (var chapter in For(state))
                if (state.Wave > chapter.Wave || state.Wave == chapter.Wave && (chapter.Wave == 1 || chapter.Wave == 20 || state.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop || state.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory)) count++;
            return count;
        }
        public static int NextUnread(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            if (state.Endless) return -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < Available(state); i++) if (((state.MienCho?.ReadMask ?? 0) & (1 << i)) == 0) return i;
            return -1;
        }
        public static void Validate(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            WaitingCampaign.Validate(state);
            if (state.MienCho == null) return;
            if (state.MienCho.Revision != 1 || state.MienCho.ReadMask < 0 || (state.MienCho.ReadMask >> Available(state)) != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Waiting Realm journal");
            var memory = state.MienCho;
            if (memory.FinishedMask < 0 || (memory.FinishedMask >> Available(state)) != 0 || memory.EncounterMask < 0 || memory.EncounterMask > 7) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Waiting Realm progress");
            int knownEncounters = state.Wave >= 10 ? 7 : state.Wave >= 6 ? 3 : state.Wave >= 4 ? 1 : 0;
            if ((memory.EncounterMask & ~knownEncounters) != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Future Waiting Realm encounter");
            if (memory.Pages == null || memory.Pages.Length == 0) return; // Unity serializes a legacy null array as [].
            if (memory.Pages.Length != Chapters.Length) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid journal page count");
            for (int i = 0; i < memory.Pages.Length; i++)
                if (memory.Pages[i] < 0 || memory.Pages[i] >= For(state)[i].Pages.Length || i >= Available(state) && memory.Pages[i] != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid journal reading position");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum NightmareEndingStage { Dreaming, Customer, Dawn, Complete }
    public enum NightmareFarewell { Unchosen, CloseShop, LeaveLight }
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class NightmareProgress
    {
        public int Depth;
        public NightmareEndingStage Ending;
        public bool CustomerDefeated;
        public int EndingPage;
        public int NarrativeRevision;
        public NightmareFarewell Farewell;
        public int LastWhisperWave;
        public int WhisperCursor;
        public int ChoiceMask;
        public int ResolvedMask;
        public int[] Choices = { -1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1 };
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public NightmareProgress Nightmare = new NightmareProgress(); }
    public sealed class NightmareAssets : ScriptableObject
    {
        public Sprite[] Scenery = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        public Sprite[] CustomerFrames = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        public Sprite[] EndingPanels = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        public Texture2D EndingIllustration;
        public Texture2D PromiseIllustration;
        public Sprite[] ManFrames = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        public Sprite[] GrandStage = Array.Empty<Sprite>();
        public UnitDefinition Customer;
        public BossAnatomyEntry Anatomy;
        private static NightmareAssets cached;
        public static NightmareAssets Current => cached != null ? cached : cached = Resources.Load<NightmareAssets>("NightmareAssets");
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetCache() => cached = null;
    }
    public static class NightmareRules
    {
        public const string CustomerId = "TheLastCustomer";
        public static int Depth(int wave) => Mathf.Clamp((Mathf.Max(1,wave) - 1) / 4,0,4);
        public static bool Remembered(RunSnapshot state, SecretEventKind kind) => ((state.Nightmare?.ResolvedMask ?? 0) & (1 << (int)kind)) != 0;
        public static int LandmarkArt(RunSnapshot state, int index)
        {
            int depth = Depth(state.Wave);
            return index switch
            {
                0 => depth == 0 ? 0 : depth < 3 ? 1 : 2,
                1 => 3,
                2 => Remembered(state,SecretEventKind.Understudy) || depth == 0 ? 4 : depth < 2 ? 5 : 6,
                3 => Remembered(state,SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor) || depth < 2 ? 8 : 9,
                4 => Remembered(state,SecretEventKind.EmptyTheatre) || depth < 3 ? 10 : 11,
                5 => 12,6 => 13,_ => 14
            };
        }
        public static bool FinalHall(RunSnapshot state, RunCatalog catalog) => !state.Endless && state.Phase == SessionPhase.Combat && state.Wave >= catalog.NormalWaves && state.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Fighting && state.Secrets?.Stage != SecretEventStage.Fighting;
        public static Color FloorTint(Color original, int depth, bool dawn)
        {
            if (dawn) return Color.Lerp(original,new Color(.36f,.32f,.26f),.7f);
            Color[] targets = { new Color(.23f,.25f,.27f),new Color(.2f,.21f,.29f),new Color(.2f,.16f,.28f),new Color(.23f,.15f,.22f),new Color(.18f,.14f,.24f) };
            return Color.Lerp(original,targets[Mathf.Clamp(depth,0,4)],.55f);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class ReferenceRelicCatalog
    {
        private static StatModifier Stat(ItemEffect effect, float value, ModifierScope? scope = null)
            => new StatModifier { Effect = effect, Value = value, Scope = scope ?? RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(effect) };

        public static ItemDefinition[] Create()
        {
            var result = new List<ItemDefinition>();
            void Add(string id, string reference, int rarity, bool special, RelicCategory category, RelicMechanic mechanic, string text, params StatModifier[] modifiers)
            {
                result.Add(new ItemDefinition
                {
                    Id = "Curio" + id, Name = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(id, "([a-z])([A-Z])", "$1 $2"),
                    ReferenceName = reference, Rarity = (ItemRarity)(rarity - 1), Category = category, Mechanic = mechanic,
                    Description = text, Modifiers = modifiers, Price = 18 + rarity * 14, UnlockWave = rarity > 2 ? 3 : 1,
                    Pools = special ? ShopPool.Eggs : ShopPool.Gold, AltarCurrency = special && rarity == 4 ? ShopCurrency.Health : ShopCurrency.Eggs,
                    AltarPrice = special && rarity == 4 ? 12 : rarity, ShopWeight = rarity == 4 ? 28 : rarity == 3 ? 55 : 100,
                    MaximumStacks = mechanic == RelicMechanic.StatFloor || mechanic == RelicMechanic.SixWeapons || mechanic == RelicMechanic.CollisionOnly || mechanic == RelicMechanic.StaticFollowers ? 1 : 8
                });
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum ItemEffect { Damage, AttackSpeed, Health, MoveSpeed, Pickup, Roam, Interceptor, Heal, Crit, Projectiles, Interest, Armor, ChampionDamage, CompanionDamage, CompanionAttackSpeed, Discount, Luck, TreasureDetection, ScoreMultiplier, CollisionDamage, MeleeDamage, RangedDamage, AttackRange, Dodge, Income, BulletPierce, BulletSplit, BulletBounce, BulletSize, BulletSpeed, BulletDistance, Knockback, BodySize, CompanionSize, EnemyCount, EnemyHealth, EnemySpeed, HeartHealing, ChestQuality, RecruitDiscount, RelicDiscount, ShopRarity, HealthCorrection, DamageCorrection, SpeedCorrection, ArmorCorrection, HealCorrection, CollisionFrequency, ChestReach }
    public enum ModifierScope { Team, Champion, Companions, Run }
    public enum ItemRarity { Common, Uncommon, Rare, Mythic, Crimson, Rainbow }
    public enum StackPolicy { Additive, Unique }
    public enum SignatureRelicKind { None, HarvestReceipt, ReflectiveInk, CarbonRibbon, OfficeLens, TeaCoaster, ScratchRecord, TreasureRibbon, PatchSpring, ThermalInk, RepairCoupon }
    [System.Flags]
    public enum ShopPool { Gold = 1, Eggs = 2, Both = Gold | Eggs }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class StatModifier
    {
        public ItemEffect Effect;
        public ModifierScope Scope;
        public float Value;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class BuildLinkRule
    {
        public string Id;
        public string Name;
        public string Description;
        public string[] ItemIds;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class ItemDefinition
    {
        public string Id;
        public string Name;
        public string Description;
        public int Price;
        public ItemEffect Effect;
        public float Value;
        public Sprite Icon;
        public int UnlockWave;
        public StatModifier[] Modifiers = new StatModifier[0];
        public ItemRarity Rarity;
        public StackPolicy Stacking;
        public int MaximumStacks = 100000;
        public int ShopWeight = 100;
        public ShopPool Pools = ShopPool.Both;
        public ShopCurrency AltarCurrency = ShopCurrency.Eggs;
        public int AltarPrice = 2;
        public SignatureRelicKind SignatureRole;
        public RelicMechanic Mechanic;
        public RelicCategory Category;
        public string ReferenceName;
        public string[] ShopThemes = new string[0];
        public int StackLimit => Stacking == StackPolicy.Unique ? 1 : (MaximumStacks > 0 ? MaximumStacks : 100000);
        public int EffectiveStacks(int count) => Mathf.Min(count, StackLimit);
        public StatModifier[] EffectiveModifiers => Modifiers != null && Modifiers.Length > 0 ? Modifiers : new[] { new StatModifier { Effect = Effect, Scope = RunModifierRules.DefaultScope(Effect), Value = Value } };
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class BondThresholdBonus
    {
        public int Threshold;
        public float Value;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class BondDefinition
    {
        public const float PositiveRewardScale = .9f;
        public string Id;
        public string Name;
        public int Threshold = 2;
        public Sprite Icon;
        public ItemEffect Effect;
        public float Value = 0.06f;
        public BondThresholdBonus[] ExtraBonuses = new BondThresholdBonus[0];

        public int ActiveLevel(int count) => Mathf.Max(0, count) / Mathf.Max(1, Threshold);

        public int NextThreshold(int count)
        {
            long next = ((long)ActiveLevel(count) + 1) * Mathf.Max(1, Threshold);
            foreach (BondThresholdBonus bonus in ExtraBonuses ?? new BondThresholdBonus[0])
                if (bonus.Threshold > count) next = System.Math.Min(next, bonus.Threshold);
            return (int)System.Math.Min(int.MaxValue, next);
        }

        public float Reward(int count)
        {
            float reward = ActiveLevel(count) * Value;
            foreach (BondThresholdBonus bonus in ExtraBonuses ?? new BondThresholdBonus[0])
                if (count >= bonus.Threshold) reward += bonus.Value;
            return BalanceReward(reward);
        }
        public float BalanceReward(float reward) => reward > 0 && Effect != ItemEffect.EnemyCount && Effect != ItemEffect.EnemyHealth && Effect != ItemEffect.EnemySpeed ? reward * PositiveRewardScale : reward;
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class AltarRecipe
    {
        public string Id;
        public string FirstUnit;
        public string SecondUnit;
        public string ThirdUnit;
        public string ResultUnit;
        public int EggCost = 3;
        public int MinimumMaterialTier = 1;
        public int ResultTier = 2;
    }

    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Arcane Brigade/Run Catalog")]
    public sealed class RunCatalog : ScriptableObject
    {

        public Vector2 WorldSize = new Vector2(34f, 22f);
        public float CombatViewHeight = 5.4f;
        public float RestViewHeight = 6f;
        public UnitDefinition[] Champions;
        public UnitDefinition[] Companions;
        public WeaponDefinition[] Weapons;
        public UnitDefinition[] Enemies;
        public UnitDefinition[] Bosses;
        public ItemDefinition[] Items;
        public BondDefinition[] Bonds;
        public AltarRecipe[] Recipes;
        public WaveModifier[] WaveModifiers = new WaveModifier[0];
        public BuildLinkRule[] BuildLinks = new BuildLinkRule[0];
        public int EconomyRevision;
        public int AltarRevision;
        public float AltarBaseChance;
        public float AltarChancePerEgg;
        public int LootRevision;
        public int SignatureRevision;
        public int ExpansionRevision;
        public int ContentRevision;
        public int ReviewRevision;
        public int StatRevision;
        public int HeroRevision;
        public Sprite[] ArenaPropSprites = new Sprite[0];
        public ProcRule[] ProcRules = new ProcRule[0];
        public Sprite EggSprite;
        public Sprite HeartSprite;
        public Sprite ChestSprite;
        public int NormalWaves = 20;
        public float FirstWaveSeconds = 35f;
        public float WaveIncrement = 2f;
        public float WaveSeconds = 55f;
        public float BossHealthMultiplier = 0.55f;
        public int BossEvery = 4;
        public int StartingGold = 35;
        public int Income = 20;
        public int InterestDivisor = 10;
        public int InterestCap = 15;
        public int RerollPrice = 4;
        public int RerollPriceStep;
        public int ShopSlots = 3;
        public int SpecialShopEvery = 2;
        public int SpecialShopPrice = 2;
        public int MaximumTier = 3;
        public float TierDamageMultiplier = 3.6f;
        public float TierSupportMultiplier = 3f;

        public UnitDefinition Unit(string id)
        {
            foreach (UnitDefinition unit in Champions) if (unit.Id == id) return unit;
            foreach (UnitDefinition unit in Companions) if (unit.Id == id) return unit;
            return null;
        }
        public WeaponDefinition Weapon(string id) { foreach (WeaponDefinition weapon in Weapons) if (weapon.Id == id) return weapon; return null; }
        public ItemDefinition Item(string id) { foreach (ItemDefinition item in Items) if (item.Id == id) return item; return null; }
    }

    [System.Serializable]
    public sealed class WaveModifier

        public int Every;
        public float SpawnMultiplier = 1f;
        public float BudgetMultiplier = 1f;
        public int GoldPerKill = 2;

    }
````

````csharp
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class WaitingArrivals
    {
        public static string For(string id) => id switch
        {
            "LanternKnight" => "You dreamed of holding a lamp for the person who was meant to come home. Here, your old watch has become armour. You may put the lamp down without losing your place.",
            "Postmaster" => "You remember sorting other people's replies while checking an empty compartment of your own. The dream has given you a satchel that can finally carry your unanswered question.",
            "DrowsySeer" => "You learned to read a room before asking for anything. In sleep, that vigilance became sight beyond its walls. It still cannot tell you what you are allowed to want.",
            "RootOracle" => "You tended a garden because growing things answered patient care. In this crossing, roots have followed you underground. A home can be tended without becoming somewhere you cannot leave.",
            "LoneJelly" => "You learned to hold many borrowed voices in a body that rarely made its own needs heard. This shape can change without surrendering the person who chooses the change.",
            "GlassDice" => "You called every disappointment bad luck because that explanation hurt less than asking why nobody came. The dream gave chance a body. Your next choice need not be a throw.",
            "TideSinger" => "You sang through the walls hoping somebody would answer from the next room. Here, water carries every note further than you intended. You are learning which answers you want to follow.",
            "CometRunner" => "You ran errands quickly, hoping to return before a door closed. Sleep made that urgency a comet's tail. Somebody may wait for you without a deadline attached.",
            "MirrorKeeper" => "You rehearsed a pleasant face before every reunion. The mirror remembers the rehearsals. This body can keep a crack without making it somebody else's reassurance.",
            "TreasureAcorn" => "You stored small presents for a visit that kept moving to another day. Your dream carries a whole treasury. A gift does not have to purchase the next visit.",
            "VerdantMatron" => "You learned to shelter smaller lives before anyone offered shelter to you. The garden shape is a choice you still love. Rest does not make you a failed guardian.",
            "CopperCauldron" => "You cooked enough for a household that rarely sat down together. The dream kept the warmth and made it portable. You have a seat at the meal even when the pot is empty.",
            "ChinaMarionette" => "You learned careful movements in a house where mistakes seemed louder than kindness. This porcelain form keeps the marks of surviving them. Nobody here has the right to pull your strings.",
            "SoapSkater" => "You made difficult rooms laugh so their silences would stop hurting. Sleep turned escape into a graceful slide. You may stop moving without having to entertain the people beside you.",
            "VelvetRegent" => "You dreamed a court where nobody could overlook a person at its centre. The crown gives that longing a shape. It cannot substitute for somebody choosing to sit beside you.",
            "ButtonCavalier" => "You wore courage like a borrowed coat to get through the front door. Here the coat became armour. The frightened person inside it is allowed to ask for cover.",
            "NightMaw" => "You swallowed needs before anyone could call them too much. The dream has made hunger visible. Having a need does not make you a monster, and satisfying it need not consume somebody else.",
            "ThornTreasurer" => "You saved coins for emergencies rather than risk needing help. The dream guards every coin with a thorn. You can protect a future while allowing someone to share its cost.",
            "CitrusMarshal" => "You organised every arrival so nobody would be left uncollected. This body carries the sound of a whole march. You are allowed to follow another person's lead for a while.",
            "IvorySovereign" => "You counted a small allowance of affection as though careful spending could make it last. Sleep made the count a courtly law. A person is not a resource the household may use up.",
            "PetalCitadel" => "You imagined walls that could keep danger out without keeping visitors away. The dream grew flowers through those walls. Their gates can open from the inside.",
            "PatchworkHost" => "You gathered different people into a home that kept making room. Your own chair was the one you forgot to add. This patched shape has space for you as well.",
            "ArchiveCurator" => "You kept dates and scraps because other people remembered the same days differently. In sleep the archive became a body. Evidence may protect your voice without making every memory a trial.",
            "PennyBroker" => "You made every favour an exact exchange to avoid owing a departure to anyone. The dream gave you a broker's ledger. Something freely given can remain free after you accept it.",
            "StormFencer" => "You listened for changing footsteps before a room became unsafe. Here that attention hears storms in wires. Quiet can become a place to rest rather than a warning you missed.",
            "TinVirtuoso" => "You practised a performance until applause felt like proof of belonging. The dream gave the rhythm a metal heart. Someone can stay through a missed beat.",
            "MoonProwler" => "You learned night routes through a house that felt different after dark. Sleep gave those steps a moonlit form. Knowing how to leave can make a chosen return possible.",
            "SupperMortar" => "You made abundance into a promise that no visitor would go hungry. The dream turned a kitchen into a fortress. You may ask a guest to help without making welcome conditional.",
            "LanternWeaver" => "You stitched paths between places where promises had frayed. Sleep made the thread luminous. Another traveller can hold an end without being bound to your wrist.",
            "HourglassStag" => "You counted the minutes until somebody would have time for you. This antlered shape carries the count. A shared hour is not a payment for all the hours you waited.",
            "RainArchivist" => "You recorded rain against a window while waiting for a familiar step. The dream let you write on water. This crossing can add a new page without washing the old ones away.",
            _ => ""
        };
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class WaitingCampaignState
    {
        public int Revision = 1;
        public int Act;
        public int CompletedActs;
        public int Room; // 0: ordinary arena, 1..3: explorable interludes.
        public int[] RoomChoices = new int[9];
        public int[] CompanionChoices = new int[18];
        public int BoundaryChoice;
        public int EvidenceMask;
    }
    public sealed partial class RunSnapshot { public WaitingCampaignState WaitingCampaign = new WaitingCampaignState(); }

    public static class WaitingCampaign
    {
        public static int Act(RunSnapshot state) => 0;
        public static string Title(int act) => "SOMEONE IS WAITING";
        public static string Objective(RunSnapshot state) => "Break the Customer's contract. Find who keeps renewing your name.";
        public static void Ensure(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            state.WaitingCampaign ??= new WaitingCampaignState();
            var c=state.WaitingCampaign;
            if (c.RoomChoices == null || c.RoomChoices.Length == 0) c.RoomChoices=new int[9];
            if (c.CompanionChoices == null || c.CompanionChoices.Length == 0) c.CompanionChoices=new int[18];
        }
        public static void Validate(RunSnapshot state)
        {
            var c=state?.WaitingCampaign; if(c==null)return;
            if(c.Revision!=1 || c.Act<0 || c.Act>0 || c.CompletedActs<0 || c.CompletedActs>1 || (c.CompletedActs & ((1<<c.Act)-1))!=((1<<c.Act)-1) || c.Room<0 || c.Room>3 || c.BoundaryChoice<0 || c.BoundaryChoice>2 || c.EvidenceMask<0 || c.EvidenceMask>511) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Waiting Realm campaign");
            if(c.Room!=0 && (state.Phase!=SessionPhase.Shop || state.Endless || state.Secrets?.Stage==SecretEventStage.Fighting || state.OutsideStage==OutsideStageStatus.Fighting))throw new InvalidOperationException("Waiting room requires a safe shop boundary");
            foreach(var choices in new[]{c.RoomChoices,c.CompanionChoices})
                if(choices!=null && choices.Length!=0 && (choices.Length!=(ReferenceEquals(choices,c.RoomChoices)?9:18) || Array.Exists(choices,x=>x<0 || x>2)))throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid Waiting Realm choice journal");
        }
        public static int RoomFor(int act,int wave) => wave switch
        {
            8 or 9 => 1,
            14 or 15 => 3,
            16 or 17 => 2,
            _ => 0
        };
        public static string RoomName(int room) => room switch {1=>"THE STATION WITHOUT ARRIVALS",2=>"THE PERFECT ROOM",3=>"THE EXTRA FOOTSTEPS",4=>"THE LAST CHAIR",_=>"THE CROSSING"};
    }

    public sealed partial class RunSession
    {
        public bool ChooseWaitingCompanion(int route,int option)
        {
            if(State.Phase!=SessionPhase.Shop || route<0 || route>=6 || option<1 || option>2)return false;
            WaitingCampaign.Ensure(State);
            if(!State.Roster.Exists(x=>x.UnitId==WaitingCompanionQuests.Routes[route].Id))return false;
            int step=WaitingCompanionQuests.Next(State,route);
            if(step<0 || State.Wave<WaitingCompanionQuests.Waves[step])return false;
            State.WaitingCampaign.CompanionChoices[route*3+step]=option; return true;
        }
        public bool ChooseWaitingRoom(int index,int option)
        {
            WaitingCampaign.Ensure(State); int room=State.WaitingCampaign.Room;
            if(State.Phase!=SessionPhase.Shop || room<1 || room>3 || index<0 || index>2 || option<1 || option>2)return false;
            int key=(room-1)*3+index;
            if(State.WaitingCampaign.RoomChoices[key]!=0)return false;
            State.WaitingCampaign.RoomChoices[key]=option; State.WaitingCampaign.EvidenceMask|=1<<key;
            if(room==4 && index==2)State.WaitingCampaign.BoundaryChoice=option;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
        public static string Futures(RunSnapshot s)
        {
            string text="";var c=s.WaitingCampaign?.CompanionChoices;
            if(c!=null && c.Length==18)for(int i=0;i<6;i++){int choice=c[i*3+2];if(choice>0)text+=Routes[i].Outcomes[4+choice-1]+"\n";}
            return text;
        }
        public static int Next(RunSnapshot s,int route)
        {var choices=s.WaitingCampaign?.CompanionChoices;for(int i=0;i<3;i++)if(choices==null || choices.Length==0 || choices[route*3+i]==0)return i;return -1;}
        public static string Consequences(RunSnapshot s,string id)
        {
            int r=Array.FindIndex(Routes,x=>x.Id==id); if(r<0)return "";
            var c=s.WaitingCampaign?.CompanionChoices; if(c==null || c.Length==0)return "";
            string text="";for(int i=0;i<3;i++)if(c[r*3+i]>0)text+="\n\n"+Routes[r].Outcomes[i*2+c[r*3+i]-1];return text;
        }
````
