````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class PlayerProfile
    {
        public const int CurrentVersion = 3;
        public int Version = CurrentVersion;
        public int BestWave;
        public int Wins;
        public int TotalKills;
        public int Cosmetic;
        public List<AchievementMetric> AchievementEvidence = new List<AchievementMetric>();
        public float Volume = 0.7f;
        public bool ReducedMotion;
        public float MusicVolume = 0.8f;
        public float SfxVolume = 0.85f;
        public bool ReducedAudio;
        public bool ShowDamageNumbers = true;
        public bool ShowLootIndicators = true;
        public bool HighReadability;
        public bool ReducedShake;
        public bool ReducedFlashes;
        public bool ReducedEffects;
        public bool TutorialSeen;
        public bool NightmareLampPromise;
        public bool NightmareShopClosed;
        public List<string> CompletedRuns = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenUnits = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenItems = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenWeapons = new List<string>();
        public List<string> Achievements = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenTiers = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenChains = new List<string>();
        public List<string> SeenBosses = new List<string>();
        public List<RunRecord> History = new List<RunRecord>();
        public List<ScoreRecord> Records = new List<ScoreRecord>();
    }

    [Serializable]
    internal sealed class SaveEnvelope { public string Payload; public string Hash; }

    public sealed class RunStorage
    {
        private readonly string directory;
        public string LastError { get; private set; } = "";
        public RunStorage(string root) { directory = root; }
        public void SaveRun(RunSnapshot run) => Write("run.json", JsonUtility.ToJson(run, true));
        public void SaveProfile(PlayerProfile profile) => Write("profile.json", JsonUtility.ToJson(profile, true));

        public RunSnapshot LoadRun(RunSession session)
        {
            foreach (string suffix in new[] { "", ".bak" })
            {
                try
                {
                    string payload = Read("run.json" + suffix);
                    if (payload == null) continue;
                    RunSnapshot run = JsonUtility.FromJson<RunSnapshot>(payload);
                    session.Validate(run);
                    return run;
                }
                catch (Exception exception) { LastError = "Run save rejected: " + exception.Message; }
            }
            return null;
        }

        public PlayerProfile LoadProfile()
        {
            foreach (string suffix in new[] { "", ".bak" })
            {
                try
                {
                    string payload = Read("profile.json" + suffix);
                    if (payload == null) continue;
                    PlayerProfile profile = JsonUtility.FromJson<PlayerProfile>(payload);
                    if (profile == null || profile.Version < 1 || profile.Version > PlayerProfile.CurrentVersion || profile.BestWave < 0 || profile.CompletedRuns == null || profile.SeenUnits == null || profile.SeenItems == null || profile.Achievements == null || !float.IsFinite(profile.Volume)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid profile");
                    if (profile.Wins < 0 || profile.TotalKills < 0 || profile.Cosmetic < 0 || profile.Cosmetic > 2) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid profile counters");
                    profile.Volume = Mathf.Clamp01(profile.Volume);
                    if (profile.SeenWeapons == null) profile.SeenWeapons = new List<string>();
                    profile.AchievementEvidence ??= new List<AchievementMetric>();
                    var evidenceKeys = new HashSet<string>();
                    if (profile.AchievementEvidence.Count > 512) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid achievement journal size");
                    foreach (AchievementMetric m in profile.AchievementEvidence) if (m == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(m.Id) || !float.IsFinite(m.Value) || m.Value < 0 || !evidenceKeys.Add(m.Id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid achievement journal");
                    if (profile.SeenTiers == null) profile.SeenTiers = new List<string>();
                    if (profile.SeenChains == null) profile.SeenChains = new List<string>();
                    if (profile.SeenBosses == null) profile.SeenBosses = new List<string>();
                    if (profile.History == null) profile.History = new List<RunRecord>();
                    if (profile.Records == null) profile.Records = new List<ScoreRecord>();
                    var historyIds = new HashSet<string>();
                    if (profile.History.Count > RunMeta.HistoryLimit) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid history limit");
                    foreach (RunRecord record in profile.History)
                    {
                        if (record == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(record.Id) || record.Build == null || record.Build.RunId != record.Id || record.Nickname == null || record.Score < 0 || !historyIds.Add(record.Id) || !profile.CompletedRuns.Contains(record.Id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid run history");
                        RunSnapshot build = record.Build;
                        if (build.Roster == null || build.Items == null || build.Contributions == null || build.Wave < 1 || build.Difficulty < 0 || build.Difficulty >= RunMeta.DifficultyNames.Length || build.ChallengeId == null || build.TotalKills < 0 || build.BossKills < 0 || !float.IsFinite(build.CombatSeconds) || build.CombatSeconds < 0 || !float.IsFinite(build.LastDamageAmount) || build.LastDamageAmount < 0 || build.Phase != SessionPhase.Victory && build.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid history build");
                        foreach (RosterEntry entry in build.Roster) if (entry == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.UnitId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.WeaponId) || entry.Tier < 1 || entry.Tier > 3) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid history roster");
                        foreach (ItemStack stack in build.Items) if (stack == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(stack.Id) || stack.Count < 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid history relic");
                        foreach (ContributionEntry entry in build.Contributions) if (entry == null || entry.WeaponId == null || !float.IsFinite(entry.Damage) || entry.Damage < 0 || !float.IsFinite(entry.Healing) || entry.Healing < 0 || entry.Kills < 0 || entry.Coins < 0 || entry.Activations < 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid history contribution");
                    }
                    var recordKeys = new HashSet<string>();
                    foreach (ScoreRecord record in profile.Records)
                        if (record == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(record.Key) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(record.RunId) || record.Score < 0 || record.Hall < 1 || !recordKeys.Add(record.Key)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid score record");
                    if (profile.Version < 3) { profile.MusicVolume = 0.8f; profile.SfxVolume = 0.85f; profile.ShowDamageNumbers = profile.ShowLootIndicators = true; }
                    if (!float.IsFinite(profile.MusicVolume) || !float.IsFinite(profile.SfxVolume)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid audio bus settings");
                    profile.MusicVolume = Mathf.Clamp01(profile.MusicVolume); profile.SfxVolume = Mathf.Clamp01(profile.SfxVolume);
                    profile.Version = PlayerProfile.CurrentVersion;
                    return profile;
                }
                catch (Exception exception) { LastError = "Profile save rejected: " + exception.Message; }
            }
            return new PlayerProfile();
        }

        private void Write(string name, string payload)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            string destination = Path.Combine(directory, name);
            string temporary = destination + ".tmp";
            string envelope = JsonUtility.ToJson(new SaveEnvelope { Payload = payload, Hash = Hash(payload) });
            byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(envelope);
            using (var stream = new FileStream(temporary, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None)) { stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length); stream.Flush(true); }
            if (File.Exists(destination)) File.Replace(temporary, destination, destination + ".bak"); else File.Move(temporary, destination);
            LastError = "";
        }

        private string Read(string name)
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(directory, name);
            if (!File.Exists(path)) return null;
            string text = File.ReadAllText(path, Encoding.UTF8);
            SaveEnvelope envelope = JsonUtility.FromJson<SaveEnvelope>(text);
            if (envelope == null || envelope.Payload == null || envelope.Hash != Hash(envelope.Payload)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Checksum mismatch");
            return envelope.Payload;
        }

        private static string Hash(string payload)
        {
            using (SHA256 algorithm = SHA256.Create()) return Convert.ToBase64String(algorithm.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload)));
        }

        public void RecordProgress(PlayerProfile profile, RunSnapshot run, RunCatalog catalog = null)
        {
            string before = JsonUtility.ToJson(profile);
            try
            {
                profile.BestWave = Mathf.Max(profile.BestWave, run.Wave);
                RunMeta.Discover(profile, run, catalog);
                if (run.Nightmare?.Ending == NightmareEndingStage.Complete && run.Nightmare.CustomerDefeated)
                {
                    if (run.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight) profile.NightmareLampPromise = true;
                    else profile.NightmareShopClosed = true;
                }
                if (run.BossKills > 0 && !profile.Achievements.Contains("First bell silenced")) profile.Achievements.Add("First bell silenced");
                if (run.Wave >= 10 && !profile.Achievements.Contains("Ten halls crossed")) profile.Achievements.Add("Ten halls crossed");
                RunMeta.Credit(profile, run);
                RunAchievements.Credit(profile, run, catalog);
                SaveProfile(profile);
            }
            catch { JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(before, profile); throw; }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class NightmareDialogue
    {
        private static readonly string[][] Layers =
        {
            new[] {
                "Welcome! The little bell says you may stay.","Three fresh miracles. Please mind their teeth.",
                "That one would suit your peculiar little family.","No charge for looking. The chair is free, too.",
                "Sold! Take good care of that small impossibility.","It stopped trembling when you chose it.",
                "Just a drop. We do not sell your last heartbeat.","Keep enough blood to get everyone home.",
                "No hurry. A small purse still belongs to a person.","Come back with coins, not apologies.",
                "New stock! The old stock has gone for a nap.","Close your eyes. No, not all of them.",
                "Listen. Three little bells have found one voice.","A family resemblance! Bigger shoes this time.",
                "Follow the warm lights. I shall keep one for you.","See you after the noise. I will put the kettle on."
            },
            new[] {
                "You are back. Good. The street outside has gone quiet.","Do not mind the chair. It has always been empty.",
                "That ribbon was tied differently a moment ago.","If it looks at you, look at a friend instead.",
                "Sold. Something familiar to take into the dark.","Keep the receipt. It proves you were here.",
                "The night can wait. Your heart cannot.","A small red promise. Nothing more.",
                "You owe me nothing for standing in the light.","Not enough coins. There is still a place by the lamp.",
                "A different shelf. The same little shop. Surely.","The bell rang twice. I only touched it once.",
                "There. A clearer voice than anything outside.","They recognized each other before I did.",
                "If the corridor changes, remember the way your friend walks.","I will still be here. Please come back."
            },
            new[] {
                "The shelves remember your footsteps now.","I wrote your name. The receipt wrote the rest.",
                "They remember every crossing. Ask where they want to go.","The eye in the glass is not a price tag.",
                "Sold. It is a companion to your story, not its ending.","The drawer sighed. I think it wanted you to choose that.",
                "Blood is not a signature. Remember that.","Only the listed price. No hidden promises.",
                "No. An empty wallet does not make you merchandise.","Keep your breath. I do not take that currency.",
                "I moved the stock. Something moved the room.","Let us change the shelf before it changes us.",
                "For a moment I remembered what morning sounded like.","That light was yours. The shop did not make it.",
                "If you hear your name outside, let your friends answer first.","The warm cup is still real. I checked."
            },
            new[] {
                "You have seen the wrist. Please do not ask where it ends.","The shop keeps things because it is afraid of forgetting.",
                "That seam was a door once. It might be again.","Some things are held together by being remembered.",
                "Take it. Ownership is not the same as belonging.","Another line on the receipt. Not another chain.",
                "I can count your heartbeats. I will not claim them.","Let this be the last thing the dark asks from you.",
                "You are a guest. Whatever the other receipt says.","I would rather lose a sale than lose you.",
                "Different objects. The same fear underneath.","The cupboard is larger inside. Please do not count the ribs.",
                "They became stronger without forgetting who they were.","That is how a dream learns to let go.",
                "The hand is trying to help. It has forgotten how to ask.","There is a handle somewhere. It must still open something."
            },
            new[] {
                "The last chair is occupied. Do not sign anything.","I kept the lamp lit. I did not know what else to do.",
                "Choose what helps you leave. Not what helps me keep you.","That one is not afraid of morning anymore.",
                "Sold. No one can buy the friends who choose to follow.","Keep it. I am learning the difference between a gift and a sale.",
                "Your heart belongs on the other side of the door.","Only this price. Not your name. Never your name.",
                "I will not let him put a price on you.","No more bargains with the part of you that wants to live.",
                "One last shelf. Then we find the door.","I hear the kettle from the first room. Hold on to that.",
                "There you are. Still yourselves. All of you.","The dark cannot agree on your names. Your friends can.",
                "When the bell rings, walk toward the light together.","If I forget how to close, remind me that goodbye is not forgetting."
            }
        };
        private static readonly string[][] Dream =
        {
            new[] { "A small dream has hatched. Be gentle.","Look softly. That one startles easily.","The dream is yours. The friendship is its own.","Some dreams prefer an honest heartbeat.","Not enough. Your last heartbeat is not for sale.","Let the old dream sleep. Here are three more.","Three names, one bright little soul.","An egg is a promise with a shell. Carry yours gently." },
            new[] { "The windows have shut their eyes.","That one has heard the bell before.","Take a little certainty into the hall.","Leave enough warmth inside your chest.","Not enough. There is no shame in walking away.","I changed the dreams, not the price of being alive.","Listen. They remember the same song.","The empty chair dreamed of a hat. Do not wait for its owner." },
            new[] { "Do not confuse being watched with being known.","Its eyes open only when someone remembers it.","It chose to go with you. That matters.","A heartbeat is not proof of purchase.","Not enough. The dream can wait for your answer.","I put the sharp memories on a different shelf.","A small bright refusal to become forgotten.","The shelf is dreaming of a spine. Walk carefully." },
            new[] { "The hand remembers how small you are.","That ribbon once held the door open.","Let it belong beside you, not beneath you.","Keep the rest of your blood for the dawn.","Not enough. Do not pay with the part of you that wants to leave.","These dreams have not met the last customer yet.","He can count them. He cannot understand them.","The tongue was a carpet before the shop learned fear." },
            new[] { "He is here. He calls the whole shop inventory.","The eye is afraid to close. Help it remember morning.","Carry this beyond the edge of the receipt.","You are not the final item on his bill.","Not enough. Your last heartbeat is not for sale.","One more dream, then we wake the door.","He cannot buy what has become a family.","Choose your way out, little waking thing." }
        };
        private static readonly string[][] Whispers =
        {
            new[] { "The kettle is still warm.","A little bell answers your footsteps.","Someone has left a light on.","Your friends know the way you walk." },
            new[] { "The chair has moved closer to the counter.","The window no longer reflects the street.","Your shadow stops. A friend waits for it.","The lamp is exactly where you remember it." },
            new[] { "A shelf inhales after you pass.","The receipt remembers a purchase you made.","Something behind the glass looks away first.","A familiar little gesture makes the room feel real." },
            new[] { "The same ribbon is tied around the wrist and the door.","The shop is trying to remember the shape of outside.","Someone has repaired a heart instead of replacing it.","The dark changes. Your friends still recognize you." },
            new[] { "The last chair is no longer empty.","There is no price written beneath the lamp.","A door handle waits under the final fold.","Hold on to the things that know you without a receipt." }
        };
        public static string Pick(RunSnapshot state, bool special, MerchantMoment moment, int cursor)
        {
            if (state == null) return MerchantDialogue.Pick(special,moment,cursor);
            int depth = NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave);
            if (cursor % 4 == 3 && (moment == MerchantMoment.Enter || moment == MerchantMoment.Inspect || moment == MerchantMoment.Leave || moment == MerchantMoment.Buy))
            {
                string memory = Memory(state,Math.Abs(cursor / 4));
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(memory)) return memory;
            }
            if (cursor % 3 == 0 && moment == MerchantMoment.Inspect) return MienChoStory.Chapters[Mathf.Clamp(MienChoStory.Available(state) - 1, 0, MienChoStory.Chapters.Length - 1)].Evidence;
            if (special) return Dream[depth][(int)moment];
            return Layers[depth][(int)moment * 2 + Math.Abs(cursor % 2)];
        }
        private static readonly string[][] Evidence =
        {
            new[] { "One chair has been reserved. Nobody remembers making the reservation.", "A blank receipt rests beneath the till. There is no price on it.", "The shopkeeper checks the latch, then leaves your side of it open.", "The little cup is warm. Not every comfort is a trick." },
            new[] { "The chair has one more leg than its shadow.", "The portraits face the wall. One small friend still faces you.", "Someone has polished the empty place where a name should be.", "The shopkeeper counts the guests. Then counts the chairs again." },
            new[] { "The grain of the wood follows something like a pulse.", "The light beyond the glass closes like an eyelid. It was not a door.", "A glove waits beside a receipt that has never been paid.", "Your friend repeats a familiar gesture. For a moment, the room settles." },
            new[] { "The shelves bend inward. The shop is remembering a body.", "The keeper's hand belongs to this dreaming place. The visitor only wants to own it.", "A name has been rubbed away until the paper is almost transparent.", "The shopkeeper hides the blank receipt before the chair can see it." },
            new[] { "Everything has stopped pretending not to wait.", "He remembers every price. There is one name he cannot say.", "The shopkeeper's smile holds a little too long. The lamp stays warm.", "The door is not asking for another purchase. It is waiting for goodbye." }
        };
        public static string Whisper(RunSnapshot state, int cursor)
        {
            int depth = NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave);
            int variation = Math.Abs(cursor / 3 % 4) + ((state.Seed >> (depth * 3)) & 3);
            string text = cursor % 3 == 2 ? Evidence[depth][variation % 4] : Whispers[depth][Math.Abs(cursor % 4)];
            if (state.Wave == 19) text = "The last bell has not rung yet. He remembers every price, but not the name.";
            if (NightmareRules.Remembered(state, SecretEventKind.Understudy) && (text.Contains("glass") || text.Contains("window"))) text = "The familiar window holds its shape. Your reflection stays beside you.";
            if (NightmareRules.Remembered(state, SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor) && (text.Contains("shelf") || text.Contains("shelves"))) text = "The repaired shelf holds its shape. Something else in the room is breathing.";
            return text;
        }
        public static string Memory(RunSnapshot state, int cursor)
        {
            NightmareProgress story = state.Nightmare;
            if (story == null || story.ResolvedMask == 0) return state.Secrets?.LetterSent == true ? "Your letter reached something beyond the stage. It is listening." : "";
            for (int offset = 0; offset < 8; offset++)
            {
                int kind = (cursor + offset) % 8;
                if ((story.ResolvedMask & (1 << kind)) == 0) continue;
                int choice = Mathf.Clamp(story.Choices[kind],0,2);
                string[][] lines = {
                    new[] { "The drawer is quiet now. Someone inside it went home with you.","The letter in the cabinet finally has someone to carry it.","You took its heart gently. The cabinet remembers." },
                    new[] { "That returning thread knows the way back to your hand.","The tailor left a second heartbeat inside your swing.","A little shelter, stitched into something you chose to keep." },
                    new[] { "Your reflection blinked first. You did not become it.","Your shadow is borrowed, not sold. We remember the difference.","You left the mirror without fighting yourself. That was allowed." },
                    new[] { "That ticket has a destination where the customer cannot follow.","The contraband thread was not on his inventory.","You faced the collector. This visitor is not your first." },
                    new[] { "The thirteenth hour was borrowed. Dawn is not.","A debt can be repaid. You are not collateral.","What you trusted to the bank still carries your name, not his." },
                    new[] { "The garden kept one small light awake for you.","You settled a promise beneath the sleeping lamp.","A dream friend is still a friend, even after visiting hours." },
                    new[] { "The paper audience learned to applaud instead of whisper.","You stood your ground when the leading actor stepped forward.","Two actors shared a stage. Neither could write your ending." },
                    new[] { "Your parcel has an address beyond these shelves.","Someone carries your letter close to their weapon.","Your invitation reached the other side of the curtain." }
                };
                return lines[kind][choice];
            }
            return "";
        }
        public static string Room(RunSnapshot state, SecretEventKind kind)
        {
            string[] early = { "Not every forgotten thing wants to be bought. Some want to be found.","A stitch can change a thing without erasing who kept it.","The reflection asks whether following you is the same as being you.","This train carries things that never belonged on a shelf.","The clock offers more time. It cannot promise a morning.","Here the shop remembers how to keep someone safe.","The audience is waiting to learn whether you are a person or a performance.","An address is a way of believing there is somewhere outside." };
            string[] late = { "The Last Customer counts missing stock. The drawer counts rescued friends.","The tailor can mend a seam. Perhaps even the one that sealed the door.","He wants obedient copies. The mirror offers you a chance to refuse.","Every unlisted parcel is a small hole in his perfect receipt.","He calls every promise a debt. The clock knows better.","The garden is not merchandise. Rest is not another purchase.","He bought the seats. He did not buy the right to choose your ending.","If a letter can leave the shop, perhaps all of you can." };
            return (NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave) >= 3 ? late : early)[(int)kind];
        }
        public static string Ending(RunSnapshot state, int page)
        {
            return page switch
            {
                0 => "THE RECEIPT ENDS HERE\nThe Customer's contract breaks. His own name is still missing, but he releases the names he took.\nFrom the empty chair, the One Who Stays asks for the old promise. You do not renew it. The door opens anyway.",
                1 => "THE SHOPKEEPER\nI delayed the directions because I feared being forgotten. I called it shelter.\nThe key is yours. You do not have to forgive me to use it.\nThe letter, the lock and the visitor's register stay in your hands. Someone did come.\n" + (state.Secrets.LetterSent ? "The letter you sent has an answer waiting outside." : "The unsent letter is yours to deliver, or keep. Nobody chooses for you."),
                2 => "MORNING, TOGETHER\n" + WaitingCompanionQuests.Futures(state) + (state.Roster.Count > 0 ? "Your companions cross as living creatures, each carrying a life beyond this crossing." : "You cross carrying your own light. You did not need to earn company to deserve freedom.") + "\n" + (state.Secrets.RescuedToy ? "The creature you rescued takes its own first step into morning.\n" : "There are other lives still waiting beyond the rooms you visited.\n") + (state.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Completed ? "The Keeper holds the frame and opens its hand." : "Beyond the shop, the Keeper's unanswered door remains a crossing for another day.") + " The One Who Stays remains by the chair. It cannot choose for you.\nMorning is real. Nobody is erased.",
                3 => "A PLACE WITHOUT A PRICE\nYou ask: 'Does anyone still need me to do something?'\nA chair is pulled closer. 'Sit here a while.'\nThe new tune misses a beat. Someone waits, and you start together.\n" + (state.Nightmare.Farewell == NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight ? "Everyone is outside before you leave a lamp. An invitation, never a debt." : "The shop closes. You do not have to return to prove you remember."),
                _ => "ONE LIGHT LEFT ON\nThe lamp marks an open route for other travellers. The key has no price.\nBeyond the counter, three knocks belong to someone with a story of their own.\nYou are awake. You may choose to answer another day. This morning is not taken back."
            };
        }

        public static int AuthoredLineCount
        {
            get
            {
                int total = 24 + 16 + 4;
                foreach (string[] layer in Layers) total += layer.Length;
                foreach (string[] layer in Dream) total += layer.Length;
                foreach (string[] layer in Whispers) total += layer.Length;
                foreach (string[] layer in Evidence) total += layer.Length;
                return total;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class OctoberDialogue : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private float next, until;
        private string speaker, line;
        private int cursor, lastWave;
        private GUIStyle copy, nameStyle;
        public void Configure(ArenaController controller) => owner = controller;
        public static string HeroLine(string reference, int index)
        {
            string[] lines = reference switch
            {
                "Mr. Work" => new[] { "One more lamp. One more friend home.", "My shift ends when everyone is safe." },
                "Derpy Wolf" => new[] { "I delivered tomorrow's letter yesterday.", "Slow down? The clock started it!" },
                "Jade Cabbage" => new[] { "Little leaves, stay where I can see you.", "Even the smallest root can break a nightmare." },
                "The Big Pot" => new[] { "Come close. There is still warmth in me.", "A dent is just another place to keep a story." },
                "Porcelain Doll" => new[] { "Careful. My cracks remember everything.", "We can mend this night, one seam at a time." },
                "Slippy" => new[] { "No running on the wet floor. That is my job.", "If it bites, give it a little nudge." },
                "Card King" => new[] { "A good king leaves room for his friends.", "The crown is heavy. Your company helps." },
                "Sassy Senior" => new[] { "I was old when this shop was young.", "Luck is experience wearing a ridiculous hat." },
                "Baggy" => new[] { "Leave the walking to the impatient.", "The roots downstairs are listening." },
                "Sir Purrcival" => new[] { "For the little ones behind the counter!", "My helmet is brave. I am catching up." },
                "Red Scale" => new[] { "Another cup, another tide.", "I can hear the ocean inside these coins." },
                "Omnom" => new[] { "The dark is hungry. So am I.", "Leave a little nightmare for me." },
                "Periwinky" => new[] { "I counted my quills. The shop counted twice.", "A full purse makes a surprisingly good pillow." },
                "Clementie" => new[] { "Stay close. We move as one.", "Little feet can make a thunderstorm." },
                "Gulpy" => new[] { "Every locked chest dreams of opening.", "I promise not to eat the receipt this time." },
                "Frosty" => new[] { "Hush. I am keeping a snowflake alive.", "Give me a moment. Even winter needs to breathe." },
                "Capped Gallant" => new[] { "Many voices. One very small hat.", "I carry my friends where the dark cannot reach." },
                "Card Queen" => new[] { "Twelve heartbeats. Spend them kindly.", "My court will remember who stood with us." },
                "Steel Shell" => new[] { "Let the dark strike first.", "A quiet shield hears the smallest cry." },
                "Box Shell" => new[] { "Special delivery. Signature optional.", "There is a whole sunrise in this box." },
                "Bloom Shell" => new[] { "A flower opened while we were fighting.", "There is room for a garden on every shell." },
                "Belle" => new[] { "Everyone gets a place in this story.", "The tickets are patched. The show goes on." },
                "Wise" => new[] { "A borrowed voice is still worth hearing.", "I keep the names the shop forgot." },
                "Nicole" => new[] { "That miracle had better come with change.", "One eye for bargains, one for the way home." },
                "Anby" => new[] { "I can hear the storm inside the wires.", "Wait for the quiet between two sparks." },
                "Billy" => new[] { "Wind me up. I know the next step.", "A little applause for the whole brigade!" },
                "Nekomata" => new[] { "The moon left pawprints on the stairs.", "If you hear a bell, try to keep up." },
                "Burgerboo" => new[] { "Dinner is ready. Stand well back.", "No nightmare leaves my kitchen hungry." },
                "Original:LanternWeaver" => new[] { "The light holds where the thread is tied.", "I stitched a path through this darkness." },
                "Original:HourglassStag" => new[] { "A grain of time for every friend.", "We cannot stop the night. We can soften its steps." },
                _ => new[] { "I wrote the rain down before it forgot us.", "Every raindrop knows a way home." }
            };
            return lines[Math.Abs(index % lines.Length)];
        }
        public static string AllyLine(UnitDefinition u, int index, int wave = 1)
        {
            string personal = CompanionBanter.Line(u.Id, index, wave);
            if (personal != null) return personal;
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "Pony") return index % 2 == 0 ? "Climb on. I know these stairs." : "Two friends travel better than one.";
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "Little Cabbage") return index % 2 == 0 ? "Do you think I will be tall tomorrow?" : "I found a root shaped like your hand.";
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "Domestic Spiked Ball") return "I am trying very hard to be a comforting shape.";
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "\"Triumphant Return\" Daniel") return "I was not late. I was waiting for the right entrance.";
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "\"The Creator\" Roger") return "I made something useful. Please do not shake it.";
            if (u.ReferenceCompanion == "Evil") return "I could be worse. I am choosing not to be.";
            string[] lines = u.Material switch
            {
                BodyMaterial.Fabric => new[] { "That was close. Check your stitches.", "Your sleeve is warm. May I stay here?", "I saved a soft corner for you." },
                BodyMaterial.Metal => new[] { "Still ticking. Still together.", "I polished a little star for the journey.", "A loose screw is no reason to leave a friend." },
                BodyMaterial.Paper => new[] { "Please keep the rain off my name.", "Fold the map. Remember the way home.", "I wrote our names on the same ticket." },
                BodyMaterial.Glass => new[] { "The light looks different through a crack.", "Hold still. There is a sunrise in your reflection.", "I remember when this window showed the sky." },
                _ => new[] { "I heard the floor whisper. I pretended not to.", "One more door. We go together.", "If you get lost, listen for my footsteps." }
            };
            return lines[Math.Abs(index % lines.Length)];
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null || owner.PresentationPaused) return;
            if (lastWave != owner.Session.State.Wave) { lastWave = owner.Session.State.Wave; next = owner.PresentationClock + 8; }
            if (owner.Session.State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || owner.HallExitPending || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen || owner.TransitionPending || owner.Session.State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Reward) { until = 0; return; }
            if (owner.PresentationClock < next || owner.Shop?.Dialogue.ExpiresAt > owner.PresentationClock) return;
            UnitDefinition u = owner.Content.Unit(owner.Session.State.ChampionId);
            if (cursor % 2 != 0 && owner.Session.State.Roster.Count > 0) u = owner.Content.Unit(owner.Session.State.Roster[(cursor / 2) % owner.Session.State.Roster.Count].UnitId);
            speaker = u.DisplayName; line = string.IsNullOrEmpty(u.ReferenceHero) ? AllyLine(u, cursor / 2, owner.Session.State.Wave) : HeroLine(u.ReferenceHero, cursor / 2);
            cursor++; until = owner.PresentationClock + 5; next = owner.PresentationClock + 16;
        }
        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (owner == null || owner.PresentationPaused || owner.PresentationClock >= until || string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) return;
            Matrix4x4 previous = GUI.matrix;
            GUI.matrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(Vector3.zero, Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(Screen.width / 1920f, Screen.height / 1080f, 1));
            copy ??= ArcadeTypography.Style(18); nameStyle ??= ArcadeTypography.Style(17, true);
            Rect card = new Rect(45, 805, 440, 155); ArcadeSkin.Ticket(card, new Color(.12f, .1f, .2f, .96f), ArcadeSkin.Teal);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(65, 819, 400, 38), speaker, nameStyle); GUI.Label(new Rect(65, 860, 400, 86), line, copy); GUI.matrix = previous;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum MerchantMoment { Enter, Inspect, Buy, BloodBuy, Denied, Reroll, Fuse, Leave }
    public sealed class MerchantDialogue
    {
        private string line;
        private float began;
        private float expires;
        private int cursor;
        private string focus;
        private float nextInspect;
        private GUIStyle copy;
        private GUIStyle name;
        public int SpokenCount { get; private set; }
        public MerchantMoment LastMoment { get; private set; }
        public string CurrentLine => line;
        public string MerchantName { get; set; }
        public float ExpiresAt => expires;
        public RunSnapshot Context { get; set; }
        public int VisibleGlyphs(float now, bool reduced) => line == null ? 0 : reduced ? line.Length : Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt((now - began) * 58), 0, line.Length);
        public bool IsSpeaking(float now) => line != null && now >= began && now < expires && VisibleGlyphs(now, false) < line.Length;

        public static string Pick(bool special, MerchantMoment moment, int variant)
        {
            string[] choices;
            if (special)
                choices = moment switch
                {
                    MerchantMoment.Enter => new[] { "Shh... a dream has just opened one eye.", "Come in. I saw you inside an egg." },
                    MerchantMoment.Inspect => new[] { "Do not stare too long. That one stares back.", "Will you take it home... or will it take you?", "I accept eggs. Some wares prefer blood." },
                    MerchantMoment.BloodBuy => new[] { "Only a little blood. Keep the rest for dreaming.", "A beating heart makes a beautiful bargain." },
                    MerchantMoment.Buy => new[] { "Keep the shell. The dream inside is yours.", "A new owner. Do not let it remember the old name." },
                    MerchantMoment.Denied => new[] { "Not enough. I will not buy your final heartbeat.", "An empty purse echoes too. Sadly, I do not accept echoes." },
                    MerchantMoment.Reroll => new[] { "Blink. I shall change the dream underneath.", "Three things that have not happened. Choose one." },
                    MerchantMoment.Fuse => new[] { "Two names sink. One name wakes." },
                    _ => new[] { "Go. Do not look into the dream behind you." }
                };
            else
                choices = moment switch
                {
                    MerchantMoment.Enter => new[] { "Clang! Market open. All three eyes can see your purse!", "Welcome! Today's receipts are still fresh." },
                    MerchantMoment.Inspect => new[] { "That one has not bitten anyone... this shift.", "Look all you like. I am not charging for looking. Yet!", "One eye on the wares, two on your purse." },
                    MerchantMoment.Buy => new[] { "Sold! I chew the coins; you get the miracle.", "A receipt longer than a monster's life. Take it!", "Clink, clink! Another dream has an owner." },
                    MerchantMoment.Denied => new[] { "Is your purse asleep? Wake it and come back!", "I hear jingling... but those are my teeth." },
                    MerchantMoment.Reroll => new[] { "Old stock into my belly, new stock onto the stands!", "Three new wares! My third eye picked them." },
                    MerchantMoment.Fuse => new[] { "Two in, one out! Do not question my arithmetic." },
                    _ => new[] { "Head down! Nightmares are not covered by warranty." }
                };
            string[] extra = moment switch
            {
                MerchantMoment.Enter => special ? new[] { "I kept your dream warm beneath the counter.", "There are more chairs than there used to be." } : new[] { "Mind the threshold. It is older than the shop.", "A warm lamp, a little company. Browse slowly." },
                MerchantMoment.Inspect => special ? new[] { "That shell remembers a different moon.", "Some gifts prefer a quiet owner." } : new[] { "Try the handle. A good tool should know your hand.", "The small print is asleep. I shall read it for you." },
                MerchantMoment.Buy => special ? new[] { "I tied a ribbon around the part that remembers.", "Careful with the seams. The dream is still young." } : new[] { "A fair bargain. Keep the change for the stairs.", "One less lonely thing on my shelf." },
                MerchantMoment.Denied => new[] { "Take your time. The shelf is not going anywhere.", "Keep your last coin. You may need a way home." },
                MerchantMoment.Reroll => new[] { "Let me see what is hiding in the bottom drawer.", "New faces, familiar prices. Give or take a coin." },
                MerchantMoment.Fuse => new[] { "Three little histories. One weapon to remember them.", "Hold still. I am threading their names together." },
                MerchantMoment.BloodBuy => new[] { "Leave yourself a heartbeat for the road.", "A red signature. I will keep it safe." },
                _ => new[] { "I will leave the lamp on.", "Bring your friends back. The kettle can wait." }
            };
            int selected = Mathf.Abs(variant % (choices.Length + extra.Length));
            return selected < choices.Length ? choices[selected] : extra[selected - choices.Length];
        }

        public void Speak(bool special, MerchantMoment moment, float now)
        {
            LastMoment = moment; line = NightmareDialogue.Pick(Context,special,moment,cursor++); began = now; expires = now + Mathf.Max(3.8f,line.Length / 32f + 1.5f); SpokenCount++;
            nextInspect = now + (moment == MerchantMoment.Inspect ? 1.6f : 2.2f);
        }
        public void Observe(bool special, string station, float now)
        {
            if (focus == station) return;
            if (station == null) { focus = null; return; }
            if (now < nextInspect) return;
            focus = station;
            Speak(special, MerchantMoment.Inspect, now);
        }
        public void ResetFocus() { focus = null; }
        public void Say(string text, float now, float seconds)
        {
            line = text; began = now; expires = now + seconds; SpokenCount++;
        }
        public void Draw(bool special, float now, bool reduced)
        {
            if (line == null || now >= expires) return;
            if (copy == null) { copy = ArcadeTypography.Style(19); copy.normal.textColor = ArcadeSkin.Ink; name = ArcadeTypography.Style(18, true); name.normal.textColor = ArcadeSkin.Ink; }
            float reveal = reduced ? 1 : Mathf.Clamp01((now - began) / 0.18f);
            float width = 370 * Mathf.SmoothStep(0.9f, 1, reveal);
            Rect bubble = new Rect(1180, 260 + (1 - reveal) * 8, width, Mathf.Max(126, copy.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(line), width - 36) + 61));
            Color previous = GUI.color; GUI.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, reveal);
            ArcadeSkin.Ticket(bubble, ArcadeSkin.Cream, special ? new Color(0.7f, 0.45f, 0.85f) : ArcadeSkin.Accent);
            string title = MerchantName ?? (special ? "MADAM DREAMSHELL" : "THE RECEIPT GULPER");
            name.fontSize = 18; name.wordWrap = false;
            name.fontSize = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(18 * (bubble.width - 36) / Mathf.Max(1, name.CalcSize(new GUIContent(title)).x)), 12, 18);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(bubble.x + 18, bubble.y + 12, bubble.width - 36, 27), title, name);
            int length = VisibleGlyphs(now, reduced);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(bubble.x + 18, bubble.y + 45, bubble.width - 36, bubble.height - 55), line.Substring(0, length), copy);
            GUI.color = previous;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum AudioBus { Music, Combat, UI, Foley, Voice, Ambience }

    /// <summary>One data-driven cue (see Tools/Audio/build_sfx.py -> Resources/Audio/Arcane/cues.json).</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ArcaneCueDef
    {
        public string id;
        public string bus;
        public int priority;
        public float gainDb;
        public float cooldown;
        public int maxVoices;
        public float pitchJitter;
        public bool loop;
        public bool danger;
        public string[] clips;
        [NonSerialized] public AudioClip[] loaded;
        [NonSerialized] public int last = -1;
        [NonSerialized] public float gain;
        [NonSerialized] public AudioBus busId;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ArcaneCueFile
    {
        public int version;
        public ArcaneCueDef[] cues;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ArcanePieceDef
    {
        public string id;
        public string title;
        public float bpm;
        public int beatsPerBar;
        public int bars;
        public double loopSeconds;
        public int loopSamples;
        public string[] scenes;
        public string family;
        public string[] stems;
        [NonSerialized] public AudioClip[] loaded;
        public double BarSeconds => loopSeconds / bars;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class ArcanePieceFile
    {
        public int version;
        public ArcanePieceDef[] pieces;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cue registry + music registry. Adding a character/weapon/map means adding a row to the Python cue table
    /// (or an alias in <see cref="EventId"/>); no code change is needed to add variations to an existing cue.
    /// </summary>
    public static class ArcaneCueLibrary
    {
        public const string SceneMenu = "menu";
        public const string SceneSelect = "select";
        public const string SceneCombatEarly = "combat_early";
        public const string SceneCombatMid = "combat_mid";
        public const string SceneCombatLate = "combat_late";
        public const string SceneBoss = "boss";
        public const string SceneEndless = "endless";
        public const string SceneShopGold = "shop_gold";
        public const string SceneShopDream = "shop_dream";

        private static Dictionary<string, ArcaneCueDef> cues;
        private static ArcanePieceDef[] pieces;
        private static bool tried;
        private static bool musicBroken;

        /// <summary>Switch for regression harnesses that assert the legacy audio path (K8AudioChecks playback).</summary>
        public static bool Enabled = true;
        public static bool Available { get { EnsureLoaded(); return Enabled && cues != null && cues.Count > 0; } }
        public static bool MusicAvailable { get { EnsureLoaded(); return Enabled && !musicBroken && pieces != null && pieces.Length > 0; } }
        public static int CueCount { get { EnsureLoaded(); return cues == null ? 0 : cues.Count; } }
        public static IEnumerable<ArcaneCueDef> All { get { EnsureLoaded(); return cues == null ? (IEnumerable<ArcaneCueDef>)new ArcaneCueDef[0] : cues.Values; } }
        public static IReadOnlyList<ArcanePieceDef> Pieces { get { EnsureLoaded(); return pieces ?? new ArcanePieceDef[0]; } }

        public static void EnsureLoaded()
        {
            if (tried) return;
            tried = true;
            try
            {
                TextAsset cueText = Resources.Load<TextAsset>("Audio/Arcane/cues");
                if (cueText != null)
                {
                    ArcaneCueFile file = JsonUtility.FromJson<ArcaneCueFile>(cueText.text);
                    cues = new Dictionary<string, ArcaneCueDef>(file.cues.Length);
                    foreach (ArcaneCueDef def in file.cues)
                    {
                        def.gain = Mathf.Pow(10f, def.gainDb / 20f);
                        def.busId = ParseBus(def.bus);
                        cues[def.id] = def;
                    }
                }
                TextAsset musicText = Resources.Load<TextAsset>("Audio/Arcane/Music/music");
                if (musicText != null) pieces = JsonUtility.FromJson<ArcanePieceFile>(musicText.text).pieces;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Arcane audio manifest failed to load; legacy audio stays active. " + exception.Message);
                cues = null; pieces = null;
            }
        }

        public static AudioBus ParseBus(string bus) => Enum.TryParse(bus, out AudioBus parsed) ? parsed : AudioBus.Foley;

        public static ArcaneCueDef Get(string id)
        {
            EnsureLoaded();
            return id != null && cues != null && cues.TryGetValue(id, out ArcaneCueDef def) ? def : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Returns a variation that is never the one played last for this cue (when more than one exists).</summary>
        public static AudioClip Pick(ArcaneCueDef def)
        {
            if (def == null || def.clips == null || def.clips.Length == 0) return null;
            if (def.loaded == null) def.loaded = new AudioClip[def.clips.Length];
            int count = def.clips.Length;
            int index = count == 1 ? 0 : UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, count - 1);
            if (count > 1 && index >= def.last && def.last >= 0) index++;
            index = Mathf.Clamp(index, 0, count - 1);
            if (def.loaded[index] == null) def.loaded[index] = Resources.Load<AudioClip>("Audio/Arcane/" + def.clips[index]);
            if (def.loaded[index] == null) return null;
            def.last = index;
            return def.loaded[index];
        }

        public static AudioClip[] LoadStems(ArcanePieceDef piece)
        {
            if (piece.loaded != null) return piece.loaded;
            var stems = new AudioClip[piece.stems.Length];
            for (int index = 0; index < stems.Length; index++)
            {
                stems[index] = Resources.Load<AudioClip>("Audio/Arcane/" + piece.stems[index]);
                if (stems[index] == null) { musicBroken = true; return null; }
            }
            piece.loaded = stems;
            return stems;
        }

        /// <summary>Pieces tagged with a scene; <paramref name="variant"/> rotates when a scene has several compositions.</summary>
        public static ArcanePieceDef PieceForScene(string scene, int variant)
        {
            EnsureLoaded();
            if (pieces == null) return null;
            ArcanePieceDef first = null;
            int matches = 0;
            foreach (ArcanePieceDef piece in pieces) if (Array.IndexOf(piece.scenes, scene) >= 0) matches++;
            if (matches == 0) return null;
            int want = Mathf.Abs(variant) % matches;
            foreach (ArcanePieceDef piece in pieces)
            {
                if (Array.IndexOf(piece.scenes, scene) < 0) continue;
                if (first == null) first = piece;
                if (want-- == 0) return piece;
            }
            return first;
        }

        public static string SceneFor(SessionPhase phase, bool boss, int wave, int normalWaves, bool endless, bool dreamShop)
        {
            if (phase == SessionPhase.Shop) return dreamShop ? SceneShopDream : SceneShopGold;
            if (phase != SessionPhase.Combat) return SceneMenu;
            if (boss) return SceneBoss;
            if (endless) return SceneEndless;
            float progress = normalWaves <= 0 ? 0f : (wave - 1f) / normalWaves;
            return progress < 0.34f ? SceneCombatEarly : progress < 0.67f ? SceneCombatMid : SceneCombatLate;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------ event -> cue id
        private static readonly string[] MaterialNames = { "paper", "metal", "wax", "fabric", "glass", "wood" };

        /// <summary>
        /// Gameplay event -> stable cue id. Returns null when the event has no sound (or the cue is missing), in which
        /// case the caller falls back to the legacy cue table. Full contract: Docs/Audio/Audio_Integration_Contract.md.
        /// Facts this relies on (verified against CombatSimulation): Fire/Windup carry the ATTACKER's faction, Hit/Kill carry the
        /// TARGET's faction; boss pattern events have no Weapon and no Subject; Hit.Cause.ItemId names secondary damage
        /// ("ember-status", "element-reaction", "arcane-chain", "projectile-split", "expanded-fuse", ...); Cause.RootId is shared by one attack.
        /// </summary>
        public static string EventId(CombatEvent value) => EventId(value, out _);

        public static string EventId(CombatEvent value, out float gainScale)
        {
            gainScale = 1f;
            bool boss = value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null && value.Subject.Definition.IsBoss;
            bool enemy = value.Faction == Faction.Enemy;
            bool bossPattern = enemy && value.Weapon == null && value.Subject == null;   // ProcessBoss emits bare Windup/Fire
            string cause = value.Cause.ItemId ?? "";
            string id = null;
            switch (value.Kind)
            {
                case CombatEventKind.HeroIdentityCast:
                    gainScale = .38f;
                    id = value.Subject == null ? "sig.bell" : value.Subject.Definition.Id switch {
                        "LanternWeaver" or "LoneJelly" => "fx.field.zipper", "CometRunner" or "CopperCauldron" => "wpn.cast.fire",
                        "MirrorKeeper" or "ArchiveCurator" => "sig.camera", "TinVirtuoso" => "sig.musicbox",
                        "StormFencer" or "HourglassStag" => "fx.reaction.arcane", "TideSinger" or "SupperMortar" => "sig.tea", _ => "sig.bell" };
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.BuildMorphCast:
                    gainScale = value.Faction == Faction.Champion ? .55f : .38f;
                    id = value.Subject == null ? null : value.Subject.Definition.BuildMorph switch
                    {
                        BuildMorphKind.Thread => "fx.field.zipper", BuildMorphKind.Cinder => "wpn.cast.fire",
                        BuildMorphKind.Clockwork => "sig.hammer", BuildMorphKind.Porcelain => "sig.tea",
                        BuildMorphKind.Constellation => "fx.reaction.arcane", BuildMorphKind.Paper => "sig.umbrella",
                        BuildMorphKind.Mirror => "sig.camera", BuildMorphKind.Chorus => "sig.musicbox",
                        BuildMorphKind.Magnet => "wpn.magnet.pull", BuildMorphKind.Tide => "wpn.boomerang.return",
                        BuildMorphKind.Frost => "wpn.cast.ice", BuildMorphKind.Seal => "sig.stamp", _ => null
                    };
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Windup:
                    if (boss || bossPattern) id = "boss.telegraph";
                    else if (enemy && value.Weapon != null) id = value.Weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Projectile ? "enemy.spit.windup" : "cmb.windup";
                    else if (value.Weapon != null && value.Weapon.Motion == WeaponMotion.Bow) id = "wpn.bow.draw";
                    else if (value.Faction == Faction.Champion || value.Weapon != null && (value.Weapon.Motion == WeaponMotion.Slam || value.Weapon.Motion == WeaponMotion.Hammer)) id = "cmb.windup";
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Fire:
                    if (cause == "hero-ParcelExpress") id = "hero.parcel.express";
                    else if (boss || bossPattern) id = "boss.attack";
                    else id = FireId(value, enemy);
                    if (value.Faction == Faction.Companion) gainScale = 0.7f;   // crowd: allies sit under the hero
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Hit:
                    if (value.Faction == Faction.Champion) { id = "plr.hurt"; break; }
                    if (cause == "ember-status") { id = "fx.burn"; break; }
                    if (cause == "element-reaction") { id = "fx.reaction.steam"; break; }
                    if (cause == "arcane-chain") { id = "fx.reaction.arcane"; break; }
                    if (cause == "expanded-fuse") { id = "sig.alarm.boom"; break; }
                    if (cause == "zipper-link" || cause == "expanded-link") { id = "fx.field.zipper"; break; }
                    if (cause == "expanded-officehazard" || cause == "expanded-toyhazard" || cause == "expanded-curtain") { id = "fx.hazard.hit"; break; }
                    if (cause == "projectile-split") gainScale = 0.55f;
                    else if (cause == "projectile-ricochet" || cause == "projectile-bounce") gainScale = 0.8f;
                    if (value.Critical) id = "cmb.crit";
                    else if (value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null) id = "cmb.hit." + MaterialNames[(int)value.Subject.Definition.Material];
                    else id = "cmb.hit.wood";
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Kill:
                    if (value.Faction == Faction.Champion) id = "plr.death";
                    else if (boss) id = "boss.defeat";
                    else if (value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null)
                        id = IsLargeEnemy(value.Subject.Definition) ? "enemy.die.large" : "enemy.die." + MaterialNames[(int)value.Subject.Definition.Material];
                    else id = "enemy.die.wood";
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Pickup:
                    id = value.Loot == LootKind.Egg ? "loot.egg" : value.Loot == LootKind.Heart ? "loot.heart" : "loot.coin.pickup";
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Heal: id = "plr.heal"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.ChestOpened: id = "loot.chest.open"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.Dodge: id = "plr.dodge"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.SignaturePulse:
                case CombatEventKind.SignatureBurst:
                    if (value.Weapon == null && value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null && value.Faction == Faction.Champion)
                        id = HeroCue(value.Subject.Definition.HeroMechanic) ?? (value.Element == DamageElement.Ember ? "hero.pulse.ember" : value.Element == DamageElement.Frost ? "hero.pulse.frost" : null);
                    else if (value.Weapon != null)
                        id = value.Weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Bell ? "sig.bell" : value.Weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Stamp ? "sig.stamp" : value.Weapon.Signature == SignatureWeapon.Umbrella ? "sig.umbrella" : null;
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.Proc:
                    id = "up.chain";
                    break;
                case CombatEventKind.ProjectileReturn: id = value.Weapon != null && value.Weapon.Mechanic == CarnivalWeapon.YoYo ? "wpn.yoyo.return" : "wpn.boomerang.return"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.ProjectilePierce: id = "wpn.pierce"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.ProjectileSplit: id = "wpn.split"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.ProjectileBounce: id = "wpn.bounce"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.Knockback: id = "fx.knockback"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.BossPhase: id = "boss.phase"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.ContactWindup: id = "enemy.lunge"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.StatusApplied: id = value.Element == DamageElement.Frost ? "fx.chill" : "fx.burn"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.LootAttract: id = "loot.coin.vacuum"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.MimicWake: id = "enemy.mimic.wake"; break;
                case CombatEventKind.BossLanded: id = value.Subject == null || value.Subject.Definition == null ? null : BossVoiceId(value.Subject.Definition.Id); break;
                case CombatEventKind.LootDrop:
                    id = value.Loot == LootKind.Coin ? "loot.coin.drop" : value.Loot == LootKind.Chest ? "loot.chest.appear" : null;
                    break;
            }
            return id != null && Get(id) != null ? id : null;
        }

        /// <summary>Large non-boss enemies (WardrobeCrab 0.55, FurnaceToad 0.48 radius). BodyScale is a player stat, not an enemy size.</summary>
        public static bool IsLargeEnemy(UnitDefinition definition) => definition != null && !definition.IsBoss && definition.Radius >= 0.45f;

        public static string HeroCue(HeroMechanic mechanic) => mechanic switch
        {
            HeroMechanic.LanternStride => "hero.lantern.stride",
            HeroMechanic.ParcelExpress => "hero.parcel.express",
            HeroMechanic.DreamBreath => "hero.dream.breath",
            HeroMechanic.RootedOracle => "hero.rooted.oracle",
            HeroMechanic.SoloMaw => "hero.solo.maw",
            HeroMechanic.GlassGambler => "hero.glass.gambler",
            HeroMechanic.TideCollector => "hero.tide.collector",
            HeroMechanic.ClockRunner => "hero.clock.runner",
            HeroMechanic.MirrorGuard => "hero.mirror.guard",
            HeroMechanic.TreasureTax => "hero.treasure.tax",
            _ => null
        };

        public static string BossVoiceId(string unitId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(unitId)) return null;
            string id = "boss.voice." + unitId.ToLowerInvariant();
            return Get(id) == null ? null : id;
        }

        private static string FireId(CombatEvent value, bool enemy)
        {
            WeaponDefinition weapon = value.Weapon;
            if (weapon == null) return null;
            if (enemy)
            {
                if (weapon.Kind != WeaponKind.Projectile) return "enemy.lunge";
                if (weapon.ProjectileCount >= 3) return "enemy.shot.burst";
                if (value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null && value.Subject.Definition.Shot == HostileShot.Hook) return "enemy.shot.arc";
                if (value.Subject != null && value.Subject.Definition != null && value.Subject.Definition.Shot == HostileShot.Weave) return "enemy.shot.spiral";
                return "enemy.spit.fire";
            }
            switch (weapon.Mechanic)
            {
                case CarnivalWeapon.YoYo: return "wpn.yoyo.throw";
                case CarnivalWeapon.Magnet: return "wpn.magnet.pull";
                case CarnivalWeapon.Sewing: return "wpn.needle.volley";
                case CarnivalWeapon.SpringHammer: return "wpn.spring.slam";
                case CarnivalWeapon.Projector: return "wpn.projector.cast";
                case CarnivalWeapon.RibbonWheel: return "wpn.ribbon.cut";
            }
            if (weapon.Family == ExpandedWeapon.Fish) return "wpn.boomerang.fly";   // TinFish, CrescentBoomerang, ClockCrescent all return to the owner
            switch (weapon.Family)
            {
                case ExpandedWeapon.Tea: return "sig.tea";
                case ExpandedWeapon.Alarm: return "sig.alarm";
                case ExpandedWeapon.TetherBow: return "wpn.bow.release";
            }
            switch (weapon.Motion)
            {
                case WeaponMotion.Slash: return "cmb.swing.blade";
                case WeaponMotion.Thrust: return "cmb.swing.spear";
                case WeaponMotion.Slam: return "cmb.swing.hammer";
                case WeaponMotion.Recoil: return weapon.ProjectileCount >= 3 || weapon.ProjectileRadius >= 0.08f ? "wpn.launcher" : "wpn.gun.pop";
                case WeaponMotion.Bell: return "sig.bell";
                case WeaponMotion.Bow: return "wpn.bow.release";
                case WeaponMotion.Cast: return weapon.Element == DamageElement.Ember ? "wpn.cast.fire" : weapon.Element == DamageElement.Frost ? "wpn.cast.ice" : "wpn.cast.arcane";
                case WeaponMotion.Stamp: return "sig.stamp";
                case WeaponMotion.Scissors: return "sig.scissors";
                case WeaponMotion.Camera: return "sig.camera";
                case WeaponMotion.Iron: return "sig.iron";
                case WeaponMotion.Hammer: return "sig.hammer";
                case WeaponMotion.Music: return "sig.musicbox";
            }
            return weapon.Kind == WeaponKind.Melee ? "cmb.swing.blade" : "wpn.gun.pop";
        }

        /// <summary>Legacy 0..38 cue index -> new cue id (UI / world calls that still pass integers).</summary>
        public static string LegacyId(int cue)
        {
            switch (cue)
            {
                case 0: return "cmb.swing.blade";
                case 1: return "wpn.bow.release";
                case 2: return "wpn.gun.pop";
                case 3: return "cmb.hit.wood";
                case 4: return "loot.coin.pickup";
                case 5: return "enemy.die.wood";
                case 6: return "boss.defeat";
                case 7: return "sig.bell";
                case 8: return "sig.stamp";
                case 9: return "sig.umbrella";
                case 10: return "sig.tea";
                case 11: return "wpn.bow.release";
                case 12: return "sig.scissors";
                case 13: return "sig.camera";
                case 14: return "sig.fish";
                case 15: return "sig.iron";
                case 16: return "sig.hammer";
                case 17: return "sig.alarm";
                case 18: return "sig.musicbox";
                case 19: return "ui.select";
                case 20: return "shop.buy.gold";
                case 21: return "shop.reroll";
                case 22: return "shop.invalid";
                case 23: return "up.merge";
                case 24: return "boss.telegraph";
                case 25: return "plr.lowhp";
                case 26: return "plr.hurt";
            }
            if (cue >= 27 && cue <= 32) return "enemy.die." + MaterialNames[cue - 27];
            if (cue >= 33 && cue <= 38) return "cmb.hit." + MaterialNames[cue - 33];
            return null;
        }
    }
}
````
