<summary>Assets/ArcaneBrigade/Runtime/Presentation/ArcadeMusic.cs | SHA-256 68e1f67d9972a713f2e7cd728d369c4bfd5c7bfda07265e6fb023e526232f9a6</summary>

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Adaptive soundtrack. Each composition is four sample-aligned looping stems (base / rhythm / melody / intensity)
    /// started on one dspTime, so they cannot drift. Scene changes crossfade on a bar line of the departing piece.
    /// If the Arcane music manifest or its clips are missing, the original four licensed tracks play as before.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ArcadeMusic : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const int StemCount = 4;   // base, rhythm, melody, intensity
        /// <summary>Beat clock of the audible piece for UI that moves with the music (see BeatPulse).</summary>
        public static double BeatOriginDsp { get; private set; }
        public static double BeatSeconds { get; private set; } = 0.5;
        public static int BeatsPerBar { get; private set; } = 4;
        public static bool BeatLive { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>0..1 low-health danger: melody/intensity stems fall away so heartbeat and rhythm carry the moment.</summary>
        public static float Danger { get; set; }
        private float dangerSmooth;
        private int dreamDepth;
        private bool dreamDawn;
        public void SetDreamDepth(int depth, bool dawn) { dreamDepth = Mathf.Clamp(depth,0,4); dreamDawn = dawn; }
        public static float DreamStemGain(int depth, int stem, bool dawn)
            => dawn ? 1 : stem == 2 ? Mathf.Lerp(1,.5f,Mathf.Clamp01(depth / 4f)) : stem == 1 ? Mathf.Lerp(1,.85f,Mathf.Clamp01(depth / 4f)) : 1;
        private static readonly List<ArcadeMusic> owners = new List<ArcadeMusic>();

        private sealed class Deck
        {
            public readonly AudioSource[] sources = new AudioSource[StemCount];
            public readonly float[] stemLevel = new float[StemCount];
            public ArcanePieceDef piece;
            public string scene;
            public double startDsp;
            public double fadeStart;
            public float fadeSeconds = 1f;
            public bool fadingOut;
            public float level;
            public bool Live => piece != null;
        }

        // ---- legacy fallback (original licensed tracks)
        private readonly AudioSource[] tracks = new AudioSource[4];
        private int selected;
        private bool legacyLoaded;
        private bool useLegacy;

        // ---- shared state
        private bool paused;
        private bool focused = true;
        private bool backgrounded;
        private bool wasSuspended;
        private double suspendedAt;

        // ---- adaptive state
        private readonly Deck[] decks = new Deck[2];
        private int current = -1;
        private SessionPhase phase = SessionPhase.Defeat;
        private bool hasPhase;
        private bool boss;
        private int wave = 1;
        private int normalWaves = 20;
        private bool endless;
        private bool dreamShop;
        private string forcedScene;
        private string scene = "";
        private float density;
        private float densityTarget;
        private float nextDensityRead;
        private float silentUntil;
        private float busSmooth = 1f;
        private AudioSource ambience;
        private string ambienceId;

        public string CurrentScene => scene;
        public float Density => density;

        public static string TrackResource(int track)
        {
            switch (track)
            {
                case 0: return "Audio/Licensed/K8-Menu-FusionJazz";
                case 1: return "Audio/Licensed/K8-Shop-CoffeeHouse";
                case 2: return "Audio/Licensed/K8-Combat-JazzClub";
                case 3: return "Audio/Licensed/K8-Boss-BattleTheme";
                default: return null;
            }
        }

        public static int PhaseTrack(SessionPhase phase, bool boss) => phase == SessionPhase.Combat ? (boss ? 3 : 2) : phase == SessionPhase.Shop ? 1 : 0;
        public static float BusGain(bool paused, bool reduced) => (paused ? 0.28f : 1f) * (reduced ? 0.75f : 1f);
        public static float TrackLevel(int track) => track == 1 ? 0.26f : track == 2 ? 0.08f : track == 3 ? 0.13f : 0.18f;

        /// <summary>Relative music level per scene (tuning table; ears decide, see Docs/Audio/Audio_QA_Checklist.md).</summary>
        public static float SceneLevel(string scene)
        {
            switch (scene)
            {
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneMenu: return 0.4f;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneSelect: return 0.35f;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneBoss: return 0.36f;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopGold: return 0.38f;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopDream: return 0.35f;
                default: return 0.3f;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Stem mix for a scene at a given enemy density (0..1). Pure function so it can be unit-checked.</summary>
        public static void StemTargets(string scene, float density, float[] levels)
        {
            float intensity = Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, Mathf.InverseLerp(0.3f, 0.85f, density));
            levels[0] = 1f;
            switch (scene)
            {
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneMenu: levels[1] = 0.85f; levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = 0f; break;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneSelect: levels[1] = 0.7f; levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = 0f; break;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopGold: levels[1] = 0.9f; levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = 0.75f; break;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopDream: levels[1] = 0.8f; levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = 0.7f; break;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneBoss: levels[1] = 1f; levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = 0.6f + 0.4f * intensity; break;
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneEndless: levels[1] = Mathf.Lerp(0.75f, 1f, density); levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = Mathf.Max(0.25f, intensity); break;
                default: levels[1] = Mathf.Lerp(0.7f, 1f, density); levels[2] = 1f; levels[3] = intensity; break;
            }
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < decks.Length; index++) decks[index] = new Deck();
            if (ArcaneCueLibrary.MusicAvailable)
            {
                for (int index = 0; index < decks.Length; index++)
                    for (int stem = 0; stem < StemCount; stem++) decks[index].sources[stem] = MakeSource(true, 210);
                ambience = MakeSource(true, 240);
            }
            else LoadLegacy();
        }

        private AudioSource MakeSource(bool loop, int priority)
        {
            AudioSource source = gameObject.AddComponent<AudioSource>();
            source.playOnAwake = false;
            source.loop = loop;
            source.spatialBlend = 0;
            source.volume = 0;
            source.pitch = 1;
            source.priority = priority;
            return source;
        }

        private void LoadLegacy()
        {
            if (legacyLoaded) return;
            legacyLoaded = true;
            for (int index = 0; index < tracks.Length; index++)
            {
                AudioSource track = MakeSource(true, 210);
                track.clip = Resources.Load<AudioClip>(TrackResource(index));
                tracks[index] = track;
                if (track.clip == null) Debug.LogWarning("Missing licensed soundtrack: " + TrackResource(index), this);
            }
        }

        private void OnEnable() { owners.Add(this); }

        public void SetPhase(SessionPhase phase, bool paused, bool boss)
        {
            selected = PhaseTrack(phase, boss);
            this.paused = paused;
            if (IsActiveOwner()) CheckpointAudio.SimulationPaused = paused;
            bool bossStarted = boss && !this.boss && hasPhase && phase == SessionPhase.Combat;
            if (hasPhase && phase != this.phase && IsActiveOwner())
            {
                if (phase == SessionPhase.Victory) { CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("sting.victory"); silentUntil = Time.unscaledTime + 3.6f; }
                else if (phase == SessionPhase.Defeat) { CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("sting.defeat"); silentUntil = Time.unscaledTime + 3.8f; }
                else if (phase == SessionPhase.Shop && this.phase == SessionPhase.Combat) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("sting.waveclear");
            }
            if (bossStarted && IsActiveOwner()) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("boss.enter");
            this.phase = phase;
            this.boss = boss;
            hasPhase = true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Adaptive context. Call every frame from the arena (cheap): wave progress picks early/mid/late combat,
        /// <paramref name="dreamShop"/> picks the dream shop piece, enemy count drives layer intensity.
        /// </summary>
        public void SetContext(int wave, int normalWaves, bool endless, bool dreamShop, IReadOnlyList<UnitState> units)
        {
            this.wave = wave; this.normalWaves = normalWaves; this.endless = endless; this.dreamShop = dreamShop;
            if (units != null && Time.unscaledTime >= nextDensityRead)
            {
                nextDensityRead = Time.unscaledTime + 0.25f;
                int alive = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < units.Count; index++) if (units[index].Faction == Faction.Enemy && units[index].Alive) alive++;
                densityTarget = Mathf.Clamp01((alive - 8) / 50f);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Menu screens (e.g. character select) can pin a scene; pass null to return to phase-driven selection.</summary>
        public void ForceScene(string sceneId) { forcedScene = sceneId; }

        private bool IsActiveOwner() => owners.Count > 0 && owners[owners.Count - 1] == this;

        private string DesiredScene()
        {
            if (Time.unscaledTime < silentUntil) return "";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(forcedScene)) return forcedScene;
            return ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneFor(hasPhase ? phase : SessionPhase.Defeat, boss, wave, normalWaves, endless, dreamShop);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            bool active = IsActiveOwner();
            bool suspended = !focused || backgrounded || AudioListener.pause;
            double dsp = AudioSettings.dspTime;
            if (suspended && !wasSuspended) suspendedAt = dsp;
            if (!suspended && wasSuspended) ShiftClocks(dsp - suspendedAt);
            wasSuspended = suspended;

            float dt = Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
            float busTarget = PresentationSettings.MusicVolume * PresentationSettings.MusicDuck * BusGain(paused, PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio) * (NightmareHaunting.Quiet ? .3f : 1);
            if (PresentationSettings.MusicVolume <= 0f) busSmooth = 0f;
            else busSmooth += (busTarget - busSmooth) * (1f - Mathf.Exp(-dt * (busTarget < busSmooth ? 7f : 3f)));

            if (!active) { StopAll(); return; }
            if (suspended) return;

            useLegacy = !ArcaneCueLibrary.MusicAvailable || ambience == null;
            if (useLegacy) { StopAdaptive(); UpdateLegacy(busSmooth); UpdateAmbience(dt); return; }

            density = density < densityTarget ? Mathf.MoveTowards(density, densityTarget, dt * 0.35f) : Mathf.MoveTowards(density, densityTarget, dt * 0.08f);
            string desired = DesiredScene();
            if (desired != scene) ChangeScene(desired, dsp);
            UpdateDecks(dsp, busSmooth, dt);
            UpdateAmbience(dt);
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ adaptive
        private void ChangeScene(string desired, double dsp)
        {
            scene = desired;
            ArcanePieceDef piece = string.IsNullOrEmpty(desired) ? null : ArcaneCueLibrary.PieceForScene(desired, wave);
            Deck live = current >= 0 && decks[current].Live ? decks[current] : null;
            if (piece == null)
            {
                if (live != null) BeginFade(live, dsp, 0.7f, true);
                return;
            }
            if (live != null && live.piece == piece && !live.fadingOut) { live.scene = desired; return; }
            AudioClip[] stems = ArcaneCueLibrary.LoadStems(piece);
            if (stems == null) { StopAdaptive(); return; } // clips missing: MusicAvailable is now false, legacy tracks take over next frame

            bool immediate = live == null || desired == ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneBoss || live.fadingOut;
            double start = dsp + 0.15;
            float fade = immediate ? 0.5f : 1.4f;
            if (!immediate)
            {
                double bar = live.piece.BarSeconds;
                double boundary = live.startDsp + Math.Ceiling((dsp - live.startDsp) / bar) * bar;
                if (boundary - dsp < 0.25) boundary += bar;
                start = boundary;
            }
            int slot = current < 0 ? 0 : 1 - current;
            Deck next = decks[slot];
            if (next.Live) KillDeck(next);
            next.piece = piece; next.scene = desired; next.startDsp = start; next.fadingOut = false; next.level = 0f;
            next.fadeStart = start; next.fadeSeconds = fade;
            for (int stem = 0; stem < StemCount; stem++)
            {
                AudioSource source = next.sources[stem];
                source.Stop();
                source.clip = stems[stem];
                source.loop = true;
                source.volume = 0f;
                next.stemLevel[stem] = 0f;
                source.PlayScheduled(start);
            }
            if (live != null) BeginFade(live, start, fade, true);
            current = slot;
        }

        private static void BeginFade(Deck deck, double at, float seconds, bool outgoing)
        {
            deck.fadeStart = at; deck.fadeSeconds = Mathf.Max(0.05f, seconds); deck.fadingOut = outgoing;
        }

        private void KillDeck(Deck deck)
        {
            foreach (AudioSource source in deck.sources) if (source != null) { source.Stop(); source.volume = 0f; }
            deck.piece = null; deck.level = 0f;
        }

        private readonly float[] targets = new float[StemCount];

        private void UpdateDecks(double dsp, float bus, float dt)
        {
            Deck audible = current >= 0 && current < decks.Length && decks[current].Live ? decks[current] : null;
            BeatLive = audible != null;
            if (audible != null)
            {
                BeatOriginDsp = audible.startDsp;
                BeatsPerBar = Mathf.Max(1, audible.piece.beatsPerBar);
                BeatSeconds = Math.Max(0.05, audible.piece.BarSeconds / BeatsPerBar);
            }
            dangerSmooth = Mathf.MoveTowards(dangerSmooth, Mathf.Clamp01(Danger), dt * 1.5f);
            for (int index = 0; index < decks.Length; index++)
            {
                Deck deck = decks[index];
                if (!deck.Live) continue;
                float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((float)((dsp - deck.fadeStart) / deck.fadeSeconds));
                float envelope = deck.fadingOut ? Mathf.Cos(progress * Mathf.PI * 0.5f) : Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI * 0.5f);
                if (deck.fadingOut && progress >= 1f) { KillDeck(deck); if (current == index) current = -1; continue; }
                StemTargets(deck.scene, density, targets);
                for (int stem = 0; stem < StemCount; stem++) targets[stem] *= DreamStemGain(dreamDepth,stem,dreamDawn);
                if (dangerSmooth > 0f) { targets[2] *= 1f - 0.65f * dangerSmooth; targets[3] *= 1f - 0.85f * dangerSmooth; targets[0] *= 1f - 0.2f * dangerSmooth; }
                float sceneLevel = SceneLevel(deck.scene);
                for (int stem = 0; stem < StemCount; stem++)
                {
                    deck.stemLevel[stem] = Mathf.MoveTowards(deck.stemLevel[stem], targets[stem], dt * (targets[stem] > deck.stemLevel[stem] ? 0.45f : 0.2f));
                    deck.sources[stem].volume = envelope * deck.stemLevel[stem] * sceneLevel * bus;
                }
            }
        }

        private void ShiftClocks(double suspendedFor)
        {
            foreach (Deck deck in decks) if (deck.Live) { deck.startDsp += suspendedFor; deck.fadeStart += suspendedFor; }
        }

        private void StopAdaptive()
        {
            for (int index = 0; index < decks.Length; index++) if (decks[index].Live) KillDeck(decks[index]);
            current = -1; scene = "";
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ ambience (one looping bed under the music)
        private static string AmbienceFor(string scene)
        {
            switch (scene)
            {
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopGold: return "amb.goldshop";
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneShopDream: return "amb.dreamshop";
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneMenu:
                case ArcaneCueLibrary.SceneSelect:
                case "": return null;
                default: return "amb.stage";
            }
        }

        private void UpdateAmbience(float dt)
        {
            if (ambience == null) return;
            string wanted = AmbienceFor(scene);
            ArcaneCueDef def = ArcaneCueLibrary.Get(wanted ?? ambienceId);
            float target = 0f;
            if (wanted != null && def != null)
            {
                target = def.gain * CheckpointAudio.BusTrim(AudioBus.Ambience) * PresentationSettings.SfxVolume * (PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio ? 0.5f : 1f)
                    * (paused ? 0.3f : 1f) * (Time.unscaledTime < PresentationSettings.DangerUntil ? 0.7f : 1f);
            }
            if (wanted != ambienceId)
            {
                ambience.volume = Mathf.MoveTowards(ambience.volume, 0f, dt * 0.25f);
                if (ambience.volume > 0.001f) return;
                ambience.Stop();
                ambienceId = wanted;
                ArcaneCueDef next = ArcaneCueLibrary.Get(wanted);
                AudioClip clip = next != null ? ArcaneCueLibrary.Pick(next) : null;
                if (clip == null) { ambienceId = wanted; return; }
                ambience.clip = clip; ambience.loop = true; ambience.volume = 0f; ambience.Play();
                return;
            }
            if (ambienceId == null) { if (ambience.isPlaying) ambience.Stop(); return; }
            ambience.volume = Mathf.MoveTowards(ambience.volume, target, dt * (target < ambience.volume ? 0.5f : 0.12f));
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------ legacy fallback
        private void UpdateLegacy(float busGainValue)
        {
            LoadLegacy();
            for (int index = 0; index < tracks.Length; index++)
            {
                AudioSource track = tracks[index];
                float target = index == selected ? TrackLevel(index) * busGainValue : 0;
                if (target > 0 && !track.isPlaying && track.clip != null) track.Play();
                track.volume = Mathf.MoveTowards(track.volume, target, Time.unscaledDeltaTime * (target < track.volume ? 0.6f : 0.22f));
                if (target == 0 && track.volume == 0 && track.isPlaying) track.Stop();
            }
        }

        private void StopAll()
        {
            StopAdaptive();
            if (ambience != null) { ambience.Stop(); ambience.volume = 0f; ambienceId = null; }
            foreach (AudioSource track in tracks) if (track != null) { track.Stop(); track.volume = 0; }
        }

        private void OnApplicationFocus(bool focus) { focused = focus; SetSuspended(); }
        private void OnApplicationPause(bool pause) { backgrounded = pause; SetSuspended(); }
        private void SetSuspended()
        {
            bool suspend = !focused || backgrounded;
            foreach (Deck deck in decks)
                foreach (AudioSource source in deck.sources) { if (source == null) continue; if (suspend) source.Pause(); else source.UnPause(); }
            if (ambience != null) { if (suspend) ambience.Pause(); else ambience.UnPause(); }
            foreach (AudioSource track in tracks)
            {
                if (track == null) continue;
                if (suspend) track.Pause();
                else track.UnPause();
            }
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            owners.Remove(this);
            CheckpointAudio.SimulationPaused = false;
            StopAll();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-30)]
    public sealed class SecretEventRoom : MonoBehaviour
    {

        private int NearestPortal()
        {
            if (owner?.Simulation == null || owner.Session == null || owner.Session.State.Phase != SessionPhase.Shop || owner.TransitionPending) return -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < portals.Count; i++) if (Vector2.Distance(owner.Simulation.Champion.Position, Positions[i]) < 1.5f) return i;
            return -1;
        }
        private void Update()
        {

            SecretEventProgress s = owner.Session.State.Secrets;
            string key = owner.Session.State.RunId + "/" + owner.Session.State.Wave + "/" + owner.Session.State.Phase + "/" + owner.Session.State.OutsideStage + "/" + s?.Stage + "/" + s?.Kind + "/" + s?.Visits + "/" + s?.VisitedMask + "/" + s?.RewardId + "/" + s?.QueuedEvent;
            if (signature != key) { signature = key; Rebuild(); enteredAt = owner.PresentationClock; selected = 0; hold = 0; armed = false; }
            if (owner.PresentationPaused || owner.TransitionPending || owner.HallExitPending) { hold = 0; return; }
            bool pressed = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Return) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.JoystickButton0);
            if (!pressed) armed = true;

            {
                int near = NearestPortal();

                    float sway = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 0 : Mathf.Sin(owner.PresentationClock * 1.4f + i) * .022f;
                    portals[i].transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, sway * 20);

                hold = near >= 0 && pressed && armed ? hold + Time.deltaTime : 0;
                if (hold >= .85f) { armed = false; owner.EnterSecret(kinds[near]); hold = 0; }

            else if (MenuOpen)
            {
                if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.LeftArrow) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton4)) { selected = (selected + 2) % 3; hold = 0; }
                if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.RightArrow) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton5)) { selected = (selected + 1) % 3; hold = 0; }
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1 + i)) { selected = i; hold = 0; }

                    armed = false; hold = 0;

        private void Rebuild()
        {

                    Prop(gallery.transform, "RightArtifact", SecretEventAssets.Current.Relics[(int)owner.Session.State.Secrets.Kind + 8], new Vector2(3, 1.2f), .85f, 310);

            for (int i = 0; i < available.Length; i++)

                kinds.Add(available[i]);

                portals.Add(p);

        }

                ArcadeSkin.Panel(new Rect(250, 130, 1420, 150), ArcadeSkin.Surface);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(280, 142, 1360, 50), SecretEventAssets.Titles[(int)s.Kind], heading);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(300, 199, 1320, 66), NightmareDialogue.Room(owner.Session.State,s.Kind) + "\nRead each offer. The way back to your shop stays open until you accept a challenge.", label);
                if (s.Stage == SecretEventStage.Choosing)
                {
                    TargetSelector(s);
                    SecretChoice[] choices = owner.Session.SecretChoices();
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                    {
                        float x = 260 + i * 470; SecretChoice c = choices[i];
                        GUI.enabled = c.Enabled;
                        if (GUI.Button(new Rect(x, 540, 460, 70), (i + 1) + "  " + c.Title, card)) { selected = i; hold = 0; }
                        GUI.enabled = true;
                        ArcadeSkin.Panel(new Rect(x, 612, 460, 245), c.Enabled ? ArcadeSkin.Surface : new Color(.12f,.12f,.15f));
                        if (selected == i) ArcadeSkin.Focus(new Rect(x, 540, 460, 317));
                        GUI.Label(new Rect(x + 18, 626, 424, 210), c.Copy + (c.Enabled ? "" : "\n\nUnavailable with your current build or active contract."), body);
                        if (c.Icon != null) DrawSprite(new Rect(x + 175, 450, 90, 80), c.Icon);
                    }
                    ArcadeSkin.Panel(new Rect(490, 862, 940, 44), ArcadeSkin.Surface);
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(500, 866, 920, 36), "1–3 / ← → / LB RB: select  ·  Hold E / Enter / A to agree: " + Mathf.FloorToInt(hold / .85f * 100) + "%", label);
                    GUI.enabled = choices[selected].Enabled;
                    if (GUI.Button(new Rect(500, 920, 440, 58), "AGREE TO SELECTED OFFER", primary)) owner.ChooseSecret(selected);
                    GUI.enabled = true;
                    if (GUI.Button(new Rect(960, 920, 460, 58), "RETURN WITHOUT A DEAL", card)) owner.LeaveSecret();
                }
                else
                {
                    ArcadeSkin.Panel(new Rect(420, 540, 1080, 315), ArcadeSkin.Surface);
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(455, 562, 1010, 160), s.Result, body);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.RewardId))
                    {
                        string reward = owner.Session.SecretRewardLabel;
                        if (GUI.Button(new Rect(640, 745, 640, 68), "CLAIM " + reward, card)) owner.ClaimSecret();
                    }
                    else if (GUI.Button(new Rect(660, 745, 600, 68), "RETURN TO THE SHOP", card)) owner.LeaveSecret();
                }
            }
            else if (owner.Session.SecretFighting)
            {
                GUI.Label(new Rect(24, 1038, 1000, 30), SecretEventAssets.Titles[(int)owner.Session.State.Secrets.Kind], small);
            }
            GUI.matrix = previous; GUI.depth = depth;
        }
        private void TargetSelector(SecretEventProgress s)
        {
            if (s.Kind != SecretEventKind.ImpossibleTailor && s.Kind != SecretEventKind.DeadLetters && s.Kind != SecretEventKind.ThirteenthHour && s.Kind != SecretEventKind.Understudy && s.Kind != SecretEventKind.ContrabandTrain) return;
            string name = owner.Content.Item(s.TargetItem)?.Name ?? "No eligible relic owned";
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(550, 310, 820, 72), panel);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(635, 325, 650, 40), "RELIC: " + name, label);
            if (GUI.Button(new Rect(555, 317, 65, 55), "<", card)) CycleTarget(-1);
            if (GUI.Button(new Rect(1300, 317, 65, 55), ">", card)) CycleTarget(1);
            if (s.Kind == SecretEventKind.DeadLetters && owner.Session.State.Roster.Count > 0)
            {
                if (GUI.Button(new Rect(550, 392, 820, 49), "FRIEND: " + owner.Content.Unit(s.TargetUnit)?.DisplayName + " / " + s.TargetWeapon + "  >", card))
                {
                    var roster = owner.Session.State.Roster; int index = roster.FindIndex(r => r.UnitId == s.TargetUnit && r.WeaponId == s.TargetWeapon);
                    RosterEntry r = roster[(index + 1) % roster.Count]; owner.SecretTarget(r.UnitId, r.WeaponId);
                }
            }
        }
        private void CycleTarget(int step)
        {
            string[] items = owner.Session.SecretTargets.ToArray(); if (items.Length == 0) return;
            int index = Array.IndexOf(items, owner.Session.State.Secrets.TargetItem);
            owner.SecretTarget(items[(index + step + items.Length) % items.Length]);
        }
        private void DrawSprite(Rect rect, Sprite sprite)
        {
            Rect t = sprite.textureRect;
            GUI.DrawTextureWithTexCoords(rect, sprite.texture, new Rect(t.x / sprite.texture.width, t.y / sprite.texture.height, t.width / sprite.texture.width, t.height / sprite.texture.height), true);
        }
        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            foreach (SpriteRenderer p in portals) if (p != null) Destroy(p.gameObject);
            if (gallery != null) Destroy(gallery);
            foreach (Texture2D t in new[] { panel, paper, disabled }) if (t != null) Destroy(t);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class NightmareFarewellRoom : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private readonly SpriteRenderer[] views = new SpriteRenderer[3];
        private readonly GroundShadow[] shadows = new GroundShadow[3];
        private readonly DreamSuspension[] suspensions=new DreamSuspension[2];
        private readonly Vector2[] positions = new Vector2[3];
        private float appeared;
        private int focus = -1;
        private bool visible;
        public int Focus => focus;
        public void Configure(ArenaController controller)
        {
            owner = controller;
            for (int index = 0; index < views.Length; index++)
            {
                var child = new GameObject("FarewellWitness" + index); child.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
                views[index] = child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>(); views[index].sortingOrder = 650;
                views[index].sprite = index == 0 ? NightmareAssets.Current.Scenery[7] : index == 1 ? NightmareAssets.Current.Scenery[3] : NightmareAssets.Current.ManFrames[0];
                shadows[index] = child.AddComponent<GroundShadow>();
                if(index<2)suspensions[index]=child.AddComponent<DreamSuspension>();
            }
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner == null) return;
            bool show = owner.TerminalDelayComplete && owner.Session.EndingChoicePending;
            if (show && !visible)
            {
                appeared = owner.PresentationClock;
                Vector2 origin = owner.Simulation.ClampPosition(owner.Simulation.Champion.Position, 4);
                positions[0] = origin + new Vector2(-2.4f, 1); positions[1] = origin + new Vector2(2.4f, 1); positions[2] = origin + new Vector2(0, 1.9f);
            }
            visible = show;
            if (!show) { foreach (SpriteRenderer view in views) view.enabled = false; foreach (GroundShadow shadow in shadows) shadow.Hide();foreach(var air in suspensions)air.Hide();return; }
            if (owner.PresentationPaused) return;
            bool stationary = owner.Simulation.Champion.Definition.HeroMechanic == HeroMechanic.RootedOracle;
            float horizontal = Input.GetAxisRaw("Horizontal");
            focus = -1;
            if (stationary) focus = horizontal > .2f ? 1 : horizontal < -.2f ? 0 : selected;
            else
                for (int index = 0; index < 2; index++)
                    if (Vector2.Distance(owner.Simulation.Champion.Position, positions[index]) < 1.45f) focus = index;
            if (focus >= 0) selected = focus;
            float age = owner.PresentationClock - appeared;
            for (int index = 0; index < views.Length; index++)
            {
                SpriteRenderer view = views[index]; view.enabled = true;
                if (index == 2) view.sprite = NightmareAssets.Current.ManFrames[PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 0 : Mathf.FloorToInt(age * 1.5f) % NightmareAssets.Current.ManFrames.Length];
                float enter = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 1 : Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01(age / 1.1f));
                float lift = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 0 : (1 - enter) * .35f;
                float breathe = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 0 : Mathf.Sin(age * 1.2f + index) * .012f;
                float width = index == 2 ? 1.05f : index == 0 ? 1.8f : 2;
                float scale = width * (1 + breathe + (focus == index ? .055f : 0)) / Mathf.Max(.01f, view.sprite.bounds.size.x);
                view.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * scale;
                Vector3 hovering = index == 2 ? Vector3.zero : DreamLevitation.Offset(owner.PresentationClock, 90 + index, 0, PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion);
                view.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, index == 2 ? 0 : DreamLevitation.Tilt(owner.PresentationClock, 90 + index, PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion));
                WorldSpriteGrounding.Place(view, (Vector3)positions[index] + Vector3.up * lift + hovering);
                view.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, enter);
                shadows[index].Display(view.sprite, positions[index], width, lift + hovering.y, .25f * enter);
                if(index<2)suspensions[index].Display(positions[index],(Vector3)positions[index]+Vector3.up*lift+hovering,width,owner.PresentationClock,90+index,view.sortingOrder-1,enter,true);
            }
            if (age >= 1.2f && focus >= 0 && (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Return) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton0))) Select(focus);
        }
        private int selected;
        private void Select(int index)
        {
            if (owner.PresentationPaused || owner.PresentationClock - appeared < 1.2f) return;
            owner.ChooseNightmareEnding(index == 0 ? NightmareFarewell.CloseShop : NightmareFarewell.LeaveLight);
        }
        public void Draw(GUIStyle text, GUIStyle button)
        {
            GUI.Label(new Rect(400, 85, 1120, 90), "THE MAN BEHIND THE RECEIPT\nI remembered the price. I forgot the name.", text);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(470, 765, 980, 70), "The door is real. Both choices lead to morning.", text);
            bool previous = GUI.enabled;
            GUI.enabled = previous && !owner.PresentationPaused && owner.PresentationClock - appeared >= 1.2f;
            if (GUI.Button(new Rect(380, 855, 540, 74), "CLOSE THE SHOP", button)) Select(0);
            if (GUI.Button(new Rect(1000, 855, 540, 74), "LEAVE ONE LIGHT ON", button)) Select(1);
            GUI.enabled = previous;
            string leave = owner.Session.State.Roster.Count > 0 || owner.Session.State.Secrets.RescuedToy ? "Leave together." : "Step outside.";
            GUI.Label(new Rect(380, 940, 540, 75), leave + " Goodbye is not forgetting.", text);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(1000, 940, 540, 75), leave + " A guiding lamp. No debt to return.", text);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(380, 1020, 1160, 45), "Move / choose left or right · Space / A · or click either choice", text);
            if (owner.PresentationPaused && GUI.Button(new Rect(760, 650, 400, 60), "RESUME", button)) owner.TogglePause();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class NightmareDeparture
    {
        private readonly List<UnitDefinition> guests = new List<UnitDefinition>();
        private readonly List<WeaponDefinition> weapons = new List<WeaponDefinition>();
        private readonly List<int> tiers = new List<int>();
        private string run;
        public int PartyCount => guests.Count;
        public static float Travel(float elapsed, int index, bool reduced) => reduced ? .55f : Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01((elapsed - index * .22f) / 4.5f));
        public static float Visibility(float travel) => 1 - Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.InverseLerp(.88f, 1, travel));
        public void Draw(Rect image, ArenaController owner, int page, float elapsed)
        {
            if (page != 2) return;
            if (run != owner.Session.State.RunId)
            {
                run = owner.Session.State.RunId; guests.Clear(); weapons.Clear(); tiers.Clear();
                if (owner.Session.State.Secrets.RescuedToy) Add(owner.Content.Unit("SecretPatchBear"));
                if (owner.Session.State.Secrets.LetterSent) Add(owner.Content.Unit("SecretPaperBird"));
                foreach (RosterEntry entry in owner.Session.State.Roster)
                {
                    UnitDefinition unit = owner.Content.Unit(entry.UnitId);
                    if (unit != null && unit.Id.StartsWith("Secret", System.StringComparison.Ordinal) && guests.Contains(unit)) continue;
                    Add(unit, owner.Content.Weapon(entry.WeaponId), entry.Tier);
                }
                Add(owner.Content.Unit(owner.Session.State.ChampionId));
            }
            GUI.BeginGroup(image);
            Rect stage = new Rect(30, image.height - 190, image.width - 60, 170);
            bool reduced = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion;
            float opening = reduced ? 1 : Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01(elapsed / 1.4f));
            Rect doorway = new Rect(stage.xMax - 150, stage.y + 2, 130, 163);
            ArcadeSkin.Glow(new Rect(doorway.x - 170, stage.yMax - 75, 330, 80), new Color(1, .75f, .36f, opening * .23f));
            Color doorTint = GUI.color;
            GUI.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, opening);
            RunHud.Sprite(doorway, NightmareAssets.Current.Scenery[7]);
            GUI.color = doorTint;
            for (int index = 0; index < guests.Count; index++)
            {
                UnitDefinition unit = guests[index];
                float stagger = guests.Count > 8 ? 1.6f / Mathf.Max(1, guests.Count - 1) : .22f;
                float localElapsed = elapsed + index * (.22f - stagger);
                float travel = Travel(localElapsed, index, reduced);
                float start = stage.x + 40 + index % 10 * 55;
                float horizontal = Mathf.Lerp(start, doorway.center.x - 12, travel);
                float bob = (reduced ? 0 : Mathf.Sin(elapsed * 9 + index) * 3 * (travel > 0 && travel < 1 ? 1 : 0)) - index / 10 * 28 * (1 - travel);
                float size = (58 + Mathf.Clamp(unit.BodyHeight, .5f, 2) * 10) * (1 + (tiers[index] - 1) * .12f);
                Sprite sprite = unit.AnimationFrames.Length > 0 ? unit.AnimationFrames[reduced ? 0 : Mathf.FloorToInt(elapsed * 6 + index) % unit.AnimationFrames.Length] : unit.Body;
                Vector3 acting = EnsembleMotion.Goodbye(unit, localElapsed, index, reduced);
                CharacterActingEntry art = CharacterActingLibrary.Current?.Find(unit.Id);
                if (!reduced && art != null && acting.x > 0) sprite = CharacterActingEntry.Frame(art.Curious, acting.x * .7f);
                if (!reduced && art != null && localElapsed - index * .22f >= 1.65f && localElapsed - index * .22f < 2.3f) sprite = CharacterActingEntry.Frame(art.Cheer, (localElapsed - index * .22f - 1.65f) / .65f);
                Color previous = GUI.color;
                float fade = Visibility(travel);
                GUI.color = new Color(0, 0, 0, fade * .3f);
                RunHud.Sprite(new Rect(horizontal - size * .5f, stage.yMax - 25, size, 13), sprite);
                GUI.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, fade);
                Rect actor = new Rect(horizontal - size * .5f, stage.yMax - size - 18 + bob - acting.z, size, size);
                Matrix4x4 matrix = GUI.matrix;
                GUIUtility.RotateAroundPivot(acting.y, new Vector2(actor.center.x, actor.yMax));
                if (acting.x > .3f) GUIUtility.ScaleAroundPivot(new Vector2(-1, 1), actor.center);
                RunHud.Sprite(actor, sprite);
                GUI.matrix = matrix;
                WeaponDefinition weapon = weapons[index];
                if (weapon != null && weapon.Sprite != null)
                    RunHud.Sprite(new Rect(horizontal + size * (acting.x > .3f ? -.7f : .15f), stage.yMax - size * .6f + bob - 15 - acting.z, size * .55f, size * .4f), weapon.Sprite);
                GUI.color = previous;
            }
            GUI.EndGroup();
        }
        private void Add(UnitDefinition unit, WeaponDefinition weapon = null, int tier = 1)
        {
            if (unit == null) return;
            guests.Add(unit); weapons.Add(weapon != null ? weapon : unit.Weapon); tiers.Add(Mathf.Clamp(tier, 1, 3));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class OutsideStageChoice : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private readonly List<GameObject> actors = new List<GameObject>();
        private readonly Vector2[] rewardPositions = { new Vector2(-3, -0.8f), new Vector2(0, -0.8f), new Vector2(3, -0.8f) };
        public static readonly Vector2 ChallengePosition = new Vector2(6.1f, 0.3f);
        public bool Focused => owner != null && owner.Session.OutsideChallengeAvailable && Vector2.Distance(owner.Simulation.Champion.Position, ChallengePosition) < 1.6f;
        private int mode;
        private float hold;
        private int selection = -1;
        private GUIStyle title;
        private GUIStyle copy;
        private Vector2 descriptionScroll;
        private int preview;
        public void Configure(ArenaController controller) { owner = controller; }
        private void Clear() { foreach (GameObject actor in actors) Destroy(actor); actors.Clear(); hold = 0; selection = -1; }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner == null || owner.Session == null) return;
            int desired = owner.Session.State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Reward ? 2 : owner.Session.OutsideChallengeAvailable ? 1 : 0;
            if (desired != mode) { Clear(); mode = desired; Build(); }
            if (mode == 0 || owner.PresentationPaused || owner.TransitionPending) { hold = 0; return; }
            Vector2 player = owner.Simulation.Champion.Position;
            int near = -1;
            if (mode == 1) { if (Focused) near = 0; }
            else for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) if (Vector2.Distance(player, rewardPositions[index]) < 1.05f) near = index;
            if (selection != near) { selection = near; hold = 0; if (near >= 0) { preview = near; descriptionScroll = Vector2.zero; } }
            bool pressed = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.JoystickButton0);
            hold = selection >= 0 && pressed ? hold + Time.deltaTime : 0;
            float time = owner.PresentationClock;
            for (int index = 0; index < actors.Count; index++)
            {
                Vector2 origin = mode == 1 ? ChallengePosition : rewardPositions[index];
                Vector3 hovering = DreamLevitation.Offset(time, 70 + index, NightmareRules.Depth(owner.Session.State.Wave), PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion);
                SpriteRenderer view = actors[index].GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
                actors[index].transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, DreamLevitation.Tilt(time, 70 + index, PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion));
                WorldSpriteGrounding.Place(view, (Vector3)origin + hovering);
                actors[index].GetComponent<GroundShadow>().Display(view.sprite, origin, mode == 1 ? 2.2f : .8f, hovering.y, .28f);
                actors[index].GetComponent<DreamSuspension>().Display(origin, (Vector3)origin + hovering, mode == 1 ? 2.2f : .8f, time, 70 + index, view.sortingOrder - 1, 1);
            }
            if (hold < 0.85f) return;
            hold = 0;
            if (mode == 1) owner.AcceptOutsideChallenge(); else owner.ClaimOutsideReward(selection);
        }
        private void Build()
        {
            OutsideStageAssets assets = OutsideStageAssets.Current;
            if (mode == 0 || assets == null) return;
            for (int index = 0; index < (mode == 1 ? 1 : 3); index++)
            {
                var actor = new GameObject(mode == 1 ? "TheHandWaits" : "PrismaticReward" + index); actor.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
                SpriteRenderer sprite = actor.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
                if (mode == 1) sprite.sprite = CarrierArtwork.Current != null ? CarrierArtwork.Current.Hand[0] : assets.BossFrames[4];
                else
                {
                    string id = owner.Session.State.OutsideRewards[index];
                    ItemDefinition item = owner.Content.Item(id); sprite.sprite = item == null ? owner.Content.Unit(id).Body : item.Icon;
                }
                sprite.sortingOrder = 950; actor.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * ((mode == 1 ? 2.5f : 1.1f) / Mathf.Max(0.01f, sprite.sprite.bounds.size.x));
                GroundShadow shadow = actor.AddComponent<GroundShadow>(); shadow.Display(sprite.sprite, mode == 1 ? ChallengePosition : rewardPositions[index], mode == 1 ? 2.2f : 0.8f, 0.5f, 0.22f);
                actor.AddComponent<DreamSuspension>();
                var glow = new GameObject("BoundPrismaticLight"); glow.transform.SetParent(actor.transform, false);
                glow.AddComponent<ShopRarityGlow>().Configure(ItemRarity.Rainbow, owner, index, sprite);
                actors.Add(actor);
            }
        }
        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (mode == 0 || owner == null || owner.TransitionPending || owner.PresentationPaused) return;
            GUISkin previousSkin = GUI.skin; GUI.skin = ArcadeSkin.Skin;
            GUIStyle choiceButton = new GUIStyle(GUI.skin.button) { font = ArcadeTypography.Heading, fontSize = 22, wordWrap = true, padding = new RectOffset(16, 16, 8, 8) };
            if (title == null)
            {
                title = new GUIStyle(GUI.skin.label) { font = ArcadeTypography.Body, fontSize = 28, alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter, wordWrap = true };
                title.normal.textColor = new Color(0.68f, 1, 0.92f);
                copy = new GUIStyle(title) { fontSize = 19 }; copy.normal.textColor = Color.white;
            }
            Matrix4x4 matrix = GUI.matrix;
            GUI.matrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(Vector3.zero, Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(Screen.width / 1920f, Screen.height / 1080f, 1));
            if (mode == 1)
            {
                if (Focused && GUI.Button(new Rect(1430, 710, 340, 70), "CHALLENGE KEEPER")) owner.AcceptOutsideChallenge();
                GUI.Label(new Rect(340, 870, 1240, 42), owner.Session.State.Secrets?.LetterSent == true ? "YOUR LETTER REACHED THE HAND THAT CARRIED YOU" : "THE HAND THAT CARRIED YOU IS WAITING", title);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(340, 915, 1240, 70), selection >= 0 ? "Hold Space / A to challenge • Defeat ends this run • Win: choose one prismatic reward" : "Approach the hand to challenge its owner. The normal exit remains available.", copy);
            }
            else
            {
                GUI.Label(new Rect(340, 180, 1240, 55), "TAKE ONE IMPOSSIBLE GIFT", title);
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                {
                    string rewardId = owner.Session.State.OutsideRewards[i];
                    string rewardName = owner.Content.Item(rewardId)?.Name ?? owner.Content.Unit(rewardId).DisplayName;
                    if (GUI.Button(new Rect(340 + i * 420, 725, 400, 62), rewardName, choiceButton)) { preview = i; descriptionScroll = Vector2.zero; }
                }
                int shown = preview;
                string id = owner.Session.State.OutsideRewards[shown]; ItemDefinition item = owner.Content.Item(id); UnitDefinition ally = owner.Content.Unit(id);
                Rect panel = new Rect(370, 805, 1180, 205);
                ArcadeSkin.Ticket(panel, new Color(.11f, .09f, .19f, .98f), RunModifierRules.RarityColor(ItemRarity.Rainbow));
                GUI.Label(new Rect(395, 815, 1130, 36), item?.Name ?? ally.DisplayName, title);
                string detail = item == null ? CompanionDescriptions.Describe(ally) + "\nWeapon rolls when claimed." : RunModifierRules.Describe(item, 1);
                bool full = item == null && owner.Session.State.Roster.Count >= owner.Session.CompanionLimit;
                if (full) detail = "BRIGADE FULL / 15 COMPANIONS. Choose a relic gift instead.\n\n" + detail;
                GUIStyle detailStyle = new GUIStyle(copy) { alignment = TextAnchor.UpperLeft, fontSize = 19 };
                float height = Mathf.Max(90, detailStyle.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(detail), 1080));
                descriptionScroll = GUI.BeginScrollView(new Rect(395, 860, 1125, 90), descriptionScroll, new Rect(0, 0, 1080, height));
                GUI.Label(new Rect(0, 0, 1080, height), detail, detailStyle); GUI.EndScrollView();
                bool previousEnabled = GUI.enabled; GUI.enabled = previousEnabled && !full;
                if (GUI.Button(new Rect(1040, 958, 470, 42), full ? "BRIGADE FULL / CHOOSE A RELIC" : "CLAIM THIS GIFT", choiceButton)) owner.ClaimOutsideReward(shown);
                GUI.enabled = previousEnabled;
                GUI.Label(new Rect(395, 960, 620, 40), "Choose one. The other two gifts vanish.", copy);
            }
            if (selection >= 0 && hold > 0) GUI.Label(new Rect(760, 1020, 400, 35), Mathf.RoundToInt(Mathf.Clamp01(hold / 0.85f) * 100) + "%", copy);
            GUI.matrix = matrix;
            GUI.skin = previousSkin;
        }
        private void OnDestroy() => Clear();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum StageCarrier { Hand, CarpetTongue, KeyholeEye }

    public sealed class StageTransfer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private Action completed;
        private SpriteRenderer courier;
        private Sprite[] frames;
        private UnitVisual[] passengers;
        private Vector2 origin;
        private float age;
        private bool active;
        private GroundShadow grounded;
        private bool outsideHand;
        private readonly SpriteRenderer[] trail = new SpriteRenderer[6];
        private Sprite[] dust;
        public StageCarrier Kind { get; private set; }
        public bool Active => active;
        public float ElapsedSeconds => age;
        public Vector2 VisualPlayerPosition => PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? origin : PassengerPosition(origin, age, Kind);
        public static bool ChangesMap(int wave) => wave > 1 && (wave - 1) % 4 == 0;
        public static StageCarrier CarrierFor(int wave) => (StageCarrier)(Mathf.Max(0, (wave - 5) / 4) % 3);

        public void Configure(ArenaController controller, Action onComplete)
        {
            owner = controller; completed = onComplete; active = true;
            origin = owner.Simulation.Champion.Position;
            CarnivalStageAssets assets = Resources.Load<CarnivalStageAssets>("CarnivalStageAssets");
            frames = assets != null ? assets.Courier : new Sprite[0];
            OutsideStageAssets outside = OutsideStageAssets.Current;
            if (outside != null && outside.BossFrames.Length == 16)
            {
                outsideHand = true;
                Kind = owner.Session.State.OutsideStage == OutsideStageStatus.Fighting ? StageCarrier.Hand : CarrierFor(owner.Session.State.Wave);
                int first = Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? 8 : Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? 12 : 4;
                frames = new[] { outside.BossFrames[first], outside.BossFrames[first + 1], outside.BossFrames[first + 2] };
            }
            passengers = FindObjectsByType<UnitVisual>();
            CarrierArtwork artwork = CarrierArtwork.Current;
            if (artwork != null && artwork.For(Kind)?.Length == 3) { frames = artwork.For(Kind); outsideHand = true; }
            courier = gameObject.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>(); courier.sortingOrder = 500;
            grounded = gameObject.AddComponent<GroundShadow>();
            PaintedAnimationLibrary painted = Resources.Load<PaintedAnimationLibrary>("PaintedAnimationLibrary");
            dust = painted != null ? painted.Dust : null;
            for (int index = 0; index < trail.Length; index++)
            {
                var child = new GameObject("CarrierLandingDust" + index);
                child.transform.SetParent(owner.transform, false); trail[index] = child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
                trail[index].sortingOrder = 420;
            }
            CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("shop.descend");
            CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("boss.telegraph");
        }

        public static Vector2 PassengerPosition(Vector2 start, float seconds)
            => PassengerPosition(start, seconds, StageCarrier.Hand);

        public static Vector2 PassengerPosition(Vector2 start, float seconds, StageCarrier kind)
        {
            Vector2 destination = new Vector2(0, -0.2f);
            Vector2 release = kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? Vector2.Lerp(start, destination, 0.5f) + Vector2.up * 1.5f : Vector2.Lerp(start, destination, 0.75f) + Vector2.up;
            if (seconds < 0.4f) return start;
            if (seconds < 1.3f)
            {
                float progress = Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, (seconds - 0.4f) / 0.9f);
                Vector2 pickup = Vector2.Lerp(start, release, progress);
                if (kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue) pickup += Vector2.right * Mathf.Sin(progress * Mathf.PI) * 0.7f;
                return pickup;
            }
            float flight = Mathf.Clamp01((seconds - 1.3f) / 0.9f);
            return Vector2.Lerp(release, destination, flight) + Vector2.up * Mathf.Sin(flight * Mathf.PI) * (kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? 2.1f : 1.4f);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!active || owner == null || owner.PresentationPaused) return;
            float previousAge = age;
            age += Mathf.Clamp(Time.unscaledDeltaTime, 0, 0.05f);
            if (!PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion)
            {
                if (previousAge < .4f && age >= .4f) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("boss.attack");
                if (previousAge < 1.3f && age >= 1.3f) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("voice.dream.gasp");
                if (previousAge < 2.2f && age >= 2.2f) CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("boss.enter");
            }
            bool reduced = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion;
            for (int index = 0; index < trail.Length; index++)
            {
                SpriteRenderer cloud = trail[index];
                float birth = index < 3 ? .38f + index * .035f : 2.15f + (index - 3) * .035f;
                float progress = Mathf.Clamp01((age - birth) / .4f);
                cloud.enabled = !reduced && !PresentationSettings.ReducedEffects && dust != null && dust.Length > 0 && age >= birth && progress < 1;
                if (!cloud.enabled) continue;
                cloud.sprite = dust[Mathf.Min(dust.Length - 1, Mathf.FloorToInt(progress * dust.Length))];
                Vector2 basePosition = index < 3 ? origin : new Vector2(0, -.2f);
                cloud.transform.position = basePosition + new Vector2((index % 3 - 1) * (.3f + progress * .5f), -.3f + progress * .15f);
                cloud.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
                float width = (.45f + progress * .6f) / Mathf.Max(.01f, cloud.sprite.bounds.size.x);
                cloud.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * width;
                cloud.color = new Color(.72f, .65f, .77f, (1 - progress) * .38f);
            }
            if (frames.Length > 0)
            {
                int pose = Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? age < 0.6f ? 0 : age < 1 ? 1 : age < 1.3f ? 2 : 0 : Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? age < 0.35f ? 0 : age < 0.85f ? 1 : age < 1.3f ? 0 : 2 : age < 0.45f ? 0 : age < 1.3f ? 1 : 2;
                courier.sprite = frames[outsideHand ? reduced ? 0 : pose : reduced ? 0 : 2 + Mathf.FloorToInt(age * 7) % 4];
                float width = outsideHand ? Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? 4.2f : Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? 5.8f : 7.2f : 3.8f;
                courier.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * (width / Mathf.Max(0.01f, courier.sprite.bounds.size.x));
                Vector2 passenger = PassengerPosition(origin, age, Kind);
                Vector2 approach = Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? Vector2.up * 6 : Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? Vector2.down * 6 : Vector2.left * 8;
                Vector2 position = age < 0.4f ? Vector2.Lerp(origin + approach, origin, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, age / 0.4f)) : age < 1.3f ? passenger : Vector2.Lerp(PassengerPosition(origin, 1.3f, Kind), new Vector2(9, 4), Mathf.Clamp01((age - 1.3f) / 1.1f));
                float offset = Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? 1.1f : outsideHand ? 1.25f : 0.45f;
                transform.position = reduced ? origin + Vector2.up : position + Vector2.down * offset;
                float rotation = Kind == StageCarrier.KeyholeEye ? Mathf.Sin(age * 2) * 5 : age < 1.3f ? Mathf.Sin(age * 2) * -8 : Mathf.Lerp(-8, Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? -35 : 22, Mathf.Clamp01((age - 1.3f) / 0.5f));
                transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, outsideHand && !reduced ? rotation : 0);
                courier.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, Mathf.Clamp01((2.6f - age) * 2));
                grounded.Configure(courier.sprite);
                grounded.Display(courier.sprite, (Vector2)transform.position - Vector2.up * (reduced ? 0 : 1.1f), width, reduced ? 0 : 1.1f, 0.22f * courier.color.a);
            }
            if (age < (reduced ? 0.6f : 2.6f)) return;
            active = false;
            Vector2 destination = new Vector2(0, -0.2f);
            foreach (UnitState unit in owner.Simulation.Units)
                if (unit.Alive && unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
                {
                    Vector2 relative = unit.Position - origin;
                    unit.Position = unit.PreviousPosition = owner.Simulation.ClampPosition(destination + relative, unit.Definition.Radius);
                }
            owner.Simulation.Champion.Position = owner.Simulation.Champion.PreviousPosition = destination;
            RestorePassengers(); completed?.Invoke(); Destroy(gameObject);
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (!active || PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion) return;
            Vector2 offset = PassengerPosition(origin, age, Kind) - origin;
            foreach (UnitVisual passenger in passengers)
                if (passenger != null && passenger.State != null && passenger.State.Alive && passenger.State.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
                {
                    passenger.transform.position = (Vector3)(passenger.State.Position + offset);
                    float grip = Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01((age - .4f) / .6f));
                    float landing = 1 - Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, Mathf.Clamp01((age - 1.6f) / .6f));
                    passenger.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, grip * landing * (Kind == StageCarrier.CarpetTongue ? -14 : 9));
                    float lift = age < 0.4f ? 0 : age < 1.3f ? Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, (age - 0.4f) / 0.9f) : Mathf.Max(0, 1 - (age - 1.3f) / 0.9f) + Mathf.Sin(Mathf.Clamp01((age - 1.3f) / 0.9f) * Mathf.PI) * 1.4f;
                    passenger.TransportShadow(offset, lift);
                }
        }
        private void RestorePassengers()
        {
            if (passengers == null) return;
            foreach (UnitVisual passenger in passengers) if (passenger != null) passenger.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
        }
        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            RestorePassengers();
            foreach (SpriteRenderer cloud in trail) if (cloud != null) Destroy(cloud.gameObject);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class BuildMorphAppearance : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private sealed class Part
        {
            public SpriteRenderer View;
            public Vector2 Offset;
            public float Height;
            public int Layer, Orbit = -1;
            public bool Weapon;
        }
        private readonly List<Part> parts = new List<Part>();
        private SpriteRenderer body, weapon;
        public int PartCount => parts.Count;
        public void Build(UnitState unit, SpriteRenderer bodyView, SpriteRenderer weaponView)
        {
            Clear(); body = bodyView; weapon = weaponView;
            int stage = Mathf.Clamp(unit.Definition.BuildMorphStage, 0, 3);
            if (unit.Faction == Faction.Enemy || stage == 0) return;
            BuildMorphArtwork art = Resources.Load<BuildMorphArtwork>("BuildMorphArtwork");
            if (art == null) return;
            BuildMorphKind kind = unit.Definition.BuildMorph;
            void Add(Sprite sprite, Vector2 offset, float height, int layer, bool onWeapon = false, int orbit = -1)
            {
                if (sprite == null) return;
                var child = new GameObject("Build" + kind + "Part" + parts.Count); child.transform.SetParent(onWeapon ? weapon.transform : body.transform, false);
                var view = child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>(); view.sprite = sprite; view.sharedMaterial = body.sharedMaterial;
                parts.Add(new Part { View = view, Offset = offset, Height = height, Layer = layer, Weapon = onWeapon, Orbit = orbit });
            }
            Add(art.Charm(kind), new Vector2(-.08f, -.13f), .25f, 6);
            Add(art.Charm(kind), new Vector2(-.25f, -.2f), .29f, 6, true);
            if (stage >= 2)
            {
                Add(art.Back(kind), new Vector2(-.3f, .32f), stage == 3 ? 1.65f : 1.35f, -3);
                Add(art.Charm(kind), new Vector2(-.35f, .14f), .26f, 5);
                Add(art.Charm(kind), new Vector2(.34f, .14f), .26f, 5);
            }
            if (stage == 3)
            {
                Add(art.Charm(kind), new Vector2(0, .62f), .3f, 6);
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) Add(art.Charm(kind), Vector2.zero, .19f, 3, orbit: i);
            }
        }
        public void Display(UnitState unit, float time, int order, bool reduced)
        {
            if (body == null || body.sprite == null) return;
            Rect bodyInk = SpriteInkMetrics.BoundsOf(body.sprite);
            foreach (Part part in parts)
            {
                part.View.enabled = unit.Alive;
                SpriteRenderer anchor = part.Weapon ? weapon : body;
                if (anchor == null || anchor.sprite == null) { part.View.enabled = false; continue; }
                if (part.Weapon && !anchor.enabled) part.View.enabled = false;
                Rect ink = part.Weapon ? SpriteInkMetrics.BoundsOf(anchor.sprite) : bodyInk;
                Vector2 offset = part.Offset;
                if (!part.Weapon && part.Orbit < 0 && unit.Facing.x < 0) offset.x = -offset.x;
                if (part.Orbit >= 0)
                {
                    float angle = (reduced ? 0 : time * 26) + part.Orbit * 120 + (int)unit.Definition.BuildMorph * 11;
                    float a = angle * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
                    offset = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(a) * .64f, .21f + Mathf.Sin(a) * .34f);
                }
                part.View.transform.localPosition = (Vector3)(ink.center + offset * ink.height);
                Rect partInk = SpriteInkMetrics.BoundsOf(part.View.sprite);
                float scale = ink.height * part.Height / Mathf.Max(.01f, partInk.height);
                part.View.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * scale;
                // Trimmed atlas pivots are at the bottom: centre the visible ink explicitly.
                part.View.transform.localPosition -= (Vector3)(partInk.center * scale);
                float sway = reduced || part.Orbit >= 0 ? 0 : Mathf.Sin(time * 3 + unit.Id) * (unit.Velocity.sqrMagnitude > .1f ? 4 : 1);
                part.View.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, sway);
                part.View.sortingOrder = (part.Weapon ? weapon.sortingOrder : order) + part.Layer;
                float alpha = part.Orbit >= 0 ? PresentationSettings.ReducedEffects ? .65f : .9f : 1;
                part.View.color = new Color(1, 1, 1, alpha);
            }
        }
        public static Vector2 WeaponShape(UnitDefinition unit)
        {
            float growth = Mathf.Clamp(unit.BuildMorphStage, 0, 3) * .045f;
            switch (unit.BuildMorph)
            {
                case BuildMorphKind.Thread: case BuildMorphKind.Frost: return new Vector2(1, 1 + growth);
                case BuildMorphKind.Clockwork: case BuildMorphKind.Paper: return new Vector2(1 + growth, 1 + growth * .4f);
                case BuildMorphKind.Chorus: case BuildMorphKind.Porcelain: return new Vector2(1 + growth * .3f, 1 + growth);
                default: return Vector2.one * (1 + growth * .5f);
            }
        }
        public void Clear()
        {
            foreach (Part part in parts) if (part.View != null) { part.View.enabled = false; if (Application.isPlaying) Destroy(part.View.gameObject); else DestroyImmediate(part.View.gameObject); }
            parts.Clear();
        }
        public void Fade(float alpha)
        {
            foreach (Part part in parts) { Color color = part.View.color; color.a *= alpha; part.View.color = color; }
        }
        private void OnDestroy() => Clear();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class CharacterActingEntry
    {
        public string Id;
        public string Alias;
        public float ReferenceHeight;
        public Sprite[] Curious;
        public Sprite[] Cheer;
        public Sprite[] Hurt;
        public Sprite[] Defeat;
        public Sprite Preview(int cue, float progress) => Frame(cue == 0 ? Curious : cue == 1 ? Cheer : cue == 2 ? Hurt : cue == 3 ? Defeat : null, progress);
        public Sprite Select(bool alive, float hurtAge, bool attacking, float celebrationAge, float curiosity, bool moving, bool reduced)
        {
            if (reduced) return null;
            if (!alive) return Frame(Defeat, 0);
            if (hurtAge >= 0 && hurtAge < .18f) return Frame(Hurt, hurtAge / .18f);
            if (attacking || moving) return null;
            if (celebrationAge >= 0 && celebrationAge < .7f) return Frame(Cheer, celebrationAge / .7f);
            if (curiosity >= 0 && curiosity < 1) return Frame(Curious, curiosity);
            return null;
        }
        public static Sprite Frame(Sprite[] frames, float progress) => frames == null || frames.Length == 0 ? null : frames[Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(Mathf.Clamp01(progress) * frames.Length), 0, frames.Length - 1)];
    }
    public sealed class CharacterActingLibrary : ScriptableObject
    {
        public CharacterActingEntry[] Entries = Array.Empty<CharacterActingEntry>();
        private static CharacterActingLibrary cached;
        public static CharacterActingLibrary Current => cached != null ? cached : cached = Resources.Load<CharacterActingLibrary>("CharacterActingLibrary");
        public CharacterActingEntry Find(string id)
        {
            foreach (CharacterActingEntry entry in Entries) if (entry.Id == id || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Alias) && entry.Alias == id) return entry;
            return null;
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetState() { cached = null; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class HeroIdentityVisual : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private sealed class View { public LineRenderer Ink, Colour; public SpriteRenderer Ghost; }
        private readonly List<View> pool=new List<View>();
        private Material material;
        public int VisibleCount { get; private set; }
        public void Display(CombatSimulation s)
        {
            VisibleCount=0;
            if(s!=null && s.HeroIdentityEnabled && (s.Phase==RunPhase.Combat || s.Phase==RunPhase.Paused))foreach(var g in s.HeroIdentityGlyphs)
            {
                if(VisibleCount>=EffectDensity.Limit(28))break;
                View v=Acquire(VisibleCount++);bool line=g.Shape==MorphGeometry.Line,seal=g.Shape==MorphGeometry.Seal,arc=g.Shape==MorphGeometry.Crescent;
                float fade=Mathf.Clamp01((g.Until-s.Elapsed)/.3f),alpha=(s.Elapsed<g.At?.35f:.75f)*fade*EffectDensity.AlliedAlpha;
                Color c=HeroIdentities.For(s.Champion.Definition.Id).Color;c.a=alpha;
                v.Colour.startColor=v.Colour.endColor=c;v.Ink.startColor=v.Ink.endColor=new Color(.035f,.055f,.09f,alpha);
                int count=line?2:seal?4:arc?25:40;
                v.Colour.positionCount=v.Ink.positionCount=count;v.Colour.loop=v.Ink.loop=!line&&!arc;
                v.Colour.widthMultiplier=PresentationSettings.HighReadability?.035f:.05f;v.Ink.widthMultiplier=.085f;
                for(int i=0;i<count;i++)
                {
                    Vector2 at;
                    if(line)at=i==0?g.Position:g.End;
                    else if(seal)at=g.Position+(Vector2)(Quaternion.Euler(0,0,45+i*90)*Vector2.right)*g.Radius;
                    else {float a=arc?Mathf.Atan2(g.Direction.y,g.Direction.x)-1.4f+i*2.8f/(count-1):i*Mathf.PI*2/count;at=g.Position+new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(a),Mathf.Sin(a))*g.Radius;}
                    v.Ink.SetPosition(i,at);v.Colour.SetPosition(i,at);
                }
                v.Ink.enabled=v.Colour.enabled=true;v.Ghost.enabled=g.Portrait!=null;
                if(g.Portrait!=null){v.Ghost.sprite=g.Portrait;Rect ink=SpriteInkMetrics.BoundsOf(g.Portrait);float scale=s.Champion.Definition.BodyHeight/Mathf.Max(.01f,ink.height);v.Ghost.transform.localScale=Vector3.one*scale;v.Ghost.transform.position=(Vector3)g.Position-(Vector3)(ink.center*scale);v.Ghost.color=new Color(c.r,c.g,c.b,alpha*.4f);}
            }
            for(int i=VisibleCount;i<pool.Count;i++)pool[i].Ink.enabled=pool[i].Colour.enabled=pool[i].Ghost.enabled=false;
        }
        private View Acquire(int index)
        {
            if(index<pool.Count)return pool[index];
            if(material==null)material=new Material(Shader.Find("Sprites/Default"));
            LineRenderer Make(string name,int layer){var go=new GameObject(name);go.transform.SetParent(transform,false);var r=go.AddComponent<LineRenderer>();r.sharedMaterial=material;r.useWorldSpace=true;r.numCapVertices=3;r.sortingOrder=layer;return r;}
            var ghost=new GameObject("HeroDream");ghost.transform.SetParent(transform,false);var sprite=ghost.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();sprite.sortingOrder=1090;
            var view=new View{Ink=Make("HeroInk",1088),Colour=Make("HeroColour",1089),Ghost=sprite};pool.Add(view);return view;
        }
        private void OnDestroy(){if(material!=null)Destroy(material);}
    }
}
````
