````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-60)]
    public sealed class MienChoPresentation : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private int chapter, page;
        private bool open;
        private bool lives;
        private int creature;
        private GUIStyle title, copy, button, small;
        private Vector2 scroll;
        private readonly Texture2D[] panels = new Texture2D[3];
        public bool Open => open;
        public int Chapter => chapter;
        public int Page => page;
        public int InputConsumedFrame { get; private set; } = -1;
        private float nextNavigation;
        private MienChoMemory Memory
        {
            get
            {
                owner.Session.State.MienCho ??= new MienChoMemory();
                if (owner.Session.State.MienCho.Pages == null || owner.Session.State.MienCho.Pages.Length == 0) owner.Session.State.MienCho.Pages = new int[MienChoStory.For(owner.Session.State).Length];
                return owner.Session.State.MienCho;
            }
        }
        public void Configure(ArenaController value)
        {
            owner = value;
            panels[0] = Resources.Load<Texture2D>("MienCho/WithheldDawn");
            panels[1] = Resources.Load<Texture2D>("MienCho/WaitingRoom");
            panels[2] = Resources.Load<Texture2D>("MienCho/OpenDawn");
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null) return;
            if (open)
            {
                if (!Application.isFocused && !RunPaths.Diagnostic) return;
                if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Return) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton0)) Advance();
                else if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton1) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton7)) { if (lives) { lives = false; scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume(); } else Close(); }
                else if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton2)) { lives = !lives; scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume(); }
                else if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.LeftArrow) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton4)) { if (lives) { creature = Mathf.Max(0, creature - 1); scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume(); } else Previous(); }
                else if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.RightArrow) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton5)) { if (lives) { creature++; scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume(); } else Advance(); }
                Vector2 pad = ArcadeNavigation.Pad;
                float vertical = Mathf.Abs(pad.y) > .2f ? pad.y : 0;
                if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.DownArrow)) vertical = -1;
                if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.UpArrow)) vertical = 1;
                scroll.y = Mathf.Max(0, scroll.y - vertical * Time.unscaledDeltaTime * 440);
                if (Time.unscaledTime >= nextNavigation && (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.PageDown) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.PageUp)))
                { SelectChapter(chapter + (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.PageDown) ? 1 : -1)); nextNavigation = Time.unscaledTime + .2f; }
                return;
            }
            if (owner.PresentationPaused || owner.TransitionPending || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen || owner.NightmareEndingVisible) return;
            if (owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Victory || owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Defeat) return;
            int unread = MienChoStory.NextUnread(owner.Session.State);
            if (unread >= 0 && (!RunPaths.Diagnostic || MienChoCapture.AllowAutomaticScenes)) Show(unread);
            else if (owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.J) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton9))) Show(Mathf.Max(0, MienChoStory.Available(owner.Session.State) - 1));
        }
        public void Show(int index)
        {
            if (owner?.Simulation == null || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen || owner.TransitionPending || owner.HallExitPending || owner.PresentationPaused && !open || index < 0 || index >= MienChoStory.Available(owner.Session.State)) return;
            chapter = index; page = Memory.Pages[index]; lives = false; scroll = Vector2.zero; open = true; Consume();
            owner.SetStoryOpen(true);
            CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("ui.page");
        }
        public void Advance()
        {
            if (!open) return;
            Consume();
            if (lives) { lives = false; scroll = Vector2.zero; return; }
            if (page + 1 >= MienChoStory.For(owner.Session.State)[chapter].Pages.Length)
            {
                int finished = Memory.FinishedMask; Memory.FinishedMask |= 1 << chapter;
                if (!owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()) { Memory.FinishedMask = finished; return; }
                Close(); return;
            }
            SetPage(page + 1);
            scroll = Vector2.zero; CheckpointAudio.PlayInterfaceId("ui.page");
        }
        private void Consume() => InputConsumedFrame = Time.frameCount;
        private void SetPage(int value)
        {
            int previous = Memory.Pages[chapter]; Memory.Pages[chapter] = value;
            if (owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()) page = value;
            else Memory.Pages[chapter] = previous;
        }
        private void Previous() { Consume(); SetPage(Mathf.Max(0, page - 1)); scroll = Vector2.zero; }
        public void SelectChapter(int index)
        {
            if (!open) return;
            chapter = Mathf.Clamp(index, 0, MienChoStory.Available(owner.Session.State) - 1);
            page = Memory.Pages[chapter]; lives = false; scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume();
        }
        public void Close()
        {
            if (!open) return;
            Consume();
            var state = owner.Session.State;
            state.MienCho ??= new MienChoMemory();
            int before = state.MienCho.ReadMask;
            state.MienCho.ReadMask |= 1 << chapter;
            if (!owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()) { state.MienCho.ReadMask = before; return; }
            open = false; owner.SetStoryOpen(false);
        }
        public void Draw(Camera camera)
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null) return;
            Matrix4x4 old = ArcadeTypography.BeginViewport(camera.pixelRect, 1920, 1080);
            if (title == null)
            {
                title = ArcadeTypography.Style(36, true); copy = ArcadeTypography.Style(27); copy.wordWrap = true;
                button = ArcadeTypography.Style(22, true); button.alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;
                small = ArcadeTypography.Style(20); small.wordWrap = true;
            }
            if (!open)
            {
                if (owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && !owner.PresentationPaused && !owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen && !owner.TransitionPending)
                    if (Press(new Rect(1540, 955, 310, 55), "WAITING JOURNAL  [J]")) Show(Mathf.Max(0, MienChoStory.Available(owner.Session.State) - 1));
                GUI.matrix = old; return;
            }
            RunHud.Fill(new Rect(0, 0, 1920, 1080), new Color(.015f, .023f, .043f, 1));
            if (lives) { DrawLives(); GUI.matrix = old; return; }
            var c = MienChoStory.For(owner.Session.State)[chapter];
            var image = panels[c.Image == "WaitingRoom" ? 1 : c.Image == "OpenDawn" ? 2 : 0];
            if (image != null) GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(60, 150, 720, 540), image, ScaleMode.ScaleToFit);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(70, 55, 1780, 75), "MIEN CHO / " + c.Title, title);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(80, 790, 680, 120), "EVIDENCE\n" + c.Evidence, small);
            if (Press(new Rect(80, 710, 680, 65), "THE PEOPLE TRAVELLING WITH YOU")) ShowLives();
            GUI.Label(new Rect(850, 145, 990, 50), "CHAPTER " + (chapter + 1) + " / PAGE " + (page + 1) + " OF " + c.Pages.Length, small);
            string text = c.Pages[page];
            if (chapter == 0 && page == 0) text += "\n\nYOUR ARRIVAL\n" + WaitingArrivals.For(owner.Session.State.ChampionId);
            float height = Mathf.Max(650, copy.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(text), 940) + 30);
            scroll = GUI.BeginScrollView(new Rect(850, 210, 1000, 660), scroll, new Rect(0, 0, 955, height));
            GUI.Label(new Rect(0, 0, 940, height), text, copy); GUI.EndScrollView();
            for (int i = 0; i < MienChoStory.Available(owner.Session.State); i++)
                if (Press(new Rect(70 + i % 5 * 125, 910 + i / 5 * 65, 110, 50), (i + 1) + ((Memory.FinishedMask & 1 << i) != 0 ? " / READ" : ""))) SelectChapter(i);
            if (Press(new Rect(850, 925, 200, 65), "PREVIOUS")) Previous();
            if (Press(new Rect(1070, 925, 490, 65), page + 1 == c.Pages.Length ? "KEEP THE EVIDENCE / CLOSE" : "CONTINUE  [ENTER]")) Advance();
            if (Press(new Rect(1580, 925, 270, 65), "READ LATER  [ESC]")) Close();
            GUI.Label(new Rect(850, 1000, 1000, 65), "Paused / page saved. Stick or arrows: scroll / LB-RB: pages / X: companions / PgUp-PgDn: chapters.", small);
            GUI.matrix = old;
        }
        private bool Press(Rect rectangle, string text)
        {
            ArcadeSkin.Plate(rectangle, ArcadeSkin.Teal);
            return GUI.Button(rectangle, text, button);
        }
        public void ShowLives() { if (!open) return; lives = true; scroll = Vector2.zero; Consume(); }
        public void DrawDawn(Rect rectangle)
        {
            if (panels[2] != null) GUI.DrawTexture(rectangle, panels[2], ScaleMode.ScaleToFit);
            var ids = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string> { owner.Session.State.ChampionId };
            foreach (var ally in owner.Session.State.Roster) ids.Add(ally.UnitId);
            GUI.BeginGroup(rectangle);
            int columns = Mathf.Min(8, ids.Count);
            float width = Mathf.Min(112, (rectangle.width - 40) / Mathf.Max(1, columns));
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.Count; i++)
            {
                var unit = owner.Content.Unit(ids[i]);
                if (unit == null) continue;
                Sprite frame = unit.AnimationFrames.Length == 0 ? unit.Body : unit.AnimationFrames[PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? 0 : Mathf.FloorToInt(owner.PresentationClock * 1.8f + i) % unit.AnimationFrames.Length];
                float x = (rectangle.width - columns * width) * .5f + i % columns * width;
                float y = rectangle.height - 125 - i / columns * 108;
                RunHud.Sprite(new Rect(x, y, width, 105), frame);
            }
            GUI.EndGroup();
        }
        private void DrawLives()
        {
            var ids = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            foreach (var entry in owner.Session.State.Roster) if (!ids.Contains(entry.UnitId)) ids.Add(entry.UnitId);
            foreach (var entry in owner.Session.State.AcquiredVariants) if (!ids.Contains(entry.UnitId)) ids.Add(entry.UnitId);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(70, 55, 1780, 75), "MIEN CHO / LIVES ALONGSIDE YOURS", title);
            if (ids.Count == 0) GUI.Label(new Rect(100, 250, 1500, 200), "Every creature you meet has a life before and after this crossing. Recruit a companion to learn their origin here.", copy);
            else
            {
                creature = Mathf.Clamp(creature, 0, ids.Count - 1);
                var id = ids[creature]; var unit = owner.Content.Unit(id);
                RunHud.Sprite(new Rect(100, 220, 560, 470), unit.Body);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(100, 730, 650, 120), unit.DisplayName + "\n" + (creature + 1) + " / " + ids.Count, title);
                string text = "LIFE IN THE WAITING REALM\n" + CreatureLives.Origin(id) + "\n\nALONG THE CROSSING\n" + CreatureLives.Arc(id, owner.Session.State.Wave) + WaitingCompanionQuests.Consequences(owner.Session.State, id);
                float height = Mathf.Max(650, copy.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(text), 940) + 30);
                scroll = GUI.BeginScrollView(new Rect(850, 180, 1000, 690), scroll, new Rect(0, 0, 955, height));
                GUI.Label(new Rect(0, 0, 940, height), text, copy); GUI.EndScrollView();
                if (Press(new Rect(100, 900, 260, 65), "PREVIOUS FRIEND")) { creature = (creature + ids.Count - 1) % ids.Count; scroll = Vector2.zero; }
                if (Press(new Rect(390, 900, 260, 65), "NEXT FRIEND")) { creature = (creature + 1) % ids.Count; scroll = Vector2.zero; }
            }
            if (Press(new Rect(900, 925, 450, 65), "RETURN TO EVIDENCE")) { lives = false; scroll = Vector2.zero; }
            if (Press(new Rect(1400, 925, 450, 65), "CLOSE JOURNAL  [ESC]")) Close();
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class ArenaController
    {
        public bool StoryOpen => GetComponent<MienChoPresentation>()?.Open == true || GetComponent<WaitingJourney>()?.Open == true;
        public bool StoryConsumesInput => StoryOpen || GetComponent<MienChoPresentation>()?.InputConsumedFrame == Time.frameCount || GetComponent<WaitingJourney>()?.InputConsumedFrame == Time.frameCount;
        public void SetStoryOpen(bool value) { pauseGate.Story = value; ApplyPause(); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    // One low-resolution world-space light field. Sixteen actors do not require sixteen
    // full-screen lights or a camera per actor. Combat telegraphs and UI are never masked.
    public sealed class SharedLightField : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public const int Capacity = 16;
        public const float HeroRadius = 6.4f;
        private ArenaController owner;
        private readonly Vector4[] lights = new Vector4[Capacity];
        private readonly Vector4[] colors = new Vector4[Capacity];
        private RenderTexture field;
        private Material painter;
        private int count;
        public int SourceCount => count;
        public static SharedLightField Active { get; private set; }
        public void Configure(ArenaController value)
        {
            owner = value;
            var source = Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/SharedLight");
            if (source == null || source.shader == null || !source.shader.isSupported) return;
            painter = new Material(source);
            field = new RenderTexture(256, 192, 0, RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32) { name = "Shared companionship light", filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear, wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp };
            field.Create();
            Active = this;
        }
        public static float Influence(Vector2 offset, float radius)
        {
            float t = Mathf.Clamp01(1 - offset.sqrMagnitude / (radius * radius));
            return t * t;
        }
        public static Color IdentityColor(string id)
        {
            uint hash = 2166136261;
            foreach (char c in id ?? "") hash = (hash ^ c) * 16777619;
            return Color.HSVToRGB((hash % 1000) / 1000f, .26f, 1);
        }
        private void Add(Vector2 position, float radius, Color tint)
        {
            if (count >= Capacity) return;
            lights[count] = new Vector4(position.x, position.y, radius, 1);
            colors[count++] = tint;
        }
        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (owner?.Simulation == null || field == null) return;
            if (owner.PresentationPaused && count > 0) return;
            count = 0;
            Add(owner.VisualChampionPosition, HeroRadius, new Color(.68f, .91f, .87f));
            float interpolation = Mathf.Clamp01((Time.time - Time.fixedTime) / Time.fixedDeltaTime);
            foreach (var unit in owner.Simulation.Units)
                if (unit.Alive && unit.Faction == Faction.Companion)
                    Add(Vector2.Lerp(unit.PreviousPosition, unit.Position, interpolation), 3.4f, IdentityColor(unit.Definition.Id));
            Vector2 size = owner.WorldBounds + Vector2.one * 12;
            painter.SetVectorArray("_PartyLights", lights);
            painter.SetVectorArray("_PartyColors", colors);
            painter.SetInt("_PartyCount", count);
            painter.SetVector("_PartyRect", new Vector4(-size.x / 2, -size.y / 2, size.x, size.y));
            var previousTarget=RenderTexture.active;
            try {Graphics.Blit(Texture2D.blackTexture,field,painter);}
            finally {RenderTexture.active=previousTarget;}
            Shader.SetGlobalTexture("_SharedLightField", field);
            Shader.SetGlobalVector("_SharedLightRect", new Vector4(-size.x / 2, -size.y / 2, size.x, size.y));
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_SharedLightEnabled", owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen ? 0 : 1);
        }
        public float Visibility(UnitState unit, float clock)
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen || owner.Session.State.Phase != SessionPhase.Combat || owner.Session.State.Nightmare.CustomerDefeated && !owner.Session.State.Endless) return 1;
            if (unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy) return 1;
            // Fully reveal danger before contact and throughout attack windups/releases.
            float safeRange = 4.3f + unit.Definition.Radius;
            if ((unit.Position - owner.Simulation.Champion.Position).sqrMagnitude < safeRange * safeRange || unit.PendingAttack || unit.TelegraphUntil > clock || unit.ContactImpactAt > clock || clock - unit.AttackStarted < unit.Definition.Weapon.Windup + unit.Definition.Weapon.Recovery + .65f) return 1;
            float light = Mathf.Max(Strength(unit.Position), NightLanternField.Active?.Illumination(unit.Position) ?? 0);
            float depth = NightmareRules.Depth(owner.Session.State.Wave) / 4f;
            float minimum = unit.Definition.IsBoss ? .8f : PresentationSettings.HighReadability ? .62f : .16f;
            return Mathf.Lerp(1, Mathf.Lerp(minimum, 1, Mathf.SmoothStep(0, 1, light * 1.7f)), depth);
        }
        public float Strength(Vector2 position)
        {
            float value = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) value = Mathf.Max(value, Influence(position - (Vector2)lights[i], lights[i].z));
            return value;
        }
        public Color ColorAt(Vector2 position)
        {
            Color result = Color.black;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                Color tint = (Color)colors[i] * Influence(position - (Vector2)lights[i], lights[i].z);
                result.r = Mathf.Max(result.r, tint.r); result.g = Mathf.Max(result.g, tint.g); result.b = Mathf.Max(result.b, tint.b);
            }
            return result;
        }
        public float SurfaceVisibility(Vector2 position)
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen) return 1;
            if (owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop) return 1;
            var light = NightmareLighting.Active;
            if (light == null) return 1;
            return Mathf.Clamp(light.Ambient + Mathf.Max(Strength(position), NightLanternField.Active?.Illumination(position) ?? 0) * .9f + light.Spill(position).maxColorComponent * .3f, PresentationSettings.HighReadability ? .35f : .1f, 1);
        }
        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (Active == this) { Active = null; Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_SharedLightEnabled", 0); }
            if (field != null) { field.Release(); Destroy(field); }
            if (painter != null) Destroy(painter);
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void Reset() { Active = null; Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_SharedLightEnabled", 0); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class NightmareLighting : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private readonly Vector4[] sources = new Vector4[4];
        private readonly Color[] colors = new Color[4];
        private static readonly int[] LightIds = { Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamLight0"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamLight1"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamLight2"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamLight3") };
        private static readonly int[] ColorIds = { Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamColor0"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamColor1"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamColor2"), Shader.PropertyToID("_DreamColor3") };
        public static NightmareLighting Active { get; private set; }
        public float Depth { get; private set; }
        public float Dawn { get; private set; }
        public float Ambient => AmbientFor(Depth, Dawn);
        public static float AmbientFor(float depth, float dawn) => Mathf.Lerp(Mathf.Lerp(.92f, .09f, Mathf.Clamp01(depth / 4)), 1.08f, Mathf.Clamp01(dawn));
        public static float Falloff(Vector2 offset, float radius)
        {
            if (radius <= 0) return 0;
            return Mathf.Exp(-offset.sqrMagnitude * 2.7f / (radius * radius));
        }
        public static Vector2 LandmarkPosition(int index, bool shop, Vector2 half) => index switch
        {
            0 => shop ? new Vector2(6.5f, 1) : half - Vector2.one * 2,
            1 => shop ? new Vector2(-6.8f, -3.7f) : new Vector2(-half.x + 2, -half.y + 2),
            2 => shop ? new Vector2(-6.8f, .5f) : new Vector2(-half.x + 2, half.y - 2),
            3 => shop ? new Vector2(6.5f, -3.7f) : new Vector2(half.x - 2, -half.y + 2),
            4 => new Vector2(0, shop ? 1.4f : half.y - 2),
            5 => new Vector2(6.5f, -1),
            6 => new Vector2(-6, -3.8f),
            _ => new Vector2(-5.9f, -3.4f)
        };
        public void Configure(ArenaController controller) { owner = controller; Active = this; }
        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (owner == null || owner.Session == null || owner.Simulation == null) return;
            if (owner.PresentationPaused) return;
            bool shop = owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop;
            bool reduced = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion;
            bool dawn = owner.Session.State.Nightmare.CustomerDefeated && !owner.Session.State.Endless;
            float blend = reduced ? 1 : 1 - Mathf.Exp(-Time.deltaTime * .9f);
            Depth = Mathf.Lerp(Depth, NightmareRules.Depth(owner.Session.State.Wave), blend);
            Dawn = Mathf.Lerp(Dawn, dawn ? 1 : 0, blend);
            Vector2 half = owner.WorldBounds * .5f;
            Vector2 lamp = LandmarkPosition(1, shop, half) + Vector2.up * .6f;
            Vector2 window = LandmarkPosition(2, shop, half);
            Vector2 player = owner.VisualChampionPosition;
            float breath = reduced || PresentationSettings.ReducedFlashes ? 1 : 1 + Mathf.Sin(owner.PresentationClock * 1.15f) * .025f;
            float retreat = shop ? 1 : Mathf.Lerp(1, .08f, Depth / 4 * (1 - Dawn));
            sources[0] = new Vector4(lamp.x, lamp.y, 4.1f, .8f * breath * retreat);
            if (StagePerformance.Active != null && !reduced) sources[0].x += StagePerformance.Active.Impact * .12f;
            sources[1] = new Vector4(window.x, window.y, 4.6f, Mathf.Lerp(.38f, .18f, Depth / 4) * retreat);
            sources[2] = new Vector4(player.x, player.y, 3.6f, .12f);
            sources[3] = new Vector4(0, -1, 6.5f, shop ? .3f : 0);
            colors[0] = new Color(1, .6f, .23f);
            colors[1] = Color.Lerp(new Color(.75f, .83f, 1), new Color(.48f, .45f, .85f), Depth / 4);
            colors[2] = new Color(.55f, .85f, .78f);
            colors[3] = owner.Shop != null && owner.Shop.Special ? new Color(.78f, .46f, .88f) : new Color(1, .7f, .38f);
            if (!shop && StagePerformance.Active != null && StagePerformance.Active.Light.w > 0)
            {
                sources[3] = StagePerformance.Active.Light; colors[3] = StagePerformance.Active.LightColor;
            }
            if (owner.Simulation.Boss?.Definition.Id == NightmareRules.CustomerId && !dawn)
            {
                Vector2 witness = owner.Simulation.Boss.Position + Vector2.up * 2;
                sources[3] = new Vector4(witness.x, witness.y, 9, .36f * breath);
                colors[3] = new Color(.85f, .36f, .24f);
            }
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamEnabled", owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen ? 0 : 1);
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamDepth", Depth);
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamDawn", Dawn);
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamAmbient", shop ? Mathf.Max(.5f, Ambient) : PresentationSettings.HighReadability ? Mathf.Max(.24f, Ambient) : Ambient);
            Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamClock", reduced ? 0 : owner.PresentationClock);
            for (int index = 0; index < sources.Length; index++)
            {
                Shader.SetGlobalVector(LightIds[index], sources[index]);
                Shader.SetGlobalColor(ColorIds[index], colors[index]);
            }
        }
        public Color Spill(Vector2 position)
        {
            if (owner == null || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen) return Color.black;
            Color light = Color.black;
            for (int index = 0; index < sources.Length; index++)
                light += colors[index] * (Falloff(position - (Vector2)sources[index], sources[index].z) * sources[index].w);
            if (SharedLightField.Active != null) light += SharedLightField.Active.ColorAt(position) * .55f;
            return light;
        }
        public Vector2 ShadowDirection(Vector2 position)
        {
            Vector2 direction = new Vector2(.8f, -.35f) * .035f;
            for (int index = 0; index < sources.Length; index++)
            {
                if (index == 2) continue;
                Vector2 offset = position - (Vector2)sources[index];
                float strength = Falloff(offset, sources[index].z) * sources[index].w;
                if (offset.sqrMagnitude > .02f) direction += offset.normalized * strength;
            }
            return direction.sqrMagnitude > .001f ? direction.normalized : new Vector2(.8f, -.35f);
        }
        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (Active != this) return;
            Active = null; Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamEnabled", 0);
        }
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetState() { Active = null; Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_DreamEnabled", 0); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class NightmarePresence : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private SpriteRenderer halo, left, right;
        private static Sprite disc;
        private static Material glow;
        private string lightIdentity;
        private Color lightColor;
        public int VisibleCues { get; private set; }
        public static bool HasEyes(string id) => id switch
        {
            "HushMite" or "ClockBat" or "BristleImp" or "InkMoth" or "SirenSeal" or "DoorBearer" or "FurnaceToad" or "WardrobeCrab" or "ChargerRam" or "CoinLeech" or "BlastPuffer" or "BroomSkater" => true,
            _ => false
        };
        private SpriteRenderer Make(string label)
        {
            if (disc == null) disc = Sprite.Create(Texture2D.whiteTexture, new Rect(0, 0, Texture2D.whiteTexture.width, Texture2D.whiteTexture.height), Vector2.one * .5f, Texture2D.whiteTexture.width);
            if (glow == null) glow = Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/WaitingGlow");
            var child = new GameObject(label); child.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
            var view = child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>(); view.sprite = disc; view.sharedMaterial = glow;
            return view;
        }
        public void Display(UnitState unit, SpriteRenderer body, float clock, float visibility)
        {
            if (halo != null) halo.enabled = false;
            if (left != null) left.enabled = false;
            if (right != null) right.enabled = false;
            VisibleCues = 0;
            if (glow == null) glow = Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/WaitingGlow");
            if (glow == null || glow.shader == null || !glow.shader.isSupported) return;
            var field = SharedLightField.Active; var lighting = NightmareLighting.Active;
            if (field == null || lighting == null || !unit.Alive) return;
            float depth = lighting.Depth / 4 * (1 - lighting.Dawn);
            if (unit.Faction != Faction.Enemy)
            {
                halo ??= Make("CompanionOwnLight");
                halo.enabled = true;
                halo.transform.position = (Vector3)unit.Position + Vector3.up * .16f;
                halo.transform.localScale = new Vector3(2.4f, 1.1f, 1);
                // Set world size independently of animation/star parent scale.
                halo.transform.localScale = Vector3.Scale(halo.transform.localScale, new Vector3(1 / transform.lossyScale.x, 1 / transform.lossyScale.y, 1));
                if (lightIdentity != unit.Definition.Id) { lightIdentity = unit.Definition.Id; lightColor = SharedLightField.IdentityColor(lightIdentity); }
                Color tint = lightColor; tint.a = Mathf.Lerp(.035f, .15f, depth);
                halo.color = tint; halo.sortingOrder = body.sortingOrder - 3;
                return;
            }
            if (unit.Definition.IsBoss || depth < .35f || visibility > .96f) return;
            left ??= Make("RealEnemyEyeOrEmber"); right ??= Make("RealEnemySecondEye");
            bool pair = HasEyes(unit.Definition.Id);
            Bounds ink = body.bounds;
            Vector3 face = new Vector3(ink.center.x, ink.min.y + ink.size.y * .66f, 0);
            float separation = Mathf.Clamp(ink.size.x * .13f, .06f, .18f);
            float alpha = Mathf.Lerp(.32f, .85f, depth) * Mathf.Clamp01((1 - visibility) * 2);
            left.enabled = true; right.enabled = pair; VisibleCues = pair ? 2 : 1;
            left.transform.position = face + Vector3.left * (pair ? separation : 0);
            right.transform.position = face + Vector3.right * separation;
            Vector3 worldSize = pair ? new Vector3(.16f, .085f, 1) : new Vector3(.16f, .24f, 1);
            var size = Vector3.Scale(worldSize, new Vector3(1 / transform.lossyScale.x, 1 / transform.lossyScale.y, 1));
            left.transform.localScale = right.transform.localScale = size;
            left.color = right.color = pair ? new Color(1, .035f, .045f, alpha) : new Color(1, .26f, .055f, alpha);
            left.sortingOrder = right.sortingOrder = body.sortingOrder + 5;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public sealed class WaitingRealmStage : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private SpriteRenderer chair;
        private FloatingStoryProp floatingChair;
        private AudioSource song;
        private AudioClip waiting, morning;
        private int songWave = -1;
        private bool dawnPlayed;
        public bool ChairVisible => chair != null && chair.enabled;
        public void Configure(ArenaController value)
        {
            owner = value;
            var child = new GameObject("TheUnoccupiedChair"); child.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
            chair = child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>(); chair.sprite = Resources.Load<Sprite>("MienCho/EmptyChair");
            floatingChair=child.AddComponent<FloatingStoryProp>();floatingChair.Configure(chair,241);
            song = gameObject.AddComponent<AudioSource>(); song.playOnAwake = false; song.spatialBlend = 0;
            waiting = Compose(false); morning = Compose(true);
        }
        // A small authored phrase. The earlier version withholds its cadence; dawn answers it
        // with several slightly offset voices. This is synthesis, not a recorded orchestra.
        private static AudioClip Compose(bool dawn)
        {
            int[] notes = dawn ? new[] { 60, 64, 67, 69, 67, 64, 62, 60, 64, 67, 72, 71, 69, 67, 62, 60 } : new[] { 60, 63, 67, 68, 67, 63, 62, 0, 60, 63, 67, 68, 67, 63, 0, 0 };
            const int rate = 22050; const float step = .56f;
            float[] samples = new float[(int)((notes.Length * step + 1.4f) * rate)];
            for (int n = 0; n < notes.Length; n++)
            {
                if (notes[n] == 0) continue;
                double frequency = 440 * System.Math.Pow(2, (notes[n] - 69) / 12d);
                int start = (int)(n * step * rate);
                for (int i = 0; i < rate * 1.4f && start + i < samples.Length; i++)
                {
                    float t = i / (float)rate;
                    double phase = t * frequency * System.Math.PI * 2;
                    double note = System.Math.Sin(phase) * .5 + System.Math.Sin(phase * 2.003) * .16 + System.Math.Sin(phase * 3.99) * .045;
                    if (dawn) note += System.Math.Sin((t + n * .0017) * frequency * 1.003 * System.Math.PI * 2) * .11;
                    float envelope = Mathf.Min(1, t * 90) * Mathf.Exp(-t * 4.5f);
                    samples[start + i] += (float)note * envelope * .3f;
                }
            }
            var clip = AudioClip.Create(dawn ? "A Morning With Other Voices" : "The Withheld Last Verse", samples.Length, 1, rate, false); clip.SetData(samples, 0); return clip;
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null || owner.Simulation == null) return;
            var state = owner.Session.State;
            bool dawn = state.Nightmare.CustomerDefeated && !state.Endless;
            chair.enabled = chair.sprite != null && !owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen && !owner.NightmareEndingVisible && state.Phase != SessionPhase.Defeat;
            if (chair.enabled)
            {
                Vector2 position = state.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop ? new Vector2(7.4f, 3.6f) : new Vector2(0, owner.WorldBounds.y * .5f - .8f);
                chair.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * (2 / Mathf.Max(.01f, chair.sprite.bounds.size.y));
                chair.sortingOrder = WorldSpriteGrounding.SortAt(position.y);
                // The unreachable seat is a narrative landmark, never a hidden threat.
                chair.color = dawn ? new Color(1, .95f, .86f) : Color.Lerp(new Color(.85f, .78f, .69f), new Color(.24f, .22f, .3f), NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave) / 4f);
                floatingChair.Display(position,owner.PresentationClock,NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave));
            }
            else floatingChair.Display(Vector3.zero,owner.PresentationClock,0);
            if (owner.PresentationPaused) { song.Pause(); return; }
            song.UnPause();
            song.volume = PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio ? 0 : PresentationSettings.MusicVolume * .16f;
            bool restPhrase = state.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && (state.Wave == 1 || state.Wave == 8 || state.Wave == 16) && state.Wave != songWave;
            if (dawn && !dawnPlayed && state.Nightmare.EndingPage >= 2) { song.clip = morning; song.Play(); dawnPlayed = true; }
            else if (restPhrase && !owner.TransitionPending) { song.clip = waiting; song.Play(); songWave = state.Wave; }
            if (state.Phase == SessionPhase.Combat && song.isPlaying) song.Stop();
        }
        private void OnDestroy() { if (waiting != null) Destroy(waiting); if (morning != null) Destroy(morning); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public enum WaitingEncounter { None = -1, ReservedTable, BreathingPhone, LateReflection }

    // Optional, repeatable story interactions in the shop. No colliders, prices or build effects.
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-55)]
    public sealed class WaitingShopEncounter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public static readonly Vector2 Anchor = new Vector2(-3.15f, -4.65f);
        public const float Reach = 1.65f;
        private ArenaController owner;
        private SpriteRenderer prop, reflection, tear;
        private GroundShadow shadow;
        private DreamSuspension suspension;
        private readonly Sprite[] artwork = new Sprite[3];
        private Sprite tearSprite;
        private AudioSource voice;
        private AudioClip ring;
        private GUIStyle prompt, caption;
        private WaitingEncounter active = WaitingEncounter.None;
        private float entered, nextRing;
        private int rang;
        private bool wasPaused;
        public WaitingEncounter Active => active;
        public bool Visible => prop != null && prop.enabled;
        public bool Near { get; private set; }
        public float AnimationClock { get; private set; }
        public int RingCount => rang;
        public int ReflectionUnitId { get; private set; }
        private bool Allowed => owner?.Session != null && owner.Session.State.Phase == SessionPhase.Shop && !owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen && owner.Session.State.OutsideStage != OutsideStageStatus.Reward && !owner.TransitionPending && !owner.HallExitPending && !owner.NightmareEndingVisible;
        public static WaitingEncounter ForWave(int wave) => wave switch
        {
            4 or 5 => WaitingEncounter.ReservedTable,
            6 or 7 => WaitingEncounter.BreathingPhone,
            10 or 11 => WaitingEncounter.LateReflection,
            _ => WaitingEncounter.None
        };
        public static int ChapterFor(WaitingEncounter kind) => kind switch
        {
            WaitingEncounter.ReservedTable => 1,
            WaitingEncounter.BreathingPhone => 2,
            WaitingEncounter.LateReflection => 4,
            _ => -1
        };
        public void Configure(ArenaController controller)
        {
            owner = controller;
            string[] names = { "ReservedTable", "BreathingPhone", "LateReflection" };
            for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++) artwork[i] = Resources.Load<Sprite>("MienCho/Encounters/" + names[i]);
            prop = Make("WaitingEncounterProp"); reflection = Make("WitnessInTheGlass"); tear = Make("ImpossibleTear");
            reflection.sharedMaterial = Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/MirrorWitness");
            var texture = Texture2D.whiteTexture;
            tearSprite = Sprite.Create(texture, new Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height), Vector2.one * .5f, texture.width);
            tear.sprite = tearSprite; tear.sharedMaterial = Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/WaitingGlow");
            shadow = prop.gameObject.AddComponent<GroundShadow>(); shadow.PinCastToFoot = true;
            suspension = prop.gameObject.AddComponent<DreamSuspension>();
            voice = gameObject.AddComponent<AudioSource>(); voice.playOnAwake = false; voice.spatialBlend = 0;
            ring = ComposeRing();
            Hide();
        }
        private SpriteRenderer Make(string label)
        {
            var go = new GameObject(label); go.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
            return go.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
        }
        private static AudioClip ComposeRing()
        {
            const int rate = 22050;
            var data = new float[rate];
            for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
            {
                float time = i / (float)rate;
                float gate = time < .27f || time > .4f && time < .67f ? 1 : 0;
                float envelope = gate * Mathf.Min(1, Mathf.Repeat(time, .4f) * 45) * Mathf.Exp(-Mathf.Repeat(time, .4f) * 7);
                data[i] = ((float)System.Math.Sin(time * 620 * Mathf.PI * 2) + (float)System.Math.Sin(time * 927 * Mathf.PI * 2) * .37f) * envelope * .16f;
            }
            var clip = AudioClip.Create("A Telephone With No Wire", data.Length, 1, rate, false); clip.SetData(data, 0); return clip;
        }
        private void Hide()
        {
            prop.enabled = reflection.enabled = tear.enabled = false; Near = false;
            shadow.Hide(); suspension.Hide(); voice.Stop();
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (owner?.Session == null || owner.Simulation == null) return;
            var state = owner.Session.State;
            var kind = ForWave(state.Wave);
            bool allowed = Allowed;
            if (!allowed || kind == WaitingEncounter.None) { Hide(); active = WaitingEncounter.None; return; }
            if (active != kind)
            {
                active = kind; entered = owner.PresentationClock; rang = 0; nextRing = entered + 1.5f;
                prop.sprite = artwork[(int)kind];
            }
            if (prop.sprite == null) { Hide(); return; }
            if (owner.PresentationPaused)
            {
                if (!wasPaused) voice.Pause();
                wasPaused = true; Near = false; return;
            }
            if (wasPaused) { voice.UnPause(); wasPaused = false; }
            AnimationClock = owner.PresentationClock;
            prop.enabled = true;
            float width = kind == WaitingEncounter.ReservedTable ? 3.15f : kind == WaitingEncounter.LateReflection ? 1.65f : 1.65f;
            prop.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * (width / Mathf.Max(.01f, SpriteInkMetrics.BoundsOf(prop.sprite).width));
            Vector3 hover = DreamLevitation.Offset(AnimationClock, 171 + (int)kind, NightmareRules.Depth(state.Wave), PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion, .75f);
            prop.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, DreamLevitation.Tilt(AnimationClock, 171 + (int)kind, PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion, .65f));
            WorldSpriteGrounding.Place(prop, (Vector3)Anchor + hover);
            prop.sortingOrder = WorldSpriteGrounding.SortAt(Anchor.y);
            prop.color = Color.white;
            shadow.SortingBase = prop.sortingOrder - 5;
            shadow.Display(prop.sprite, Anchor, width * .8f, hover.y, .25f);
            suspension.Display(Anchor, (Vector3)Anchor + hover, width, AnimationClock, 171 + (int)kind, prop.sortingOrder - 1, 1, true);
            Near = Vector2.Distance(owner.Simulation.Champion.Position, Anchor + Vector2.up * .35f) <= Reach;
            if (owner.Shop?.Nearby != null || owner.Shop?.Animating == true) Near = false;
            UpdateReflection(kind);
            voice.volume = PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio ? 0 : PresentationSettings.SfxVolume * .2f;
            if (kind == WaitingEncounter.BreathingPhone && Near && rang < 2 && AnimationClock >= nextRing && (state.MienCho?.EncounterMask & 2) != 2)
            {
                if (!PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio) voice.PlayOneShot(ring);
                rang++; nextRing = AnimationClock + 4;
            }
            if (Near && (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.R) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton2))) TryInspect();
        }
        private void UpdateReflection(WaitingEncounter kind)
        {
            reflection.enabled = tear.enabled = kind == WaitingEncounter.LateReflection;
            ReflectionUnitId = 0;
            if (!reflection.enabled) return;
            UnitState witness = owner.Simulation.Champion;
            foreach (var unit in owner.Simulation.Units) if (unit.Alive && unit.Faction == Faction.Companion) { witness = unit; break; }
            ReflectionUnitId = witness.Id;
            Sprite[] frames = witness.Definition.AnimationFrames;
            reflection.sprite = frames.Length > 1 ? frames[1] : witness.Definition.Body;
            Bounds mirror = prop.bounds;
            reflection.transform.position = new Vector3(mirror.center.x, mirror.min.y + mirror.size.y * .56f, 0);
            reflection.transform.rotation=prop.transform.rotation;
            float fit = Mathf.Min(mirror.size.x * .53f / reflection.sprite.bounds.size.x, mirror.size.y * .43f / reflection.sprite.bounds.size.y);
            reflection.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * fit;
            reflection.flipX = witness.Facing.x >= 0;
            reflection.color = new Color(.48f, .75f, .86f, .65f);
            reflection.sortingOrder = prop.sortingOrder + 1;
            float drop = PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion ? .44f : Mathf.Repeat((AnimationClock - entered) * .13f, 1);
            tear.transform.position = reflection.transform.position + prop.transform.rotation*new Vector3(mirror.size.x * .11f, .25f - drop * .35f, 0);
            tear.transform.rotation=prop.transform.rotation;
            tear.transform.localScale = new Vector3(.055f, .13f, 1);
            tear.color = new Color(.63f, .85f, 1, .8f); tear.sortingOrder = prop.sortingOrder + 2;
        }
        public bool TryInspect()
        {
            if (!Allowed || !Near || !Visible || owner.PresentationPaused || active == WaitingEncounter.None) return false;
            var journal = owner.GetComponent<MienChoPresentation>();
            journal.Show(ChapterFor(active));
            if (!journal.Open) return false;
            var memory = owner.Session.State.MienCho;
            int previous = memory.EncounterMask; memory.EncounterMask |= 1 << (int)active;
            if (!owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()) memory.EncounterMask = previous;
            voice.Stop(); Near = false;
            return true;
        }
        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (!Visible || !Near || owner.PresentationPaused || owner.StoryConsumesInput) return;
            Matrix4x4 previous = ArcadeTypography.BeginViewport(Camera.main.pixelRect, 1920, 1080);
            prompt ??= ArcadeTypography.Style(22, true); prompt.alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;
            caption ??= ArcadeTypography.Style(19); caption.alignment = TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;
            var panel = new Rect(1000, 820, 510, 120); ArcadeSkin.Plate(panel, ArcadeSkin.Teal);
            string title = active == WaitingEncounter.ReservedTable ? "THREE CHAIRS. TWO CUPS. A NAME YOU HAVE NOT MET." : active == WaitingEncounter.BreathingPhone ? "THE WIRE IS CUT. THE TELEPHONE STILL RINGS." : "THE REFLECTION DOES NOT FOLLOW YOU.";
            GUI.Label(new Rect(1020, 830, 470, 48), title, caption);
            if (GUI.Button(new Rect(1020, 883, 470, 45), "EXAMINE  [R / X]", prompt)) TryInspect();
            GUI.matrix = previous;
        }
        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (ring != null) Destroy(ring); if (tearSprite != null) Destroy(tearSprite);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-70)]
    public sealed class WaitingJourney : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private ArenaController owner;
        private GUIStyle title,copy,button,small;
        private bool nextAct;
        private int route;
        private Vector2 scroll;
        public bool Open {get;private set;}
        public int InputConsumedFrame {get;private set;}=-1;
        public void Configure(ArenaController value){owner=value;}
        private void Consume()=>InputConsumedFrame=Time.frameCount;
        public void Show()
        {
            if(owner?.Session==null || owner.StoryOpen || owner.PresentationPaused || owner.TransitionPending || owner.HallExitPending || owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen || owner.Session.State.Phase!=SessionPhase.Shop)return;
            nextAct=false;Open=true;Consume();owner.SetStoryOpen(true);
        }
        public void Close(){Open=false;Consume();owner.SetStoryOpen(false);}
        private void Update()
        {
            if(owner?.Session==null)return;
            if(!Application.isFocused && !RunPaths.Diagnostic)return;
            if(Open)
            {
                if(Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape)||Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton1)){Close();return;}
                if(Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.LeftArrow)||Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton4)){route=(route+5)%6;scroll=Vector2.zero;Consume();}
                if(Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.RightArrow)||Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton5)){route=(route+1)%6;scroll=Vector2.zero;Consume();}
                if(!nextAct && Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha1))Choose(1);
                if(!nextAct && Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Alpha2))Choose(2);
                float vertical=ArcadeNavigation.Pad.y;
                if(Input.GetKey(KeyCode.UpArrow))vertical=1;if(Input.GetKey(KeyCode.DownArrow))vertical=-1;
                scroll.y=Mathf.Max(0,scroll.y-vertical*Time.unscaledDeltaTime*400);return;
            }
            if(Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.K)||Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.JoystickButton3))Show();

        }
        public bool Choose(int option)
        {
            if(!Open || nextAct)return false;
            string before=JsonUtility.ToJson(owner.Session.State);
            if(!owner.Session.ChooseWaitingCompanion(route,option))return false;
            if(!owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()){owner.Session.Restore(JsonUtility.FromJson<RunSnapshot>(before));return false;}
            scroll=Vector2.zero;Consume();return true;
        }
        public bool EnterRoom()
        {
            var state=owner.Session.State;int room=WaitingCampaign.RoomFor(WaitingCampaign.Act(state),state.Wave);
            if(!Open || nextAct || room==0 || state.Endless)return false;
            WaitingCampaign.Ensure(state);state.WaitingCampaign.Room=room;
            if(!owner.SaveNightmareBoundary()){state.WaitingCampaign.Room=0;return false;}
            Close();SceneManager.LoadScene("WaitingRoom");return true;
        }
        public void Draw(Camera camera)
        {
            if(owner?.Session==null)return;
            var matrix=ArcadeTypography.BeginViewport(camera.pixelRect,1920,1080);
            title??=ArcadeTypography.Style(34,true);copy??=ArcadeTypography.Style(25);copy.wordWrap=true;
            button??=ArcadeTypography.Style(21,true);button.alignment=TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;button.wordWrap=true;
            small??=ArcadeTypography.Style(19);small.wordWrap=true;
            var state=owner.Session.State;
            if(!Open)
            {
                if(state.Phase==SessionPhase.Shop && !owner.PresentationPaused && !owner.StoryOpen && !owner.Session.SecretRoomOpen && !owner.TransitionPending)
                    if(Press(new Rect(1540,882,310,60),"PATHS & PEOPLE [K / Y]"))Show();
                GUI.matrix=matrix;return;
            }
            RunHud.Fill(new Rect(0,0,1920,1080),new Color(.018f,.023f,.045f));
            GUI.Label(new Rect(70,45,1760,65),"ACT "+(WaitingCampaign.Act(state)+1)+" / "+WaitingCampaign.Title(WaitingCampaign.Act(state)),title);
            int room=WaitingCampaign.RoomFor(WaitingCampaign.Act(state),state.Wave);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(70,130,1770,80),WaitingCampaign.Objective(state),small);
            if(room>0 && !state.Endless)
            {if(Press(new Rect(70,230,1770,70),"ENTER WALKABLE ROOM / "+WaitingCampaign.RoomName(room)))EnterRoom();}
            else GUI.Label(new Rect(80,230,1740,70),"Walkable rooms open after waves 8-9, 14-15, 16-17.",small);
            for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(Press(new Rect(70+i*295,335,280,75),owner.Content.Unit(WaitingCompanionQuests.Routes[i].Id).DisplayName)){route=i;scroll=Vector2.zero;}
            var quest=WaitingCompanionQuests.Routes[route];int stage=WaitingCompanionQuests.Next(state,route);
            RunHud.Sprite(new Rect(90,470,330,320),owner.Content.Unit(quest.Id).Body);
            GUI.Label(new Rect(80,810,350,120),quest.Title,title);
            string text=stage<0?"THEIR CHOSEN FUTURE\nThis route is complete. Their decisions remain in the room and epilogue.":"PART "+(stage+1)+" / SHOP AFTER WAVE "+WaitingCompanionQuests.Waves[stage]+"\n"+quest.Scenes[stage];
            text+=WaitingCompanionQuests.Consequences(state,quest.Id);
            float height=Mathf.Max(340,copy.CalcHeight(new GUIContent(text),1280)+20);
            scroll=GUI.BeginScrollView(new Rect(500,450,1330,340),scroll,new Rect(0,0,1290,height));GUI.Label(new Rect(0,0,1280,height),text,copy);GUI.EndScrollView();
            bool ready=stage>=0 && state.Wave>=WaitingCompanionQuests.Waves[stage] && state.Roster.Exists(x=>x.UnitId==quest.Id);
            if(ready)
            {
                if(Press(new Rect(500,815,640,95),"1 / "+quest.First[stage]))Choose(1);
                if(Press(new Rect(1170,815,640,95),"2 / "+quest.Second[stage]))Choose(2);
            }
            else GUI.Label(new Rect(500,815,1300,100),stage<0?"Their story continues through the consequences you chose. No stat reward or loyalty debt.":"Travel with this companion and reach the stated shop. You can leave now and return later; the main route never requires this quest.",small);
            if(Press(new Rect(1330,960,480,65),"RETURN TO THE SHOP [ESC / B]"))Close();
            GUI.Label(new Rect(80,980,1180,60),"Paused. LB/RB: companion / stick: scroll. Choices change scenes and futures, never recruit quotas.",small);
            GUI.matrix=matrix;
        }
        private bool Press(Rect rect,string text){ArcadeSkin.Plate(rect,ArcadeSkin.Teal);return GUI.Button(rect,text,button);}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    // Separate, walkable interludes. Saves the same run at a shop boundary; no combat rewards.
    public sealed class WaitingRoomController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private RunSession session;
        private RunStorage storage;
        private RunCatalog content;
        private Camera view;
        private SpriteRenderer traveller,backdrop,chair,window;
        private SpriteRenderer[] friends,markers;
        private FloatingStoryProp[] floatingRecords;
        private FloatingStoryProp floatingChair;
        private Vector2 chairFloor=new Vector2(-4,2.6f);
        private TextMesh[] labels;
        private Material floorMaterial;
        private AudioSource sound;
        private int room,selected=-1;
        private float clock,nextFootstep;
        private Vector2 position=new Vector2(0,-3.8f);
        private readonly Vector2[] points={new Vector2(-4,1.8f),new Vector2(0,2.8f),new Vector2(4,1.8f)};
        private GUIStyle heading,copy,button,small;
        private Vector2 scroll;
        private string error="";
        private bool paused;
        public RunSession Session=>session;
        public int Room=>room;
        public int Selection=>selected;
        public Vector2 Position=>position;
        public bool Paused=>paused;
        public float Clock=>clock;
        private bool Modal=>selected>=0 || paused;
        private void Start()
        {
            storage=new RunStorage(RunPaths.Root);content=Resources.Load<RunCatalog>("RunCatalog");session=new RunSession(content);
            var state=storage.LoadRun(session);
            if(state==null || state.WaitingCampaign?.Room<1){RunLaunch.Resume=true;SceneManager.LoadScene("RunArena");return;}
            session.Restore(state);WaitingCampaign.Ensure(session.State);room=session.State.WaitingCampaign.Room;
            PresentationSettings.Apply(storage.LoadProfile());
            view=Camera.main;if(view==null){var go=new GameObject("JourneyRoomCamera");go.tag="MainCamera";view=go.AddComponent<Camera>();}
            view.clearFlags=CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;view.orthographic=true;view.orthographicSize=6.94f;view.transform.position=new Vector3(0,0,-10);view.backgroundColor=new Color(.015f,.02f,.035f);
            if(FindAnyObjectByType<AudioListener>()==null)view.gameObject.AddComponent<AudioListener>();
            AudioListener.pause=false;AudioListener.volume=storage.LoadProfile().Volume;
            sound=gameObject.AddComponent<AudioSource>();sound.playOnAwake=false;
            backdrop=Make("A Room With An Inside Release",Resources.Load<Sprite>("MienCho/Journey/"+WaitingRooms.Art(room)+"_Painted_v1"),Vector2.zero,18.5f,-100);
            var material=Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/JourneyRoomLight");if(material!=null){floorMaterial=new Material(material);backdrop.sharedMaterial=floorMaterial;}

                floorMaterial.SetVectorArray("_RoomLights",lights);floorMaterial.SetInt("_RoomLightCount",friends.Length+1);floorMaterial.SetFloat("_RoomAmbient",PresentationSettings.HighReadability?.55f:.3f);
            }

            {
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

    // Eight drawn sprite fixtures, a Unity light/shadow field and a low-resolution fog pass.

        private readonly GroundShadow[] shadows=new GroundShadow[8];

            wind=gameObject.AddComponent<AudioSource>();wind.playOnAwake=false;wind.loop=true;wind.clip=Resources.Load<AudioClip>("MienCho/Audio/DarkWind");if(wind.clip!=null)wind.Play();breakClip=Resources.Load<AudioClip>("MienCho/Audio/LanternBreak");

        private void LateUpdate()

            bool changed=current!=wave || shop!=previousShop;
            if(wave>0 && current>wave && BrokenFor(current)>BrokenFor(wave) && !PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio && breakClip!=null)wind.PlayOneShot(breakClip,PresentationSettings.SfxVolume*.2f);
            wave=current;previousShop=shop;wind.volume=PresentationSettings.ReducedAudio?0:PresentationSettings.SfxVolume*(shop?.015f:Mathf.Lerp(.025f,.13f,NightmareRules.Depth(wave)/4f));

                bool firstFixture=modelStates[i]<0;
                if(modelStates[i]!=state)
                {
                    sprites[i].sprite=pictures[state];modelStates[i]=state;
                }
                float light=!fixtureVisible || state==2?0:state==1?.5f:1;
                if(!PresentationSettings.ReducedFlashes && state==1)light*=.94f+Mathf.Sin(Clock*.8f+i)*.025f;
                brightness[i]=firstFixture || PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion?light:Mathf.MoveTowards(brightness[i],light,Time.deltaTime*1.6f);
                Vector3 hover=DreamLevitation.Offset(Clock,211+i,NightmareRules.Depth(wave),PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion);
                Vector3 foot=(Vector3)basePosition+hover;
                Quaternion lean=Quaternion.Euler(0,0,DreamLevitation.Tilt(Clock,211+i,PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion));
                ruptures[i]=new Vector4(basePosition.x,basePosition.y,1.6f,state==2 && fixtureVisible?1:0);
                sprites[i].enabled=fixtureVisible;
                if(sprites[i].sprite!=null)
                {
                    sprites[i].transform.localScale=Vector3.one*(2.7f/sprites[i].sprite.bounds.size.y);
                    sprites[i].transform.rotation=lean;
                    sprites[i].transform.position=foot-sprites[i].transform.TransformVector(LampLocal(sprites[i].sprite,new Vector2(.40f,.025f)));
                    sprites[i].sortingOrder=WorldSpriteGrounding.SortAt(basePosition.y);

                }

                sources[i]=new Vector4(flame.x,flame.y-1.15f,5,brightness[i]*(1-dawn*.75f));
                halos[i].enabled=fixtureVisible && brightness[i]>.01f;halos[i].transform.position=new Vector3(flame.x,flame.y,0);halos[i].transform.rotation=lean;halos[i].transform.localScale=new Vector3(.9f,1.1f,1);halos[i].color=new Color(1,.52f,.16f,brightness[i]*.19f);halos[i].sortingOrder=WorldSpriteGrounding.SortAt(basePosition.y)+7;
                if(fixtureVisible)

                    shadows[i].SortingBase=order-10;shadows[i].Display(sprites[i].sprite,basePosition,.6f,hover.y,.35f);
                    suspensions[i].Display(basePosition,foot,.85f,Clock,211+i,order-1,.9f,state!=2);

            fogPainter.SetVectorArray("_FogRuptures",ruptures);fogPainter.SetVector("_FogRect",rect);fogPainter.SetFloat("_FogClock",PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion?0:Clock);

        private static void Paint(RenderTexture target,Material painter)
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    public static class DreamLevitation
    {
        public static Vector3 Offset(float time, float identity, float depth, bool reduced, float strength = 1)
        {
            float phase = identity * 2.399963f;
            float height = (.36f + Mathf.Clamp01(depth / 4) * .13f) * strength;
            if (reduced) return Vector3.up * height;
            // Different periods as well as phases avoid a roomful of synchronized pistons.
            float breath=time*Mathf.Lerp(.48f,.66f,Mathf.Repeat(identity*.618034f,1));
            return new Vector3((Mathf.Sin(time*.27f+phase)*.055f+Mathf.Sin(breath*.63f+phase*.7f)*.02f)*strength,
                height+(Mathf.Sin(breath+phase)*.08f+Mathf.Sin(time*.21f+phase*1.7f)*.02f)*strength,0);
        }
        public static float Tilt(float time, float identity, bool reduced, float strength = 1)
            => reduced ? 0 : (Mathf.Sin(identity*1.71f)*1.3f+Mathf.Sin(time*.34f+identity*2.399963f)*2.4f+Mathf.Sin(time*.16f+identity)*.65f)*strength;
    }
    // Only edge motes remain. The under-object wind, smoke and ribbons were removed.
    public sealed class DreamSuspension : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private readonly SpriteRenderer[] motes=new SpriteRenderer[2];
        private static Sprite moteSprite;
        private bool initialized;
        public void Display(Vector3 floor,Vector3 foot,float width,float time,float identity,int order,float opacity,bool warm=false)
        {
            if(!initialized)
            {
                initialized=true;
                var glow=Resources.Load<Material>("MienCho/WaitingGlow");
                if(glow!=null)
                {
                    if(moteSprite==null)moteSprite=Sprite.Create(Texture2D.whiteTexture,new Rect(0,0,Texture2D.whiteTexture.width,Texture2D.whiteTexture.height),Vector2.one*.5f,Texture2D.whiteTexture.width);
                    for(int i=0;i<motes.Length;i++){var child=new GameObject("DriftingDreamMote"+i);child.transform.SetParent(transform,false);motes[i]=child.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();motes[i].sprite=moteSprite;motes[i].sharedMaterial=glow;}
                }
            }
            Color tint=warm?new Color(.95f,.72f,.39f):new Color(.55f,.72f,.96f);
            for(int i=0;i<motes.Length;i++)
            {
                var mote=motes[i];if(mote==null)continue;
                mote.enabled=opacity>.01f && !PresentationSettings.ReducedEffects && AnimationDetailBudget.Level<2;
                if(!mote.enabled)continue;
                float age=PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion?.45f:Mathf.Repeat(time*.12f+identity*.37f+i*.5f,1);
                float clock=PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion?0:time;
                mote.transform.position=foot+new Vector3((i==0?-1:1)*Mathf.Min(width*.34f,.9f)+Mathf.Sin(clock*.4f+identity+i)*.055f,.15f+age*.55f,0);
                mote.transform.rotation=Quaternion.identity;
                float size=.045f+Mathf.Sin(age*Mathf.PI)*.035f;Vector3 scale=transform.lossyScale;
                mote.transform.localScale=new Vector3(size/Mathf.Max(.001f,Mathf.Abs(scale.x)),size/Mathf.Max(.001f,Mathf.Abs(scale.y)),1);
                mote.color=new Color(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b,Mathf.Sin(age*Mathf.PI)*opacity*.42f);mote.sortingOrder=order+1;
            }
        }
        public void Hide(){foreach(var mote in motes)if(mote!=null)mote.enabled=false;}
        private void OnDisable()=>Hide();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ArcaneBrigade
{
    // The caller owns the floor anchor and clock; interactions never follow visual drift.
    public sealed class FloatingStoryProp : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private SpriteRenderer view;
        private GroundShadow shadow;
        private DreamSuspension suspension;
        private float identity;
        public void Configure(SpriteRenderer renderer,float phase)
        {
            view=renderer;identity=phase;
            shadow=gameObject.AddComponent<GroundShadow>();shadow.PinCastToFoot=true;
            suspension=gameObject.AddComponent<DreamSuspension>();
        }
        public void Display(Vector3 floor,float clock,float depth)
        {
            if(view==null || !view.enabled || view.sprite==null){shadow.Hide();suspension.Hide();return;}
            Vector3 hover=DreamLevitation.Offset(clock,identity,depth,PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion);
            view.transform.rotation=Quaternion.Euler(0,0,DreamLevitation.Tilt(clock,identity,PresentationSettings.ReducedMotion));
            WorldSpriteGrounding.Place(view,floor+hover);
            shadow.SortingBase=view.sortingOrder-10;
            shadow.Display(view.sprite,floor,view.bounds.size.x*.75f,hover.y,.3f*view.color.a);
            suspension.Display(floor,floor+hover,view.bounds.size.x,clock,identity,view.sortingOrder-1,view.color.a);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
            return result + "\nEach companion counts once, regardless of tier.";

"Endless" : "Journey") + (parts.Length > 3 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(parts[3]) ? " · " + AchievementName("challenge-" + parts[3]) : "");

        public static string DamageSource(string source, RunCatalog catalog)
        {
            foreach (UnitDefinition enemy in catalog.Enemies)
                if (source == enemy.DisplayName || source == enemy.DisplayName + " contact") return UnitName(enemy) + (source.EndsWith(" contact") ? " · contact" : "");
            foreach (UnitDefinition boss in catalog.Bosses)
                if (source == boss.DisplayName || source == boss.DisplayName + " contact") return UnitName(boss) + (source.EndsWith(" contact") ? " · contact" : "");
            return source == "Enemy damage" ? "Enemy attack" : source;
        }

    public enum RunUIDevice { KeyboardMouse, Controller, Touch }
    public static class RunUIHints
    {
        private static int frame = -1;
        private static Vector2 previousPad;
        private static Vector3 previousMouse;
        public static RunUIDevice Device { get; private set; }
        public static void Refresh()
        {
            if (frame == Time.frameCount) return;
            frame = Time.frameCount;
            Vector2 pad = ArcadeNavigation.Pad;
            if (Input.anyKeyDown || (Input.mousePosition - previousMouse).sqrMagnitude > 4) Device = RunUIDevice.KeyboardMouse;
            bool padPressed = false;
            for (int index = 0; index < 20; index++) padPressed |= Input.GetKeyDown((KeyCode)((int)KeyCode.JoystickButton0 + index));
            if (padPressed || pad.sqrMagnitude > 0.16f && (pad - previousPad).sqrMagnitude > 0.01f) Device = RunUIDevice.Controller;
            if (Input.touchCount > 0 || Application.isMobilePlatform) Device = RunUIDevice.Touch;
            previousPad = pad; previousMouse = Input.mousePosition;
        }
        public static string Details(RunUIDevice device) => device == RunUIDevice.Controller ? "Brigade · Y / button 3" : device == RunUIDevice.Touch ? "Tap to inspect brigade" : "Brigade · I";
        public static string Pause(RunUIDevice device) => device == RunUIDevice.Controller ? "Pause / resume · Start or B" : device == RunUIDevice.Touch ? "Tap to pause / resume" : "Pause / resume · Esc";
        public static string Interact(RunUIDevice device) => device == RunUIDevice.Controller ? "USE · A" : device == RunUIDevice.Touch ? "USE" : "USE · Space";
        public static string Menu => Device == RunUIDevice.Controller ? "Stick: select · A: confirm · B: back" : Device == RunUIDevice.Touch ? "Tap to select · drag to scroll" : "Arrows / Tab: select · Enter: confirm · Esc: back";
        public static string DetailsNavigation => Device == RunUIDevice.Controller ? "LB/RB: tab · A/X: next/previous row · Y/B: close" : Device == RunUIDevice.Touch ? "Tap a tab or row · drag to scroll" : "Tab: change tab · ↑/↓: select row · I/Esc: close";
    }

    public sealed class RunBondFeedback
    {
        private string runId;
        private float lastObserved;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, float> rewards = new Dictionary<string, float>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, float> flashes = new Dictionary<string, float>();
        public void Observe(string identity, BondDefinition[] bonds, Dictionary<string, int> counts, float now)
        {
            if (now < lastObserved) flashes.Clear();
            lastObserved = now;
            bool initial = runId != identity || rewards.Count == 0;
            if (runId != identity) { rewards.Clear(); flashes.Clear(); runId = identity; }
            foreach (BondDefinition bond in bonds)
            {
                float reward = bond.Reward(counts.TryGetValue(bond.Id, out int count) ? count : 0);
                if (!initial && rewards.TryGetValue(bond.Id, out float previous) && reward > previous) flashes[bond.Id] = now + 2;
                if (rewards.TryGetValue(bond.Id, out float before) && reward < before) flashes.Remove(bond.Id);
                rewards[bond.Id] = reward;
            }
        }
        public bool Flashing(string id, float now) => flashes.TryGetValue(id, out float until) && now < until;
        public float Burst(string id, float now)
        {
            if (!flashes.TryGetValue(id, out float until)) return 0;
            float age = now - (until - 2);
            return age >= 0 && age < 0.65f ? Mathf.Sin(age * 18) * Mathf.Exp(-age * 5) : 0;
        }
    }
}
````
